original: idameva vyākhyānaṃ helā- rājīye dṛśyata iti pare | kārakatvenānvayitvamiti | kartṛtvakarmatvetarakārakatva-

original: vyāpyarūpeṇānvayitvamityarthaḥ | tena pacati bhavatītyādau kartṛtvakarmatvarūpeṇānvayi- tvasattve'pi nāsattvabhaṅga ityuktaṃ prāk | naivamiti | tathā ca dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭānti- kayorvaiṣamyād dṛṣṭāntatvaṃ nopapadyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: vyāpya rūpeṇa anvayitvam iti arthaḥ tena pacati bhavati ityādau kartṛ tva karmatva rūpeṇa anvayi tva sattve api na asattva bhaṅgaḥ iti uktam prāk na evam iti tathā ca dṛṣṭānta dārṣṭāntikayoḥ vaiṣamyāt dṛṣṭānta tvam na upapadyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: dṛṣṭāntadārṣṭāntikabhāve sarvāśe sāmyaṃ na niyāmakam, tathā iti candramukhādyorapi sa ma bhavet, api tu kicidaṃśe eva, tacca prakṛte'stītyāha tathāpīti | mānatvāditi | sādhyatvena pratīyamānārthe eva kārakānvayāt, prakṛte tathānupasthitau karmakatvānupapattau 'kartṛkarmaṇoḥ--' iti ṣaṣṭhyanupapattiriti bhāvaḥ | ṣaṣṭhīti |
analyzed: dṛṣṭānta dārṣṭāntika bhāve sarva āśe sāmyam na niyāmakam tathā iti candra mukha ādyoḥ api sa bhavet api tu kicid aṃśe eva tat ca prakṛteḥ ti iti āha tathā api iti māna tvāt iti sādhya tvena pratīyamāna arthe eva kāraka anvayāt prakṛte tathā anupasthitau karmaka tva anupapattau kartṛ karmaṇoḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī anupapattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ ṣaṣṭhī iti

original: tathā ca ghañante tathā'pratītāvapyupapadya- mānayā ṣaṣṭhyā tatkalpanā na saṃbhavatīti bhāvaḥ | nanvadhyāhṛtatiṅantopasthita- kriyādvārako yogaḥ kṛdante nāstyato na ṣaṣṭhyanupapattirityābhipretyāha-na loketi |
analyzed: tathā ca ghañ ante tathā pratītau api upapadya mānayā ṣaṣṭhyā tad kalpanā na saṃbhavati iti bhāvaḥ nanu adhyāhṛta tiṅ anta upasthita kriyā dvārakaḥ yogaḥ kṛt ante na asti atas na ṣaṣṭhī anupapattiḥ iti ābhipretya āha na loka iti

original: na ca kartṛkarmaṇoḥ--'iti vidhivaiyarthyam, na ca kriyāntaramādāyaiva ṣaṣṭhyupa- pādanīyā, sā ca na loketi niṣedhena na sambhatīti vācpaṃ, karttari kṛtiti sūtrabhāṣyaprāmāṇyāttumunādīnāmivaktino'pi sādhyāvasthāpannadhātvarthānuvādakatva- meveti--vastrasya kṛtirityādau caritārthatvāt | evamodanapāka ityādau samāso'pi na bhavet, asāmarthyāt |
analyzed: na ca kartṛ karmaṇoḥ iti vidhi vaiyarthyam na ca kriyā antaram ādāya eva ṣaṣṭhī upa pādanīyā sā ca na loka iti niṣedhena na vācpam karttari sūtra bhāṣya prāmāṇyāt tumuna ādīnām sādhya avasthā āpanna dhātvartha anuvādaka tvam eva iti vastrasya kṛtiḥ ityādau caritārtha tvāt evam odana pākaḥ ityādau samāsaḥ api na bhavet asāmarthyāt

original: 'kṛdyogā ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyate' iti vacanasya vastrakṛtirityatra caritārthyāt | na ca śeṣaṣaṣṭhyaiva vākyaṃ samāsaśceti vācyam, nalapāka ityādau nalakartatvādiprakārakabodhasyānubhavasiddhasyānāpatteḥ, 'āścartho gāvāṃ doho'gopene't.siddhyāpatteśca |
analyzed: kṛt yogā ca ṣaṣṭhī samasyate iti vacanasya vastra kṛtiḥ iti atra caritārthyāt na ca śeṣa ṣaṣṭhyā eva vākyam samāsaḥ ca iti vācyam nala pākaḥ ityādau nala karta tva ādi prakāraka bodhasya anubhava siddhasya anāpatteḥ gāvām dohaḥ gopena id siddhi āpatteḥ ca

original: 'ibhayaprāptau--'ityasyānantarasyeti nyāyena 'kartṛkarmaṇoḥ--' ityasyaiva niyāmakatayā agopapadāt śeṣaṣaṣṭhyā durvāratvādityā- dyahyamiti vadanti | nanvevaṃ sati 'kāṣṭhaiḥ pāka' ityāpadyeta, ākhyātenaiva bhāvanā sādhyatayocyate iti mīmāsakamate tasyāmiṣṭatyādityāśaṅkāmiṣṭāpattyā pari- harati-evaṃ rītyeti |
analyzed: ibhaya prāptau ityasya anantarasya iti nyāyena kartṛ karmaṇoḥ ityasya eva niyāmaka tayā a ga upapadāt śeṣaṣaṣṭhyāḥ durvāra tvāt iti vadanti nanu evam sati kāṣṭhaiḥ pākaḥ iti āpadyeta ākhyātena eva bhāvanā sādhyatayā ucyate iti mīmāsaka mate tasyām iṣṭatyāt iti āśaṅkām iṣṭāpattyā pari harati evam rītyā iti

original: tathā ca 'nanvasattvabhūtakriyāyā' ityādipūrvapakṣe iṣṭapatti- reveti tātparyam | nanvekasyaiva dhātvarthasya viruddhasādhyatvasiddhatvābhyāṃ bhānaṃ na saṃbhavatīti cenna | yathā saṃbandhibhadādekasyaivācāryatvaṃ mātulatvaṃ ca tathaikatraiva kārakaliṅgādirūpasaṃbandhibhedādubhayasaṃbhavena tayovirodhasyaivābhāvāt |
analyzed: tathā ca nanu asattva bhūta kriyāyāḥ ityādi pūrvapakṣe iṣṭa pattiḥ revā iti tātparyam nanu ekasya eva dhātvarthasya viruddha sādhyatva siddhatvābhyām bhānam na saṃbhavati iti ced na yathā saṃbandhi bhadāt ekasya eva ācārya tvam mātula tvam ca tathā ekatra eva kāraka liṅga ādi rūpa saṃbandhi bhedāt ubhaya saṃbhavena tayoḥ virodhasya eva abhāvāt

original: yathā vā 'paśya mṛgo dhāvatī'tyatraikasyaiva dhāvanasya mṛgaṃ prati sādhyatvaṃ, darśanaṃ prati sādhanatvaṃ tathaikasyaiva dhātvarthasya sādhyatvena prakāratā, siddhatvena viśeṣyatā | ekaniṣṭhatvācca na tayoḥ sphuṭaṃ graho bodhe | ata eva 'ghañvācyo bhāvaḥ pradhāna'miti granthāḥ saṃgacchante |
analyzed: yathā vā paśya mṛgaḥ dhāvati iti atra ekasya eva dhāvanasya mṛgam prati sādhya tvam darśanam prati sādhana tvam tathā ekasya eva dhātvarthasya sādhya tvena prakāra tā siddha tvena viśeṣya tā eka niṣṭha tvāt ca na tayoḥ sphuṭam grahaḥ bodhe atas eva ghañ vācyaḥ bhāvaḥ pradhānam iti granthāḥ saṃgacchante

original: 'kartari kṛt' iti sūtre bhāṣye cektaṃ 'ghañvācyo bhāvo bāhyaḥ prakṛtyarthāt' iti | ityupapadyata iti | anyathā kārakāṇāṃ
analyzed: kartari kṛt iti sūtre bhāṣye ca iktam ghañ vācyaḥ bhāvaḥ bāhyaḥ prakṛti arthāt iti iti upapadyate iti anyathā kārakāṇām

original: sādhyatvenopasthite evānvaya iti niyamādabhedenānvaye'pi sādhyatvenopasthiti- rapekṣiteti stokaṃ pāka iti nopadyeteti bhāvaḥ | vyāpārānvaye tu śobhanaḥ pāka ityeva | vyāpārasyākarmatayā tadviśeṣaṇe dvitīyāyā aprāpteḥ | phalānvaye dvitīyāṃ bādhitvā 'kartṛkarmaṇoḥ-- iti ṣaṣṭhī na | kartṛ sāhacaryeṇa dhātvarthe'bhedenānvayi- karmaṇa eva grahaṇāt |
analyzed: sādhya tvena upasthite eva anvaye iti niyamāt abhedena anvaye pi sādhya tvena upasthitiḥ rapekṣitā iti stokam pākaḥ iti na upadyeta iti bhāvaḥ vyāpāra anvaye tu śobhanaḥ pākaḥ iti eva vyāpārasya akarmatayā tad viśeṣaṇe dvitīyāyāḥ aprāpteḥ phala anvaye dvitīyām bādhitvā kartṛ karmaṇoḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī na kartṛ sāhacaryeṇa dhātvarthe bhedena anvayi karmaṇaḥ eva grahaṇāt

original: spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ 'pūjanāt pūjitam--' ityatra bhāṣye ityanyatra vistaraḥ || 14 ||
analyzed: spaṣṭam ca idam pūjanāt pūjitam iti atra bhāṣye iti anyatra vistaraḥ

original: mūle sādhyatveneti | tatra - ghañādyante | atra'pratīyata' iti śeṣaḥ | tadbodhakamāha-dhāturūpeti | dhāturūpaṃ nibandhanaṃ-nimittaṃ yasyā ityarthaḥ | pratītiniṣṭhaṃ nimittatvaṃ pratīyamāneupacaritamiti bahuvrīhau kriyāyāḥ prādhānyopa- pattiḥ | siddhabhāvaḥ - siddhatvena pratītiḥ |
analyzed: mūle sādhya tvena iti tatra ghañ ādi ante atra pratīyataḥ iti śeṣaḥ tad bodhakam āha dhātu rūpa iti dhātu rūpam nibandhanam nimittam yasyāḥ iti arthaḥ pratīti niṣṭham nimitta tvam pratīyamāne upacaritam iti bahuvrīhau kriyāyāḥ prādhānya upa pattiḥ siddha bhāvaḥ siddha tvena pratītiḥ

original: 'parvatāḥ santī'tyādiprayogānupapattiḥ, tatrātmadhāraṇānukūlavyāpārasya nityatayā- sādhyatvābhāvāt kriyātvābhāvāt, taddharmasya prārabdhāparisamāptatvarūpavaptamānatvā- bhāvadityāśaṅgāṃ nirācaṣṭe ātmetyādinā |
analyzed: parvatāḥ santi ityādi prayoga anupapattiḥ tatra ātma dhāraṇa anukūla vyāpārasya nitya tayā sādhya tva abhāvāt kriyā tva abhāvāt tad dharmasya prārabdha aparisamāpta tva rūpa vaptamāna tvā bhāvat iti āśaṅgām nirācaṣṭe ātma ityādinā

original: tadviśiṣṭasya - tādṛśajakriyāviśiṣṭasyātmādikartṛkoktavyāpārasyetyarthaḥ | utpattyādikamityatra ādipadāt samāptestattatkālabhedasya ca parigraha | tathā cātmādikartṛkoktavyāpārasya nityatayotpattyādivirahe'pi tattatkālikarājakriyā- viśiṣṭasya tasyotpattyādimattayā niruktavartamānatvaṃ sūpapadamiti bhavāḥ |
analyzed: tad viśiṣṭasya tādṛśa ja kriyā viśiṣṭasya ātma ādi kartṛka ukta vyāpārasya iti arthaḥ utpatti ādikam iti atra ādi padāt samāpteḥ tat tad kāla bhedasya ca parigraha tathā ca ātma ādi kartṛka ukta vyāpārasya nitya tayā utpatti ādi virahe pi tad tad kālika rāja kriyā viśiṣṭasya tasya utpatti ādimat tayā nirukta vartamāna tvam sūpapadam iti bhavāḥ

original: tatra 'vartamāne laṭ' sūtrasthabhāṣyaṃ pramāṇayati uktaṃ ca bhāṣye iti | tiṣṭhateradhikaraṇamiti | tatra kaiyaṭopādhyāyo'pītthaṃ vyācaṣṭa 'tatra śajñāṃ sthiti- rbhūtādibhedena bhinnā parvatādisthityāderbhediketi kriyārūpatvaṃ kālatrayayogaścopa- padyate' iti |
analyzed: tatra vartamāne sūtra stha bhāṣyam pramāṇayati uktam ca bhāṣye iti tiṣṭhateḥ adhikaraṇam iti tatra kaiyaṭa upādhyāyaḥ api ittham vyācaṣṭa tatra sthitiḥ bhūta ādi bhedena bhinnā parvata ādi sthiti ādeḥ bhedikā iti kriyā rūpa tvam kāla traya yogaḥ ca upa padyate iti

original: anyathā parvatādisthitīnāṃ sadṛśāvayavatvāt pūrvāparībhūtāvayavaka- samūhatvarūpakriyātvānupapattiḥ, evaṃ tāsāṃ durabadhārabhedatayā kālabhedānupapattiśca syāditi bhāvaḥ | kriyāyāḥ kālarūpatve, kriyāḥ tiṣṭhateradhikaraṇan - kālikasaṃbandhenādhikaraṇamityarthakatayā yathāśrutameva sādhu |
analyzed: anyathā parvata ādi sthitīnām sadṛśa avayava tvāt evam tāsām kāla bheda anupapattiḥ ca syāt iti bhāvaḥ kriyāyāḥ kāla rūpa tve kriyāḥ kālika saṃbandhena adhikaraṇam iti arthaka tayā yathāśrutam eva sādhu

original: 'prakṛtipariṇāmabhūto- 'tibhaṅguro'vibhuḥkṣaṇarataddhārātmaka eva kāla' iti mate tu kriyāpadasya tatparicchedakakālaparatvena tadīyakālasya parvatādisthitāvātmasattāyāṃ cādheyatāsaṃbandhenāropa ityāśayakaṃ bodhyam | parato sidyata iti | sarva - ātmāsattādikaṃ sarva, parato sidyate -parata eva sidyate, bhedasādhakaṃ svātiriktameva |
analyzed: eva kālaḥ iti mate tu kriyā padasya tad paricchedaka kāla paratvena tadīya kālasya parvata ādi sthitau ātma sattāyām ca ādheyatā saṃbandhena āropaḥ iti āśayakam bodhyam sidyate iti sarve ātma asattā ādikam sarve paratas sidyate paratas eva sidyate bheda sādhakam sva atiriktam eva

original: ātmā tu - svasvarūpaṃ tu, na vikalpate - svato bhedakaṃ bhavati | pararūpeṇa bhidyata ityasyokta evārtho helārājīye spaṣṭaḥ |
analyzed: ātmā tu sva svarūpam tu na vikalpate svatas bhedakam bhavati para rūpeṇa bhidyate iti asya uktaḥ eva arthaḥ helārājīye spaṣṭaḥ

original: tama āsīditi | tamo'jñānaṃ tasya sarvadā sattvena bhūtakālārthakapratyayaprayogo'pītthameva nirvahati | evameva 'pihitamajñānenāvṛtamāsī' dityādāvapi bodhyam | vartamānatvādīti | vartamānakālādītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tamaḥ āsīt iti tamaḥ jñānam tasya sarvadā sattvena bhūta kāla arthaka pratyaya prayogaḥ upi ittham eva nirvahati evam eva pihitam ajñānena āvṛtam āsīt ityādau api bodhyam vartamāna tva ādi iti vartamāna kāla ādi iti arthaḥ

original: nanu laḍāderdyotakatvaṃ śattayudbodhakatvarūpaṃ vācyaṃ, tacca dhātorvartamānatvādau śakti vinā na saṃbhavati, evaṃ ca bahūnāṃ dhātūnāṃ tatra śaktikalpanāyāṃ gauravādalpatarapratyayānā- meva vācakatvameva syānna tu dyotakatvamityata āha kriyāsāmānyeti | vācakasyetyanantaraṃ 'dhāto'riti śeṣaḥ |
analyzed: nanu laṭ ādeḥ dyotaka tvam vācyam tat ca dhātoḥ vartamānatva ādau śakti vinā na saṃbhavati evam ca bahūnām dhātūnām tatra śakti kalpanāyām gauravāt alpatara pratyayānām eva vācaka tvam eva syāt na tu dyotaka tvam iti atas āha kriyā sāmānya iti vācakasya iti anantaram dhātoḥ iti śeṣaḥ

original: tadviśiṣṭe iti | vartamānatvādiviśiṣṭakriyāyāmityarthaḥ | tātparyagrahakatveneti | viśiṣṭalakṣaṇāyāṃ tātparyagrahakatvameva prakṛte dyotakatvamiti
analyzed: tad viśiṣṭe iti vartamāna tva ādi viśiṣṭa kriyāyām iti arthaḥ tātparya grahaka tvena iti viśiṣṭa lakṣaṇāyām tātparya grahaka tvam eva prakṛte dyotaka tvam iti

original: bhāvaḥ | lakṣaṇāsvīkārācca na śaktikalpanāprayuktaṃ gauravaṃ, vṛttidvayenaikaśabdajanya- bodhānabhyupagamādviśiṣṭalakṣaṇānusaraṇaṃ, 'gaṅgāyāṃ mīnaghoṣau sta' iti vākya- ghaṭakagaṅgāpadācchaktilakṣaṇābhyāmupasthitapravāhatīrayorbodhānubhavādvṛttidvayavirodhe mānābhāva' iti matābhyupagame tu vartamānatvādāveva latraṇeti bodhyam |
analyzed: bhāvaḥ lakṣaṇā svīkārāt ca na śakti kalpanā prayuktam gauravam vṛtti dvayena eka śabda janya bodha anabhyupagamāt viśiṣṭa lakṣaṇa anusaraṇam gaṅgāyām mīna ghoṣau staḥ iti vākya ghaṭaka gaṅgā padāt śakti lakṣaṇābhyām upasthita pravāha tīrayoḥ bodha anubhavāt vṛtti dvaya virodhe māna abhāvaḥ iti mata abhyupagame tu vartamāna tva ādau eva latraṇā iti bodhyam

original: laḍādervartamānatvādivāvakatvapakṣe tu kartrāderlaḍādivācyatvaṃ na syāt, viśeṣeṇa sāmānyabādhāt, tathā ca 'caitramaitrau pacata' ityādau karturabhānāt tadgatadvitvādyapratītau dvivacanabahucanānāpattiḥ, śabādyanupapattiḥ, tṛtīyāpattiśca caitrādipadāt syāt, karturamabhidhānāt, ato dyotakatāpakṣa eva yuktaḥ |
analyzed: laṭ ādeḥ vartamānatva ādi vāvaka tva pakṣe tu kartṛ ādeḥ laṭ ādi vācyatvam na syāt viśeṣeṇa sāmānya bādhāt tathā ca caitra maitrau pacate ityādau kartuḥ abhānāt tad gata dvi tva ādi apratītau dvivacana bahucana anāpattiḥ śap ādi anupapattiḥ tṛtīya āpattiḥ ca caitra ādi padāt syāt kartuḥ am abhidhānāt atas dyotaka tā pakṣaḥ eva yuktaḥ

original: yadyapi niravakāśatvamevaṃ sati kartrādīnāṃ syāt, loḍādisthale'pi vidhyādyarthairbādhāt, kiṃ ca takrakauṇḍinyanyāsya vidheyaviṣayatayā'rthasya samarthasūtrasthabhāṣyaprāmāṇyadavidheya- tayā bādhaprasaktireva na, spṭaṃ cedaṃ 'nityaṃ kauṭilye gatau' ityādi sūtre bhāṣyapradipoddyotādāviti sa pakṣe'pi sūpapadastathāpi vācakatāpakṣe pratyayārthatayā
analyzed: yadi api niravakāśa tvam evam sati kartṛ ādīnām syāt loḍa ādi sthale api vidhi ādi arthaiḥ bādhāt kim ca takrakauṇḍinya nyāsya vidheya viṣaya tayā arthasya bādha prasaktiḥ eva na spṭam ca idam nityam kauṭilye gatau ityādi sūtre bhāṣya pradipa uddyota ādau iti sa pakṣe api su upapadaḥ tathā api vācaka tā pakṣe pratyaya artha tayā

original: prādhānyāpattiḥ, tadartha 'prakṛtipratyayayo'riti niyamasaṃkocaḥ kalpanīyaḥ, dyotakatāpakṣe tu 'hetumati ca' iti sūtrabhāṣyaprāmāṇyena dyotyārthasya viśeṣaṇatvaniyamasiddhau, pratyayavācyaviṣayasya 'prakṛtipratyayayo'rityasyāvatāra evātra neti na saṃkocakalpanāprasaktiḥ, spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ 'mañjūṣādā'vityayaṃ pakṣa eva sādhīyāniti bodhyam |
analyzed: prādhānya āpattiḥ tad artha prakṛti pratyayayoḥ iti niyama saṃkocaḥ kalpanīyaḥ dyotaka tā pakṣe tu hetumati ca iti sūtra bhāṣya prāmāṇyena dyotya arthasya viśeṣaṇa tva niyama siddhau pratyaya vācya viṣayasya prakṛti pratyayayoḥ iti asya avatāraḥ eva atra na iti na saṃkoca kalpanā prasaktiḥ spaṣṭam ca idam mañjūṣā ādau iti ayam pakṣaḥ eva sādhīyān iti bodhyam

original: ata evātrāpyagre 'ityapi' pakṣāntara'miti 'api' padaghaṭitamasvarasasūcakamuktam | tadrūpam - vartamānatvādirūpam | laḍādivācya- miti |
analyzed: atas eva atra api agre iti api pakṣa antaram iti api pada ghaṭitam asvarasa sūcakam uktam tad rūpam vartamāna tva ādi rūpam laṭ ādi vācyam miti

original: vācakatāvacchedakaṃ laṭtvaliṭtvādikaṃ, tadapi laḍādeśe tibādāvanubhavasiddhameva, tacca tatrāropitam, ata eva 'yajete'tyatrāstyaṃśadvayam, ākhyātatvaṃ, liṅtvaṃ ca, tatra liṅtvena śābdī bhāvanābhidhīyata"iti māmāṃsakagranthaḥ saṃgacchate |
analyzed: vācaka tā avacchedakam laṭ tva liṭ tva ādikam tat api laṭ ādeśe tip ādau anubhava siddham eva tat ca tatra āropitam atas eva yajeta iti atra asti aṃśa dvayam ākhyāta tvam liṅ tvam ca tatra liṅ tvena śābdī bhāvanā abhidhīyate iti māmāṃsaka granthaḥ saṃgacchate

original: anye tu tibādikameva tathā, laṭtvādijñānavidhurasyāpi śābdabodhotpatteḥ, tattadānupūrvīviroṣasya tadbodhe tātparyagrāhakatvācca na 'pakṣyatī'tyādau 'vartamānatvādibodhāpattirityāhuḥ |
analyzed: anye tu tip ādikam eva tathā laṭ tva ādi jñāna vidhurasya api śābda bodha utpatteḥ tad tad ānupūrvī viroṣasya tad bodhe tātparya grāhaka tvāt ca na pakṣyati ityādau vartamāna tva ādi bodha āpattiḥ iti āhuḥ

original: anadyatane bhūte iti . adya bhavo'dyatanastadbhinnakālavṛttiḥ parokṣā yā kriyā tadarthakāddhātorliḍiti sūtrārthaḥ | evameva 'anadyatane luṭ' ityādau vyākhyānaṃ bodhyam, evaṃ caitanmate tadarthabodhako liḍityarthaḥ, pakṣāntare tu tadvācaka ityarthaḥ | krameṇa 'anadyatana' ityādiviśeṣaṇaprayojanamāha tenetyādinā |
analyzed: anadyatane bhūte iti adya bhava udyatanaḥ tad bhinna kāla vṛttiḥ parokṣā yā kriyā tad arthakāt dhātoḥ liṭ iti sūtra arthaḥ evam eva anadyatane luṭ ityādau vyākhyānam bodhyam evam ca etad mate tad artha bodhakaḥ liṭ iti arthaḥ pakṣa antare tu tad vācakaḥ iti arthaḥ krameṇa anadyatanaḥ ityādi viśeṣaṇa prayojanam āha tena ityādinā

original: tena anadyatana ityādiviśeṣaṇopādānena | 'adyatane bhūte' ityādisaptamyantayugalatrikasya 'na
analyzed: tena anadyatanaḥ ityādi viśeṣaṇa upādānena adyatane bhūte ityādi saptamī anta yugala trikasya na

original: liṭprayogaḥ' ityanenānvayaḥ | etāddaśaviṣayateti | etādṛśabdābhilapyamānaviṣaya- tetyarthaḥ, jñāne vaktṛvṛttitvaṃ niveśyaṃ, tenānyavṛttitādṛśajñānaviṣayatve'pi 'ayaṃ papāce'tyādiprayogasya nānupapattiḥ | avyāvartakamiti |
analyzed: liṭ prayogaḥ iti anena anvayaḥ etāddaśa viṣaya tā iti etādṛś śabda abhilapyamāna viṣaya tā iti arthaḥ jñāne vaktṛ vṛtti tvam niveśyam tena anya vṛtti tādṛśa jñāna viṣaya tve pi ayam papāca ityādi prayogasya na anupapattiḥ avyāvartakam iti

original: kasyāścit kriyāyāḥ pratyakṣaviṣayatve tathāvidhābhiprāyeṇa tādṛśaprayogavyāvartanāya 'parokṣe' iti sārthakaṃ bhavet, kriyāmātrasya pārokṣye tu tannirarthakamityāśaṅkate ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: kasyāścid kriyāyāḥ pratyakṣa viṣaya tve tathāvidha abhiprāyeṇa tādṛśa prayoga vyāvartanāya parokṣe iti sārthakam bhavet kriyā mātrasya pārokṣye tu tat nirarthakam iti āśaṅkate iti arthaḥ

original: 'apariddaṣṭe'ti pāṭhamāśritya, pūrvāparībhūtā avayavā yasyāḥ, ata eva piṇaḍībhūtā nidarśayituṃ na śakyā, pūrvāparībhūtāvayavakatvena piṇḍībhāvasyaivābhāvāditi bhāṣyasya vyākhyānamanusṛtya samādhatte piṇḍībhūtāyā iti | avayavaśaḥ - ekaikasyāvayavasyetyarthaḥ, saṃkhyaikavacanācca' iti śas | pratyakṣatvasaṃbhavāditi |
analyzed: apariddaṣṭā iti pāṭham āśritya pūrvāparībhūtāḥ avayavāḥ yasyāḥ atas eva piṇaḍībhūtā nidarśayitum na śakyā pūrvāparībhūta avayavaka tvena piṇḍībhāvasya eva abhāvāt iti bhāṣyasya vyākhyānam anusṛtya samādhatte piṇḍībhūtāyāḥ iti avayavaśas ekaikasya avayavasya iti arthaḥ saṃkhyā ekavacanāt ca iti pratyakṣa tva saṃbhavāt iti

original: tathā ca kriyāvayavānāṃ vaktraparokṣatvadaśāyāṃ liṭprayogasya sādhutvavyāvartanāya tadāvayakameveti bhāvaḥ | avayavanāmapi parokṣatve bādhakamāha anyatheti | darśanakarmatā na syāditīti | tathā ca prāmāṇikasya tādṛśaprayogasyānupapattiriti bhāvaḥ

original: prakārāntareṇa parokṣapadaṃ sārthakayatāmanyeṣāṃ matamāha vyāpārāviṣṭānāmiti | vyāpāraviśiṣṭānāmityarthaḥ | noktadoṣa iti | vyāpārāviṣṭasādhanānāṃ vaktuḥ pratyakṣadaśāyām 'ayaṃ papāce'ti prayogavāraṇārthatayā sārthakye satyavyāvartakatvarūpo doṣo netyarthaḥ | vyāpārasya viśeṣaṇavidhayā niveśaprayojanamāha ayaṃ papāceti |
analyzed: prakāra antareṇa parokṣa padam sārthakayatām anyeṣām matam āha vyāpāra āviṣṭānām iti vyāpāra viśiṣṭānām iti arthaḥ na ukta doṣaḥ iti vyāpāra āviṣṭa sādhanānām vaktuḥ pratyakṣa daśāyām ayam papāca iti prayoga vāraṇa ārthatayā sārthakye satya vyāvartaka tva rūpaḥ doṣaḥ na iti arthaḥ vyāpārasya viśeṣaṇa vidhayā niveśa prayojanam āha ayam papāca iti

original: kartuḥ pratyakṣadaśāyāṃ tādṛśapyogānupapattiriti 'vyāpārāviśiṣṭa'niveśaḥ | vaktuḥ- pratyakṣāviṣaya kartṛkasthale 'caitraḥ papāce'tyādāveva liṭprayogaḥ syāditi bhāvaḥ | ata evedaṃśabdadhaṭitānudhāvanam |
analyzed: kartuḥ pratyakṣa daśāyām tādṛśa pyoga anupapattiḥ iti vyāpāra aviśiṣṭa niveśaḥ vaktuḥ pratyakṣa aviṣaya kartṛka sthale caitraḥ papāca ityādau eva liṭ prayogaḥ syāt iti bhāvaḥ atas eva idam śabda dhaṭita anudhāvanam

original: api vadantītyanenārucisūcanaṃ kṛtaṃ, tadbījaṃ tu kriyāyāmeva parokṣetiviśeṣaṇānvaye'pyuktarītyā sārthakatve saṃbhavati tathāvidhasādhanānvayānaucityaṃ, 'dhātoḥ' ityadhikārāt kriyāyāḥ śīghropasthiterityādikamavaseyam |
analyzed: api vadanti iti anena aruci sūcanam kṛtam tad bījam tu kriyāyām eva parokṣa iti viśeṣaṇa anvaye pi ukta rītyā sārthaka tve saṃbhavati tathāvidha sādhana anvaya anaucityam dhātoḥ iti adhikārāt kriyāyāḥ śīghra upasthiteḥ iti ādikam avaseyam

original: yāgādijanyasvargādiphale rāgautkaṭyena yāgādijanyaduḥkhe dveṣānutpādena tatra pravṛttiniṣpratyūhaiva, evaṃ ca tadabhāvādeva bhadhuviṣasaṃpṛktānnabhojane pravṛttinirvāhe tenānyathāsiddhaṃ balavadaniṣṭā- janakatvajñānaṃ na pravṛttiheturityarthaḥ |

original: nanu nāntarīyakaduḥkhādhikaduḥkhājanakatvaṃ balavadaniṣṭājanakatvaṃ, tajjñānasya hetutayā na bahṇāyāsasādhye pravṛttyanāpattistajjanyabahutaraduḥkhāsyāpi balavattvābhāvāt, na cāvaśyakadveṣābhāvena tasyānyathāsiddhiriti vācyam, svatantrānvayavyatirekaśālitayoktajñānasya hetutvāvaśyakatvāt |

original: dveṣābhāvadaśāyāṃ tathāvidhajñānaṃ vinā pravṛttyāpatteścetyā- śaṅkya vbhicārānna hetutvaṃ tasyetyāha āstiketyādinā | āstikatvotkīrtanaṃ parakīyasundarīgamane narakasādhanatājñānasattvāvaśyakatvasūcanāya, tena tathāvidhajñānavidhuranāstikasya parakīyakāminīpravṛttau na vyabhicārastasya balavadaniṣṭājanakatvajñānasyāpi saṃbhavāditi śaṅkāvyudāsaḥ |

original: 'daśāyā'mityantena tadabhāvadaśāyāṃ pravṛttau narakājanakatvajñānasya bhramarūpasya saṃbhavena tasya vbhicārābhāve'pi na kṣatiriti sūcitam | vyabhicārā - vyatirekavyabhicārāt | tathā ca niyatānvayavtirekāvasiddhau, kkācitkānvaya- vyatirekau tvakicitkarau, tādṛśajñānaṃ vinā dveṣābhāvadaśāyāṃ pravṛttāviṣṭāpattiśceti bhāvaḥ | upasaṃharati tasmāditi |

original: karmasaṃjñayā bādhenāpādānasaṃjñāyā virahāt pañcamyāḥ sādhutvābhāve'pyapādānasaṃjñābhrameṇa tatra tādṛśaprayogādavadhyanvayabodhāpattirityā- śaṅkāṃ pariharati-bhramādityadinā | buddheḥ - upasthiteḥ | hetutvaṃ vācyamiti | na caivaṃ tyajipatyoḥ paryāyatvabhramadaśāyāmapi tathāvidhaprayogādapādānatvabodhānupa- pattiriti vācyam |
analyzed: karma saṃjñayā bādhena apādāna saṃjñāyāḥ virahāt pañcamyāḥ sādhu tva abhāve pi apādāna saṃjñā bhrameṇa tatra tādṛśa prayogāt avadhi anvaya bodha āpattiḥ iti ā śaṅkām pariharati bhramāt iti adinā buddheḥ upasthiteḥ hetutvam vācyam iti na ca evam tyaji patyoḥ paryāya tva bhrama daśāyām api tathāvidha prayogāt apādāna tva bodha anupapattiḥ iti vācyam

original: iṣṭāpatterityāśayāt, patyādiparyāyatvenāgṛhītatyajyādya- janyopasthititvena hetutvamityatra vā prakṛtagranthatātparya kalpyaṃ, tena noktadoṣaḥ | vibhāgānavacchinnavyāpāropasthitehetutvaṃ kalpayitvā bodhavāraṇaṃ tu na samyak, gatijanyasaṃyogārthakapatiyoge tadvodhānāpatteriti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: iṣṭa āpatteḥ iti āśayāt pati ādi paryāya tvena agṛhīta tyajya ādya janya upasthiti tvena hetutvam iti atra vā prakṛta grantha tātparya kalpyam tena na ukta doṣaḥ vibhāga anavacchinna vyāpāra upasthita ihetutvam kalpayitvā bodha vāraṇam tu na samyak gati janya saṃyoga arthaka patiyoge tad vodha anāpatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: atra yadi bodhābhāvo'nubhavasiddha ityatra 'yadi' padena tādṛśabodha iṣṭa eveti sūcitam | nanu 'balāhakādvidyotata' ityatrāpādānatvānupapattiḥ, gateranupasthitestasyā evāpāyatvādata āha valāhakāditi | niḥsṛtyeti | adhyeti | atrādhyāhārastatpūrvakavidyotane dhātūrvṛttiḥ, vakṣayati caitadanupadaṃ grandhakāro'pi |
analyzed: atra yadi bodha abhāvaḥ anubhava siddhaḥ iti atra yadi padena tādṛśa bodhaḥ iṣṭaḥ eva iti sūcitam nanu balāhakāt vidyotate iti atra apādāna tva anupapattiḥ gateḥ anupasthiteḥ tasyāḥ eva apāya tvāt atas āha valāhakāt iti niḥsṛtya iti adhyeti atra adhyāhāraḥ tad pūrvaka vidyotane vakṣayati ca etat anupadam grandhakāraḥ api

original: balāhako nāma dhūmajyotiḥsalilamarutāṃ saṃdhātaḥ, tādṛśasamudāyātmaka- meghādavayavabhūtajyotīrūpavidyuto bhedāvivakṣaṇāttasyāvadhitvam | yadā tu tejasa ādhāratvena sa vivakṣyate tadā 'valāhake vidyotate' vidyuditi saptamī | yadā saṃghātāvayavayorabhedāvivakṣā tadā prātipadikārthamātre prathamā bhavatīti bodhyam | spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ kaiyaṭādau |
analyzed: balāhakaḥ nāma dhūma jyotiḥ salila marutām saṃdhātaḥ tādṛśa samudāya ātmaka meghāt avayava bhūta jyotī rūpa vidyutaḥ bheda avivakṣaṇāt tasya avadhi tvam yadā tu tejasaḥ ādhāra tvena sa vivakṣyate tadā valāhake vidyotate vidyut iti saptamī yadā saṃghāta avayavayoḥ abheda avivakṣā tadā prātipadika artha mātre prathamā bhavati iti bodhyam spaṣṭam ca idam kaiyaṭa ādau

original: 'rūpaṃ rasāt pṛtha'gityatra rūpe vibhāgapūrvaka- saṃyogānukūlavyāpārarūpaniḥsaraṇasya bādhādityāśaṅkāṃ nirākartumāha- rūpamiti | buddhiparikalpitamiti | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ 'dhruvamapāye ' ityatrāpāyaśabdena bhedasyāpi grahaṇaṃ 'pañcamī vibhakte' ityatra vibhaktaśabdeneva, pṛthakśabdārtho'pi bheda eva, na tu guṇāntaramuktaprayogādeva |
analyzed: rūpam rasāt pṛthak iti atra rūpe vibhāga pūrvaka saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāra rūpa niḥsaraṇasya bādhāt iti āśaṅkām nirākartum āha rūpam iti buddhi parikalpitam iti ayam bhāvaḥ dhruvam apāye iti atra apāya śabdena bhedasya api grahaṇam pañcamī vibhakte iti atra vibhakta śabdena iva pṛthak śabda arthaḥ api bhedaḥ eva na tu guṇa antara mukta prayogāt eva

original: bhādajñānaviṣayatvamapi 'bhidir vidāraṇa iti' vidāraṇaśabdena gṛhyate | ekatvenājñātasya bhedaviṣayatvena jñāne buddhividāraṇasya tatrāpi sattvāt | evaṃ ca 'ghaṭād bhinna' ityādāvivātrāpyanena sūtreṇāpādānatve 'apādāne pañcamī' iti sūtreṇa pañcamī | 'anyārāt ' iti sūtre'nyetyarthagrahaṇaṃ tu na, itaraśabdasya pṛdhagupādānāt |
analyzed: bhāda jñāna viṣaya tvam api bhidiḥ vidāraṇaḥ iti vidāraṇa śabdena gṛhyate ekatvena ajñātasya bheda viṣaya tvena jñāne buddhi vidāraṇasya tatra api sattvāt evam ca ghaṭāt bhinnaḥ ityādau iva atra api anena sūtreṇa apādāna tve apādāne pañcamī iti sūtreṇa pañcamī tu na itara śabdasya pṛdhak upādānāt

original: bhedaviṣayabuddhiviṣayatvarūpabuddhiyidāraṇa-
analyzed: bheda viṣaya buddhi viṣaya tva rūpa

original: sāpekṣatayā buddhiparikalpitatvamucyata iti | atra pṛthakaśabdasyākriyāvācitvāt kārakatvānupapattiriti na śaṅkyaṃ, bhavatītvadhyāhṛtya dhātūnāmanekārthatayā bhaidātmakapṛthagbhāvasya tadarthatvāṅgīkāreṇādoṣa iti tātparyāt |
analyzed: sāpekṣa tayā buddhi parikalpita tvam ucyate iti atra pṛthaka śabdasya akriyā vāci tvāt kārakatva anupapattiḥ iti na śaṅkyam bhavati itu adhyāhṛtya dhātūnām aneka artha tayā bhaida ātmaka pṛthagbhāvasya tad artha tva aṅgīkāreṇa adoṣaḥ iti tātparyāt

original: imaṃ kleśaṃ parihartu sūtrāntareṇāpyatra pañcamīmāha 'pṛthagvinā ' iti | pare tu apāye - gativiśeṣe sati yad dhruvamavadhibhāvo'pagamāśrate sati tadatiriktasyāvadhitvāpayogivyāpārasyānāśrayo yastadapadānamiti sūtrārthaḥ | trāsādervṛtrāt parṇamityādau vyabhicārānnāvadhitvopayogitā | prakṛte'vādhitvo- payogitve'pi tasyāvivakṣitatvānna doṣaḥ |
analyzed: imam kleśam parihartu sūtra antareṇa api atra pañcamīm āha pṛthak vinā iti pare tu apāye gati viśeṣe sati yat dhruvam avadhi bhāva upagama āśrate sati tad atiriktasya avadhi tva apayogi vyāpārasya anāśrayaḥ yaḥ tat apadānam iti sūtra arthaḥ trāsa ādeḥ vṛtrāt parṇam ityādau vyabhicārāt na avadhi tva upayogi tā prakṛtā iva ādhi tva upayogi tve api tasya avivakṣita tvāt na doṣaḥ

original: ata eva bhāṣye adhrauvyasyāvivakṣayā 'trastādaśvā'dityatra śaṅkā samāhitā | 'dhruvamapāye' ' iti tu vṛkṣasya parṇa patatītyādau vastugatyā vṛkṣasya kriyājanakatayā prāptāpādānatvavāraṇāya | tatrāpāye iti kriyājanakatvena vivakṣite ityarthatātparyamāha |
analyzed: atas eva bhāṣye adhrauvyasya avivakṣayā trastāt aśvāt iti atra śaṅkā samāhitā dhruvam apāye iti tu vṛkṣasya patati ityādau vastugatyā vṛkṣasya kriyā janakatayā prāpta apādānatva vāraṇāya tatra apāye iti kriyā janakatvena vivakṣite iti artha tātparyam āha

original: dhruvagrahaṇaṃ tvapādānasyāvadhibhāvopagama eva vyāpāro na tu kārakāntarasyevānyo vyāpāra iti jñāpanāyetyāhurityanyatra vistaro'vagantavyaḥ | tadvibhajatenardiṣṭaviṣayamiti | atra viṣayaśabde nimittabhūtagatipara ityāśayenāha-yatra sākṣāditi | uktarūpādhyāhāraṃ vinetyarthaḥ | dhātunā - gatyarthakatvena prasiddhadhātunā |
analyzed: dhruva grahaṇam tu apādānasya avadhi bhāva upagamaḥ eva vyāpāraḥ na tu kāraka antarasya iva anyaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti jñāpanāya iti āhuḥ iti anyatra vistaraḥ uvagantavyaḥ tat vibhajate nardiṣṭa viṣayam iti atra viṣaya śabde nimitta bhūta gati paraḥ iti āśayena āha yatra sākṣāt iti ukta rūpa adhyāhāram vinā iti arthaḥ dhātunā gati arthaka tvena prasiddha dhātunā

original: nirdiśyate - upasthāpyate | gatyarthakadhāturyatra nirdiśyata iti yāvat | upāttaviṣayaṃ lakṣayati-yatra dhātvantareti | dhātvantarasya - niḥsaratyāderartho dhātvantarārthaḥ, soṅgaṃ - viśeṣaṇaṃ yatretyarthaḥ | uktamartha lakṣye saṃgamayi-niḥsaraṇāṅga iti | niḥsaraṇaṃ - vibhāgaburvakaṃ gamanaṃ yatreti bahuvrīhiḥ | apekṣiteti | ākāṅakṣitetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: nirdiśyate upasthāpyate gati arthaka dhātuḥ yatra nirdiśyate iti yāvat upātta viṣayam lakṣayati yatra dhātu antara iti dhātu antarasya niḥsarati ādeḥ arthaḥ dhātu antara arthaḥ sa ūṅgam viśeṣaṇam yatra iti arthaḥ uktam artha lakṣye saṃgamayi niḥsaraṇa aṅge iti niḥsaraṇam vibhāga burvakam gamanam yatra iti bahuvrīhiḥ apekṣitā iti ākāṅakṣita ityarthaḥ

original: ākāṅakṣā cānupādāne sati bhavatītyāśayenāha-yathā kuta iti | gamyamānāpi kriyā kārakavibhaktiprayodiketi bhāvaḥ | praśnottaravākyedve api apekṣitakriye iti bodhyam || uddeśyasya caturthyarthatve mānamāha-tathā hīti | sūtrāt saṃpradānasya caturthyarthatvasiddhāvapi noddeśyasya tattvasiddhirityāśaṅkāṃ nirācaṣṭe-tacceti | tacca - saṃpradānaṃ ca |
analyzed: ākāṅakṣā ca anupādāne sati bhavati iti āśayena āha yathā kutas iti gamyamānā api kriyā kāraka vibhakti prayodikā iti bhāvaḥ api apekṣita kriye iti bodhyam uddeśyasya caturthī artha tve mānam āha tathā hi iti sūtrāt saṃpradānasya caturthī artha tva siddhau api na uddeśyasya tattva siddhiḥ iti āśaṅkām nirācaṣṭe tat ca iti tat ca saṃpradānam ca

original: 'karmaṇā yamabhipraiti sa saṃpradānam' iti sūtrāduddeśya ityanvayaḥ | saṃpradānasyoddeśyarūpatāgamakatānirvāhakaṃ viśeṣaṇamāha-karmaṇetyādinā ityarthakādityantena | karaṇabhūteneti | anena karmaṇeti sahārthe tṛtīyeti bhramam, asaṃgatā tṛtīyeti bhramaṃ ca nirākaroti |
analyzed: karmaṇā yam abhipraiti sa saṃpradānam iti sūtrāt uddeśyaḥ iti anvayaḥ saṃpradānasya uddeśya rūpa tā gamaka tā nirvāhakam viśeṣaṇam āha karmaṇā ityādinā iti arthakāt ityantena karaṇa bhūtena iti anena karmaṇā iti saha arthe tṛtīyā iti bhramam asaṃga tā tṛtīyā iti bhramam ca nirākaroti

original: karmaṇaḥ karaṇatvaṃ saṃbandhaviṣayakecchārūpabhiprāyaghaṭakasaṃbandhaghaṭakasattvādidvārā | tathā gavādi- niṣṭhasvatvādirūpaphalanirūpakatvādisaṃbandhavattayoddeśyaḥ saṃpradānamiti paryavasito'rtha
analyzed: karmaṇaḥ karaṇa tvam saṃbandha viṣayaka icchā rūpa abhiprāya ghaṭaka saṃbandha ghaṭaka sattva ādi dvārā tathā gavādi niṣṭha svatva ādi rūpa phala nirūpaka tva ādi saṃbandhavattayā uddeśyaḥ saṃpradānam iti paryavasitaḥ ūrthaḥ

original: iti bhāvaḥ | idameva - uddeśyatvameva | tatra mīmāṃsakasaṃvādamāha-taduddeśyakeccheti | tathā cecchīyaviṣayatāviśeṣa uddeśyatvamiti bhāvaḥ . ityadhikaraṇa iti | pūrvatantrai caturthādhyādvitīyacaraṇasthabhidamadhikaraṇam | niṇīṃtamiti |
analyzed: iti bhāvaḥ idam eva uddeśya tvam eva tatra mīmāṃsaka saṃvādam āha tad uddeśyaka icchā iti tathā ca icchīya viṣayatā viśeṣaḥ uddeśya tvam iti bhāvaḥ iti adhikaraṇe iti pūrva tantraiḥ caturtha adhyā dvitīya caraṇa stha bhidam adhikaraṇam

original: tatra hi dīkṣitasya daṇḍapradānaṃ vidhāya punarāmrātaṃ 'krīte some maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍaṃ prayatthatī'ti, tadetaddhākyavihitaṃ maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍapradānaṃ pratipattikarma, yato dīkṣitahastadhāraṇe kṛtārtho daṇḍaḥ pratipattyapekṣaḥ |
analyzed: tatra hi dīkṣitasya daṇḍa pradānam vidhāya punar āmrātam krīte some maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍam prayatthati iti tat etat hākya vihitam maitrāvaruṇāya daṇḍa pradānam pratipatti karma yatas dīkṣita hasta dhāraṇe kṛtārthaḥ daṇḍaḥ pratipatti apekṣaḥ

original: dvitīyayā tasya prādhānyaṃ ca ganyate, dānasyutu na, ato maitrāvaruṇahaste prakṣepo'sya kartavya iti pūrvapakṣayitvā saṃpradānacaturthyā maitrāvaruṇasya uddeśyatvalakṣaṇaprādhānyāvagamānmaitrāvaruṇārtha daṇḍapradānaṃ daṇḍasya prayojakaṃ, sthitvā praiṣānuvacane kurvatastasyālambanatayā dṛṣṭārtha eva hi daṇḍaḥ |
analyzed: dvitīyayā tasya prādhānyam ca ganyate dānasyu tu na atas maitrāvaruṇa haste prakṣepaḥ usya kartavyaḥ iti pūrvapakṣayitvā saṃpradāna caturthyā maitrāvaruṇasya uddeśya tva lakṣaṇa prādhānya avagamāt maitrāvaruṇa artha daṇḍa pradānam daṇḍasya prayojakam sthitvā praiṣa anuvacane kurvataḥ tasya ālambana tayā dṛṣṭa arthaḥ eva hi daṇḍaḥ

original: ata evāgnīṣomīyapaśuvikāre niruḍhapaśau dīkṣite satyapi maitrāvaruṇārthatvena daṇḍopādānasiddhiriti siddhāntitamatyarthaḥ | tathā ca dvitīyānirdiṣṭadaṇḍāpekṣayā caturthīnirdiṣṭamaitrāvaruṇasya prādhānyāvagamādibhimata- sidhiriti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: atas eva agnīṣomīya paśu vikāre niruḍha paśau dīkṣite sati api maitrāvaruṇa artha tvena daṇḍa upādāna siddhiḥ iti siddhāntitam ati arthaḥ tathā ca dvitīyā nirdiṣṭa daṇḍa apekṣayā caturthī nirdiṣṭa maitrāvaruṇasya prādhānya avagamāt ibhimata sidhiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: ata evājāṃ grāmaṃ nayatītyatra grāmasyājāṃ prati śeṣitvābhāvānna saṃpradānatvaṃ, grāmasaṃskārarthamajānayane tu grāme tatsattve'pi paratvāt karmasaṃjñayā bādhānna doṣa ityāhuḥ |
analyzed: atas eva ajām grāmam nayati iti atra grāmasya ajām prati śeṣi tva abhāvāt na saṃpradāna tvam grāma saṃskāra artham ajā nayane tu grāme tad sattve pi paratvāt karma saṃjñayā bādhāt na doṣaḥ iti āhuḥ

original: nanu 'sjakāya vastraṃ dadātī'ti prayogāpattistatra dādhātonirṇejanānukūlecchādirūpo vyāpārastatkarmaṇā vastreṇābhipreyamāṇatvā- drajakasyetyāśaṅakyeṣṭāpattyā pariharati rajakāyeti | tādṛśaprayogasyeṣṭatve mānamāha khaṇḍiketi | bālakopādhyāya ityarthaḥ | bhāṣyodāharaṇāditi |
analyzed: nanu sjakāya vastram dadāti iti prayoga āpattiḥ tatra vyāpāraḥ tad karmaṇā vastreṇa abhipreyamāṇa tvā drajakasya iti āśaṅakya iṣṭa āpattyā pariharati rajakāya iti tādṛśa prayogasya iṣṭatve mānam āha khaṇḍikā iti bālaka upādhyāyaḥ iti arthaḥ bhāṣya udāharaṇāt iti

original: atra dadāteḥ syogaviśeṣānukūlavyāpārārthatayā mukhyadānārthakatadyoge eva saṃpradānatvāṅgīkāre bhāṣyasyoktaprayogānupapattiḥ | capeṭā - prasṛtakaratalam |
analyzed: atra dadāteḥ syoga viśeṣa anukūla vyāpāra arthatayā mukhya dāna arthaka tad yoge eva saṃpradāna tva aṅgīkāre bhāṣyasya ukta prayoga anupapattiḥ capeṭā prasṛta kara talam

original: na ca bhāktaḥ sa prayoga iti vācyam, kriyāgrahaṇaṃ kartavyamiti vacanaṃ khaṇḍayadbhirbhāṣyakāraiḥ saṃpradānasaṃjñāyā anvarthatvāṅgīkāreṇoktaprayogasya, rajakāyetyādiprayogasya ca mukhyatvopagamāt | evaṃ 'na śūdrāya mati dadyā'dityapyata eva saṃgacchate | tatra dadātirbodhanārthaḥ, matiśabdastajjanakavedādiparaḥ |
analyzed: na ca bhāktaḥ sa prayogaḥ iti vācyam kriyā grahaṇam kartavyam iti vacanam khaṇḍayadbhiḥ bhāṣyakāraiḥ saṃpradāna saṃjñāyāḥ anvartha tva aṅgīkāreṇa ukta prayogasya rajakāya ityādi prayogasya ca mukhya tva upagamāt evam na śūdrāya mati dadyāt iti api atas eva saṃgacchate tatra dadātiḥ bodhana arthaḥ mati śabdaḥ tad janaka veda ādi paraḥ

original: 'viprāya gāṃ dadātī'tyatra viprasaṃpradānakagokarmakaṃ dānamiti bodhaḥ | saṃpradānamityasyānvarthatāṃ svīkurvatāṃ vṛttikāraṇāṃ matamāha vṛttikārāstviti | svasvatvanivṛttiparyantamiti | svasvatvanivṛttayanukūlavyāpārarthantamityartha- | idaṃ ca dānamātreṇa na parasvatvotpattirapi tu pratigraheṇetyabhipretya |
analyzed: viprāya gām dadāti iti atra vipra saṃpradānaka go karmakam dānam iti bodhaḥ saṃpradānam iti asya anvarthatām svīkurvatām vṛtti kāraṇām matam āha vṛtti kārāḥ tu iti sva svatva nivṛtti paryantam iti sva svatva nivṛttay anukūla vyāpāra iti arthaḥ idam ca dāna mātreṇa na para sva tva utpattiḥ api tu pratigraheṇa iti abhipretya

original: anyathā punaḥ svasvatvanivṛttiparamātrasvatvotpattyanukūlavyāpāraparyantamityarthaḥ | saṃsṛṣṭidhane
analyzed: anyathā punar sva svatva nivṛtti para mātra svatva utpatti anukūla vyāpāra paryantam iti arthaḥ saṃsṛṣṭi dhane

original: dadātītyatra prayogāt paramātretyuktam | svatvavati svatvāntarānutpattyā patrāpi svatvavināśo'bhyupetavyaḥ | tatra sādhāraṇasvatvotpāde'pi na paramātrasvatvo- tpattiriti nātiprasaṅgaḥ | svatvaṃ ca dānādināśyaṃ pratigrahādijanyaṃ padārthāntaram |
analyzed: dadāti iti atra prayogāt para mātra iti uktam svatvavati svatva antara anutpattyā svatva vināśaḥ abhyupetavyaḥ tatra sādhāraṇa sva tva utpāde api na para mātra sva tva utpattiḥ iti na atiprasaṅgaḥ svatvam ca dāna ādi nāśyam pratigraha ādi janyam padārtha antaram

original: vitṛbhyaḥ śrāddhaṃ dadyādityādau vitṛnirūpitasvatvabādhe'pi dānoddeśyatvasya pitṛṣvakṣatatayā saṃpradānatvānna doṣaḥ | artha varṇayanta iti | uktadānakarmaṇe- tyādyarthamityarthaḥ | āhurityasyarasasūcanam | tadbijaṃ tūktameva | idaṃ ceti | idaṃ ca - saṃpradānaṃ ca, trividham |
analyzed: vitṛbhyaḥ śrāddham dadyāt ityādau vitṛ nirūpita svatva bādhe pi dāna uddeśya tvasya pitṛṣu akṣatatayā saṃpradānatvāt na doṣaḥ artha varṇayantaḥ iti ukta dāna karmaṇe tyādi artham iti arthaḥ āhuḥ iti asya rasa sūcanam tad vijam tu uktam eva idam ca iti idam ca saṃpradānam ca trividham

original: traividhye hetumāha anirākaraṇādityādinā vākyapadīyādityantena | kartuḥkarmaṇā īpsitatamanirākaraṇāddānānirākaraṇādapratyākhyānāt preraṇānumatibhyāṃ ca dānaviṣayakapreraṇānumatibhyāṃ ca tyāgāṅgaṃ - tyāganirvāhakam, anena kārakatvamāveditaṃ tathā ca tādṛśaṃ kārakaṃ saṃpradānatāṃ labhata iti yojanā |
analyzed: traividhye hetum āha anirākaraṇāt ityādinā vākyapadīyāt iti antena kartuḥ karmaṇā īpsitatama nirākaraṇāt dāna anirākaraṇāt apratyākhyānāt preraṇa anumatibhyām ca dāna viṣayaka preraṇa anumatibhyām ca tyāga aṅgam tyāga nirvāhakam anena kāraka tvam āveditam tathā ca tādṛśam kārakam saṃpradāna tām labhate iti yojanā

original: athavā saṃpradānatāyāmevānirākāraṇādityādi trayaṃ hetutvanānveti | tathā cānirākartṛ prerakamanumantṛ ceti trividhamityarthaḥ | nātra sūrya iti | sūrye prārthanānumatyonirākaraṇaṃ tadrūpānākrāntatvabodhanāya | dvitīyādikārakaprakṛtyartha- vibhattayarthayoranvayabodhaṃ varṇayati atra sarvatreti | 'hari bhajatī'tyādiṣu | prakṛtipratyayārthayoriti |
analyzed: athavā saṃpradānatāyām eva anirākāraṇāt ityādi trayam hetutvanā anveti tathā ca anirākartṛ prerakam anumantṛ ca iti trividham iti arthaḥ na atra sūryaḥ iti sūrye prārthana anumatyoḥ nirākaraṇam tad rūpa anākrānta tva bodhanāya dvitīya ādi kāraka prakṛti artha anvaya bodham varṇayati atra sarvatra iti hari bhajati ityādiṣu prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ iti

original: prakṛtyarthasya pratyayārthe'bhedasaṃbandhena viśeṣaṇatvamityarthaḥ | na ca pratyayārthe prakṛtyarthasyābhedasaṃbandhena viśeṣaṇatvaṃ na dṛṣṭamiti vācyam | mīmāṃsakamate devatārthakataddhitādau dṛṣṭatvāt | taduktam
analyzed: prakṛti arthasya pratyaya arthe bheda saṃbandhena viśeṣaṇa tvam iti arthaḥ na ca pratyaya arthe prakṛti arthasya abheda saṃbandhena viśeṣaṇa tvam na dṛṣṭam iti vācyam mīmāṃsaka mate devatā arthaka taddhita ādau dṛṣṭa tvāt tat uktam

original: 'āmikṣāṃ devatāyaktāṃ vadatyevaiṣa taddhitaḥ |' iti |

original: tatra dvitīyārthasyāśrayatvasyādheyatāsaṃbandhena phale'nvayaḥ | kartṛtṛtīyārthattya tasya dhātṛpāttavyapāre, karaṇatṛtīyārthasya tasya vyutpattivaicitryeṇa tṛtīyopātta- vyāpāre, tasya ca janyatāsaṃbandhena dhātvarthavyāpāre tadupāttaphale ca | athavā vyāpāro na tṛtīyārthaḥ |
analyzed: tatra dvitīya arthasya āśraya tvasya ādheya tā saṃbandhena phala invayaḥ tasya karaṇa tṛtīyārthasya tasya vyutpatti vaicitryeṇa tṛtīya upātta vyāpāre tasya ca janya tā saṃbandhena dhātvartha vyāpāre tad upātta phale ca athavā vyāpāraḥ na tṛtīyā arthaḥ

original: api tvāśrayaḥ karaṇatvaśaktimān vā, tasya svavṛttivyāpārajanyatvasaṃbandhena dhātvarthe saptamyarthāśrayasya kartṛkarmadvārā tannaṣṭhavyāpāre phale ceti yathākramamiti bodhyam | pratyakṣārthakadhātusamabhivyāhāre laukikaviṣayataiva phalatāvacchedakaḥ saṃbandha iti niyamaḥ, anyathā saurabhādyapanītabhāne'pi 'saurabhaṃ paśyatī'tyādiprayogāpatteḥ .
analyzed: api tu āśrayaḥ karaṇatva śaktimān vā tasya sva vṛtti vyāpāra janya tva saṃbandhena dhātvarthe saptamī artha āśrayasya kartṛ karma dvārā tad naṣṭha vyāpāre phale ca iti yathākramam iti bodhyam pratyakṣa arthaka dhātu samabhivyāhāre laukika viṣayatā eva phala tā avacchedakaḥ saṃbandhaḥ iti niyamaḥ anyathā saurabha ādi apanīta bhāne pi saurabham paśyati ityādi prayoga āpatteḥ

original: evaṃ ca kathamatra tathāvidhaprakāratāyāḥ phalatāvacchedakatvābhyupagama iti na śaṅkyam | tādṛśaniyamasya viṣayānupahitapratyakṣārthasthale eva svīkārāt | 'grandhaṃ
analyzed: evam ca katham atra tathāvidha prakāratāyāḥ phalatā avacchedaka tva abhyupagamaḥ iti na śaṅkyam tādṛśa niyamasya viṣaya anupahita pratyakṣa artha sthale eva svīkārāt grandham

original: jighratī'tyatra dhrāṇajapratyakṣānukūlo vyāpāro dhātvarthaḥ | na tu gandhasya tadarthe'ntarbhāvaḥ | laukikaviṣayatārupaphalatāvacchedakasaṃbandhena tathāvidhapratyakṣa- rūpaphalāśrayatvād gandhasya karmatvamita bodhyam | 'puṣpaṃ jidhratī'tyatra gandhanirūpitalaukikaviṣayitāśālipratyakṣānukūlo vyāpāro dhātvarthaḥ |
analyzed: jighrati iti atra dhrāṇa ja pratyakṣa anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ dhātvarthaḥ na tu gandhasya tad arthe antarbhāvaḥ laukika viṣayatā rupa phalatā avacchedaka saṃbandhena tathāvidha pratyakṣa rūpa phala āśraya tvāt gandhasya karma tvam ita bodhyam puṣpam jidhrati iti atra gandha nirūpita laukika viṣayitā śāli pratyakṣa anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ dhātvarthaḥ

original: ādheyatvoyasāṃsagikaviṣatānirūpitaprakāratārūpaviṣayatāviśeṣātmakaphalatāvacchedakasaṃbandhena tathāvidhapratyakṣātmakaphalāśrayatayā puṣpasya karmatvam | 'tadānanaṃ mṛtsurabhi kṣitīśvara' ityatrānane gandha iti jñānīyatādṛśaprakāratāvatvamānane- 'stītyānanasya karmatvopapattiḥ |
analyzed: ādheya tva uya sāṃsagika viṣatā nirūpita prakāra tā rūpa viṣayatā viśeṣa ātmaka phalatā avacchedaka saṃbandhena tathāvidha pratyakṣa ātmaka phala āśraya tayā puṣpasya karmatvam tat ānanam mṛd surabhi kṣitīśvaraḥ iti atra ānane gandhaḥ iti jñānīya tādṛśa prakāratāvatvam ānane sti iti ānanasya karmatva upapattiḥ

original: saṃbandhaghaṭakaprakāratve gandhaniṣṭhaviśeṣyatā- nirūpitatvaṃ niveśanīyam | tenadānītanapuṣpe gandha iti pratyakṣīyapuṣye viśeṣyatānirūpitādheyatvīyasāṃsargikaviṣayatānirūpitāprakāratāyāḥ kāle samādā- yāpi noktadoṣaḥ | samavāyasaṃbandhāvacchinnatvenādheyatvasya viśeṣaṇatvāditi diktve'pi kālaṃ jidhratīti na prayogaḥ |
analyzed: saṃbandha ghaṭaka prakāra tve gandha niṣṭha viśeṣyatā nirūpita tvam niveśanīyam tena dānītana puṣpe gandhaḥ iti pratyakṣīya puṣye viśeṣyatā nirūpita ādheyatvīya sāṃsargika viṣayatā nirūpita a prakāratāyāḥ kāle na ukta doṣaḥ samavāya saṃbandha avacchinna tvena ādheyatvasya viśeṣaṇa tvāt iti diś tve pi kālam jidhrati iti na prayogaḥ

original: kāle gandha iti bhramamādaya taddoṣatādavasthyaṃ tu nāpādyam, tādṛśabhramasyāprāmāṇikatvāt | ata eva 'tejo jidhrati' 'rūpaṃ jidhrati'tyādiprayoge na kālikasaṃbandhāvacchinnādheyatvasaṃbandhena kālaprakārakapramā |
analyzed: kāle gandhaḥ iti bhramam ādaya tad doṣa tādavasthyam tu na āpādyam tādṛśa bhramasya aprāmāṇika tvāt atas eva tejaḥ jidhrati rūpam jidhrati iti ādi prayoge na kālika saṃbandha avacchinna ādheya tva saṃbandhena kāla prakāraka pramā

original: nanu dvitīyārthāśrayasyādheyatāsaṃbandhena dhātvarthaphalenānvaya- svīkāro na saṃbhavati, tasya haryādirūpanāmārthābhinnasya dhātvarthe bhedasaṃbandhenānvayasyāvyutpannatvāt | anyathā taṇḍulaḥ pacatītyatra karmatādisaṃbandhenāpi tadāpatteriti cenna | nāmārthadhātvarthayovibhattayarthamadvārīkṛtya parasparamanvayo netyeva vyutpatteḥ |
analyzed: nanu dvitīyārtha āśrayasya ādheyatā saṃbandhena dhātvartha phalena anvaya svīkāraḥ na saṃbhavati tasya hari ādi rūpa nāmārtha abhinnasya dhātvarthe bheda saṃbandhena anvayasya avyutpanna tvāt anyathā taṇḍulaḥ pacati iti atra karmatā ādi saṃbandhena api tad āpatteḥ iti ced na nāmārtha dhātvarthayoḥ vibhattayartham a dvārīkṛtya parasparam anvayaḥ na iti eva vyutpatteḥ

original: prakṛte vibhattayarthadvārā tathānvaye bādhakābhāvāt | nanu prakṛtipratyayārthayorabhedhaḥsaṃsargo na saṃbhavati, vibhaktīnāṃ dharmamātravācaka- tvādityata āha vibhaktīnāṃ dhamīṃti | dvitīyādīnāṃ karmatvādirūpadharmamātre śaktirlādhavāducitā tatra prakṛtyarthasya svarūpasaṃbandhe nādheyatayānvayaḥ |
analyzed: prakṛte vibhattayartha dvārā tathā anvaye bādhaka abhāvāt nanu prakṛti pratyaya arthayoḥ abhedhaḥ saṃsargaḥ na saṃbhavati vibhaktīnām dharma mātra vācaka tvāt iti atas āha vibhaktīnām dvitīya ādīnām karma tva ādi rūpa dharma mātre śaktiḥ lādhavāt ucitā tatra prakṛti arthasya svarūpa saṃbandhe na ādheyatayā anvayaḥ

original: tasya ca nirūpakatāsaṃbandhena dhātvarthaphalādāviti paramataṃ dūṣayati dharmamātreti | mātrapadena dharmivyavacchedaḥ | 'karmaṇi ' iti | 'karmaṇi dvitīyā' 'kartṛkaraṇayostṛtīyā' ityādisūtrasvarasabhaṅgāpatterityarthaḥ | anyathā 'karmatve dvitīyā' ityādi sūtrayetra tu 'karmaṇa' ityādi |
analyzed: tasya ca nirūpaka tā saṃbandhena dhātvartha phala ādau iti para matam dūṣayati dharma mātra iti mātra padena dharmi vyavacchedaḥ karmaṇi iti karmaṇi dvitīyā kartṛ karaṇayoḥ tṛtīyā ityādi sūtra svarasa bhaṅga āpatteḥ iti arthaḥ anyathā karma tve dvitīyā ityādi tu karmaṇaḥ ityādi

original: karmaṇivācye ityādirnārtho'pi tu karmaṇi bodhye dvitīyetyādirarthaḥ, tannirvāhaśca prakṛtyarthasya pratyayārthe'nvayād bhavati, evaṃ ca na tatsvarasabhaṅgaḥ | na cāśrayatve haryādeḥ prakṛtyarthasyānvaye'pi hariviśiṣṭamāśrayatvamityeva bodho, na tvāśrayatvavān haristatkathaṃ
analyzed: karmaṇi vācye ityādiḥ na arthaḥ api tu karmaṇi bodhye dvitīyā ityādiḥ arthaḥ tad nirvāhaḥ ca prakṛti arthasya bhavati evam ca na tad svarasa bhaṅgaḥ na ca āśraya tve hari ādeḥ prakṛti arthasya anvaye pi hari viśiṣṭam āśraya tvam iti eva bodhaḥ na tu āśraya tvavān hariḥ tat katham

original: karmabodhanirvāhakatvaṃ dvitīyāyā iti vācyam, āśrayatve prakṛtyarthaharyāderanvayabodhe harirāśraya iti bhānasabodhasaṃbhavāt |
analyzed: karma bodha nirvāhaka tvam dvitīyāyāḥ iti vācyam āśraya tve prakṛti artha hari ādeḥ anvaya bodhe hariḥ āśrayaḥ iti bhāna sa bodha saṃbhavāt

original: 'rājasakho devadatta' ityato devadatte rājamitratvaśābdabodhe rājani devadattamitratvagrahavat, karmaṇi śaktibodhaka- sūtrasyāśrayamātraśaktigrāhakatvakalpanāpi, bhavanmate'pi sūtrasvarasabhaṅgatādava- sthyācca phalasya dhātulabhyatayāśrayamātre tatkalpanamiti cenmamāpi mate lāghavāddhameṃ tatkalpanamiti tulyamityata āha dvitīyādyarthaketi |
analyzed: rāja sakhaḥ devadattaḥ iti atas devadatte rāja mitra tva śābdabodhe rājani devadatta mitra tva graha vat karmaṇi śakti bodhaka sūtrasya āśraya mātra śakti grāhaka tva kalpanā api bhavat mate pi sūtra svarasa bhaṅga tāt avasthyāt ca phalasya dhātu labhya tayā āśraya mātre tat kalpanam iti ced mama api mate lāghavāt tat kalpanam iti tulyam iti atas āha dvitīya ādi arthaka iti

original: dharmivācakateti | 'prāptodaka' ityata udakakartṛkaprāptikarmagrāma ityākārakasya samāsārthasya, grāmasya ca sāmānādhikaraṇyaviṣayakabodhasyānubhavasiddhasya nirvāhāya dvitīyāyāḥ karmaṇi śaktirāvaśyakī | anyathā dvitīyārthabahuvrīherapi karmatvabodhakatvāpattyā sāmānādhikaraṇyānupapatteḥ |
analyzed: dharmi vācaka tā iti prāpta udakaḥ iti atas udaka kartṛka prāpti karma grāmaḥ iti ākārakasya samāsa arthasya grāmasya ca sāmānādhikaraṇya viṣayaka bodhasya anubhava siddhasya nirvāhāya dvitīyāyāḥ karmaṇi śaktiḥ āvaśyakī anyathā dvitīyārtha bahuvrīheḥ api karmatva bodhaka tva āpattyā sāmānādhikaraṇya anupapatteḥ

original: dharmivācakatāyāṃ bhāṣyamapi sādhakamityāha supāṃ karmādaya iti | paramate tu etatsvarasabhaṅgāpattiśceti bhāvaḥ | na cātrāpi karmapaddaṃ karmatvaparam, anekasthale lakṣaṇāpatteḥ |
analyzed: dharmi vācakatāyām bhāṣyam api sādhakam iti āha supām karma ādayaḥ iti para mate tu etat svarasa bhaṅga āpattiḥ ca iti bhāvaḥ na ca atra api karma pad dam karmatva param aneka sthale lakṣaṇa āpatteḥ

original: nanu karmaṇītyādau karmādipade lakṣaṇāpattāvapi dvitīyādīnāṃ dharmamātravācakatvamucitaṃ lāghavāt, astu ca bahuvrīherapi dharmamātravācakatvaṃ, sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ ca lakṣaṇayopapādyam, mukhyārthe prāptodakādiprayogastu prāptodako'stītyādāvityata āha digiti | tadarthasamavetaṃ sati kṛtastaddhitasaṃjñakasyāpi tabyāderdhanivācakatvaṃ na sidhyet |
analyzed: nanu karmaṇi ityādau karma ādi pade lakṣaṇā āpattau api dvitīya ādīnām dharma mātra vācakatvam ucitam lāghavāt astu ca bahuvrīheḥ api dharma mātra vācakatvam sāmānādhikaraṇyam ca lakṣaṇayā upapādyam mukhya arthe prāpta udaka ādi prayogaḥ tu prāpta udakaḥ asti ityādau iti atas āha diś iti tad artha samavetam sati kṛtaḥ taddhita saṃjñakasya api tabi ādeḥ dhani vācakatvam na sidhyet

original: 'paktavyārataṇḍulā' ityādau taṇḍulādisāmānādhikaraṇyānubhavānurodhāttatheti cenna | uktarītyaiva tadupapatteḥ | 'paktavya'ityāditaḥ karmatvamātrabodho'nubhavaviruddha iti cet, prāptodakādāvapi tulyamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: paktavyāḥ ityādau taṇḍula ādi sāmānādhikaraṇya anubhava anurodhāt tathā iti ced na ukta rītyā eva tad upapatteḥ paktavyā etyāditaḥ karmatva mātra bodhaḥ anubhava viruddhaḥ iti ced prāpta udaka ādau api tulyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: dvitīyādīnāmāśraye'pi na śaktiḥ, phalavyāpārayordhātulabhyatvavadāśrayasyāpi prakṛtibhūtaprātipadikana labhyatvāt, api tvāśrayatvādimātre'nanyalabhyatvāt |
analyzed: dvitīya ādīnām āśraye pi na śaktiḥ phala vyāpārayoḥ dhātu labhya tva vat āśrayasya api prakṛti bhūta prātipadikana labhya tvāt api tu āśraya tva ādi mātrena anya labhya tvāt

original: dharmadharmiṇoścābhedāt karmaṇītyādinirdeśo nānupapannaḥ, ata eva dvitīyādeḥ karmatvādiśaktivācakatvimati saddhānte prāptodakādibadavrīherdharmibodhakatānirvāhaḥ, śaktibhedabhadāpannāyā eva śaktevibhakti- vācyatvāt |
analyzed: dharma dharmiṇoḥ ca abhedāt karmaṇi ityādi nirdeśaḥ na anupapannaḥ atas eva dvitīya ādeḥ karma tva ādi śakti vācaka tvimati saddhānte prāpta udaka ādi bada vrīheḥ dharmi bodhaka tā nirvāhaḥ śakti bheda bhada āpannāyāḥ eva śaktevibhakti vācya tvāt

original: tiḍkṛdādestu pacati paktā pakka ityādita evāśrayapratīteḥ 'yuṣmadyupapade samānādhikaraṇe-' iti vyavahārānurodhāccāśraye śaktiryuktetyāśayenāha-āśrayasyāpītyādinā | āśrayasyāpi prakṛtyaiva lābhānna vibhaktivācyatetyanvayaḥ | na vibhaktīti | na dvitīyādivibhaktivācyatetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tiḍkṛt ādeḥ tu pacati paktā pakkaḥ ityāditaḥ eva āśraya pratīteḥ yuṣmadi upapade samāna adhikaraṇe iti vyavahāra anurodhāt ca āśraye śaktiḥ yuktā iti āśayena āha āśrayasya api ityādinā āśrayasya api prakṛtyā eva lābhāt na vibhakti vācya tā iti anvayaḥ na vibhakti iti na dvitīya ādi vibhakti vācya tā iti arthaḥ

original: nanvāśrayatvasya vācyatve āśrayatvātvasya śakyatāvacchedakatvamupeyaṃ, tathā ca gauravaṃ, tasya tadāśrayādyatiriktāvṛttitve sati sakalatadāśrayavṛttitvarūpatvādityata āha
analyzed: nanu āśraya tvasya vācyatve āśraya tva atvasya śakyatā avacchedaka tvam upeyam tathā ca gauravam tasya tad āśraya ādi atirikta avṛtti tve sati sakala tad āśraya vṛtti tva rūpatvāt iti atas āha

original: tadeveti | āśrayatvamevetyarthaḥ | evenāśrayatātvavyāvacchedaḥ | tadvṛttestasya kathaṃ tanniṣṭhavācyatābacchedakatvamityāśaṅkyāha-tādātmyeneti | tādātmyasya vṛttyā- niyāmakatve'pi saṃbandhitvaṃ tena saṃbhavatyevetyāśrayatvasya tādātmyena svasaṃbandhitayā na svaniṣṭhavācyatāvacchedakatvānupapattiriti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tat eva iti āśraya tvam eva iti arthaḥ evena āśraya tā tva vyāvacchedaḥ tad vṛtteḥ tasya katham tad niṣṭha vācyatā abacchedakatvam iti āśaṅkya āha tādātmyena iti tādātmyasya vṛttyā niyāmaka tve api saṃbandhitvam tena saṃbhavati eva iti āśraya tvasya tādātmyena sva saṃbandhitayā na sva niṣṭha vācyatā avacchedakatva anupapattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: yajyapyāśrayatātvasyākhaṇḍo- padhitvāṅgīkāre tasyāvacchedakatve'pi na gauravaṃ, tathāpi phalāśrayatvatvādereva dvitīyādivācyatve āśrayatātvasyātīprasaktatayā tadavacchedakatvāsaṃbhavaḥ, phalāśrayatātvasyānekaphalaghaṭitatayā gauravatādavasthyam |
analyzed: yaji api āśraya tā tvasya akhaṇḍa upadhi tva aṅgīkāre tasya avacchedaka tve pi na gauravam tathā api phala āśraya tva tva ādeḥ eva dvitīya ādi vācyatve āśraya tā tvasya atī prasakta tayā tad avacchedaka tva asaṃbhavaḥ phala āśraya tā tvasya aneka phala ghaṭita tayā gaurava tādavasthyam

original: kiṃ cāśrayatātvaviśiṣṭe śaktikalpanāyāṃ dharmadharmiṇorubhayatra tatkalpanayā na pūrvakalpāpekṣayā lāghavamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: kim ca āśraya tā tva viśiṣṭe śakti kalpanāyām dharma dharmiṇoḥ ubhayatra tad kalpanayā na pūrva kalpa apekṣayā lāghavam iti bhāvaḥ

original: vyāpāro'rīti | karaṇatāghaṭakavyāpāro'pītyarthaḥ | apināśrayatvaparigrahaḥ | ṣaṇṇāmiti | ṣaṇṇāṃ kārakavibhaktīnāmityarthaḥ |
analyzed: karaṇatā ghaṭaka vyāpāraḥ iti arthaḥ apinā āśraya tva parigrahaḥ ṣaṇṇām iti ṣaṇṇām kāraka vibhaktīnām iti arthaḥ

original: kārakāṇāṃ ṣaṭatvena tatprayuktavibhaktitvenopādānāt ṣaṣṭhīrahitavibhaktīnāṃ vivakṣaṇe tāsāṃ paṭtve'pi kārakaṣaṣṭhyā asaṃrgahaḥ, tatsahitānāṃ vibhaktīnāṃ vivakṣaṇe tu tāsāṃ saptatvaprakārakavibhaktisaṃgrahāpattiśceti ṣaṇṇāmityuktirasaṃgataiveti dūṣaṇānavakāśaḥ | anena caipapadavibhaktīnāṃ saṃbandhārthakatvamiti sūcitam |
analyzed: kārakāṇām ṣaṭa tvena tad prayukta vibhakti tvena upādānāt ṣaṣṭhī rahita vibhaktīnām vivakṣaṇe tāsām paṭtve api kāraka ṣaṣṭhyāḥ asaṃrgahaḥ tad sahitānām vibhaktīnām vivakṣaṇe tu tāsām saptatva prakāraka vibhakti saṃgraha āpattiḥ ca iti ṣaṇṇām iti uktiḥ asaṃgatā eva iti dūṣaṇa anavakāśaḥ anena ca epapada vibhaktīnām saṃbandha arthaka tvam iti sūcitam

original: atha keṣucit prayogeṣu vibhattayartho nirupyate tatropapadavibhaktīnāmatrā'rthe tu viśeṣānuktestatsthale tatsaṃbandhapratīśca tadarthakatvam | tatra yāsāṃ viśeṣasaṃbandhe vidhānaṃ, yatra ca tatsaṃbandhena saṃbandhini niyatākāṅkṣā-tatra tāsāṃ viśeṣarūpeṇaiva saṃbandhārthakatvam yathā 'anurlakṣaṇe' ityādau 'antarā tvāṃ māṃ hari'rityādau ca |
analyzed: atha keṣucid prayogeṣu vibhattayarthaḥ nirupyate tatra upapada vibhaktīnām atra arthe tu viśeṣa anukteḥ tad sthale tad saṃbandha pratīḥ ca tad arthaka tvam tatra yāsām viśeṣa saṃbandhe vidhānam yatra ca tad saṃbandhena saṃbandhini niyata ākāṅkṣā tatra tāsām viśeṣa rūpeṇa eva saṃbandha arthaka tvam yathā anuḥ lakṣaṇe ityādau antarā tvām mām hariḥ ityādau ca

original: 'japamanu prāvarṣa'dityatra lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvasaṃbandho dvitīyāvācyo na dyotyaḥ, karmapravacanīyatvāt | 'karma proktavantaḥ karmapravacanīyāḥ' iti tadvayutpattipradarśanena kriyāgataviśeṣaṃ dyotitavatāṃ saṃprati nāmārthakriyayoḥ saṃbandhadyotakānāmeva tatsaṃjñāvidhānāt |
analyzed: japam anu prāvarṣat iti atra lakṣya lakṣaṇa bhāva saṃbandhaḥ dvitīyā vācyaḥ na dyotyaḥ karmapravacanīya tvāt karma proktavantaḥ karmapravacanīyāḥ iti tad vayutpatti pradarśanena kriyā gata viśeṣam dyotitavatām saṃprati nāma artha kriyayoḥ saṃbandha dyotakānām eva tad saṃjñā vidhānāt

original: yatra tu tadvādhastatra vidhānasāmarthyāt saṃjñā, yathā 'adhiparī anarthakau' ityādinādhyādīnām | spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ 'karmapravacanīyāḥ' ityatra bhāṣyādau | japamityatra vibhakterhetutṛtīyābādhakatvāddhetuvācakatvamapi, lakṣyatvaṃ ca prakṛte jñānajanyajñānaviṣayatvarūpajñāpyatvasvarūpam |
analyzed: yatra tu tad vādhaḥ tatra vidhāna sāmarthyāt saṃjñā yathā adhi parī anarthakau ityādinā adhi ādīnām spaṣṭam ca idam karmapravacanīyāḥ iti atra bhāṣya ādau japam iti atra vibhakteḥ hetu tṛtīyā bādhaka tvāt hetu vācaka tvam api lakṣya tvam ca prakṛte jñāna janya jñāna viṣaya tva rūpa jñāpya tva svarūpam

original: japasya hi kālaviśeṣādikaraṇa- katvena jñātasya svādhikaraṇakālottarakālavaiśiṣṭyena jñāpakatvam | etena japasya vṛṣṭivyāpyatvābhāvādavṛṣṭerjapajñāpyatvāsaṃbhava iti śaṅkā nirastā | nirjñātakāla- kriyāyā anirjñātakālakriyāyāḥ kālaviśeṣavaiśiṣṭyena jñāpakatvāt | ata eva 'kadā vṛṣṭa' iti praśne etasyottaratvaṃ saṃgacchate |
analyzed: japasya hi kāla viśeṣa ādi karaṇa ka tvena jñātasya sva adhikaraṇa kāla uttara kāla vaiśiṣṭyena jñāpaka tvam etena japasya vṛṣṭi vyāpya tva abhāvāt avṛṣṭeḥ japa jñāpya tva asaṃbhavaḥ iti śaṅkā nirastā nirjñāta kāla kriyāyāḥ anirjñāta kāla kriyāyāḥ kāla viśeṣa vaiśiṣṭyena jñāpaka tvāt atas eva kadā vṛṣṭaḥ iti praśne etasya uttara tvam saṃgacchate

original: kālaviśeṣavaiśiṣṭyajñānaṃ ca tadvākyajanyaṃ, mānāntarajanyaṃ vetyanyadetat | japābhinnahetujñānajanyajñānaviṣayo varṣaṇamiti bodhaḥ | uktaṃ ca hariṇā
analyzed: kāla viśeṣa vaiśiṣṭya jñānam ca tad vākya janyam māna antara janyam vā iti anyat etat japa abhinna hetu jñāna janya jñāna viṣayaḥ varṣaṇam iti bodhaḥ uktam ca hariṇā

original: 'kriyāyā dyotako nāyaṃ, saṃbandhasya na vācakaḥ |
analyzed: kriyāyāḥ dyotakaḥ na ayam saṃbandhasya na vācakaḥ

original: nāpi kriyāpadākṣepī, saṃbandhasya tu bhedakaḥ ||' iti |
analyzed: nā api kriyā pada ākṣepī saṃbandhasya tu bhedakaḥ iti

original: tadarthastu 'prajayatī'tyādāvupasargavanna kriyāgataprakārṣādirūpaviśeṣadyotakaḥ anuḥ, prādeśaṃ viparilikhatītyādau viśabda iva na kriyāpadākṣeī, viśabdo hi vimānakriyāmākṣipati, ata eva prādeśasya karmatvam, prādeśaṃ vimāya parilikhatītyarthāt, tathā satyākṣiptakriyānibandhanadvitīyāsiddhau
analyzed: tad arthaḥ tu prajayati ityādau upasarga vat na kriyā gata prakārṣa ādi rūpa viśeṣa dyotakaḥ anuḥ prādeśam viparilikhati ityādau viśabdaḥ iva na viśabdaḥ hi vimāna kriyām ākṣipati atas eva prādeśasya karma tvam prādeśam vimāya parilikhati iti arthāt tathā sati ākṣipta kriyā nibandhana dvitīya asiddhau

original: 'karmapravacamīyayukte-' ityasya vaiyarthyāpatteḥ, kiṃ tu viśiṣṭakriyajanitoktasaṃbandhasya vibhaktivācyasya dyotakaḥ, prakṛte tu niśamanakriyākṛta uktasaṃbandha iti |
analyzed: karmapravacamīya yukte iti asya vaiyarthya āpatteḥ kim tu viśiṣṭa kriya janita ukta saṃbandhasya vibhakti vācyasya dyotakaḥ prakṛte tu niśamana kriyā kṛtaḥ ukta saṃbandhaḥ iti

original: anye tu lakṣaṇaṃ - vyāvartanaṃ, prakṛte ca pravarṣaṇakriyā japottarakālikatayā bodhyatvena vivakṣitā, vyāvartakaśca japa iti kālottarakālikatvarūpasaṃbandhahetuśca na dyotyo vibhattayarthaḥ | japābhinnahetvadhikaraṇakālottarakālikaṃ varṣaṇamiti bodha ityāhuḥ |
analyzed: anye tu lakṣaṇam vyāvartanam prakṛte ca pravarṣaṇa kriyā japa uttara kālikatayā bodhya tvena vivakṣitā vyāvartakaḥ ca japaḥ iti kāla uttara kālika tva rūpa saṃbandha hetuḥ ca na dyotyaḥ vibhattayarthaḥ japa abhinna hetu adhikaraṇa kāla uttara kālikam varṣaṇam iti bodhaḥ iti āhuḥ

original: viśeṣasaṃbandhe tattadupapadavibhaktevidhānaṃ, viśeṣarūpeṇa saṃbandhavivakṣaṇe ṣaṣṭyeveti 'caturthī-' iti sūtrabhāṣyasiddham, tatra hi guroradaṃ gurvarthamityatra tādarthyasya saṃbandhatvena vivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhītyuktam, tena 'tava mama cāntarā kamaṇḍalu'rityatra yuṣamdasmadbhyāṃ na dvitīyā, avadhitvasya saṃbandhatvena vivakṣaṇānna tvavadhitvatvena |
analyzed: viśeṣa saṃbandhe viśeṣa rūpeṇa saṃbandha vivakṣaṇe ṣaṣṭyā eva iti caturthī iti sūtra bhāṣya siddham tatra hi guroḥ adam guru artham iti atra tādarthyasya saṃbandha tvena vivakṣāyām ṣaṣṭhī iti uktam tena tava mama ca antarā kamaṇḍaluḥ iti atra na dvitīyā avadhi tvasya saṃbandha tvena vivakṣaṇāt na tu avadhi tva tvena

original: antarāśabdavācyamadhyādhikaraṇaghaṭakamadhyatvasyāvadhitvasaṃbandhena saṃbandhiniyatā- kāṅkṣatvāt, avadhitvatvavacchinnasyaiva dvitīyārthatvād dvitīyā'prāpteḥ |
analyzed: antarā śabda vācya madhya adhikaraṇa ghaṭaka madhya tvasya avadhi tva saṃbandhena saṃbandhi niyatā ākāṅkṣatvāt avadhi tva tu avacchinnasya eva dvitīyā artha tvāt dvitīyā prāpteḥ

original: ata eva svasaṃbandhikamaṇḍalutātparyeṇoccarite kamaṇḍalau yuṣmadasmadarthasya svasvāmibhāvarūpasaṃbandhavivakṣayā ṣaṣṭyantaprayogopapattāvapi tadasvāmikakamaṇḍalu- tātparyakatādṛśaprayogānupapattiriti dūṣaṇānavakāśaḥ | antarāśabdasyā- bhāvavānapyarthaḥ, antarā hari na sukhamityādau | hariśabdastātparyagrāhakaḥ |
analyzed: atas eva sva saṃbandhi kamaṇḍalu tātparyeṇa uccarite kamaṇḍalau yuṣmat asmat arthasya sva svāmi bhāva rūpa saṃbandha vivakṣayā ṣaṣṭi anta prayoga upapattau api tad asvāmika kamaṇḍalu tātparyaka tādṛśa prayoga anupapattiḥ iti dūṣaṇa anavakāśaḥ antarā śabdasya ā bhāvavān api arthaḥ antarā hari na sukham ityādau hari śabdaḥ tātparya grāhakaḥ

original: yadvā pratiyogitātvena tadviśeṣabhānam | etena śuddhapratiyogitvasya vācyatve haribhaktimatyapi dvitvādinā tatpratiyogikābhāvasattvādantarā hari sukhamiti prayogāpattiriti dūṣaṇaṃ nirastam . astītyadhyāhārasabhyasukhakartṛkasattābhāve haribhaktayabhāvata ādheyatvasaṃbandhenānvayaḥ |
analyzed: yat vā pratiyogitā tvena tad viśeṣa bhānam etena śuddha pratiyogitvasya vācyatve hari bhaktimati api dvi tva ādinā tad pratiyogika abhāva sattvāt antarā hari sukham iti prayoga āpattiḥ iti dūṣaṇam nirastam asti iti adhyāhāra sabhya sukha kartṛka sattā bhāve hari bhaktaya bhāvataḥ ādheyatva saṃbandhena anvayaḥ

original: na ca nāmārthayoriti vyutpattivirodhāt tathānvayāsaṃbhava iti vācyam | nipātātirikteti viśeṣaṇāt | yadvābhāva evāntarāśabdārthaḥ | sāmānādhikaraṇasaṃbandhena tathāvidhābhāve tasyānvayaḥ, pakṣadvaye'pi sukhādyabhāve haribhattayabhāvaprayojyatvaṃ paryavasyati | dvitīyayakṣe tenaiva vā saṃbandhenānvayaḥ |
analyzed: na ca nāma arthayoḥ iti vyutpatti virodhāt tathā anvaya asaṃbhavaḥ iti vācyam nipāta atiriktā iti viśeṣaṇāt yat vā abhāvaḥ eva antarā śabda arthaḥ sāmānādhikaraṇa saṃbandhena tathāvidha abhāve tasya anvayaḥ pakṣa dvaye pi sukha ādi abhāve paryavasyati dvitīya yakṣe tena eva vā saṃbandhena anvayaḥ

original: yadyapi nipātātirikteti viśeṣaṇāt pratiyogitvādisaṃbandhenānvayaḥ prakṛtyarthasya saṃbhavati, tathāpi tasyāḥ sārthakatve saṃbhabhavati sādhutvamātraprayojanakatvasvīkāro'nucitaḥ | ṣaṣṭhyā iva tasyā uktārthakatvāvaśyakatvācca | mañjūṣākṛnmate nipātānāṃ nāmatvābhāvātanmate nipātātiriktatvaviśeṣaṇapraleśo nāsti |
analyzed: yadi api nipāta atiriktā iti viśeṣaṇāt pratiyogitva ādi saṃbandhena anvayaḥ prakṛti arthasya saṃbhavati tathā api tasyāḥ sārthaka tve sādhutva mātra prayojanakatva svīkāraḥ unucitaḥ ṣaṣṭhyāḥ iva tasyāḥ ukta arthaka tva āvaśyaka tvāt ca mañjūṣā kṛt mate nipātānām nāma tva abhāvāt tad mate nipāta atirikta tva viśeṣaṇa praleśaḥ na asti

original: evamantareṇaśabdo'pyanena samānārthakaḥ | tadyoge'pi 'antarāntareṇa' iti sūtreṇa antareṇa tvāṃ māṃ hariḥ, antareṇa hari na sukhamityatra dvitīyā | tatrāpyuktaprakāro'nusartavyaḥ | evaṃ
analyzed: evam antareṇa śabdaḥ api anena samāna arthakaḥ tad yoge api antarā antareṇa iti sūtreṇa antareṇa tvām mām hariḥ antareṇa hari na sukham iti atra dvitīyā tatra api ukta prakāraḥ anusartavyaḥ evam

original: vināśabdo'pyabhāvavadarthako'bhāvārthako vā tatrāpyeṣaiva dik | 'vṛkṣaṃ prati vidyotate vidyu'dityādau pratiparyanūnāṃ dyotyo lakṣyalakṣaṇabhāvo vibhaktivācyaḥ, niviḍāndhakāre vṛkṣadarśanena hi tatsamīpadeśaviśeṣe vidyudvidyotanamanumīyate, jñānajanyajñānaviṣayatvaṃ vibhattayarthaḥ | va-kṣaviṣayakajñānajanyajñānaviṣayo vidyudvidyotanamiti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: vinā śabdaḥ upi abhāva vat arthakaḥ bhāva arthakaḥ vā tatra api eṣā eva diś vṛkṣam prati vidyotate vidyut ityādau dyotyaḥ lakṣya lakṣaṇa bhāvaḥ vibhakti vācyaḥ nibiḍa andhakāre vṛkṣa darśanena hi tad samīpa deśa viśeṣe vidyut vidyotanam anumīyate jñāna janya jñāna viṣaya tvam vibhatti arthaḥ vidyut vidyotanam iti bodhaḥ

original: bhakto viṣṇuṃ pratītyādau bhaktatvākhyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ kaṃcitprakāraṃ prāptasyākhyāne pratyādiḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjña ityarthakana 'itthaṃbhūtākhyāne' ityanena karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāka- pratyādidyotyo vibhaktivācyaḥ, na tu viṣayaviṣayibhāvastathā, sūtropāttasya bhaktatvasyaiva tathātvaucityāt |
analyzed: bhaktaḥ viṣṇum prati ityādau bhakta tva ākhyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ kaṃcid prakāram prāptasya ākhyāne pratyādiḥ karmapravacanīya saṃjñaḥ iti arthakanaḥ itthaṃbhūta ākhyāne iti anena karmapravacanīya saṃjñāka pratyādi dyotyaḥ vibhakti vācyaḥ na tu viṣaya viṣayi bhāvaḥ tathā sūtra upāttasya bhakta tvasya eva tathātva aucityāt

original: na ca tasya bhaktapadopāttatayā na dvitīyāśakti- saṃbhavo'nanyalabhyasyaiva śabdārthatvādita vācyam | prakāratayā bodhe siddhe'pi saṃsargatayā bodhanirvāhāya vibhaktiśakterāvaśyakatvāt | padāntaravācyasyāpi vibhattayarthasya saṃsargatayā bhānasya caitrasya putra ityadau dṛṣṭatvāt | janyatsasyaiva putrapadaśaktiviśeṣye saṃbandhatāsaṃbhavāt |
analyzed: na ca tasya bhakta pada upātta tayā na saṃbhavaḥ ūna anya labhyasya eva śabda artha tvāt iti vācyam prakāratayā bodhe siddhe api saṃsargatayā bodha nirvāhāya vibhakti śakteḥ āvaśyaka tvāt pada antara vācyasya api vibhatta arthasya saṃsargatayā bhānasya caitrasya putraḥ iti adau dṛṣṭa tvāt janya tsasya eva putra pada śakti viśeṣye saṃbandhatā saṃbhavāt

original: padārthaḥ padārtheneta vyutpattivirodhena padārthaikadeśajanyatve nirūpitatsasya saṃbandhatāyā anucitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | 'lakṣmīrhari pratī'tyādau svasvāmibhāvaḥpratyādidyotyo vibhaktivācyaḥ | harisvāmikā lakṣmīriti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: padārthaḥ vyutpatti virodhena padārtha eka deśa janya tve saṃbandhatāyāḥ anucita tvāt iti bhāvaḥ lakṣmīḥ hari prati ityādau sva svāmi bhāvaḥ pratyādi dyotyaḥ vibhakti vācyaḥ hari svāmikā lakṣmīḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: 'vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣaṃ prati siñcati'tyādau vīpsāviṣaye vyāpyatvaṃ dvirvacanadyotyaṃ, vṛkṣaśabdasya vyāpyatvaviśiṣṭavṛkṣaparatvaṃ, tasya ca vyāpakatvasaṃbandhenānvaye ttparyagrāhakaḥ pratyādiḥ | vyāpyatāvacchedaka- saṃbandhastādātmyaṃ, vyāpakatāvacchedakaśca secanasya dravadravyasaṃyogānukūla- vyāpārātmanaḥ svajanyasaṃyogaḥ |
analyzed: vṛkṣam vṛkṣam prati siñcati ityādau vīpsā viṣaye vyāpya tvam dvirvacana dyotyam vṛkṣa śabdasya vyāpya tva viśiṣṭa vṛkṣa paratvam tasya ca vyāpaka tva saṃbandhena anvaye pratyādiḥ vyāpya tā avacchedaka saṃbandhaḥ tādātmyam vyāpaka tā avacchedakaḥ ca secanasya drava dravya saṃyoga anukūla vyāpāra ātmanaḥ sva janya saṃyogaḥ

original: tādṛśasaṃyoge vyāpakatvabhāne tu samavāyastathā | vyāpakatāghaṭakābhāve pratiyogivaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ niravacchinnavṛttitvarūpaṃ, vyāpyavṛttitvaṃ vā niveśyam | tena kriyāyāḥ saṃyogasya cāvyāpyavṛttitayā tadabhāvasya tadvatyapi vṛkṣe sattve'pi na vyāpakatvahāniḥ | secanaviśeṣe jagatītalagatavṛkṣasāmānya- vyāpakatvasaṃbhave'pi na kṣatiḥ |
analyzed: tādṛśa saṃyoge vyāpaka tva bhāne tu samavāyaḥ tathā vyāpaka tā ghaṭaka abhāve pratiyogi vaiyadhikaraṇyam niravacchinna vṛtti tva rūpam vyāpya vṛtti tvam vā niveśyam tena kriyāyāḥ saṃyogasya ca avyāpya vṛtti tayā tad abhāvasya tadvati api vṛkṣe sattve api na vyāpaka tva hāniḥ secana viśeṣe jagatī tala gata vṛkṣa sāmānya vyāpaka tva saṃbhave api na kṣatiḥ

original: vṛkṣapadasya buddhisthatvena vṛkṣaviśeṣaparatvāt | tathā ca tādṛśavṛkṣaniṣṭhapratiyogivyadhikaraṇābhāvapratiyogitānavacchedakaṃ yaccaitrakartṛka- secanatvādi tadvattvarūpaṃ vyāpakatvaṃ saṃbandha iti paryavasitam, na tu tādṛśābhāvapratiyogitāśūnyatvam |
analyzed: vṛkṣa padasya buddhi stha tvena vṛkṣa viśeṣa paratvāt tathā ca tādṛśa vṛkṣa niṣṭha pratiyogi vyadhikaraṇa abhāva pratiyogitā anavacchedakam yat caitra kartṛka secana tva ādi tadvat tva rūpam vyāpaka tvam saṃbandhaḥ iti paryavasitam na tu tādṛśa abhāva pratiyogitā śūnyatvam

original: tādṛśasecanasya tādṛśavṛkṣaniṣṭhasvaprati- yogitāvacchedakāvacchinnavyadhikaraṇobhyābhāvādipratiyogitvād vyāpakatvāsaṃbhavā- patteriti dik | secanakriyāyāḥ sakarmakatayā karmaṇyeva dvitīyā, karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāphalaṃ tu gatyupasargasaṃjñābādhanadvārā patvābhāva eveti prāñca āhuḥ
analyzed: tādṛśa secanasya tādṛśa vṛkṣa niṣṭha sva prati yogitā avacchedaka avacchinna vyadhikaraṇa ubhya abhāva ādi pratiyogitvāt vyāpaka tva asaṃbhava āpatteḥ iti diś secana kriyāyāḥ sakarmaka tayā karmaṇi eva dvitīyā karmapravacanīya saṃjñā phalam tu gati upasarga saṃjñā bādhana dvārā patva abhāvaḥ eva iti prāñcaḥ āhuḥ

original: | tanmate secanakarmatve tatkarmaṇi vā svarūpasaṃbandhena tādātmyena yathākramaṃ vyāpakatvaṃ prakṛtyarthasaṃbandhatayā bhāsate, na tu secanādau | vibhattayartha viśeṣaṇatayānvitasya prakṛtyarthasya secanādau viśeṣaṇatayānvayāyogāt | anye tu karmatvāvivakṣāyāṃ dvitīyāsiddhirapi karmapravacanīyasaṃjñāprayojanam |
analyzed: tad mate secana karma tve tad karmaṇi vā svarūpa saṃbandhena tādātmyena yathākramam vyāpaka tvam prakṛti artha saṃbandhatayā bhāsate na tu secana ādau viśeṣaṇatayā anvitasya prakṛti arthasya secana ādau viśeṣaṇatayā anvaya ayogāt anye tu karma tva avivakṣāyām dvitīyā siddhiḥ api karmapravacanīya saṃjñā prayojanam

original: ata eva pratyartha śabdābhiniveśa ityādāvarthasya niveśanakriyānirūpitādhikaraṇatve'pi arthamartha pratītyeva vigrahapradarśanaṃ bhāṣyādau kṛtam | vṛkṣādeḥ kriyāyāḥ karmatvamupaganyaitasyāḥ saṃjñāyā dvitīyāsādhakatvāṅgīkāre tu saptamyantenaiva prakṛte vigrahasya samucitatayā tathāvidhabhāṣyasaṃgatyāpattiḥ |
analyzed: atas eva pratyartha śabda abhiniveśaḥ ityādau arthasya niveśana kriyā nirūpita adhikaraṇa tve pi artham artha prati itya iva vigraha pradarśanam bhāṣya ādau kṛtam vṛkṣa ādeḥ kriyāyāḥ karma tvam upaganya etasyāḥ saṃjñāyāḥ dvitīyā sādhaka tva aṅgīkāre tu saptamī antena eva prakṛte vigrahasya samucita tayā tathāvidha bhāṣya saṃgati āpattiḥ

original: tādṛśasaṃjñāyā dvitīyāphalakatve tvarthasyādhikaraṇatva- vivakṣāyāṃ vyāpakatvasaṃbandhādhikā dvitīyeti nāsaṃgatiḥ | ata eva 'vṛkṣaṃ vṛkṣaṃ prati śyāmatā' 'ghaṭaṃ ghaṭaṃ prati gandha' ityādāvapi kriyājanitavyāpārakatvasaṃbandhāthikā dvitīyā sidhyati |
analyzed: tādṛśa saṃjñāyāḥ dvitīyā phalaka tve tu arthasya adhikaraṇa tva vivakṣāyām vyāpakatva saṃbandha adhikā dvitīyā iti na asaṃgatiḥ atas eva vṛkṣam vṛkṣam prati śyāma tā ghaṭam ghaṭam prati gandhaḥ ityādau api kriyā janita vyāpāraka tva saṃbandha athikā dvitīyā sidhyati

original: dvirvacanena vyāpyatvadyotanāt secanārthakapadasamabhi- vyāhārāttattadvayāpakaṃ vyāpyatvarūpeṇa prakāratayā bhāsate | anugatavyāpyatvatvānaṅgīkāre tu vīpsāyaṃ dviruktividhānaṃ ca ? vyāpyatvasya vṛkṣādyarthakatve mānam | tathā hi vyāptipratīticchāprakṛte pyupasṛṣṭāpnotestatpratītiparatvād dviruktaprayogādicchāyā apratīterna tasya tadarthakatā |
analyzed: dvirvacanena vyāpya tva dyotanāt secana arthaka pada samabhi vyāhārāt tat tat vayāpakam vyāpya tva rūpeṇa prakāratayā bhāsate anugata vyāpya tva tva anaṅgīkāre tu vīpsā ayam dvirukti vidhānam ca vyāpya tvasya vṛkṣa ādi arthaka tve mānam tathā hi vyāpti pratīti chā prakṛte pi upasṛṣṭa āpnoteḥ tad pratīti paratvāt dvirukta prayogāt icchāyāḥ apratīteḥ na tasya tad arthaka tā

original: evaṃ ca pyāptipratīticchāyāṃ satyāṃ dvirvacanamiti vākyārthaḥ paryavasannaḥ | na ca dhātureva vyāpakatvārthako'stu astu ca sādhutvārthī vibhaktiriti vācyam | nāmārthadhātvarthayoḥ sākṣādbhedasaṃbandhasyāvyutpannatayā vṛkṣasya vyāpakatādau nirūpitātvādisaṃbandhenānvayāsaṃbhavāt |
analyzed: evam ca satyām dvirvacanam iti vākya arthaḥ paryavasannaḥ na ca dhātuḥ eva astu ca sādhu tva arthī vibhaktiḥ iti vācyam nāma artha dhātvarthayoḥ sākṣāt bheda saṃbandhasya avyutpanna tayā vṛkṣasya vyāpaka tā ādau nirūpita ātva ādi saṃbandhena anvaya asaṃbhavāt

original: ata eva caitraḥ pacyata ityādau pākādau caitrādeḥ kartṛtānirūpakatvādisaṃbandhenānvayabodho na, śobhana pacatītyatra śobhanapadārthasya dhātvarthe bhedenānvayādbhedeneti | taṇḍulaṃ pacatītyādau taṇḍulādevibhattayarthadvārānvayāt sākṣāditi |
analyzed: atas eva caitraḥ pacyate ityādau pāka ādau caitra ādeḥ kartṛtā nirūpaka tva ādi saṃbandhena anvaya bodhaḥ na śobhana pacati iti atra śobhana padārthasya dhātvarthe bhedena anvayāt bhedena iti taṇḍulam pacati ityādau taṇḍula ādeḥ vibhattayartha dvāra anvayāt sākṣāt iti

original: 'māsamadhīte' atra 'kālādhvanoḥ-' iti sūtreṇa kālādhvānuyogike kriyādravyaguṇādibhāvapratiyogike'tyanta- saṃyoge'tyantasaṃbandhe nirantarasaṃbandhe satupasthitatvat kālādhvavācakebhyo dvitīyetyarthakena dvitīyā | antaṃ virāmamatikrāntaścāsau saṃyogaśceti vyutpattyā nirantarasaṃbandhalābhaḥ |
analyzed: māsam adhīte atra kāla adhvanoḥ iti sūtreṇa kāla adhva anuyogike kriyā dravya guṇa ādi bhāva pratiyogika ityanta saṃyoga ityanta saṃbandhe nirantara saṃbandhe kāla adhva vācakebhyaḥ dvitīyā iti arthakena dvitīyā antam virāmam atikrāntaḥ ca asau saṃyogaḥ ca iti vyutpattyā nirantara saṃbandha lābhaḥ

original: upasthitāśabdasvarūpamātrasya na prakṛtitvaṃ 'kālāḥ' 'antantasaṃyoge ca' iti samāsavidhau bahuvacananirdaśālliṅgāt | vyāpakatvaṃ dvitīyārthaḥ | padārthatāvacchedakamāsatvanirūpitavyāpakatvabhānāṅgīkāre samavāyādirvyāpyatāghaṭakasaṃbandhastādātmyaṃ, tattvaṃ ca triśadahorātra tvarūpamāsatva-
analyzed: na prakṛti tvam kālāḥ ca iti samāsa vidhau bahuvacana nirdaśāt liṅgāt vyāpaka tvam dvitīya arthaḥ padārtha tā avacchedaka māsa tva nirūpita vyāpaka tva bhāna aṅgīkāre samavāya ādiḥ vyāpya tā ghaṭaka saṃbandhaḥ tādātmyam tattvam ca triśat ahorātra tva rūpa māsa tva rūpa māsa tva nirūpay anta anta anta saṃyoga ca triśat ahorātra tva rūpa māsa tva nirūpay anta anta anta saṃyoga ca

original: vanniṣṭhapratiyogivyadhikaraṇābhāvapratiyogitānavacchedakadharmitvam | vyāpakatā- ghaṭakaśca kālikaviśeṣaṇatātmakaḥ saṃbandhaḥ | sāsapadaṃ cāvayavānatirikta- triśādahorātrasamuhaparaṃ, na tu tāvatparthantasthāyisthūlakālaparam | tathā satyekadinādimātrādhyayanakartaryapi māsamadhīte iti prayogāpatteḥ |
analyzed: vat niṣṭha pratiyogi vyadhikaraṇa abhāva pratiyogitā anavacchedaka dharmitvam vyāpaka tā ghaṭakaḥ ca kālika viśeṣaṇa tā ātmakaḥ saṃbandhaḥ sāsa padam ca avayava anatirikta na tu tathā sati eka dina ādi mātra adhyayana kartari api māsam adhīte iti prayoga āpatteḥ

original: tadīyādhyayanasyāpi triśadahorātrarūpatādṛśakālaniṣṭhapratiyogivyadhikaraṇābhāva- pratiyogitānāvacchedakatadīyādhyayanatvavattvena māsādivyāpakatvasaṃbhavāt tadīyādhya- yanābhāvasya pratiyogivyadhikaraṇatayā noktagoṣaḥ | tadghaṭakāhorātraśca sūryodayāvadhisūryodayaparyantasthāyyavayavātiriktaḥ kṣaṇasamūpādireva |
analyzed: tadīya adhyayanasya api triśat ahorātra rūpa tādṛśa kāla niṣṭha pratiyogi vyadhikaraṇa abhāva pratiyogitā an avacchedaka tadīya adhyayana tva vat tvena māsa ādi vyāpaka tva saṃbhavāt tadīya adhyayana abhāvasya pratiyogi vyadhikaraṇa tayā na ukta goṣaḥ tad ghaṭaka ahorātraḥ ca sūrya udaya avadhi sūrya udaya paryanta sthāyi avayava atiriktaḥ kṣaṇa samūpa ādiḥ eva

original: tena triśaddine pratyahamadhyayanasthale'pi svāpādisamayāvacchedena māsatvādhikaraṇe kṣaṇādau tadīyādhyayanasya pratiyogivyadhikaraṇābhāvaniveśe uktarītyoktadoṣatādavasthyamiti tannirāsāya tanniveśaḥ | pratiyogivaidhikaraṇyaṃ ca vyāpakatāvacchedakatvenābhimata- saṃbandhāvacchinnapratiyogitāvacchedakāvacchinānādhikaraṇatāvadbhinnavṛttitvam |
analyzed: tena triśat dine pratyaham adhyayana sthale api svāpa ādi samaya avacchedena māsa tva adhikaraṇe kṣaṇa ādau tadīya adhyayanasya pratiyogi vyadhikaraṇa abhāva niveśe ukta rītyā ukta doṣa tādavasthyam iti tad nirāsāya tad niveśaḥ pratiyogi vaidhikaraṇyam ca vyāpakatā avacchedaka tvena abhimata saṃbandha avacchinna pratiyogitā avacchedaka avacchina an adhikaraṇa tā vat bhinna vṛttitvam

original: na tu tatsaṃbandhena priyogitāvacchedakāvacchinnādhikaraṇāvṛttitvamadhyayanādeḥ rālikāvyāpya- vṛttitayā svādhikaraṇakāle'pi kicitkṣaṇādyavacchedena svābhāvasya sattvena pratiyogyadhikaraṇāvṛttitvābhāvena māsāntargataikadinādhyayanaśālinyapi māsamadhīte iti prayogāpattiḥ |
analyzed: na tu tad saṃbandhena priyogitā avacchedaka avacchinna adhikaraṇa avṛtti tvam adhyayana ādeḥ rālikā vyāpya vṛttitayā sva adhikaraṇa kāle api kicit kṣaṇa ādi avacchedena sva abhāvasya sattvena pratiyogi adhikaraṇa avṛtti tva abhāvena māsa antargata eka dina adhyayana śālini api māsam adhīte iti prayoga āpattiḥ

original: krośaikadeśamātre parvatādisattve'pi krośatvākrāntatadanyadeśa- niṣṭhasaṃyogasaṃbandhāvacchinnapratiyogitākatadabhāvasya krośatvākrānte tatra kālikasaṃbandhela parvarūpapratiyogyadhikaraṇatvasattvena pratiyogyanadhikaraṇa- vṛttitvavaiśiṣṭyābhāvenātītatadvayaktyabhāva eva krośe tādṛśapratiyogivaiyadhikaraṇya- viśiṣṭatatpratiyogitānāvacchedakatvasya
analyzed: krośa eka deśa mātre parvata ādi sattve api krośa tva ākrānta tad anya deśa niṣṭha saṃyoga saṃbandha avacchinna pratiyogitāka tad abhāvasya krośa tva ākrānte tatra kālika saṃbandha ila parva rūpa pratiyogi adhikaraṇa tva sattvena pratiyogi anadhikaraṇa vṛtti tva vaiśiṣṭya abhāvena atīta tad vayakti abhāve eva krośe tādṛśa pratiyogi vaiyadhikaraṇya viśiṣṭa tad pratiyogitā na avacchedaka tvasya

original: parvatatve sattvāt 'krośaṃ parvata' iti prayogāpattiḥ | ato vyāpakatāghaṭakasaṃbandhena pratiyogyanadhikaraṇatvanivaśaḥ | yadā devadatte na kāśyānupavāsa ekāhastadadvayādikaṃ vā kriyate, māsantaḥ- pātidhvavaśiṣṭāhorātreṣu kāśīto bahirūpoṣyate tādṛśasthale devadattīyo bhojanābhāvo māsaṃ kāśyāniti prayogāpattiḥ |
analyzed: parvata tve sattvāt krośam parvataḥ iti prayoga āpattiḥ atas vyāpaka tā ghaṭaka saṃbandhena yadā devadatte na kāśyaiḥ upavāsaḥ eka ahar tad advaya ādikam vā kriyate tādṛśa sthale devadattīyaḥ bhojana abhāvaḥ māsam kāśyān iti prayoga āpattiḥ

original: kāśyavacchinnatva- viśiṣṭadevadattīyabhojanābhāvasya kāśyanavacchinnatādṛśabhojanābhāvasya caikyena kāśyavacchinnasya tādṛśabhojanābhāvasyābhāvo dināntarātmakatādṛśamāsatvādhikaraṇe vartamāno'pi devadattīyabhojanābhāvātmakapratiyogyadhikaraṇatvena tanmāsatvākrānta- dināntarasya na pratiyogivyadhikaraṇo'pi tvanyābhāva eva, tatpratiyogitā-
analyzed: kāśi avacchinna tva viśiṣṭa devadattīya bhojana abhāvasya kāśi anavacchinna tādṛśa bhojana abhāvasya ca aikyena kāśi avacchinnasya tādṛśa bhojana abhāvasya abhāvaḥ dina antara ātmaka tādṛśa māsa tva adhikaraṇe vartamānaḥ api devadattīya bhojana abhāva ātmaka pratiyogi adhikaraṇa tvena tad māsa tva ākrānta dina antarasya na pratiyogi vyadhikaraṇaḥ upi tu anya abhāvaḥ eva tad pratiyogitā

original: nāvacchedakatvasya kāśyavacchinnadevadattīyabhojanābhāvatve sattvāt | evaṃ
analyzed: na avacchedaka tvasya kāśi avacchinna devadattīya bhojana abhāva tve sattvāt evam

original: māsāntargatadinadvayaṃ devadatte na bahirūṣitaṃ tadanantaramaṣṭāviśatidināni kāśyāmuṣitaṃ, tatra devadattābhāvo māsaṃ kāśyāmiti prayogāpattiḥ | kāśyava- cchinnadevadattābhāvābhāvasya māsatvākrāntadinaniṣṭhatve'pi priyogivyadhikaraṇatvā- bhāvāt |
analyzed: māsa antargata dina dvayam devadatte na bahis ūṣitam tad anantaram aṣṭāviśati dināni kāśyām uṣitam tatra devadatta abhāvaḥ māsam kāśyām iti prayoga āpattiḥ kāśi ava chinna devadatta abhāva abhāvasya māsa tva ākrānta dina niṣṭhatve pi priyogi vyadhikaraṇa tva abhāvāt

original: deśāntarāvacchinnatvaviśiṣṭadevadattābhāvarūpapratiyogisamānādhikaraṇa- tvāt |viśiṣṭasya śuddhānatirekitvāt | ataḥ pratiyogitāvacchedakāvacchinnavaiyadhi- karaṇyaniveśaḥ |
analyzed: deśa antara avacchinna tva viśiṣṭa devadatta abhāva rūpa pratiyogi samāna adhikaraṇa tvāt viśiṣṭasya śuddha anatireki tvāt atas pratiyogitā avacchedaka avacchinna vaiyadhikaraṇya niveśaḥ

original: tathā sati kāśyavacchinnatvaviśiṣṭadevadattīyabhojanābhāvatvarūpa- pratiyogitāvacchedakāvacchinnānadhikaraṇatvasya māsatvādhikaraṇadināntare sattvāt kāśyavacchinnadevadattīyabhojanābhāvādirapi pratiyogivyadhikaraṇa iti noktātiprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: tathā sati kāśi avacchinna tva viśiṣṭa devadattīya bhojana abhāva tva rūpa pratiyogitā avacchedaka avacchinna anadhikaraṇa tvasya māsa tva adhikaraṇa dina antare sattvāt kāśi avacchinna devadattīya bhojana abhāva ādiḥ api pratiyogi vyadhikaraṇaḥ iti na ukta atiprasaṅgaḥ

original: atredaṃ bodhyam dvitīyārtho na vyāpakatvaṃ, vyāpakatvasya vyapyaviśeṣāghaṭitasyākhaṇḍasya durvacatayā tadghaṭitavyāpakatvānāmānantyā- cchaktyānantyaprasaṅgāt | prakṛtyarthasya vibhattayarthe nirākāṅkṣatayānanvayāpatteśceti pratiyogivaiyadhikaraṇyaviśiṣṭābhāve pratiyogitāvacchedakatve abhāve ca khaṇḍaśaḥ vṛttiḥ |

original: 'kālabhāvādhvadeśānāmāntarbhūtakriyāntaraiḥ |

original: sarvairakarmakairyoge karmatvamupajāyate ||' iti |

original: tatrākarmakairityuktāvapi nyāyasāmyena sakarmakadhātorapi tadarthāntarbhāveṇa vṛttisvīkāre bādhakābhāvaḥ | ata evaitatsūtrasya vaiyarthyamuktābhiprāyeṇa 'prākṛtamevaitat krarme'ti prakṛtasūtrasthabhāṣyeṇāśaṅkitam | akarmake evoktarīterabhyupagame māsamadhīte ityādiprayoganirvāhārtha sūtrāvaśyakatve śaṅkā asaṃgatā syāt |
analyzed: tatra akarmakaiḥ iti uktau api nyāya sāmyena sakarmaka dhātoḥ api tad artha antarbhāveṇa vṛtti svīkāre bādhaka abhāvaḥ atas eva etad sūtrasya vaiyarthyam ukta abhiprāyeṇa prākṛtam eva etat krarma iti prakṛta sūtra stha bhāṣyeṇa āśaṅkitam akarmake eva ukta rīteḥ abhyupagame māsam adhīte ityādi prayoga nirvāha artha sūtra āvaśyaka tve śaṅkā asaṃgatā syāt

original: na ca tādṛśaśaṅkāparabhāṣyāttādṛśaprayogo neṣyata eveti vācyam | 'apavarge tṛtīyā' iti sūtre anyathā māsamāste māsamadhīte iti dvividhaprayoganirvāhakasyāsya sūtrasya vaiyarthyaśaṅkānupapatteḥ | etatsūtre āsyate māsaḥ śayyate krośa ityakarmakadhātughaṭitaprayoga evāsti |
analyzed: na ca tādṛśa śaṅkā apara bhāṣyāt tādṛśa prayogaḥ na iṣyate eva iti vācyam apavarge tṛtīyā iti sūtre anyathā māsam āste māsam adhīte iti dvividha prayoga nirvāhakasya asya sūtrasya vaiyarthya śaṅkā anupapatteḥ etad sūtre āsyate māsaḥ śayyate krośe iti akarmaka dhātu ghaṭita prayogaḥ eva asti

original: na tu māsamadhīte ityādiḥ sakarmakadhātughaṭitaḥ prayogo yena tatrāpi vyāpanāntarbhāva āstheyaḥ | mānamadhīto'nuvāko na cānena gṛhīta iti prayogāt tādṛśaprayogāṇāmapīṣṭatvāt | ata eva māsamodanaṃ pacatīti prayogo'pi vyāpanakarmatvavivakṣayāpi bhavati |
analyzed: na tu māsam adhīte ityādiḥ sakarmaka dhātu ghaṭitaḥ prayogaḥ yena tatra api vyāpana antarbhāvaḥ āstheyaḥ mānam adhītaḥ nuvākaḥ na ca anena gṛhītaḥ iti prayogāt tādṛśa prayogāṇām api iṣṭatvāt atas eva māsam odanam pacati iti prayogaḥ upi vyāpana karmatva vivakṣayā api bhavati

original: kālādikarmaṇo bahīraṅgatayā na tatra lādirapi tvantaraṅge dravyakarmaṇyedheti spaṣṭaṃ bhāṣyapradīpoddayote | anayaiva rītyātyantasaṃyoge karmavallādyarthamiti vacanamapi na kartavyamiti bhāṣye uktam | akarmakadhātubhiriti vacanaṃ tu bhāṣye nāstyeva | 'akathitaṃ ca' iti sūtrabhāṣye

original: 'kālabhāvādhvagantavyāḥ karmasaṃjñā hyakarmaṇām |'

original: ityapi siddhārthakathanaṃ na tvapūrva, hiśabdaprayogāditi spaṣṭaṃ śakharādau | tatra kālādikarma pradhānaṃ karma, dryamapradhānaṃ karma, kālāderādhāratvena dravyadvāraiva
