original: kriyāsaṃbandhāt | tasmāt sūtraṃ vyarthamiti cenna | yatrākriyayā saṃyogastadarthamidaṃ vaktavyamiti bhāṣye eva samādhānāt |
analyzed: kriyā saṃbandhāt tasmāt sūtram vyartham iti ced na yatra akriyayā saṃyogaḥ tad artham idam vaktavyam iti bhāṣye eva samādhānāt

original: kathaṃ tarhi māsamadhīte ityudāharaṇamiti cet, saṃbandhasāmānyavivakṣāyāṃ ṣaṣṭhībādhanārthatvena kriyāyogārthamapyasyāvaśyakatvena yatra kriyākārakabhāvena nānvayavivakṣā tatrātyantasaṃyogārthamiti tadbhāṣya- vyākhyānasyocitatvamityāśayāt |
analyzed: katham tarhi māsam adhīte iti udāharaṇam iti ced saṃbandha sāmānya vivakṣāyām ṣaṣṭhī bādhana artha tvena kriyā yoga artham api asya āvaśyaka tvena yatra kriyā kāraka bhāvena na anvaya vivakṣā tatra atyanta saṃyoga artham iti tat bhāṣya vyākhyānasya ucitatvam iti āśayāt

original: yadyapi krośaṃ kuṭilā nadītyatrāstīi kriyādhyāhāraṃ vinā prathamāyāḥ sādhutvānirvāhāttadadhyāhārāvaśyakatā tathāpi kauṭilyādereva krośavyārakatvavivakṣāyāṃ dvitīyāsiddhayarthamidamiti na bhāṣyādigranthāsaṃgatiḥ |
analyzed: yadi api krośam kuṭilā nadī iti atra asti iti kriyā adhyāhāram vinā prathamāyāḥ sādhutva anirvāhāt tad adhyāhāra āvaśyaka tā tathā api kauṭilya ādeḥ eva krośa vyārakatva vivakṣāyām dvitīyā siddhayartham idam iti na bhāṣya ādi grantha asaṃgatiḥ

original: tatra kauṭilyādirūpe padārthaikadeśe'nvayo vyutpatti- vaicitryāt, tadviśiṣṭadharmiṇi vā, anye tu sarvatra tattaddhātorvyāptiparyantaṃ vṛttisvīkṛtya krośaṃ kuṭilā nadītyādāvapi dvitīyopapādane'pi māsi māsamāsitetyatra kṛdyogalakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhyeva syānna dvitīyeti tadarthamida- māvaśyakabhityāhuḥ | iti dvitīyārthanirūpaṇam ||
analyzed: tatra kauṭilya ādi rūpe vyutpatti vaicitryāt tad viśiṣṭa dharmiṇi vā anye tu sarvatra tad tad dhātoḥ vyāpti paryantam vṛtti svīkṛtya krośam kuṭilā nadī ityādau api dvitīya upapādane pi māsi māsam āsitā iti atra kṛt yoga lakṣaṇā ṣaṣṭhī eva syāt na dvitīyā iti tad artham idam āvaśyakam iti āhuḥ iti dvitīya artha nirūpaṇam

original: dhūmena vahnimanuminoti, atra karaṇe tṛtīyā | dhūmādijñānasyānumiti- karaṇatāpakṣe dhūmādiśabdaḥ svajñāparaḥ | jñāyamānasya karaṇatāmate tu mukhyārthaka eva | vyāptiviśiṣṭavaiśiṣṭyāvagāhiparāmarśasya vyāpāratvād vyāptiviśiṣṭa- dhūmādijñānasya karaṇatānirvāhaḥ |

original: anvayitāvacchedakavahnividheyakānumititvāva- cchedena dhūmādijñānakaraṇakatvānvayopagamādyatra vahnyanumitau na prayogaḥ | na vā dhūmena ghaṭamanuminotīti prayogaḥ | nanu tārkikanaye idaṃ saṃbhavati na śābdakanaye, tathā hi tannaye vidheyatā vidheyitādadvitīyārthaḥ | vahyanvitāyāstasyā nirūpakatvādisaṃbandhenānumitāvanvayaḥ |
analyzed: anvayi tā avacchedaka vahni vidheyaka anumiti tva ava chedena dhūma ādi jñāna karaṇaka tva anvaya upagamāt yatra vahni anumitau na prayogaḥ na vā dhūmena ghaṭam anuminoti iti prayogaḥ nanu tārkika naye idam saṃbhavati na śābdaka naye tathā hi tad naye vidheyatā vidheyitāt advitīya arthaḥ vahi anvitāyāḥ tasyāḥ nirūpaka tva ādi saṃbandhena anumitau anvayaḥ

original: tādṛśavidheyatādiviśaṣṭāyāmanumitau dhūmajñānakaraṇakatvānvayādvahnividheyakatvādelanvayitāvacchedakatvasaṃbhavaḥ | śābdi- kamate tvanumityanukūlavyāpāro dhātvarthaḥ | nidheyatāsaṃbandhaḥ phalāvacchedakaḥ | itthaṃ ca vahnividheyakānumititvasyānvayitāvacchedakatvābhāvaḥ spaṣṭa eva |
analyzed: tādṛśa vidheya tā ādi viśaṣṭāyām anumitau dhūma jñāna karaṇaka tva anvayāt vahni vidheyaka tva ādeḥ anvayitā avacchedaka tva saṃbhavaḥ śābdika mate tu anumiti anukūla vyāpāraḥ dhātvarthaḥ nidheya tā saṃbandhaḥ phala avacchedakaḥ ittham ca vahni vidheyaka anumiti tvasya anvayitā avacchedaka tva abhāvaḥ spaṣṭaḥ eva

original: tathā ca pūrvāktātiprasaṅgo durvāra evaitanmata iti cenna, vidheyatādisthānīyavidheyatā- saṃbandhenānumitisaṃbaddhavahnyavacchedena dhūmādijñānakaraṇakatvānvayopagamenoktāti- prasaṅgāsaṃbhavāt | nanu tathāpi yatra dhūmaliṅgakavahnyanumitau ghaṭādijñānena dravyatvādyavagāhitvaṃ tatra ghaṭena na vahnimanuminotīti nañghaṭitaprayogānupapattiḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca pūrva akta atiprasaṅgaḥ durvāraḥ eva etad mataḥ iti ced na vidheya tā ādi sthānīya vidheya tā saṃbandhena anumiti saṃbaddha vahni avacchedena dhūma ādi jñāna karaṇaka tva anvaya upagamena uktā ati prasaṅga asaṃbhavāt nanu tathā api yatra dhūma liṅgaka vahni anumitau ghaṭa ādi jñānena dravya tva ādi avagāhi tvam tatra ghaṭena na vahnim anuminoti iti nañ ghaṭita prayoga anupapattiḥ

original: uktasamūhālambanavahnyanumatau ghaṭajñānakaraṇakatvābhāvabādhena tatprayuktaghaṭajñāna- karaṇatvaviśiṣṭoktānumitivirahabodhanāsaṃbhavāt | dhūmenedaṃ vahneranumānaṃ na ghaṭeneti
analyzed: ukta samūha ālambana vahni anumatau ghaṭa jñāna karaṇaka tva abhāva bādhena tad prayukta ghaṭa jñāna karaṇa tva viśiṣṭa ukta anumiti viraha bodhana asaṃbhavāt dhūmena idam vahneḥ anumānam na ghaṭena iti

original: prayogasya tārkikamate'pyanupapattiḥ | pūrvoktasthale prathamāntārthe ghaṭajñānakaraṇa- kavahnyanumiterghaṭe vahnivyāpyatvabhramadāśāyāṃ prasiddhāyā abhāvabodhanasaṃbhave'pyatra tadasaṃbhavāditi cenna, uktasamūhālambanātmakānumitisattve dhūmakaraṇakaṃ vahneridamanumānaṃ na ghaṭakaraṇakamiti prayogasya saraṇeratra pradarśanīyatvād, yathā
analyzed: prayogasya tārkika mate api anupapattiḥ pūrvokta sthale prathama anta arthe ghaṭa jñāna karaṇa ka vahni anumiteḥ ghaṭe vahni vyāpya tva bhrama dāśāyām prasiddhāyāḥ abhāva bodhana saṃbhave pi atra tad asaṃbhavāt iti ced na ukta samūha ālambana ātmaka anumiti sattve dhūma karaṇakam vahneḥ idam anumānam na ghaṭa karaṇakam iti prayogasya saraṇeḥ atra pradarśanīya tvāt yathā

original: tādṛśaprayogo neṣyate tathāgatyā pūrvoktaprayogadvayamapi neṣyata ityāhuḥ | anye tu dhūmādipadaṃ jñānakaraṇatāmate'pi mukhyārthakameva 'hetau' iti sūtreṇa tṛtīyāsaṃbhavāt prayojakatvarūpaṃ hetutvaṃ janakatāvacchedakasādhāraṇamiti viṣayitayānumitajanaka- tāvacchedakadhūmādāvi tadakṣatam |
analyzed: tādṛśa prayogaḥ na iṣyate tathā gatyā pūrvokta prayoga dvayam api na iṣyate iti āhuḥ anye tu dhūma ādi padam jñāna karaṇatā mate api mukhya arthakam eva hetau iti sūtreṇa tṛtīyā asaṃbhavāt prayojaka tva rūpam hetu tvam janakatā avacchedaka sādhāraṇam iti viṣayitayā anumita janaka tā avacchedaka dhūma ādau tat akṣatam

original: prayojakatvaṃ janyatāvacchedakatārūpaṃ prayojyatvaṃ vā tṛtīyārthaḥ | tasya vahnimityādivibhattayantārthavahnividheyakatve nirūpakatādi- saṃbandhenānvayābhyupagamānnātaḥ ghaṭena vahnimityādiprayogāpattiḥ | vahnividheyakatve ghaṭaniṣṭhaprayojakatānirūpakatādyabhāvāt | tatra ghaṭaprayojyatvābhāvasyābādhita- tvānna ghaṭenetyādiprayogopapattiśca |
analyzed: prayojaka tvam janyatā avacchedaka tā rūpam prayojya tvam vā tṛtīyā arthaḥ tasya vahnim ityādi vibhattaya nta artha vahni vidheyakatve nirūpakatā ādi saṃbandhena anvaya abhyupagamān na atas ghaṭena vahnim ityādi prayoga āpattiḥ vahni vidheyakatve ghaṭa niṣṭha prayojakatā nirūpakatā ādi abhāvāt tatra ghaṭa prayojya tva abhāvasya abādhita tvāt na ghaṭena ityādi prayoga upapattiḥ ca

original: dhūmena vahnimityādiprayogopapattihni- vidheyitāyā dhūmaniṣṭaprayojakatā nirūpakatvāt prayojyatvācca | śābdikamate vibhaktau lakṣaṇāviraheṇa vitheyitāyā vibhaktyarthatāvirahānnañdhaṭitoktaprayoga- nirvāhāyāgatyānupūrvakaminotereva vahnividheyatākānumitilākṣaṇikatvaṃ vahni- mityādivibhaktyantasya tātparyagrāhakatvaṃ cāṅgīkaraṇīyam |
analyzed: dhūmena vahnim ityādi vidheyitāyāḥ dhūma niṣṭa prayojakatā nirūpaka tvāt prayojya tvāt ca śābdika mate vibhaktau lakṣaṇā viraheṇa vitheyitāyāḥ vibhakti artha tā virahāt nañ dhaṭita ukta prayoga nirvāhāya āgatya anupūrvaka minoteḥ eva vahni vidheyatāka anumiti lākṣaṇika tvam vahni m ityādi vibhakti antasya tātparya grāhaka tvam ca aṅgīkaraṇīyam

original: evaṃ ca nātrokta- samūhālambanānumititātparyeṇa ghaṭena vahnimanuminotīti prayogāpattiḥ | na ghaṭena vahnimanuminotīti prayogastu dhātvarthaikadeśavahnividheyakatvādau tṛtīyārthanvayā- bhyupagame eva saṃpādyavahnividheyakatvādau ghaṭādijñānaprayojyatvābhāvaprayukta- viśiṣṭānumityabhāvabodhanasaṃbhavena saṃpādya ityāhuḥ |
analyzed: evam ca na atra ukta samūha ālambana anumiti tātparyeṇa ghaṭena vahnim anuminoti iti prayoga āpattiḥ na ghaṭena vahnim anuminoti iti prayogaḥ tu dhātvartha eka deśa vahni vidheyaka tva ādau tṛtīyārtha nvaya abhyupagame eva saṃpādya vahni vidheyaka tva ādau ghaṭa ādi jñāna prayojya tva abhāva prayukta viśiṣṭa anumiti abhāva bodhana saṃbhavena saṃpādyaḥ iti āhuḥ

original: 'putreṇa sahāgataḥ pite'tyatra 'sahayukte 'pradhāne' iti tṛtīyā | sahaśabdārthaḥ sāhityam | tacca samabhivyāhṛtapadosthāpyakriyādisamānakālikakriyādyanvayitvam | tadanvayitvaṃ ca samabhivyāhṛtakriyādibodhakapadena sāhityānvayinikriyāyā yādṛśaḥ saṃbandhaḥ pratīyate tādṛśaḥ saṃbandha eva | putreṇetyādau kartṛtvarūpaḥ saḥ |
analyzed: putreṇa saha āgataḥ pitā iti atra saha yukte pradhāne iti tṛtīyā saha śabda arthaḥ sāhityam tat ca samabhivyāhṛta pada usthāpya kriyā ādi samāna kālika kriyā ādi anvayitvam tad anvayitvam ca samabhivyāhṛta kriyā ādi bodhaka padena sāhitya anvayi nikriyāyāḥ yādṛśaḥ saṃbandhaḥ pratīyate tādṛśaḥ saṃbandhaḥ eva putreṇa ityādau kartṛ tva rūpaḥ saḥ

original: 'payasā sahaudanaṃ bhuṅke' 'payasā sahaudano bhūjyata' ityādau karmatvam | khaḍgena saha bāṇena hata ityatra karaṇatvam | śiṣyeṇa saha gurave dakṣiṇā dīyata ityatra saṃpradānatvam | prayāgeṇa saha kāśyāṃ devāḥ santītyatrādhikaraṇatvam | putreṇa saha sthūla ityādāvādhāratvādiḥ saṃbandhaḥ, putreṇetyādau tṛtīyārthe'pi kartṛtvādikameva |
analyzed: payasā saha odanam bhuṅke payasā saha odanaḥ bhūjyate ityādau karmatvam khaḍgena saha bāṇena hataḥ iti atra karaṇa tvam śiṣyeṇa saha gurave dakṣiṇā dīyate iti atra saṃpradāna tvam prayāgeṇa saha kāśyām devāḥ santi iti atra adhikaraṇa tvam putreṇa saha sthūlaḥ ityādau ādhāra tva ādiḥ saṃbandhaḥ putreṇa ityādau tṛtīyārthe pi kartṛ tva ādikam eva

original: ādheyatāsaṃbandhena|putrānvitakartṛtvasyāgamānakālikāgamanakartatvarūpasahārthaghaṭakī-
analyzed: ādheya tā saṃbandhena putra anvita kartṛ tvasya āgamāna kālikā gamana karta tva rūpa saha artha ghaṭakī

original: bhūtāgamane nirūpakatāsaṃbandhenānvayaḥ | sahārthakartṛtvasya pitaryākṣayatayānvayaḥ | tadviśiṣṭakṛtpratyayāntārthasyāgamanakartṛrabhedenānvayaḥ | na coddeśyatāvacchedakavidheya- yoraikyānnirākāṅkṣatvamiti vācyam |
analyzed: bhūta āgamane nirūpakatā saṃbandhena anvayaḥ saha artha kartṛ tvasya pitari ākṣayatayā anvayaḥ tad viśiṣṭa kṛtpratyaya anta arthasya āgamana kartṛ rabhedena anvayaḥ na ca uddeśya tā avacchedaka vidheya yoḥ aikyāt nirākāṅkṣa tvam iti vācyam

original: karmakartṛtvādeḥ saṃbandhatvenaiva sahārthe'nta- rbhāveṇaikarūpoddeśyatāvacchedakavidheyayoraikye eva nirākāṅkṣatayā prakṛte tadabhāvāt | yadvā saṃbandhisamānakālikapadārthasaṃbandhitvameva sahaśabdārthaḥ | saṃbandhaśca kartṛtvādireva saṃbandhatvena pūrvavadantarbhāvyaḥ putrapadottaratṛtīyārthaḥ |
analyzed: karma kartṛ tva ādeḥ saṃbandha tvena eva eka rūpa uddeśya tā avacchedaka vidheyayoḥ aikye eva nirākāṅkṣa tayā prakṛte tad abhāvāt yat vā saṃbandhi samāna kālika padārtha saṃbandhi tvam eva saha śabda arthaḥ saṃbandhaḥ ca kartṛ tva ādiḥ eva saṃbandha tvena pūrvavat antarbhāvyaḥ putra pada uttara tṛtīyā arthaḥ

original: kartṛtvaṃ sahaśabdārthānvayabalāt pratīyamānāgamanakriyānirūpitam | ata eva śiṣyeṇa sahāgata ityādau kartṛtṛtīyayaiva siddhamiti bhāṣyasya nāsaṃgatiḥ |
analyzed: kartṛ tvam saha śabda artha anvaya balāt pratīyamāna āgamana kriyā nirūpitam atas eva śiṣyeṇa saha āgataḥ ityādau kartṛ tṛtīyayā eva siddham iti bhāṣyasya nā asaṃgatiḥ

original: pratīyamānakriyāsaṃbandhasyāpi kārakavibhaktiprayojakatvasya klaptatvāt putrasaṃbandhitādṛśapadārthasaṃbandhīyateti bodhe vṛtte āgamanasya putrasaṃbandhaṃ vinā pratītasya putrasya saṃbandhitādṛśapadārthasaṃbandhitvasyānupapattyā putre'pi na tatsaṃbandhasya manasā pratyāyyatvāt putrapadārthasya tṛtīyābodhitasvaniṣṭhakartṛtvādi- nirūpakatvasaṃbandhe
analyzed: pratīyamāna kriyā saṃbandhasya api kāraka vibhakti prayojaka tvasya klapta tvāt putra saṃbandhi tādṛśa padārtha saṃbandhīyatā iti bodhe vṛtte āgamanasya putra saṃbandham vinā pratītasya putrasya saṃbandhi tādṛśa padārtha saṃbandhi tvasya anupapattyā putre api na tad saṃbandhasya manasā pratyāyya tvāt putra padārthasya tṛtīyā bodhita sva niṣṭha kartṛ tva ādi nirūpaka tva saṃbandhe

original: sahārthaghaṭakasaṃbandhinyanvayaḥ | payasā sahaudanaṃ bhuṅke ityatra pratīyamānakriyānirūpitakarmatṛtīyāghaṭitasaṃbandhena putrasya saṃbandhinyanvayaḥ | athavā tādṛśapadārthānvayitvasamaniyatamakhaṇḍapadārthāntararūpaṃ sāhityam | śeṣaṃ pūrvavat | atra kalpe addeśyatāvacchedakavidheyayoraikyaśaṅkāpi na |
analyzed: saha artha ghaṭaka saṃbandhinī anvayaḥ payasā saha odanam bhuṅke iti atra pratīyamāna kriyā nirūpita karma tṛtīyā ghaṭita saṃbandhena putrasya saṃbandhinī anvayaḥ athavā tādṛśa padārtha anvayitva samaniyatam akhaṇḍa padārtha antara rūpam sāhityam śeṣam pūrvavat atra kalpe aikya śaṅkā api na asti

original: tādṛśasāhitya- syaivoddeśyatāvacchedakatvāt | tathā ca putrasāhityavān pitāgamanakartṛbhinna ityādibodhaḥ | etanmate prakṛtyarthasya sāhitye nirūpitatvasaṃbandhenānvayaḥ | 'saputra' iti samāsaghaṭakasahaśabdasya tu dharmiparatvam | ata eva tasya pitrādipadena samānādhikaraṇyopapattiḥ | ata eva ca 'tena saha' iti bahuvrīhividhānaṃ caritārtham |
analyzed: tādṛśa sāhitya sya eva uddeśya tā avacchedaka tvāt tathā ca putra sāhityavān pitā āgamana kartṛ bhinnaḥ ityādi bodhaḥ etad mate prakṛti arthasya sāhitye nirūpitatva saṃbandhena anvayaḥ sa putraḥ iti samāsa ghaṭaka saha śabdasya tu dharmi paratvam atas eva tasya pitṛ ādi padena samānādhikaraṇya upapattiḥ atas eva ca tena saha iti bahuvrīhi vidhānam caritārtham

original: sāhityavato'nyapadārthatvābhāvena anekam 'iti sūtrasyāprāpteḥ | sāhityamātrārthakatvāṅgīkāreṇa tu tatsūtrakhaṇḍanaṃ bhāṣyakṛtām | adhavā sahārtha sāhityam | tacca samabhivyāhṛtapadopasthāpitāgamanādipadasamāna- kālikapadatvādikameva, lāghavāt | ādipadena samānadeśatvaṃ tatsamaniyatama- khaṇḍopādhirūpaṃ vā sāhityaṃ tadarthaḥ |
analyzed: sāhityavataḥ nya padārtha tva abhāvena anekam iti sūtrasya aprāpteḥ sāhitya mātra arthaka tva aṅgīkāreṇa tu tad sūtra khaṇḍanam bhāṣyakṛtām adhavā sahārtha sāhityam tat ca samabhivyāhṛta pada upasthāpita āgamana ādi pada samāna kālika pada tva ādikam eva lāghavāt ādi padena samāna deśa tvam vā sāhityam tad arthaḥ

original: tasya cāgatādipadopasdhāpyāgamanādāvanvayaḥ | tṛtīyārthaśca kriyāsamabhivyāhāre kriyāyā yādṛśasaṃbandhaḥ pradhāne pratīyate sa eva, kartṛtvādiḥ sahārthānvayabalāt pratīyamānatattatkriyānirūpito dravyādisamabhivyāhāre sahārthanvayabalāt pratīyamānatattatpadārthanirūpitaḥ svasvāmibhāvādireva saṃbandhaḥ | tasya ca dhātvādyarthāgamanādāvanvayaḥ |
analyzed: tasya ca āgata ādi pada upasdhāpya āgamana ādau anvayaḥ tṛtīyā arthaḥ ca kriyā samabhivyāhāre kriyāyāḥ yādṛśa saṃbandhaḥ pradhāne pratīyate saḥ eva kartṛ tva ādiḥ saha artha anvaya balāt pratīyamāna tad tad kriyā nirūpitaḥ dravya ādi samabhivyāhāre saha artha anvaya balāt pratīyamāna tad tad padārtha nirūpitaḥ sva svāmi bhāva ādiḥ eva saṃbandhaḥ tasya ca dhātu ādi artha āgamana ādau anvayaḥ

original: putreṇa saha sthūla ityādau sthūlapadārthaikadeśe'pisthaulyādau vyutpattivaicitryeṇa sahārthasthaulyasamāna- kālikatvasyānvayaḥ |
analyzed: putreṇa saha sthūlaḥ ityādau sthūla padārtha eka deśepi sthaulya ādau vyutpatti vaicitryeṇa saha artha sthaulya samāna kālika tvasya anvayaḥ

original: tathāca putreṇa sahāmataḥ pitā, putreṇa saha piturgauḥ, putreṇa saha sthūla ityādau putrakartṛkāgamanasamānakālikāgamanāśrayaḥ, putrasvāmikatvasamānakālikapitṛsvāmikatvavatī gauḥ, putravṛttisthaulyasamānakālikasthaivyavānityādikrimeṇa bodhaḥ | saputra ityādau tu samudāyārthatādṛśakriyāderantarbhāvānnāsāmarthyam |
analyzed: tathā ca putreṇa saha amataḥ pitā putreṇa saha pituḥ gauḥ putreṇa saha sthūlaḥ ityādau putra kartṛkā gamana samāna kālika āgamana āśrayaḥ putra svāmika tva samāna kālika pitṛ svāmika tvavatī gauḥ putra vṛtti sthaulya samāna kālika sthaivyavān ityādi krimeṇa bodhaḥ sa putraḥ ityādau tu samudāya artha tādṛśa kriyā ādeḥ antarbhāvāt na asāmarthyam

original: vyapekṣāvāde samāsadhaṭakasahaśabdasyāgamanasamāna- kālikāgamanavān lakṣaṇayārthaḥ putrapadasya putrakartṛkatvamarthastasya cāgamane'bhedenānvayaḥ | putrasya svaniṣṭhakartṛtānirūpakatvena vā sahārthāgamane'nvayaḥ | putreṇa saha sthūla ityatra putrapadasya putrādheyatvavānarthaḥ | sahapadasya sthaulyasamānakālikasthaulyavān |
analyzed: vyapekṣā vāde samāsa dhaṭaka saha śabdasya āgamana samāna kālika āgamanavān lakṣaṇayā arthaḥ putra padasya putra kartṛka tvam arthaḥ tasya ca āgamane bhedena anvayaḥ putrasya sva niṣṭha kartṛtā nirūpaka tvena vā saha artha āgamane nvayaḥ putreṇa saha sthūlaḥ iti atra putra padasya putra ādheya tvavān arthaḥ saha padasya sthaulya samāna kālika sthaulyavān

original: pūrvapadārthasyottarapadārthe- 'ntargatasthaulye'bhadaḥ saṃsargaḥ, putrasyādheyatvena cānvayaḥ | evamanyatrāpi bodhyam | agatyā vyastasamāsavākyayorasamānākārabodhajanakatvaṃ saputra āgataḥ saputraḥ sthūla ityādau riyāyāḥ pitrādau dvedhāsaṃbandhabhānaṃ copagamyate |
analyzed: pūrva padārthasya uttara padārthe ntargata sthaulya ibha daḥ saṃsargaḥ putrasya ādheya tvena ca anvayaḥ evam anyatra api bodhyam agatyā vyasta samāsa vākyayoḥ asamāna ākāra bodha janaka tvam sa putraḥ āgataḥ sa putraḥ sthūlaḥ ityādau riyāyāḥ pitṛ ādau dvedhā saṃbandha bhānam ca upagamyate

original: putreṇa sahāgataḥ patetyatra vyartha tasya dvedhābhānamityabhiprāyeṇottarapakṣo'ṅgīkṛto bṛddhaiḥ | vakṣyamāṇarītyā nañghaṭutavākye prakṛtadhātūpasthitakriyāyāmeva putrakartṛkāgamanādisamānakālikatvabhānasyāvaśyakatvācca | yatra kṣetre māṣavāpottaraṃ tilā upyante tatra tilaiḥ saha māṣānvaya iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: putreṇa saha āgataḥ pata iti atra vyartha tasya dvedhā bhānam iti abhiprāyeṇa uttara pakṣaḥ ṅgīkṛtaḥ bṛddhaiḥ vakṣyamāṇa rītyā prakṛta dhātu upasthita kriyāyām eva putra kartṛka āgamana ādi samāna kālika tva bhānasya āvaśyaka tvāt ca yatra kṣetre māṣa vāpa uttaram tilāḥ upyante tatra tilaiḥ saha māṣa anvayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: tatra samabhivyāhṛtapadārthasamānadeśatvaṃ tadarthaḥ | atarat pūrvavat | nanu kartṛtṛtīyayaiva gatārthatā sūtrasya | na ca putraṇa sahagamanaṃ devadattasyetyatra kṛdyogalakṣaṇaṣaṣṭhībādhanārtha taditi vācyam | itarasamabhivyāhāraṃ vināpi pratīyamāne kṛtpratyayārthakartrādereva tatra grahaṇāt |
analyzed: tatra samabhivyāhṛta padārtha samāna deśa tvam tad arthaḥ atarat pūrvavat nanu kartṛ tṛtīyayā eva gatārtha tā sūtrasya na ca putraṇa saha gamanam devadattasya iti atra kṛt yoga lakṣaṇa ṣaṣṭhī bādhana artha tat iti vācyam itara samabhivyāhāram vinā api pratīyamāne kṛt pratyaya artha kartṛ ādeḥ eva tatra grahaṇāt

original: ktenāvidhānānna kartṛtṛtīyāprāptirityapi na etādṛśakartureva ktenābhidhānāditi cenna | uktarītyā putraṇa saha sthūla ityādyartha tasyāvaśyakatvāt | idaṃ tu bodhyam | pūrvamate putraṇa saha nāgacchatītyādau nañsamabhivyāhāre samabhivyāhṛtakriyādāveva sahaśahdārthasyāgamanādisamānakālikatvasyānvaya upagantavyaḥ |
analyzed: ktena avidhānāt na kartṛ tṛtīyā prāptiḥ iti api na etādṛśa kartuḥ eva ktena abhidhānāt iti ced na ukta rītyā putraṇa saha sthūlaḥ ityādi artha tasya āvaśyaka tvāt idam tu bodhyam pūrva mate putraṇa saha nā āgacchati ityādau nañ samabhivyāhāre samabhivyāhṛta kriyā ādau eva saha śahda arthasya āgamana ādi samāna kālika tvasya anvayaḥ upagantavyaḥ

original: anyathā putrānāgamanasthale putrasāhityasya pitari bādhe'pi putrasāhityavat pitṛkartṛkāgamanābhāvasyāvādhena putreṇa saha nāgacchati pitetyādiprayogasyopapattāvapi putreṇa saha nāgataḥ pitā, putreṇa saha na sthūla ityāderanupapattiḥ | tatra putrasāhityavati pitari āgamanakartṛbhadasya sthūlabhedasya ca bodho vaktavyaḥ |

original: anyakartṛkasvaviṣayakadarśanābhāvānukūlā vyavahitadeśe sthitirantarghistaddhaṭakaṃ yatkartṛkadarśanābhāvamicchati tadapādānamiti sūtrārthaḥ | līṅdhātoruktāntarghirarthaḥ | udāharaṇe icchā ākṣepalabhyā, darśane mātṛkartṛkatvaṃ pratyāsattito labhyam |
analyzed: anya kartṛka sva viṣayaka darśana abhāva anukūlā vyavahita deśe sthitiḥ antarghiḥ tad dhaṭakam yad kartṛka darśana abhāvam icchati tat apādānam iti sūtra arthaḥ līṅ dhātoḥ ukta antarghiḥ arthaḥ udāharaṇe icchā ākṣepa labhyā darśane mātṛ kartṛka tvam pratyāsattitaḥ labhyam

original: tathā ca mātrapādānakasva- karmakamarthānmātṛkartṛkaṃ yaddarśanaṃ tadabhāvānukūlastādṛśadeśāvasthitirūpo vyāpāraḥ kṛṣṇakartṛka iti bodhaḥ | anye tu kartṛtvaṃ pañcamyarthastasya dhātvarthaghaṭakadarśane nirūpakatvasaṃbandhenānvayaḥ | tathā ca mātṛkartṛkaṃ svakarmakaṃ yaddarśanaṃ tadabhāvānukūlastādṛśo vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca arthāt mātṛ kartṛkam yat darśanam tad abhāva anukūlaḥ tādṛśa deśa avasthiti rūpaḥ vyāpāraḥ kṛṣṇa kartṛkaḥ iti bodhaḥ anye tu kartṛ tvam pañcamī arthaḥ tasya dhātvartha ghaṭaka darśane nirūpaka tva saṃbandhena anvayaḥ tathā ca mātṛ kartṛkam sva karmakam yat darśanam tad abhāva anukūlaḥ tādṛśaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: sūtre 'yena' ityasābhāve yastādṛśadarśanābhāvamicchati tasyaiva syāditi 'yena' ityupāttam | nanu kartṛkarmaṇoḥ kṛti' iti ṣaṣṭhīprasaṅgād 'yena' iti nirdeśānupapattiḥ | na ca ātmana iti karmaṇo'dhyāhāreṇa 'ubhayaprāptau' iti niyamānna doṣa iti vācyam |
analyzed: sūtre yena iti asa abhāve yaḥ tādṛśa darśana abhāvam icchati tasya eva syāt iti yena iti upāttam nanu kartṛ karmaṇoḥ kṛti iti ṣaṣṭhī prasaṅgāt yena iti nirdeśa anupapattiḥ na ca ātmanaḥ iti karmaṇā udhyāhāreṇa ubhaya prāptau iti niyamāt na doṣaḥ iti vācyam

original: evaṃ sati 'atha śabdānuśāsanam' ityatrāpyācāryasya karuḥ prasiddhatayādhyāhārāvaśyakatayā 'ubhayaprāptau-' iti niyamaprasattayā 'karmaṇi ca' iti samāsaniṣedhāpatteḥ | vastutastūbhayopādāne eva niyamapravṛttiriti 'ātmamāne-' iti sūtrabhāṣye spaṣṭam | evaṃ ca prakṛte ātmana ityasyādhyāhārānna doṣa iti sustham |
analyzed: evam sati atha śabda anuśāsanam iti atra api ācāryasya karuḥ prasiddha tayā adhyāhāra āvaśyaka tayā ubhaya prāptau iti niyama prasattayā karmaṇi ca iti samāsa niṣedha āpatteḥ vastutas tu ubhaya upādāne eva niyama pravṛttiḥ iti ātma māne iti sūtra bhāṣye spaṣṭam evam ca prakṛte ātmanaḥ ityasya adhyāhārāt na doṣaḥ iti sustham

original: 'upādhyāyādadhīte' 'paṇḍitāt purāṇaṃ śrṛṇoti' atra 'ākhyātopayoge' iti sūtreṇāpādānatvam | niyamapūrvakavidyā- svīkāre sati vaktāpādānamiti tadarthaḥ | uccāraṇottarakāliko brahmacaryādirūpaniyamapūrvakagrantha- svīkārānukūlo vyāpāra iṅdhātvarthaḥ | niyamapūrvakaśravaṇapratyakṣānukūlā vyāpāraḥ śrudhātvarthaḥ |
analyzed: upādhyāyāt adhīte paṇḍitāt purāṇam śrṛṇoti atra ākhyāta upayoge iti sūtreṇa apādāna tvam niyama pūrvaka vidyā svīkāre sati vaktā apādānam iti tad arthaḥ uccāraṇa uttara kālikaḥ brahmacarya ādi rūpa niyama pūrvaka grantha svīkāra anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ iṅ dhātvarthaḥ niyama pūrvaka śravaṇa pratyakṣa anukūlā vyāpāraḥ śru dhātvarthaḥ

original: yadi niyamapūrvakavidyāsvīkārarūpopayogasya svarūpasattāyāḥ saṃjñopayogitvaṃ svīkriyate na tu tasya śābdabodhe bhānamapi tadā dhātvarthe niyamapūrvākatvaṃ nāntarbhāvyam | upādhyāyāpādānakastādṛśo vyāpāra iti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: yadi niyama pūrvaka vidyā svīkāra rūpa upayogasya svarūpa sattāyāḥ saṃjñā upayogitvam svīkriyate na tu tasya śābda bodhe bhānam api tadā dhātvarthe niyama pūrvāka tvam na antarbhāvyam upādhyāya apādānakaḥ tādṛśaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: anye tu kartruccāraṇādhīnatvaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ, uccāraṇādhīnatvamātraṃ vā, ādye pañcamyarthaghaṭakakartari prakṛtyarthasyābhedenānvayaḥ, antye svakartṛkatvasaṃbandhena pañamyarthasyoccāraṇādi-
analyzed: anye tu kartṛ uccāraṇa adhīna tvam pañcamī arthaḥ uccāraṇa adhīna tva mātram vā ādye pañcamī artha ghaṭaka kartari prakṛti arthasya abhedena anvayaḥ antye sva kartṛkatva saṃbandhena pañamī arthasya uccāraṇa ādi

original: rūpe dhātvarthe āśrayatvasaṃbandhenetyāhuḥ | brahmaṇaḥ prajāḥ prajāyante-atra 'janikartuḥ-' iti sūtreṇāpādānatvam, jananaṃ janirutpattistasyāḥ karteti ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣaḥ, tṛnnantatvānna samāsaniṣedhaḥ | na caivaṃ 'na loka-' iti ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhaprasaṅgaḥ, kārakaṣaṣṭhyā eva sa niṣedha iti siddhāntāccheṣa- ṣaṣṭhīpravṛttau bādhakābhāvāt |
analyzed: rūpe dhātvarthe āśraya tva saṃbandhena iti āhuḥ brahmaṇaḥ prajāḥ prajāyante atra jani kartuḥ iti sūtreṇa apādāna tvam jananam janiḥ utpattiḥ tasyāḥ kartā iti ṣaṣṭhī tatpuruṣaḥ tṛn anta tvāt na samāsa niṣedhaḥ na ca evam na lokaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī niṣedha prasaṅgaḥ kāraka ṣaṣṭhyāḥ eva sa niṣedhaḥ iti siddhāntāt śeṣa ṣaṣṭhī pravṛttau bādhaka abhāvāt

original: vastutastu śeṣaṣaṣṭhyāstṛjantenāpi samāsaḥsulabha iti dhyeyam | spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ manoramādau | evaṃ cotpattyāśrayasya prakṛtirūpādānakāraṇamapādānamiti sūtrārthaḥ | prakṛtiśabdasya tatraiva prasiddheḥ | māyāśabalasya brahmaṇo jagadupādānatvaṃ vedāntisiddhāntasiddham | ata eva brahmaṇo jagadupādānatve 'yato vā imāni siddhatvācca |
analyzed: vastutas tu śeṣaṣaṣṭhyāḥ tṛc antena api samāsaḥ sulabhaḥ iti dhyeyam spaṣṭam ca idam manoramā ādau evam ca utpatti āśrayasya prakṛtiḥ ūpādānakāraṇam apādānam iti sūtra arthaḥ prakṛti śabdasya tatra eva prasiddheḥ māyā śabalasya brahmaṇaḥ jagat upādāna tvam vedānti siddhānta siddham atas eva brahmaṇaḥ jagat upādāna tve yatas vā imāni siddha tvāt ca

original: putrāt pramodo'jāyata ityādāvupādānatvāropeṇa nirvāhaḥ | vṛttikṛtastadanuyāyino'nye ca putrāt pramoda ityādiprayogānurodhena prakṛtipadena hetumātraparigraha ityāhuḥ na ca dhūmādagrimānityādāviva prakṛte'pi 'vibhāṣā-' iti pañacamīsiddhau kimanena sūtreṇeti vācyam | apādānatvaprakārakabodhanirvāhārthametasyāvaśyakatvāt |
analyzed: putrāt pramodaḥ jāyate ityādau upādānatva āropeṇa nirvāhaḥ vṛtti kṛtaḥ tad anuyāyinaḥ anye ca putrāt pramodaḥ ityādi prayoga anurodhena prakṛti padena hetu mātra parigrahaḥ iti āhuḥ na ca dhūmāt agrimān ityādau iva prakṛte api vibhāṣā iti pañacamī siddhau kim anena sūtreṇa iti vācyam apādānatva prakāraka bodha nirvāha artham etasya āvaśyaka tvāt

original: anye tu hetutvātiriktasvarūpa- saṃbandhaviśeṣādhīnatvabodhe pañcamīsiddhaya idāmāvaśya, saṃbandhatvena rūpeṇa hetutvabodhanirvāhārtha cetyāhuḥ | himavato gaṅga prabhavati-atra 'bhuvaḥ prabhavaḥ' ityamenāpādānatvam | bhavanaṃ bhūḥ, saṃpadāditvāt bhāve kkip | samāsaikadeśabhūtamapi kartṛgrahaṇamanuvartate svaritatvāt |
analyzed: anye tu hetutva atirikta svarūpa saṃbandha viśeṣa adhīnatva bodhe pañcamī siddhaye saṃbandha tvena rūpeṇa hetutva bodha nirvāha artha ca iti āhuḥ himavataḥ gaṅga prabhavati atra bhuvaḥ prabhavaḥ iti amena apādānatvam bhavanam bhūḥ saṃpad ādi tvāt bhāve kkip samāsa eka deśa bhūtam api kartṛ grahaṇam anuvartate svarita tvāt

original: tathā ca bhavanakartuḥ prabhavaḥ, prabhavatyasmāditi prabhavaḥ-prathamaprakāśādhikaraṇamapādānamiti tadarthaḥ | 'prabhavo jalamūle syājjanmahetau parākrame | jñānasya cādimasthāne-' iti viśvaḥ | prabhavatītyatra prathamopalambharūpaḥ prathamaprakāśo dhātvarthaḥ | sūtre'pi bhūdhāturuktārthaka eva |
analyzed: tathā ca bhavana kartuḥ prabhavaḥ prabhavati asmāt iti prabhavaḥ prathama prakāśa adhikaraṇam apādānam iti tad arthaḥ prabhavaḥ jala mūle syāt janma hetau parākrame jñānasya ca ādima sthāne iti viśvaḥ prabhavati iti atra prathama upalambha rūpaḥ prathama prakāśaḥ dhātvarthaḥ sūtre api bhūdhātuḥ ukta arthakaḥ eva

original: prakāśapratyakṣātmaka- jñānaviṣayatvaṃ, tādṛśajñānamātraṃ vā viṣayatāsaṃbandhena | tadāśrayasya gaṅgādeḥ kartṛtvam |
analyzed: prakāśa pratyakṣa ātmaka jñāna viṣaya tvam tādṛśa jñāna mātram vā viṣayatā saṃbandhena tad āśrayasya gaṅgā ādeḥ kartṛ tvam

original: tadgataṃ prāthamyaṃ ca samānakālikatvasaṃbandhena svadhvaṃsāvijñiṣṭatvam, tādṛśaṃ jñānaṃ bhūmaṇḍalasthasya kasyacideva gaṅgāvirbhāvasamānakālikasya saṃbhavati |dakṣiṇadeśādāgatasya vindhyācale gaṅgāyāḥ prathamadarśane'pi na vindhyādito gaṅga prabhavatīti prayogaḥ, taddarśanasya tādṛśadhvaṃsāviśiṣṭatvābhāvāt |
analyzed: tad gatam prāthamyam ca samāna kālika tva saṃbandhena sva dhvaṃsa a vijñiṣṭa tvam tādṛśam jñānam bhū maṇḍala sthasya kasyacid eva gaṅgā āvirbhāva samāna kālikasya saṃbhavati dakṣiṇa deśāt āgatasya vindhya acale gaṅgāyāḥ prathama darśane api na vindhya āditaḥ gaṅga prabhavati iti prayogaḥ tad darśanasya tādṛśa dhvaṃsa a viśiṣṭa tva abhāvāt

original: jñānaṃ ca tātparyavaśānmanuyalokasthaniṣṭhameva | ato devānāṃ tādṛśajñānaviṣayatvamādāya na vaikuṇṭhādgaṅga prabhavatīti prayogāpattiḥ | apādānatvaśaktimān pañcamyartha iti mañjūṣākṛtaḥ | adhikaraṇatvaṃ pañcamyartha ityapare | saṃbandhādhīnatvaṃ tadartha iti vyutpattivādakṛtaḥ |
analyzed: jñānam ca tātparya vaśāt manuya loka stha niṣṭham eva atas devānām tādṛśa jñāna viṣayatvam ādāya na vaikuṇṭhāt gaṅga prabhavati iti prayoga āpattiḥ apādāna tva śaktimān pañcamī arthaḥ iti mañjūṣā kṛtaḥ adhikaraṇa tvam pañcamī arthaḥ iti apare saṃbandha adhīna tvam tad arthaḥ iti vyutpattivāda kṛtaḥ

original: darśanayogyatvābhāvāvacchedakadeśāvyāvahitadeśāvacchedena darśanayogyatvaṃ dhātvarthaḥ | tādātmyaṃ pañmyarthaḥ | tasya dhātvarthaghaṭakadvitīyadeśe'nvayaḥ | tathā ca himavadabhinno yo darśanayogyatvābhāvāvacchedaka- deśāvyavahitadeśastadavacchinnadarśanayogyatvavatī gaṅgeti bodha iti tārkikaratnākarakṛtaḥ |
analyzed: darśana yogya tva abhāva avacchedaka deśa avyāvahita deśa avacchedena darśana yogya tvam dhātu arthaḥ tādātmyam pañmī arthaḥ tasya dhātu artha ghaṭaka dvitīya deśe nvayaḥ tathā ca himavat abhinnaḥ yaḥ darśana yogya tva abhāva avacchedaka deśa avyavahita deśaḥ tad avacchinna darśana yogya tvavatī gaṅgā iti bodhaḥ iti tārkika ratnākara kṛtaḥ

original: kārakavādakakṛtastu-ādyabahiḥ saṃyogo dhātvarthaḥ | vahiḥ padārthaḥ prakṛte rasātalaṃ, syogadhvaṃsāvyavahitottarakṣaṇavṛttitvaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ | āśrayatvamākhyātārthaḥ |
analyzed: kāraka vādaka kṛtaḥ tu ādya bahis saṃyogaḥ dhātvarthaḥ vahis padārthaḥ prakṛte rasātalam syoga dhvaṃsa avyavahita uttara kṣaṇa vṛtti tvam pañcamī arthaḥ āśraya tvam ākhyāta arthaḥ

original: tathā ca himālayānuyogikasaṃyogadhvaṃsāvyavahitottarakṣaṇavṛttitvaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ, āśrayatvamākhyā tārthaḥ | tathā ca himālayānuyogikasaṃyogadhvaṃsāvyavahitottarakṣaṇavṛttyādyapṛthvīsaṃyogāśrayatvavatī gaṅgeti bodhaḥ | vaikuṇṭhāt prabhavati gaṅga kāśīto veti prayogavāraṇāyāvyavahitatvādyatvayo- rupādānam |
analyzed: tathā ca himālaya anuyogika saṃyoga dhvaṃsa avyavahita uttara kṣaṇa vṛtti tvam pañcamī arthaḥ āśraya tvam ākhyā ta arthaḥ tathā ca himālaya anuyogika saṃyoga dhvaṃsa avyavahita uttara kṣaṇa vṛtti ādya pṛthvī saṃyoga āśraya tvavatī gaṅgā iti bodhaḥ vaikuṇṭhāt prabhavati gaṅga vā iti prayoga vāraṇāya avyavahita tva ādya tvayoḥ upādānam

original: bhūsaṃyogasya vaikuṇṭhasaṃyogadhvaṃsāvyavahitottarakṣaṇavṛttitvābhāvāt, kāśīsaṃyogadhvaṃsā- vyavahitottarakṣaṇavṛttigaṅgābhūsaṃyogasyādyatvābhāvānna doṣa ityāhuḥ | atra prathamajñānātmakaprathama- prakāśa eva dhātvartha iti jñānasya cādimasthāna ityuktaviśvakośāllabhyate | upalabheteti
analyzed: bhū saṃyogasya vaikuṇṭha saṃyoga dhvaṃsa avyavahita uttara kṣaṇa vṛtti tva abhāvāt kāśī saṃyoga dhvaṃsāḥ vyavahita uttara kṣaṇa vṛtti gaṅgā bhū saṃyogasya ādya tva abhāvāt na doṣaḥ iti āhuḥ atra prathama jñāna ātmaka prathama prakāśaḥ eva dhātvarthaḥ iti jñānasya ca ādima sthāne iti ukta viśvakośāt labhyate upalabheta iti

original: prabhavatītyasya vṛttisthavyākhyānācca | atra āsanāt prekṣate, 'lyablope karmaṇyadhikaraṇe ca' iti pañcamī | gamyamānārthakatayāprayogo lopaḥ | evaṃ ca vyabantasyājñāne pratyāsattyā lyabantadhātvarthakarmaṇītyādirarthaḥ | lyabantasyānuccāraṇe iti tu 'lyablope' ityasya nārthaḥ | darśanābhāvasyaiva lopasaṃjñakatvāt |
analyzed: prabhavati ityasya vṛtti stha vyākhyānāt ca atra āsanāt prekṣate lyap lope karmaṇi adhikaraṇe ca iti pañcamī gamyamāna arthaka tayā aprayogaḥ lopaḥ evam ca vyap antasya ajñāne pratyāsattyā lyap anta dhātvartha karmaṇi ityādiḥ arthaḥ lyap antasya anuccāraṇe iti tu lyap lope iti asya na arthaḥ darśana abhāvasya eva lopa saṃjñaka tvāt

original: dṛśeścoccāraṇakriyatvābhāvāditi spaṣṭaṃ bṛhacchabdaratnādau | āsane upaviśya prekṣata ityarthaḥ | prāsādāt prekṣate-prāsādamāruhya prekṣata ityarthaḥ | krameṇādhikaraṇakarmaṇī pañcamyarthau | upaveśanādikriyāyā vākyaikadeśanyāyena bhānamityanyatra vistaraḥ|
analyzed: dṛśeḥ ca uccāraṇa kriyatva abhāvāt iti spaṣṭam bṛhat śabdaratna ādau āsane upaviśya prekṣate iti arthaḥ prāsādāt prekṣate prāsādam āruhya prekṣate iti arthaḥ krameṇa adhikaraṇa karmaṇī pañcamī arthau upaveśana ādi kriyāyāḥ vākya ekadeśa nyāyena bhānam iti anyatra vistaraḥ

original: āsalādhikaraṇakaṃ yadupaveśanaṃ tadavyavahitottarakālikaṃ tatsamānakartṛkaṃ prekṣaṇamityādiḥ śābdabodhaḥ | vanād grāmo yojane yojanaṃ vā atra 'yataścādhvakālanirmāṇaṃ tatra pañcamī, tadyuktādadhvanaḥ prathamāsaptamyau kālāt saptamī ca vaktavyā' iti vacanāt pañcamyādikaṃ vidhīyate |
analyzed: yat upaveśanam tad avyavahita uttara kālikam tad samāna kartṛkam prekṣaṇam ityādiḥ śābda bodhaḥ vanāt grāmaḥ yojane yojanam vā atra yatas ca adhva kāla nirmāṇam tatra pañcamī tad yuktāt adhvanaḥ prathamā saptamyau kālāt saptamī ca vaktavyā iti vacanāt pañcamyā ādikam vidhīyate

original: yadavadhitvenāśrityādhvakālānyatarasya nirmāṇaṃ paricchedaḥ pratipādyate tataḥ pañcamī, tadyuktāt - tena pañcamyantenārthadvārā yuktāt paricchedyādhvavācinaḥ prathamāsaptamyau bhavataḥ | kālādityatrāpi tadyuktādityasyānuṣaṅgaḥ | tathāvidhakālārthakāt stamīti tadarthaḥ | avyavahitottaratvaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ |
analyzed: yad avadhi tvena āśritya adhva kāla anyatarasya nirmāṇam paricchedaḥ pratipādyate tatas pañcamī tad yuktāt tena pañcamī antena artha dvārā yuktāt paricchedya adhva vācinaḥ prathamā saptamyau bhavataḥ kālāt iti atra api tad yuktāt iti asya anuṣaṅgaḥ tathāvidha kāla arthakāt tat arthaḥ avyavahita uttaratvam pañcamī arthaḥ

original: pratiyogitvasaṃbandhena prakṛtyarthānvitasyāśrayatvasaṃbandhena yojane'nvayaḥ | prathamāsaptamyoravyahitottara- vṛttitvamarthaḥ | tasya grāme āśrayatayānvayaḥ |
analyzed: pratiyogitva saṃbandhena prakṛti artha anvitasya āśraya tva saṃbandhena yojana invayaḥ prathamā saptamyoḥ avyahita uttara vṛtti tvam arthaḥ tasya grāme āśrayatayā anvayaḥ

original: evaṃ ca vanāvyavahitottarayojanāvyavahitottaradeśavṛttirgrāma iti bodhaḥ | kārtikyā āgrahāyaṇī māse ityatrāvayavaghaṭitatvaṃ pañcamyā arthaḥ, avyavahitottarakālavṛttitvaṃ saptamyāḥ, kārtikīrūpa- prakṛtyarthasya tādātmyasaṃbandhena pañcamyarthaghaṭakāvayave'nvayaḥ | kārtikyavayavaghaṭitamāsā- vyavahitottarakālavṛttirāgrahāyaṇīti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: evam ca vana avyavahita uttara yojana avyavahita uttara deśa vṛttiḥ grāmaḥ iti bodhaḥ kārtikyāḥ āgrahāyaṇī māse iti atra avayava ghaṭita tvam pañcamyāḥ arthaḥ avyavahita uttara kāla vṛtti tvam saptamyāḥ kārtikī rūpa prakṛti arthasya tādātmya saṃbandhena pañcamī artha ghaṭaka avayava invayaḥ kārtikī avayava ghaṭita māsā vyavahita uttara kāla vṛttiḥ āgrahāyaṇī iti bodhaḥ

original: pūrvatra prathamāsaptamyoratra ca saptamyā avyavahitottaratva- mātraṃ vārthaḥ | tasyāśrayatvasaṃbandhena grāme'nvayaḥ | yojanādhikavyavadhāne vanād grāma ityaprayogāttatra pañcamyarthe'vyavadhānāṃśaniveśaḥ | yojanīttaravibhattayarthe'pyata eya tanniveśaḥ | māse ityatra saptamyarthe tadantarbhāvo'pyetadarthameva |
analyzed: pūrvatra prathamā saptamyoḥ atra ca saptamyāḥ avyavahita uttaratva mātram vā arthaḥ tasya āśraya tva saṃbandhena grāme nvayaḥ yojana adhika vyavadhāne vanāt grāmaḥ iti aprayogāt tatra pañcamī arthe vyavadhāna aṃśa niveśaḥ yojanī uttara vibhatta yarthe ipi atas tad niveśaḥ māse iti atra saptamī arthe tad antarbhāvaḥ api etad artham eva

original: anyathā kārtikyāḥ pauṣī māse ityāderapyāpatteḥ | kārtikīghaṭita- māsottaravṛttitvasya pauṣyāmapi sattvāt | kārtikyā iti pañcamyā vanādityatrevāvyavahitottaratvaṃ nārthaḥ | kārtikyavyavahitotaramāsāvyavahitottaravṛttitvasyāgrahāyaṇyāmasaṃbhavāduktaprayogānupapatteḥ | ubhayatra pañcamyā avadhitvamarthaḥ |
analyzed: anyathā kārtikyāḥ pauṣī māse ityādeḥ api āpatteḥ kārtikī ghaṭita māsa uttara vṛtti tvasya pauṣyām api sattvāt kārtikyāḥ iti pañcamyāḥ vanāt iti atra iva avyavahita uttaratvam na arthaḥ kārtikya vyavahita utara māsa avyavahita uttara vṛtti tvasya ā grahāyaṇyām asaṃbhavāt ukta prayoga anupapatteḥ ubhayatra pañcamyāḥ avadhitvam arthaḥ

original: vanāvadhikayojanāvyahitottaradeśavṛttirgrāma ityākārako bodha iti śābdikaratmākarakṛtaḥ | yojanādyarthe jñāte niyamenāvadhyākāṅkṣāyāḥ sattvānnāsaṃbhava iti bhāvaḥ | kārtikyā ityādāvapi nārthāsaṃgatiḥ taddharmavato'pi taddharmāvadhitvāt, yathābhividhāviti bhāvaḥ | ghaṭādanya ityādau svapratiyogikabhedasaṃbandhaḥ pañcamyarthaḥ |
analyzed: vana avadhika yojana avyahita uttara deśa vṛttiḥ grāmaḥ iti ākārakaḥ bodhaḥ iti śābdika ratmākara kṛtaḥ yojana ādi arthe jñāte niyamena avadhya ākāṅkṣāyāḥ sattvāt na asaṃbhavaḥ iti bhāvaḥ kārtikyāḥ ityādau api na artha asaṃgatiḥ tad dharmavataḥ api tad dharma avadhi tvāt yathā abhividhau iti bhāvaḥ ghaṭāt anyaḥ ityādau sva pratiyogika bheda saṃbandhaḥ pañcamī arthaḥ

original: tena saṃbandhena prakṛtyarthasyānyasminnanvayaḥ, ata eva nātraikadeśānvayaprasaktiḥ | ata eva devadattasya putra ityādau janyatvādeḥ ṣaṣṭhayarthatvamabhyupayanti śābdikāḥ | anyādiśabdena bhedādyavagatanirākāṅkṣatvaṃ na prakāratayā, tadbodhe eva nirākāṅkṣatvena saṃsargatayā bodhe nirākāṅkṣatvavirahāt |
analyzed: tena saṃbandhena prakṛti arthasya anyasmin anvayaḥ atas eva na atra eka deśa anvaya prasaktiḥ atas eva devadattasya putraḥ ityādau janya tva ādeḥ ṣaṣṭhayartha tvam abhyupayanti śābdikāḥ anya ādi śabdena bheda ādi avagata nirākāṅkṣa tvam na prakāratayā tad bodhe eva nirākāṅkṣa tvena saṃsargatayā bodhe nirākāṅkṣa tva virahāt

original: svapratiyogikatvamityasya prakṛtyarthatāvacchedakāvacchinnapratiyogitākatvamityarthaḥ | tena ghaṭe'pi ghaṭāntaramādāya ghaṭo ghaṭādanya iti prayogāpattiḥ | svapadena ghaṭatvādiviśiṣṭatattadvayaktyupādāne'pi dvitvādinā tatpratiyogika- bhedamādāya taddoṣastadavastha iti dūṣaṇaṃ prayuktam | anye tu pratiyogitvaṃ pratiyogimatt‌vaṃ vā pañcamyarthaḥ |
analyzed: sva pratiyogika tvam iti asya prakṛti artha tā avacchedaka avacchinna pratiyogitāka tvam iti arthaḥ tena ghaṭe api ghaṭa antaram ādāya ghaṭaḥ ghaṭāt anyaḥ iti prayoga āpattiḥ sva padena ghaṭa tva ādi viśiṣṭa tad tad vayakti upādāne api dvi tva ādinā tad pratiyogika bhedam ādāya tad doṣaḥ tad avasthe iti dūṣaṇam prayuktam anye tu pratiyogitvam pratiyogimattvam vā pañcamī arthaḥ

original: pratiyogitve prakṛtyarthatāvacchedakāvacchinnādheyatvasaṃbandhena prakṛtyarthasya prakṛtyarthānvitasya nirūpakatvasaṃbandhena bhede taddhaṭitasaṃbandhena tadvati vānvayaḥ | dvitīyapakṣenuyogitā- svarūpe
analyzed: pratiyogitve prakṛti artha tā avacchedaka avacchinna ādheyatva saṃbandhena prakṛti arthasya prakṛti artha anvitasya nirūpaka tva saṃbandhena bhede tad haṭita saṃbandhena tadvati vā anvayaḥ dvitīya pakṣa inuyogitā svarūpe

original: pratiyogimattve prakṛtyarthatāvacchedakāvacchinnanirūpitatvasaṃbandhena prakṛtyarthasyānvayaḥ, tasya cāśrayatvasaṃbandhena bhede ekadeśe'pyanvayo vyutpattivaicivyād vispaṣṭapaṭurityatra pāṭave yathā vyutpattivaicivyādanvayaḥ |
analyzed: pratiyogimat tve prakṛti artha tā avacchedaka avacchinna nirūpita tva saṃbandhena prakṛti arthasya anvayaḥ tasya ca āśraya tva saṃbandhena bhede eka deśe api anvayaḥ vyutpatti vaicivyāt vispaṣṭa paṭuḥ iti atra pāṭave yathā vyutpatti vaicivyāt anvayaḥ

original: ata eva mukhyasāmānādhikaraṇyābhāvād, 'viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇa' iti karmadhārayo na ki tu supsupeti samāso vispaṣṭādīnīti jñāpakādveti spaṣṭaṃ 'prāk kaḍārāt samāsaḥ' ita sūtre bhāṣyakaiyaṭayoḥ | taddhaṭitasaṃbandhena bhedavati vānvaya ityāhuḥ | anyetyartha- grahaṇamata eva ghaṭādbhinna iti prayogasiddhiḥ |
analyzed: atas eva mukhya sāmānādhikaraṇya abhāvāt viśeṣaṇam viśeṣyeṇa iti karmadhārayaḥ na ki tu sup supā iti samāsaḥ vispaṣṭa ādīni iti jñāpakāt vā iti spaṣṭam prāk kaḍārāt samāsaḥ sūtre bhāṣya kaiyaṭayoḥ tad ghaṭita saṃbandhena bhedavati vā anvayaḥ iti āhuḥ anya ityartha grahaṇam atas eva ghaṭāt bhinnaḥ iti prayoga siddhiḥ

original: ghaṭasya bheda ityatra tu na pañcamīprasaktiḥ | bhedaviśiṣṭārthakasyaiva grahaṇāt anyaśabdasya viśiṣṭārthakatvāt | itaragrahaṇametadarthasūcakamevetyabhi- pretyaiva prapañcārthamityuktaṃ kaumudyām |
analyzed: ghaṭasya bhedaḥ iti atra tu na pañcamī prasaktiḥ bheda viśiṣṭa arthakasya eva grahaṇāt anya śabdasya viśiṣṭa arthaka tvāt itara grahaṇam etad artha sūcakam eva iti abhi pretya eva prapañca artham iti uktam kaumudyām

original: ata eva ghaṭo netyatra na tadāpattistasya dyotakatvāṅgīkārācceti prāñcaḥ | navyaśābdikamate tu nārthagrahaṇaṃ bhāṣyānuktatvāt | ghaṭādbhinna ityatra pañcamīnirvāhastu prāgukta evetyalam | kṛṣṇādṛte duḥkham, atra kṛṣṇaśabdastadbhaktilākṣaṇikaḥ | ṛteśabdārthaḥ saṃsargābhāvaḥ |
analyzed: atas eva ghaṭaḥ na iti atra na tad āpattiḥ tasya dyotaka tva aṅgīkārāt ca iti prāñcaḥ navya śābdika mate tu na artha grahaṇam bhāṣya anukta tvāt ghaṭāt bhinnaḥ iti atra pañcamī nirvāhaḥ tu prāk uktaḥ eva iti alam kṛṣṇāt ṛte duḥkham atra kṛṣṇa śabdaḥ tad bhakti lākṣaṇikaḥ ṛte śabda arthaḥ saṃsarga abhāvaḥ

original: pratiyogitāsaṃbandhena prakṛtyarthānvitasya tasya sāmānādhikaraṇyasaṃbandhena tatsthe duḥkhe'nvayaḥ | abhāve pratiyogivaiyadhikaraṇyaṃ niveśanīyamanyathārādhyatvaprakārakajñānātmakabhakteravyāpyavṛttitayā tadabhāva- sāmānādhikaraṇyasya sukhe'pi sattvena kṛṣṇādṛte sukhamiti prayogāpattiḥ | kkacit prayuktatvasaṃbandhenaivānvayaḥ |
analyzed: pratiyogitā saṃbandhena prakṛti artha anvitasya tasya sāmānādhikaraṇya saṃbandhena tad sthe duḥkha invayaḥ abhāve pratiyogi vaiyadhikaraṇyam niveśanīyam anyathā ārādhya tva prakāraka jñāna ātmaka bhakteḥ avyāpya vṛtti tayā tad abhāva sāmānādhikaraṇyasya sukhe api sattvena kṛṣṇāt ṛte sukham iti prayoga āpattiḥ kkacid prayuktatva saṃbandhena eva anvayaḥ

original: ata eva vṛṣṭeṛte sukhamiti na | anyathā vṛṣṭeḥ kṣetrādau sattve'pi tadabhāvasyātmani sattvena syāttathā prayogaḥ | svadeśāt śatroḥ prayāṇādṛte devadattasya duḥkhamityādau prayuktatvabodhasyānubhavasiddhatvādāvaśyakatvācca |
analyzed: atas eva vṛṣṭeḥ ṛte sukham iti na anyathā vṛṣṭeḥ kṣetra ādau sattve api tad abhāvasya ātmani sattvena syāt tathā prayogaḥ sva deśāt śatroḥ prayāṇāt ṛte devadattasya duḥkham ityādau prayuktatva bodhasya anubhava siddhatvāt āvaśyaka tvāt ca

original: anyathā śatroḥ prayāṇe satyapi tadabhāvasya devadateta sattvena tadīyavyādhyādiprayuktaduḥkhe tādṛśaprayāṇābhāvasāmānādhikaraṇyamādāya durvāratvāt | evaṃ daṇḍādṛte na ghaṭa itivadrāsabādṛte na ghaṭa ityādiprayogāpattirapyata eva na | daṇḍābhāvaprayuktatvasya ghaṭābhāve'bādhitatvavadrāsabhābhāvaprayuktatvasyābādhitatvavirahāt |
analyzed: anyathā śatroḥ prayāṇe sati api tad abhāvasya devadateta sattvena tadīya vyādhi ādi prayukta duḥkhe tādṛśa prayāṇa abhāva sāmānādhikaraṇyam ādāya durvāra tvāt evam daṇḍāt ṛte na ghaṭaḥ iti vat rāsabāt ṛte na ghaṭaḥ iti ādi prayoga āpattiḥ api atas eva na daṇḍa abhāva prayukta tvasya ghaṭa abhāve bādhita tva vat rāsabha abhāva prayukta tvasya abādhita tva virahāt

original: sāmānādhikaraṇyasaṃbandhasya saṃsargatve tu syādevoktaprayogāpattiḥ | prayuktatvasaṃbandhenaiva tasyānvaya iti niyamastu na vahnoṛte parvatarūpābhāva ityādau tadasaṃbhavādityalam |
analyzed: sāmānādhikaraṇya saṃbandhasya saṃsarga tve tu syāt evā ukta prayoga āpattiḥ prayuktatva saṃbandhena eva tasya anvayaḥ iti niyamaḥ tu na vahnoḥ ṛte parvata rūpa abhāvaḥ ityādau tad asaṃbhavāt iti alam

original: ṛte vātādvṛkṣaḥ patati, atrābhāvastadvānvā tadarthaḥ | vātābhāvaviśiṣṭavṛkṣasya patane saṃbandhāvagatau patane vā tajjanyatvābhāvalābha ārthaḥ | janyatvaśabdādanupasthitasyābhāvapratiyogitayā bhānāsaṃbhavājjanyatvasya vṛttyaniyāmakatayā tatsaṃbandhāvacchinnapratiyogitākavātābhāvabodho'pi na saṃbhavati |
analyzed: ṛte vātāt vṛkṣaḥ patati atra abhāvaḥ tadvān vā tad arthaḥ vāta abhāva viśiṣṭa vṛkṣasya patane saṃbandha avagatau patane vā tad janya tva abhāva lābhaḥ ārthaḥ janya tva śabdāt anupasthitasya abhāva pratiyogitayā bhāna asaṃbhavāt janya tvasya vṛtti aniyāmaka tayā tad saṃbandha avacchinna pratiyogitāka vāta abhāva bodhaḥ api na saṃbhavati

original: vātapadasya vātajanyatvalakṣaṇāyāṃ tu tadāśrayaṇameva doṣaḥ | bhedavānapi ṛteśabdārthaḥ | yathā rāmādṛte na dhanurdhara ityatra | rāmabhinno dhanurdharabhinna iti bodhaḥ | ghaṭādanya ityatroktaprakāraḥ sarvo'pyatrāvagantavyaḥ | etadyoge dvitīyāpi 'tato'nyatrāpi dṛśyate' ityatra dṛśigrahaṇāt | ata eva cāndrā 'ṛte dvitīyā ca' iti sūtrayanti |
analyzed: vāta padasya vāta janya tva lakṣaṇāyām tu tad āśrayaṇam eva doṣaḥ bhedavān api ṛte śabda arthaḥ yathā rāmāt ṛte na dhanurdharaḥ iti atra rāma bhinnaḥ dhanurdhara bhinnaḥ iti bodhaḥ ghaṭāt anyaḥ iti atra ukta prakāraḥ sarvaḥ api atra avagantavyaḥ etad yoge dvitīyā api tatas nyatra api dṛśyate iti atra dṛśi grahaṇāt atas eva cāndrāḥ ṛte dvitīyā ca iti sūtrayanti

original: ata eva 'puruṣārādhanamṛte' iti prayogo'pi sādhurbhavati | tena ṛte vātaṃ vṛkṣaḥ patatītyapi bhavati | pūrvo grāmāttaḍāgaḥ atra 'anyarāt-' iti sūtreṇa pañcamī | atra pūrvaśabdasyādigvṛttitve'pi śabdagrahaṇasāmarthyāddiśi dṛṣṭamātrasya grahaṇāt | udayā- calasaṃnihitadeśaḥ pūrvapadārthaḥ | avadhitvaṃ pcamyarthaḥ |
analyzed: atas eva puruṣa ārādhanam ṛte iti prayogaḥ api sādhuḥ bhavati tena ṛte vātam vṛkṣaḥ patati iti api bhavati pūrvaḥ grāmāt taḍāgaḥ atra iti sūtreṇa pañcamī atra pūrva śabdasya a diś vṛtti tve pi śabda grahaṇa sāmarthyāt diśi dṛṣṭa mātrasya grahaṇāt udayā cala saṃnihita deśaḥ pūrva padārthaḥ avadhi tvam pcamī arthaḥ

original: avadhitvasākāṅkṣo dharmāviśeṣaḥ pūrvatvam | sa cākhaṇḍopādhiḥ | evaṃ paratvādyapi | grāmāvadhitānirūpakapūrvatvavānityādikrameṇa bodhaḥ | caitrāt pūrvaḥ phālgunaḥ-atra pratiyogitaddhvaṃsānadhikaraṇakāla eva bhāsate tattadavadhibodhakapadasamabhivyāhāra- sācivyāt | caitrāvadhikapūrvatvavatkālabhavaḥ phālguna iti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: avadhi tva sākāṅkṣaḥ dharma aviśeṣaḥ pūrvatvam sa ca akhaṇḍa upādhiḥ evam paratva ādi api grāma avadhitā nirūpaka pūrvatvavān ityādi krameṇa bodhaḥ caitrāt pūrvaḥ phālgunaḥ atra pratiyogi tad dhvaṃsa anadhikaraṇa kālaḥ eva bhāsate tad tad avadhi bodhaka pada samabhivyāhāra sācivyāt caitra avadhika pūrva tva vat kāla bhavaḥ phālgunaḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: taddhvaṃsamātrānadhikaraṇabhavasya
analyzed: tad dhvaṃsa mātra anadhikaraṇa bhavasya

original: pūrvatvena rūpeṇa vācyatve caitrāt pūrvaścaitra iti prayogāpattiḥ | tatpratiyogimātrānadhikaraṇabhavasya tathātve vaiśākhācaitrādirūpapratiyogyādyantarbhāveṇa śaktyaṅgīkāre śattayānantyam | pratiyogitvādirūpeṇevāntarbhāve'prasiddhirityādidoṣabhayāt tādṛśakālabhavasya pūrvatvenaiva śaktiraṅgīkṛtā |
analyzed: pūrva tvena rūpeṇa vācya tve caitrāt pūrvaḥ caitraḥ iti prayoga āpattiḥ tad pratiyogi mātra anadhikaraṇa bhavasya tathātve vaiśākhā caitra ādi rūpa pratiyogi ādi antarbhāveṇa śakti aṅgīkāre śat tayā ānantyam pratiyogitva ādi rūpeṇa iva antarbhāve prasiddhiḥ ityādi doṣa bhayāt tādṛśa kāla bhavasya pūrva tvena eva śaktiḥ aṅgīkṛtā

original: kālasya kriyāmātraparicchedakatvāt phālgunādinānvayo na syādatasta- dbhavamyāntarbhāvaḥ | pūrvādiśabdasya tatra lakṣaṇā | lakṣaṇābhāve tu caitrāt pūrva phālguna ityeva prayogaḥ | adhikaraṇaśaktipradhānamavyayam | astītvāderadhyāhāraḥ | anye tu grāmāt pūrva ityatrodayācalāvadhikāparatvāśrayaḥ | pūrvaśabdārthaḥ, pañcamyāḥ paratvanirūpakatvamarthaḥ |
analyzed: kālasya kriyā mātra paricchedaka tvāt phālguna ādinā anvayaḥ na syāt atas tad bhavamyā antarbhāvaḥ pūrva ādi śabdasya tatra lakṣaṇā lakṣaṇa abhāve tu caitrāt pūrva phālgunaḥ iti eva prayogaḥ adhikaraṇa śakti pradhānam avyayam asti iti ādeḥ adhyāhāraḥ anye tu grāmāt pūrvaḥ iti atra udaya acalau adhika aparatva āśrayaḥ pūrva śabda arthaḥ pañcamyāḥ paratva nirūpaka tvam arthaḥ

original: tathā ca grāmavṛttiparatvanirupakaṃ yadudayācalāvadhikamaparatvaṃ tadāśraya iti bodhaḥ | caitrādityādyudāharaṇe pūrvaśabdaḥ prāgagabhāvāśrayārthakaḥ | pratiyogitvārthikā pañcamī | prāgabhāvānaṅgīkāre tu dhvaṃsapratiyogo purvaśabdārthaḥ | ādheyatvaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ | tasya ca dhvaṃse'nvayaḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca grāma vṛtti paratva nirupakam yat udaya acalau adhikam aparatvam tad āśrayaḥ iti bodhaḥ caitrāt ityādi udāharaṇe pūrva śabdaḥ prāgagabhāva āśraya arthakaḥ pratiyogitva arthikā pañcamī prāgabhāva anaṅgīkāre tu dhvaṃsa pratiyogaḥ purva śabda arthaḥ ādheya tvam pañcamī arthaḥ tasya ca dhvaṃsa anvayaḥ

original: caitrapratiyogikaprāgabhāvāśrayaḥ phālguna ityādyākāro bodha ityāhuḥ | atra mate prāgabhāvādeḥ sāvadhikatvābhāvena tadarthakapūrvaśabdasyāvadhyākāṅkṣārthakatvaṃ na syāt, tathā ca vyavasthābhāve sarvanāmatā na syāt | na ca pratiyogyākaṅkṣāsattvādeva tathātvopapattiriti vācyam |
analyzed: caitra pratiyogika prāgabhāva āśrayaḥ phālgunaḥ ityādi ākāraḥ bodhaḥ iti āhuḥ atra mate prāgabhāva ādeḥ sāvadhika tva abhāvena tad arthaka pūrva śabdasya avadhya ākāṅkṣā arthaka tvam na syāt tathā ca vyavasthā bhāve sarvanāmatā na syāt na ca pratiyogi ākaṅkṣā sattvāt eva tathātva upapattiḥ iti vācyam

original: prati- yogitvāvadhitvarthobhedāt, pūrvatvasya sāvadhikatvānmanmate nānupapattirityāhuḥ śābdikāḥ | caitrāt paro vaiśākhaḥ-caitradhvaṃsādhikaraṇakālabhavaḥ paratvena paraśabdārthaḥ | avadhitve pañcamī | 'gṛhādgaṅga mama parā kāśyāḥ saivāparā mama' ityādau viprakṛṣṭadeśasthasaṃnikṛṣṭadeśasthau paratvāparatvābhyāṃ parāparaśabdapratipādyau |
analyzed: prati yogitva avadhi tu arthaḥ bhedāt pūrvatvasya sāvadhika tvāt mad mate nā anupapattiḥ iti āhuḥ śābdikāḥ caitrāt paraḥ vaiśākhaḥ caitra dhvaṃsa adhikaraṇa kāla bhavaḥ paratvena para śabda arthaḥ avadhi tve pañcamī gṛhāt gaṅga mama parā kāśyāḥ sā eva aparā mama ityādau viprakṛṣṭa deśa stha saṃnikṛṣṭa deśa sthau paratva aparatvābhyām para apara śabda pratipādyau

original: gṛhāvadhikamatsaṃbandhiparatvavatī gaṅgetyādi krameṇa bodhaḥ | paratvādiniṣṭhaḥ svasaṃbandhaḥ svasaṃyuktasaṃyogaparaṃparāśrayāśritatvādyātmakaḥ madhyavati gṛhaṃ svasaṃbandhyanyasaṃbandhi vetyanyadetat | yasya tadarthe utthitākāṅkṣā pratyāsattyā tannimittakavibhaktestadvācakādeva svīkārāt | parādipadaṃ cāvadhāveva niyatākāṅkṣamiti spaṣṭameva |
analyzed: gṛhau adhika mad saṃbandhi paratvavatī gaṅgā ityādi krameṇa bodhaḥ paratva ādi niṣṭhaḥ sva saṃbandhaḥ sva saṃyukta saṃyoga paraṃparā āśraya āśrita tva ādi ātmakaḥ madhyavati gṛham sva saṃbandhi anya saṃbandhi vā iti anyat etat yasya tad arthe utthita ākāṅkṣā pratyāsattyā tad nimittaka vibhakteḥ tad vācakāt eva svīkārāt para ādi padam ca avadhau eva niyata ākāṅkṣam iti spaṣṭam eva

original: prāgādayaḥ pūrvādinā vyākhyātāḥ | sadhyuṅ caitreṇetyādau tu pañcamīsāhaṭaryeṇa digvācakasyaivāñcūttarapadasya pañcamīnimittatvābhyupagamāt | grāmādvahniḥ samabhivyāhṛtapadārtha- tāvacchedakānāśrayastatsthaṃ ca bahiṣṭarūpopādhinocyate | anāvṛtadeśa ityanenāpyayamevārtho'bhipretaḥ | ata eva dravyādbahirbhūto guṇa ityādyupapadyate |
analyzed: prāk ādayaḥ pūrva ādinā vyākhyātāḥ caitreṇa ityādau tu pañcamī sāhaṭaryeṇa diś vācakasya eva āñcu uttara padasya pañcamī nimitta tva abhyupagamāt grāmāt vahniḥ samabhivyāhṛta padārtha tā avacchedaka anāśrayaḥ tad stham ca anāvṛta deśaḥ iti anena api ayam eva arthaḥ abhipretaḥ atas eva dravyāt bahis bhūtaḥ guṇaḥ ityādi upapadyate

original: kāśīto bahirbhūtamitaṃ gṛhamiti ca | bahiḥśabdena pañcamī samāsavidhānajñāpitātra pañcamī | jñāpakasiddhasyāsārvatrikatvena 'karasya karabho bahiḥ' iti siddhamityāhuḥ | apa hareḥ pari hareḥ saṃsāra ityatrāpaparī ṛteśabdasamānārthau | 'apaparī varjane' iti karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā | 'pañcamyapāṅparibhiḥ' iti pañcamī | hariśabdo haribhaktilākṣaṇikaḥ |
analyzed: bahis bhūta mitam gṛham iti ca bahis śabdena pañcamī samāsa vidhāna jñāpitā atra pañcamī jñāpaka siddhasya a sārvatrika tvena karasya karabhaḥ bahis iti siddham iti āhuḥ apa hareḥ pari hareḥ saṃsāre iti atra apa parī ṛte śabda samāna arthau apa parī varjane iti karmapravacanīya saṃjñā pañcamī apa āṅ paribhiḥ iti pañcamī hari śabdaḥ hari bhakti lākṣaṇikaḥ

original: haribhattayabhāvasamānādhikaraṇastatprayojyo vā saṃsāraḥ | saṃsāro janmādi | apare tu atyantābhāvo'nayorarthaḥ, pañcamyā ādheyatvam | tasya cātyantābhāve'nvayo'tyantābhāvasya pratiyāgitayā saṃsāre | harivṛttyatyantābhāvapratiyogī saṃsāra iti bodhaḥ | apa pṛthivyā gandhābhāva ityādau tathaivānubhavāditi vadanti |
analyzed: samāna adhikaraṇaḥ tad prayojyaḥ vā saṃsāraḥ saṃsāraḥ janma ādi apare tu arthaḥ pañcamyāḥ ādheya tvam tasya pratiyāgitayā saṃsāre hari vṛtti atyanta abhāva pratiyogī saṃsāraḥ iti bodhaḥ pṛthivyāḥ gandha abhāvaḥ ityādau tathā eva anubhavāt iti vadanti

original: teṣāmayamāśayaḥ pṛthivyabhāvasamānādhikaraṇo gandhabhāva iti bodhābhyupagamo na saṃbhavi | apa pṛthivyāḥ snehābhāva ityāderapyāpatteḥ |
analyzed: teṣām ayam āśayaḥ pṛthivī abhāva samāna adhikaraṇaḥ gandha bhāvaḥ iti bodha abhyupagamaḥ na saṃbhavi apa pṛthivyāḥ sneha abhāvaḥ ityādeḥ api āpatteḥ

original: atha pṛthivyabhāvaprayukto gandhābhāva iti bodhaḥ svīkriyate snehādyabhāvaśca na tatprayukta iti nātiprasaṅga iti cet, hetu- tāvacchedakasaṃbandhāvacchinnahetvabhāvasyaiva kāryābhāvaprayojakatayā saṃyogādisaṃbandhāvacchinnatatadabhāvasya tathātvāsaṃbhavāditi prathivyanyonyābhāvaprayuktatvabodhābhyupagame tu noktadoṣa iti bodhyam |
analyzed: atha pṛthivī abhāva prayuktaḥ gandha abhāvaḥ iti bodhaḥ svīkriyate sneha ādi abhāvaḥ ca na tad prayuktaḥ iti na atiprasaṅgaḥ iti ced hetu tā avacchedaka saṃbandha avacchinna hetu abhāvasya eva kārya abhāva prayojaka tayā saṃyoga ādi saṃbandha avacchinna tad abhāvasya tathātva asaṃbhavāt iti prathivī anyonya abhāva prayuktatva bodha abhyupagame tu na ukta doṣaḥ iti bodhyam

original: āmukteḥ saṃsāraḥ āṅo'tra maryādārthaḥ | kāladeśabhedena maryādā dvividhā | kālagataṃ maryādātvaṃ svasvottarakālobhayaprāgabhāvādhikaraṇayāvatkālabhavo yaḥ samabhivyāhṛtapadārthastada- nadhikaraṇatvam | muktipadaṃ tadadhikaraṇakālaparam, maryādāmaryādibhāvasaṃbandhaḥ pañcamyarthaḥ sa evāṅdyotyaḥ | muktimaryādakaḥ saṃsāra iti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: āmukteḥ saṃsāraḥ āṅaḥ utra maryādā arthaḥ kāla deśa bhedena maryādā dvividhā kāla gatam maryādā tvam sva sva uttarakāla ubhaya prāgabhāva adhikaraṇa yāvat kāla bhavaḥ yaḥ samabhivyāhṛta padārthaḥ tad anadhikaraṇa tvam mukti padam tad adhikaraṇa kāla param maryādā maryādi bhāva saṃbandhaḥ pañcamī arthaḥ saḥ eva āṅ dyotyaḥ mukti maryādakaḥ saṃsāraḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: muktikālaprāgabhāvādinirūpitaṃ yanmuktikālatatprāgabhāvakālānyakālavṛttitvaviśiṣṭavyāpakatvaṃ saṃsāre tadbodhastvārthikaḥ |
analyzed: mukti kāla prāgabhāva ādi nirūpitam yat mukti kāla tad prāgabhāva kāla anya kāla vṛttitva viśiṣṭa vyāpakatvam saṃsāre tad bodhaḥ tu ārthikaḥ

original: tādṛśakālavṛttitvasyārthikabodhanirvāhārthameva taduttarakālaprāgabhāvopādānaṃ kṛtam |tādṛśaprāgabhāvādhi- karaṇakāle samabhivyāhṛtakālaprāgabhāvānadhikaraṇatvamapi praveśyam, tena sāvitrī jaaidardhāstamite maṇḍale ā nakṣatradarśanāditi prayoge japaniṣṭhatathāvidhapragabhāvānirūpitavyāpakatvabhānānirvāhaḥ, anyathā
analyzed: tādṛśa kāla vṛtti tvasya ārthika bodha nirvāha artham eva tad uttara kāla prāgabhāva upādānam kṛtam tādṛśa prāgabhāva adhi karaṇa kāle samabhivyāhṛta kāla prāgabhāva anadhikaraṇa tvam api praveśyam tena maṇḍale ā nakṣatra darśanāt iti prayoge japa niṣṭha tathāvidha pragabhāva anirūpita vyāpaka tva bhāna anirvāhaḥ anyathā

original: tatparāgabhāvasyārdhāstamitapūrvakāle'pi sattvena tadavyāpakatvasya bādhena tadanirvāhāt | atra vastugatyā yastādṛśaviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭaḥ samabhivyāhṛtapadārthastadadhikaraṇabhedarūpaṃ tadanadhikaraṇatvaṃ samabhivyāhṛtapadārthabhedādhikaraṇabhedatvena rūpeṇocyate saṃbandhatvena veti na śattayānantyaṃ, maryāditvaṃ ca tathāvidhamaryādātvanirūpakatvamiti
analyzed: tad parāgabhāvasya ardhāstamita pūrva kāle api sattvena tad avyāpaka tvasya bādhena tad anirvāhāt atra vastugatyā yaḥ tādṛśa viśeṣaṇa viśiṣṭaḥ samabhivyāhṛta padārthaḥ tad adhikaraṇa bheda rūpam tad anadhikaraṇa tvam samabhivyāhṛta padārtha bheda adhikaraṇa bheda tvena rūpeṇa ucyate saṃbandha tvena vā iti na maryādi tvam ca tathāvidha maryādā tva nirūpaka tvam iti

original: bodhayam | tārkikaratnākārakṛtastu samānakālikatvābhāvaḥ kālikamavyavadhānaṃ cāṅā pratyāyyate | tādṛgavyavadhānaṃ tatprāgabhāvādhikaraṇakṣaṇaprāgabhāvānadhikaraṇatve sati tatprāgabhāvādhikaraṇabhūto yaḥ kṣaṇastadvṛttitvam | prāghabhāvānabhyupagame tu tadadhikaraṇakṣaṇotpattikadhvaṃsapratiyogikṣaṇavṛttitvaṃ pratiyogitvaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tārkikaratnākāra kṛtaḥ tu samāna kālika tva abhāvaḥ kālikam avyavadhānam ca āṅā pratyāyyate tādṛś avyavadhānam tad prāgabhāva adhikaraṇa kṣaṇa prāgabhāva anadhikaraṇa tve sati tad prāgabhāva adhikaraṇa bhūtaḥ yaḥ kṣaṇaḥ tad vṛttitvam prāghabhāva anabhyupagame tu tad adhikaraṇa kṣaṇa utpattika dhvaṃsa pratiyogi kṣaṇa vṛttitvam pratiyogitvam pañcamī arthaḥ

original: tathā ca muktisamānakālikavābhāvavān muttavyavahitaḥ saṃsāra iti bodha ityāhuḥ | atra mate saṃsāre muttayuttarakālāvṛttitvasyārthika eva lābha iti bodhyam | na ca tadabhāne'pi na kṣatiriti vācyam | madhyāhnottaraṃ tatpūrva cādhyayane madhye'vasāne ā madhyāhnādadhīta iti prayogāpatteḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca mukti samāna kālika vā abhāvavān mutta vyavahitaḥ saṃsāraḥ iti bodhaḥ iti āhuḥ atra mate saṃsāre muttay uttara kāla avṛtti tvasya ārthikaḥ eva lābhaḥ iti bodhyam na ca tad abhāne pi na kṣatiḥ iti vācyam madhyāhna uttaram ca adhyayane madhye vasāne ā madhyāhnāt adhīte iti prayoga āpatteḥ

original: pratidinaṃ sāyaṃkālaparyantamadhyayanakartari ā sāyaṃkālādadhīte ityādi tu dhātostattadadhyayanaparatvena nirvāhyam | avyavahitottarakālaviśeṣo vottarakāletyanena vivakṣaṇīyaḥ | atra mate prātaḥkāle sāyaṃkālavyavahitapūrvakāle eva jape prātarārabhyā sāyaṃkālājjapatīti prayogāpattiriti tu draṣṭavyam |
analyzed: pratidinam sāyaṃkāla paryantam adhyayana kartari ā sāyaṃkālāt adhīte ityādi tu dhātoḥ tad tad adhyayana paratvena nirvāhyam avyavahita uttara kāla viśeṣaḥ vā uttara kāla iti anena vivakṣaṇīyaḥ atra mate prātar kāle sāyaṃkāla vyavahita pūrva kāle eva jape prātar ārabhya ā sāyaṃkālāt japati iti prayoga āpattiḥ iti tu draṣṭavyam

original: apare tu maryādātvaghaṭakaḥ prāgabhāva evāṅo'rthaḥ | muktipadaṃ muktikālaparaṃ pañcamyāḥ pratiyogitvaṃ vācyam | evaṃ ca muttayadhikaraṇakālapratiyogikaprāgabhāvalābhaḥ | tasya svasvottarakālāvṛttitva- sahitavyāpakatvasaṃbandhena saṃsāre'nvayaḥ ityāhuḥ | prayāgāt prabhṛtyā kāśyā vṛṣṭo deva ityādau deśarūpā maryādā |
analyzed: apare tu maryādā tva ghaṭakaḥ prāgabhāvaḥ eva āṅaḥ arthaḥ mukti padam mukti kāla param pañcamyāḥ pratiyogitvam vācyam evam ca muttaya adhikaraṇa kāla pratiyogika prāgabhāva lābhaḥ tasya sva sva uttara kāla avṛttitva sahita vyāpaka tva saṃbandhena saṃsāra invayaḥ iti āhuḥ prayāgāt prabhṛtyā kāśyāḥ vṛṣṭaḥ devaḥ ityādau deśa rūpā maryādā

original: maryādātvaṃ ca svasvottaradeśayoganaṣṭhaṃ kāśīprayāgobhayāntarā- likayāvaddeśavṛttisamabhivyāhṛtapadārthavṛṣṭyādyanadhikaraṇatvam | uttaradeśāvṛttitādṛśasamabhivyāhṛta- padārthānadhikaraṇatvaṃ tanniṣṭhaṃ maryādātvamiti tu parasārthaḥ | uttaradeśe tadanadhikaraṇatvaniveśāt kāśītaḥ pūrvadeśe'pi vṛṣṭisadbhāve na tādṛśaprayogāpattiḥ |
analyzed: maryādā tvam ca sva sva uttara deśa yoga naṣṭham kāśī prayāga ubhaya antarā lika yāvat deśa vṛtti samabhivyāhṛta padārtha vṛṣṭi ādi anadhikaraṇa tvam uttara deśa avṛtti tādṛśa samabhivyāhṛta padārtha anadhikaraṇa tvam tad niṣṭham maryādā tvam iti tu para sārthaḥ uttara deśe tad anadhikaraṇa tva niveśāt kāśītaḥ pūrva deśe api vṛṣṭi sadbhāve na tādṛśa prayoga āpattiḥ

original: pāṭaliputrāt pūrvadeśe vṛṣṭisattve kāśīpāṭaliputrāntarāle tadasattve prayāgakāśīmadhyadeśe vṛṣṭisattvadaśāyāmuktaprayogasya prāmāṇikatve uttaraśabdenāvyavahitottaradeśo grāhyaḥ | vṛṣṭipadaṃ vā vṛṣiṭiviśeṣaparaṃ, prayāgapadottaraṃ pañcamī prabhṛtyarthayoge | tathā ca prayāgādikāśīmaryādakavṛṣṭikatā deva iti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: pāṭaliputrāt pūrva deśe vṛṣṭi sattve kāśī pāṭaliputra antarāle tad asattve prayāga kāśī madhya deśe vṛṣṭi sattva daśāyām ukta prayogasya prāmāṇika tve uttara śabdena avyavahita uttara deśaḥ grāhyaḥ vṛṣṭi padam vā prayāga pada uttaram pañcamī prabhṛti artha yoge tathā ca prayāga ādi kāśī maryādaka vṛṣṭika tā devaḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: prayāgādhikaramakaprārambhikā kāśīprayāgobhayāntarālikayāvaddeśaniṣṭhaṃ yatkāśītaduttaradeśaliṣṭhābhāva- pratiyogyadhikaraṇatvaṃ tannirūpikā yā vṛṣṭistatkarteti yāvat | pañcamyarthamaryādātvaśarīre kāśyuttaradeśe samabhivyāhṛtapadārthānadhikaraṇatvāntarbhāvo'nanyagatikatayā svīkāryaḥ | evaṃ sati nānārthātve iṣṭāpattiriti bhāva |
analyzed: prayāga adhika ramaka prārambhikā kāśī prayāga ubhaya antarālika yāvat deśa niṣṭham yat kāśī tad uttara deśa liṣṭa abhāva pratiyogi adhikaraṇa tvam tad   yā vṛṣṭiḥ tad kartā iti yāvat pañcamī artha maryādā tva śarīre kāśi uttara deśe samabhivyāhṛta padārtha anadhikaraṇa tva antarbhāvaḥ ūnanyagatikatayā svīkāryaḥ evam sati nānārthātve iṣṭa āpattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: vastutastu ubhayavidhamaryādātvānugamakaṃ maryādātvaṃ dharmaviśeṣa- rūpam
analyzed: vastutas tu ubhayavidha maryādā tva anugamakam maryādā tvam dharma viśeṣa rūpam

original: | evaṃ ca na nānārthatvaprasaktiḥ, ata eva kāśīmaryādaketi bodhapradarśanamabhiyuktaiḥ kriyate | dharmaviśeṣarūpamaryādātvasyānaṅgīkāre tu pūrvoktarītiratrāpyanusaṃdheyā | prayāgādikāśīpaścimadeśa- nirūpitaṃ yatsubhikṣadeśaviśeṣāvṛttitvaviśiṣṭavyāpakatvaṃ tadbādhastvārthaḥ | tādṛśavyāpakatvasya śabdādanupasthiteḥ |
analyzed: evam ca na nānārthatva prasaktiḥ atas eva kāśī maryādaka iti bodha pradarśanam abhiyuktaiḥ kriyate dharma viśeṣa rūpa maryādā tvasya anaṅgīkāre tu pūrvokta rītiḥ atra api anusaṃdheyā prayāga ādi kāśī paścima deśa nirūpitam yat subhikṣa deśa viśeṣa avṛtti tva viśiṣṭa vyāpakatvam tat bādhaḥ tu ārthaḥ tādṛśa vyāpakatvasya śabdāt anupasthiteḥ

original: kāśīpadottarapañcamyā vyāpakatvārthakatvāṅgīkāreṇa nirvāha iti tu na, vyāpakatvasya vyāpyaviśeṣāghaṭitasya durvacatvāt, tadghaṭakapadārtheṣu khaṇḍaśaḥ śaktisvīkāre gauravaṃ vyāpyasyānupasthitāviṣṭānirvāhaśca | vyāpyaviśeṣāntarbhāveṇa śaktau śatayānantyamityādikaṃ bodhyam | abhividhistatparyantamabhivyāptiḥ, tatpadenāvadhiḥ |
analyzed: kāśī pada uttara pañcamyāḥ vyāpakatva arthaka tva aṅgīkāreṇa nirvāhaḥ iti tu na vyāpaka tvasya vyāpya viśeṣa aghaṭitasya durvaca tvāt tad ghaṭaka padārtheṣu khaṇḍaśas śakti svīkāre gauravam vyāpyasya anupasthitau iṣṭa anirvāhaḥ ca vyāpya viśeṣa antarbhāveṇa śaktau śatayā ānantyam iti ādikam bodhyam abhividhiḥ tad paryantam abhivyāptiḥ tad padena avadhiḥ

original: apare tu kārtikītaścaitramityatrottarakālapūrvatvaṃ kāśītaḥ pāṭalīputramityatra pūrvadeśapaścimatvaṃ yāvacchabdārthaḥ | avadhitvaṃ dvitīyārthaḥ | tasya yāvacchabdārthe'nvayaḥ | uttarakālapūrvatvasya vyāpakatvasaṃbandhena śītabhavane'nvayaḥ | vyāpakatvaghaṭakottarakālapūrvatvādhikaraṇe samabhivyāhṛta- kārtikyādipūrvakālabhedo niveśyaḥ |

original: dvitīye'pi pūrvadeśapaścimatvasya vyāpakatvasaṃbandhena vṛṣṭāvanvayaḥ | atrāpi vyāpakatvaghaṭakapūrvadeśapaścimatvādhikaraṇe kāśī paścimadeśabhedo niveśyaḥ |

original: etādṛśavyāpakatvabhāne kārtīkīpūrvakālādyavṛttitvamarthāt siddhaṃ bhavatītyalamativistareṇa | āṅghaṭitodāharaṇe'pīdaṃ sarva bodhyamityāhuḥ | kārtikyā iti pañcamī tu prabhṛtyarthayoganimittakā | ārabhyetyarthakamavyayaṃ prabhṛtīti | 'yataścādhvakāla ' iti vārtikapratyākhyānāya bhāṣye 'idamatra prayoktavyaṃ sanna prayumīti vacanasattvaṃ sūcitam |
analyzed: etādṛśa vyāpaka tva bhāne kārtīkī pūrva kāla ādya vṛtti tvam arthāt siddham bhavati iti alam ati vistareṇa āṅghaṭita udāharaṇe api idam sarva bodhyam iti āhuḥ kārtikyāḥ iti pañcamī tu prabhṛti artha yoga nimittakā ārabhya iti arthakam avyayam prabhṛti iti yatas ca adhva kālaḥ iti vārtika pratyākhyānāya bhāṣye idam atra prayoktavyam sat na vacana sattvam sūcitam

original: tena tadaprayo'pi pañcamīsiddhiḥ, avadhimādāyeti tadarthaḥ | avadhitvena svīkṛtyeti yāvat | ārabhyetyasya tadarthakatāgrahaṇamātrārthakatā ca | ādye pañcamī, dvitīye prātaḥkālamārabhyetyādau karmatvād dvitīyā | avadhitvaṃ ca bhavāt prabhṛti sevyo harirityatra samabhivyāhṛtapadārthamaraṇāntakālāpekṣamityanyatra vistaraḥ | avadhitvaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tena tad aprayopi pañcamī siddhiḥ avadhim ādāya iti tad arthaḥ avadhi tvena svīkṛtya iti yāvat ārabhya iti asya tad arthaka tā grahaṇa mātra arthaka tā ca ādye pañcamī dvitīye prātar kālam ārabhya ityādau karma tvāt dvitīyā avadhi tvam ca bhavāt prabhṛti sevyaḥ hariḥ iti atra samabhivyāhṛta padārtha maraṇa anta kāla apekṣam iti anyatra vistaraḥ avadhi tvam pañcamī arthaḥ

original: pradyumnaḥ kṛṣṇāt prati atra 'pratiḥ pratinidhipratidānayoḥ' iti prateḥ karmapravacanīyasaṃjñā | 'pratinidhipratidāne ca yasmāt' iti sūtreṇa pañcamī | yasmāditi ṣaṣṭhyarthe sūtre pañcamī, yatsaṃbandhī yatpratiyogī pratinidhiḥ pratidānaṃ vā karmapravacanīyayuktatadarthakāt pañcamīti sūtrārthaḥ, pratiyogitvarūpasaṃbandhaḥ sūtrasya pañcamyarthaḥ |
analyzed: pradyumnaḥ kṛṣṇāt prati atra pratiḥ pratinidhi pratidānayoḥ iti prateḥ karmapravacanīya saṃjñā pratinidhi pratidāne ca yasmāt iti sūtreṇa pañcamī yasmāt iti ṣaṣṭhī arthe sūtre pañcamī yad saṃbandhī yad pratiyogī pratinidhiḥ pratidānam vā karmapravacanīya yukta tad arthakāt pañcamī iti sūtra arthaḥ pratiyogi tva rūpa saṃbandhaḥ sūtrasya pañcamī arthaḥ

original: priḥ sadṛśārthakaḥ | kṛṣṇāditi pañcamyāḥ pratiyogitvamarthaḥ, kṛṣṇapratiyogikasādṛśyavāniti bodhaḥ, tilebhyaḥ pratiyacchati māṣān | grahaṇapūrvakaṃ pratyarpaṇaṃ pratidānam, tatra gṛhītarṇajanyā dṛṣṭadhvaṃsaphalakadānātmakaṃ pratisamabivyāhṛtayacchaterarthaḥ |
analyzed: priḥ sadṛśa arthakaḥ kṛṣṇāt iti pañcamyāḥ pratiyogitvam arthaḥ kṛṣṇa pratiyogika sādṛśyavān iti bodhaḥ tilebhyaḥ pratiyacchati māṣān grahaṇa pūrvakam pratyarpaṇam pratidānam tatra gṛhīta ṛṇa janyā dṛṣṭa dhvaṃsa phalaka dāna ātmakam pratisamabivyāhṛta yacchateḥ arthaḥ

original: tilagrahaṇapūrvakaṃ māṣakarmakapratidānamiti bodhaḥ, karmatvā maḥ saṃbandhaḥ pañcamyarthaḥ, tasya dhātvarthaghaṭakagrahaṇe'nvayaḥ |
analyzed: tila grahaṇa pūrvakam māṣa karmaka pratidānam iti bodhaḥ karma tvā maḥ saṃbandhaḥ pañcamī arthaḥ tasya dhātvartha ghaṭaka grahaṇena ayaḥ

original: tārkikaratnākarakṛtastu ṛṇatvadhvaṃsajanakatvaṃ praterarthaḥ, tasyāśrayatvenādāne'nvayaḥ, pañcamyā ādānajanyatvamartha ṛṇatānvayī ṛṇatvaṃ padārthāntaraṃ pāpaviśeṣo vā, tilādānajanyarṇatvadhvaṃsajanakamāṣadānakarmetyādyākāro bodha ityabhyupayanti sma | śatādbaddhaḥ 'akartṛryṛṇe pañcamī' iti sūtreṇātra pañcamī |
analyzed: tārkika ratnākara kṛtaḥ tu ṛṇa tva dhvaṃsa janaka tvam prateḥ arthaḥ tasya āśraya tvena ādāne anvayaḥ pañcamyāḥ ādāna janya tvam arthaḥ ṛṇatā anvayī ṛṇa tvam padārtha antaram pāpa viśeṣaḥ vā tila ādāna janya ṛṇa tva dhvaṃsa janaka māṣa dāna karma ityādi ākāraḥ bodhaḥ iti abhyupayanti sma śatāt baddhaḥ a kartṛri ṛṇe pañcamī iti sūtreṇa atra pañcamī

original: kartṛbhinnaṃ hetubhūtaṃ yadṛṇaṃ tadvācakāt pañcamīti tadarthaḥ hetuhetumadbhāvo hetutvaṃ hetumattvaṃ vā pañcamyarthaḥ | śatahetukaṃ bandhanakarmeti bodhaḥ | ṛṇatvaṃ tu vastusannimita na tu tasya vācyakoṭāvantarbhāva ityāhuḥ | tasya vācyatvaṃ na yuktaṃ gauravāttadbodhasyānubhavādvetyāhuḥ |
analyzed: kartṛ bhinnam hetu bhūtam yat ṛṇam tad vācakāt pañcamī iti tad arthaḥ hetu hetumat bhāvaḥ hetu tvam hetumat tvam vā pañcamī arthaḥ śata hetukam bandhana karma iti bodhaḥ ṛṇa tvam tu na tu tasya vācya koṭau antarbhāvaḥ iti āhuḥ tasya vācya tvam na yuktam gauravāt tad bodhasya anubhavāt vā iti āhuḥ

original: śatena bandhita iti pratyudāharaṇe hetumaṇṇya tāt karmaṇi ktaḥ | śatamiha ṛṇaṃ prayojakakartṛ 'tatprayojakaḥ ' iti hetusaṃjñaṃ ca | jāḍyādvaddha ityatra 'vibhāṣā guṇe ' iti vaikalpikī pañcamī | pakṣe hetutṛtīyā | jāḍyahetukabandhanakarmeti bodhaḥ, dhūmādagnimānityādo jñānaniṣṭhajanyajanakabhāvasya viṣaye āropāt pañcamītyāhurmañjūṣākṛtaḥ |
analyzed: śatena bandhitaḥ iti pratyudāharaṇe karmaṇi ktaḥ śatam iha ṛṇam prayojaka kartṛ tad prayojakaḥ iti hetu saṃjñam ca jāḍyāt vaddhaḥ iti atra vibhāṣā guṇe iti vaikalpikī pañcamī pakṣe hetu tṛtīyā jāḍya hetuka bandhana karma iti bodhaḥ dhūmāt agnimān ityādaḥ jñāna niṣṭha janya janaka bhāvasya viṣaye āropāt pañcamī iti āhuḥ mañjūṣā kṛtaḥ

original: etatpakṣe dhūmahetuko vahniriti bodhaḥ | etena bhūmādervahnayādyajanakatve'pi pañcamyanupapattinirastā | jñāpakasyāpi hetupadena grahaṇamiti tu na yuktam | 'heturnā kāraṇaṃ bījam' iti kośena hetupadasya kāraṇārthakatvaniścayāt | loke tatra prayogābhāvācca | dhūmapadaṃ dhūmajñānaparam | agnimatpadaṃ svajñānaviṣaye lākṣaṇikamiti laghuśekhare |
analyzed: etad pakṣe dhūma hetukaḥ vahniḥ iti bodhaḥ etena bhūma ādeḥ vahnayā ādi ajanakatve pi pañcamī anupapattiḥ nirastā jñāpakasya api hetu padena grahaṇam iti tu na yuktam hetuḥ nā kāraṇam bījam iti kośena hetu padasya kāraṇa arthaka tva niścayāt loke tatra prayoga abhāvāt ca dhūma padam dhūma jñāna param agnimat padam sva jñāna viṣaye lākṣaṇikam iti laghuśekhare

original: etanmate dhūmajñānahetukavahnimajjñānaviṣayaparvata iti bodhaḥ | maṇikṛtastu-vahnipadaṃ vahnijñānalākṣaṇikaṃ, dhūmapadaṃ dhūmajñānalākṣaṇikaṃ hetutvaṃ janakatvarūpaṃ pañcamyarthaḥ | prakṛtyartha dhūmajñānāndhitasya tasya nirūpakatāsaṃbandhena vahnipadārthahnijñāne'nvayaḥ |
analyzed: etad mate dhūma jñāna hetuka vahnimat jñāna viṣaya parvataḥ iti bodhaḥ maṇi kṛtaḥ tu vahni padam vahni jñāna lākṣaṇikam dhūma padam dhūma jñāna lākṣaṇikam hetu tvam janaka tva rūpam pañcamī arthaḥ prakṛti artha dhūma jñāna andhitasya tasya nirūpaka tā saṃbandhena vahni padārtha hni jñāna anvayaḥ

original: matuvartho viṣayatāvān iṣayatā vā vahnipadalakṣaṇā vā āśrayatvasaṃbandhī matuvarthaḥ | athavā vahnipadaṃ jñāyamānavahnilākṣaṇikaṃ matuvarthaḥ saṃyogīti svīcakuḥ | anayormañjūṣāśekharoktayoḥ pakṣayomadhye jñānagatajanyajanakabhāvasya viṣaya āropa ityeva pakṣaḥ samyagiti pratibhāti |
analyzed: viṣayatāvān vā vahni pada lakṣaṇā vā āśraya tva saṃbandhī matup arthaḥ athavā vahni padam jñāyamāna vahni lākṣaṇikam matup arthaḥ saṃyogī iti svīcakuḥ anayoḥ mañjūṣāśekhara uktayoḥ pakṣayoḥ madhye jñāna gata janya janaka bhāvasya viṣayaḥ āropaḥ iti eva pakṣaḥ samyak iti pratibhāti

original: dīdhitikārādayastu jñānajñāpyatvaṃ pañcamyartho dhūmapadaṃ mukhyārthakameva | ata evodeharaṇādivākye na dhūmasyaiva gamakatā-
analyzed: dīdhitikāra ādayaḥ tu jñāna jñāpya tvam pañcamī arthaḥ dhūma padam mukhya arthakam eva atas eva udeharaṇa ādi vākye na dhūmasya eva gamaka tā

original: mātuḥ smaratītyādau ca kriyākārakabhāvasya viṣaśerūpeṇa bodhābhyupagame bādhakadvitīyādyāpattyā saṃbandhatvenaiva tasya bodha upeyata iti navyāḥ śābdikāstārkikāśca miśrā- dikāḥ | prāñcastvatrāpi kriyākārakabhāvamūlakaṃ viśeṣaṇatvarūpaṃ, viṣayatvaṃ nimittatvaṃ vā saṃbandhatvena, viśeṣarūpeṇa vā pratīyate | ata eva

original: ityanena saṃbandhasya kriyākārakabhāvamūlakatvamabhyadhāyi bhartaharibhiḥ | sarvatraiva hi saṃbandhasta- nmūlakaḥ | rājñaḥ pūruṣa ityatra svasvāmibhāvasaṃbandhaḥ kriyākārakabhāvapūrvakaḥ | 'yataḥ rājā pūruṣāya dravyaṃ dadāti tato'sau purūṣasya svāmībhavati' iti bhāṣyādau spaṣṭam |
analyzed: iti anena saṃbandhasya kriyā kāraka bhāva mūlaka tvam abhyadhāyi bharta haribhiḥ sarvatra eva hi saṃbandhaḥ tad mūlakaḥ rājñaḥ pūruṣaḥ iti atra sva svāmi bhāva saṃbandhaḥ kriyā kāraka bhāva pūrvakaḥ yatas rājā pūruṣāya dravyam dadāti tatas asau purūṣasya svāmībhavati iti bhāṣya ādau spaṣṭam

original: kriyā hi siddhasvābhāvānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ kriyāṃ vinā parasparasaṃbandhamabhajatāṃ niḥśrayaṇīva saṃbandhaṃ karotīti spaṣṭaṃ bhāṣyakaiyaṭādau | bhātuḥ smaratītyādau kriyā śrutā, rājñaḥ puruṣa ityādau tvaśrutā dānādikriyānumīyate ityāhuḥ | vistarastu mañjūṣāto'nusaṃdheyaḥ |
analyzed: kriyā hi siddha sva abhāvānām dravyāṇām kriyām vinā paraspara saṃbandham abhajatām niḥśrayaṇī iva saṃbandham karoti iti spaṣṭam bhāṣya kaiyaṭa ādau bhātuḥ smarati ityādau kriyā śrutā rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ ityādau tu aśrutā dāna ādi kriyā anumīyate iti āhuḥ vistaraḥ tu mañjūṣātaḥ nusaṃdheyaḥ

original: svasvāmibhāvadisaṃbandhasya dviniṣṭhatve'pi viśeṣaṇavācakādeva rājādiśabdāt ṣaṣṭhī, na tu purūṣādiśabdāt, prakṛtyartha pri pratyayārthasya prādhānyānurodhāt, tathā hi rājādiḥ saṃbandhe viśeṣaṇaṃ, sa ca purūṣe viśeṣaṇam, rājasaṃbandho purūṣa iti bodhāt |

original: ṣaṣṭhyarthasaṃbandhasya saṃsargatayaiva bhānāmiti bhāṣyamate'pi prakāratāyāḥ sāṃsargikaviṣayatāviśeṣyato- bhayanirūpyatayā prakāratānirūpakaviṣayatāśālitvarūpaprādhānyamakṣatameva | na hīdaṃ purūṣādiśabdāt ṣaṣṭhyāṃ satyāṃ nirvahati | kiṃ ca viśeṣyapurūṣādau kārakaprātipadikārthānyataratvasyāvaśyakatve nāśeṣatvānna tadvācakāt ṣaṣṭhītyāhuḥ |
analyzed: ṣaṣṭhī artha saṃbandhasya saṃsarga tayā eva bhānām iti bhāṣya mate pi prakāratāyāḥ sāṃsargika viṣayatā viśeṣyataḥ bhaya nirūpya tayā prakāratā nirūpaka viṣayatā śāli tva rūpa prādhānyam akṣatam eva na hi idam purūṣa ādi śabdāt ṣaṣṭhyām satyām nirvahati kim ca viśeṣya purūṣa ādau kāraka prātipadika artha anyataratvasya āvaśyaka tve na aśeṣatvāt na tad vācakāt ṣaṣṭhī iti āhuḥ

original: pare tu śabdaśaktisvabhāvādviśeṣaṇa eva saṃbandha udbhūtatayā pratīyata iti ṣaṣṭhī | taduktaṃ haribhiḥ
analyzed: pare tu śabda śakti svabhāvāt viśeṣaṇe eva saṃbandhaḥ udbhūta tayā pratīyate iti ṣaṣṭhī tat uktam haribhiḥ

original: parārthatvād - guṇānāṃ paraṃ prati viśeṣaṇatayā vivakṣitatvāt | ayaṃ bhāvaḥ prakāratāyāabhedasya saṃbandhatvānaṅgīkartṛnaye nīlo ghaṭa ityādau vyabhicāra iti bhedasāhityānusaraṇam | bhedasahitāyāḥ saṃbandhaniyatatayā viśeṣaṇe eva tadākāṅkṣodayena tatra eva saṃbandha udbhūtatayā pratīyata iti tatraiva ṣaṣṭhī padamādadhāti |
analyzed: para artha tvāt guṇānām param prati viśeṣaṇatayā vivakṣita tvāt ayam bhāvaḥ prakāratāyāḥ abhedasya saṃbandha tva an aṅgīkartṛ naye nīlaḥ ghaṭaḥ ityādau vyabhicāraḥ iti bheda sāhitya anusaraṇam bheda sahitāyāḥ saṃbandha niyata tayā viśeṣaṇe eva tad ākāṅkṣā udayena tatra eva saṃbandhaḥ udbhūta tayā pratīyate iti tatra eva ṣaṣṭhī padam ādadhāti

original: viśeṣyasya tu padāntarāsaṃnidhāne svaniṣṭhatvādeva na viśeṣyatāniyāmakasaṃbandhākāṅkṣā | svaniṣṭhatvaṃ ca svārthapravṛttinimittanirūpitā- viśeṣyatayā bhāsamānatvaṃ, tacchālitvaṃ vā | apradhāne ṣaṣṭhyādināṃśataḥ pratītipathāvatīrṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ prādhānopayogyapi bhavati, tasya dviniṣṭhatvāt |
analyzed: viśeṣyasya tu pada antara asaṃnidhāne sva niṣṭhatvāt eva na viśeṣyatā niyāmaka saṃbandha ākāṅkṣā sva niṣṭhatvam ca svārtha pravṛtti nimitta nirūpitā viśeṣyatayā bhāsamāna tvam tad śāli tvam vā apradhāne ṣaṣṭhī ādinā aṃśataḥ pratīti pathā avatīrṇaḥ saṃbandhaḥ prādhāna upayogī api bhavati tasya dvi niṣṭhatvāt

original: rājādipadasāhitye pratīyamānarājādinirūpita- viśeṣyatāyā upakārako bhavatīti yāvat | ṣaṣṭhyāntarājapadasattve eva tadarthanirūpitaviśeṣyatā- śālī, tāda-śaviśeṣyatāvattvena bodhaviṣayo vā bhavati, rājña ityādestu puruṣādipadāsattve'pi adhyāha-tasaṃbandhisāmānyanirūpitaviśeṣaṇatvapratitiriti viśeṣaḥ |
analyzed: rāja ādi pada sāhitye pratīyamāna rāja ādi nirūpita viśeṣyatāyāḥ upakārakaḥ bhavati iti yāvat ṣaṣṭhyā anta rāja pada sattve eva tad artha nirūpita viśeṣyatā śālī tādaśa viśeṣyatā vattvena bodha viṣayaḥ vā bhavati rājñaḥ ityādeḥ tu puruṣa ādi pada asattve pi adhyāhata saṃbandhi sāmānya nirūpita viśeṣaṇa tva pratitiḥ iti viśeṣaḥ

original: rājña ityetāvatā svāmitvamava- gamyamānamanyathānupapattyā puruṣe svatvaṃ gamayati | ataḥ saṃbandhasya bahiraṅgatvāt puruṣādantaraṅgatvāt prathamaiva, ata eva svatvasvāmitvādisamūhasyaiva saṃbandhatayā tasyaiva vibhattayarthatvaṃ,
analyzed: rājñaḥ iti etāvatā svāmi tvam ava gamyamānam anyathā anupapattyā puruṣe svatvam gamayati atas saṃbandhasya bahis aṅga tvāt puruṣāt antar aṅga tvāt prathamā eva atas eva svatva svāmi tva ādi samūhasya eva saṃbandha tayā tasya eva vibhattayartha tvam
