original: na svatvādimātrasya, dviniṣṭhatvābhāvāt | svatvasya nirūpakatayā svāmivṛttitvena tattvamanapavādamiti tu na vācyam, nirūpakatvasya vṛttyaniyamākatayā svāminastadvattvāsaṃbhavāt, spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ sarva prakṛtasūtrabhāṣyādāviti prāhuḥ |
analyzed: na svatva ādi mātrasya dvi niṣṭha tva abhāvāt svatvasya nirūpakatayā svāmi vṛtti tvena tattvam anapavādam iti tu na vācyam nirūpakatvasya svāminaḥ tadvattva asaṃbhavāt spaṣṭam ca idam prakṛta sūtra bhāṣya ādau iti prāhuḥ

original: puruṣasya viśeṣaṇatvavivakṣāyāṃ tato ṣaṣṭhī bhavatyevāṅgānāṃ rājetivat, śeṣapadasyāpradhānārtha- katvamabhyupagamya puruṣapadāt ṣaṣṭhīvāraṇaṃ tu na samyak, śuklaḥ paṭa ityādau śuklādestatprasaṅgāt | bhedasaṃbandhāvacchinnaviśeṣaṇatārūpaprādhānyapuraskāre tu nāyaṃ doṣa iti pratibhāti |
analyzed: puruṣasya viśeṣaṇa tva vivakṣāyām ṣaṣṭhī bhavati eva aṅgānām rājā iti vat śeṣa padasya apradhāna artha ka tvam abhyupagamya puruṣa padāt ṣaṣṭhī vāraṇam tu na samyak śuklaḥ paṭaḥ ityādau śukla ādeḥ tad prasaṅgāt bheda saṃbandha avacchinna viśeṣaṇatā rūpa prādhānya puraskāre tu na ayam doṣaḥ iti pratibhāti

original: atredaṃ bodhyam saṃyogasaṃbandhenādhikaraṇakārakasya saṃbandhatvena na vivakṣā, ata eva 'tadasyāstyasmin-' iti sūtre 'vṛkṣavān parvata' ityādiprayogasiddhaye saptamyupāttā, 'gomān devadatta' ityādyartha ca ṣaṣṭhīti tatsūtre bhāṣye uktam |
analyzed: atra idam bodhyam saṃyoga saṃbandhena adhikaraṇa kārakasya saṃbandha tvena na vivakṣā atas eva tat asya asti asmin iti sūtre vṛkṣavān parvataḥ ityādi prayoga siddhaye saptamī upāttā gomān devadattaḥ ityādi artha ca ṣaṣṭhī iti tad sūtre bhāṣye uktam

original: nanvadhi brahmadatte pañcālā ityatrādhikaraṇasaptamī 'ādhṛtāste tatra bhavanti' ityādinā granthena 'yasmādadhikam-' iti bhāṣye svīkṛtā, tadvadatrāpi gāvaḥ santyasminniti saptamī bhaviṣyatīti kimartha ṣaṣṭhyupādānamiti cenna | svasvāmibhāvavivakṣāyāmapi gomānityādiprayogasiddhaye tadupādānāditi mañjūṣāyāṃ vistaraḥ | annasya hetorvasati |
analyzed: nanu adhi brahmadatte pañcālāḥ iti atra adhikaraṇa saptamī ādhṛtāḥ te tatra bhavanti ityādinā granthena yasmāt adhikam iti bhāṣye svīkṛtā tadvat atra api gāvaḥ santi asmin iti saptamī bhaviṣyati iti kimartha ṣaṣṭhī upādānam iti ced na sva svāmi bhāva vivakṣāyām api gomān ityādi prayoga siddhaye tad upādānāt iti mañjūṣāyām vistaraḥ annasya hetoḥ vasati

original: 'ṣaṣṭhī hetuprayoge' iti sūtreṇātra ṣaṣṭhī, hetuśabdaprayoge tasmāttatsamānādhikaraṇācca ṣaṣṭhīti tadarthaḥ | 'hetoḥ' itṣuktau hetuśabdādeva syānna tu viśeṣyānnavācakāditi tathā nāsūtri | hetuhetumadbhāvaḥ saṃbandhaḥ ṣaṣṭhyarthaḥ | annahetuko vāsa iti bodhaḥ | hetuśabdo'traiva tātparyagrāhakaḥ | evamannena hetunā vasatītyādāvapi bodhyam |
analyzed: ṣaṣṭhī hetu prayoge iti sūtreṇa atra ṣaṣṭhī hetu śabda prayoge tasmāt tad samāna adhikaraṇāt ca ṣaṣṭhī iti tad arthaḥ hetoḥ hetu śabdāt eva syāt na tu viśeṣya anna vācakāt iti tathā na asūtri hetu hetumat bhāvaḥ saṃbandhaḥ ṣaṣṭhī arthaḥ anna hetukaḥ vāsaḥ iti bodhaḥ hetu śabdaḥ utra eva tātparya grāhakaḥ evam annena hetunā vasati ityādau api bodhyam

original: vibhaktiḥ prayojanaṃ hetuṃ ca yathāyathamabhidhatte | prayojanatvādiprakārako bodha ityanye |
analyzed: vibhaktiḥ prayojanam hetum ca yathāyatham abhidhatte prayojana tva ādi prakārakaḥ bodhaḥ iti anye

original: kṛṣṇasya kṛtiḥ, jagataḥ kartā kṛṣṇaḥ, atra 'kartṛkarmaṇoḥkṛti' iti ṣaṣṭhī | tadarthaścakartā karma | kṛṣṇakartṛkā kṛtiḥ, jagatkarmakakṛtyāśraya iti bodhaḥ | tārkikamate kartṛtvaṃ karmatvamarthaḥ | prakṛtyarthasya tatrādheyatvasaṃbandhenānvayaḥ | kartṛtvādinirūpakatāsaṃbandhena dhātvarthe'nvayaḥ |
analyzed: kṛṣṇasya kṛtiḥ jagataḥ kartā kṛṣṇaḥ atra kartṛ karmaṇoḥ kṛti iti ṣaṣṭhī tad arthaḥ ca kartā karma kṛṣṇa kartṛkā kṛtiḥ jagat karmaka kṛti āśrayaḥ iti bodhaḥ tārkika mate kartṛ tvam karma tvam arthaḥ prakṛti arthasya tatra ādheyatva saṃbandhena anvayaḥ kartṛ tva ādi nirūpakatā saṃbandhena dhātvartha invayaḥ

original: kṛṣṇa- vṛttikartṛtānirūpakakṛtiḥ jagadvṛttiviṣayatārūpakarmatānirūpakakṛtyāśraya iti bodhaḥ | idamanuśāsanaṃ śaktigrāhakameva na tu lakṣaṇāgrāhakam | lakṣaṇāgrāhakatvasya kutrāpyanuśāsane'bhāvāditi mañjūṣādau vistaraḥ | kṛtapūrvī kaṭamityādau tu na kaṭādipadādanena sūtreṇa ṣaṣṭhī |
analyzed: kṛṣṇa vṛtti kartṛtā nirūpaka kṛtiḥ jagat vṛtti viṣaya tā rūpa karmatā nirūpaka kṛti āśrayaḥ iti bodhaḥ idam anuśāsanam śakti grāhakam eva na tu lakṣaṇā grāhakam lakṣaṇā grāhaka tvasya kutra api anuśāsana bhāvāt iti mañjūṣā ādau vistaraḥ kṛta pūrvī kaṭam ityādau tu na kaṭa ādi padāt anena sūtreṇa ṣaṣṭhī

original: kṛdgrahaṇasāmarthyana kṛdantamātraśaktigrahaprayojyopasthitiviṣayakriyākartṛkarmaṇoreva ṣaṣṭhīvidhānāt | anyathā tiṅyoge 'na loka-' iti niṣedhena kṛdyoge eva ṣaṣṭhīsiddhau tadvaiyarthya spaṣṭameveti kaiyaṭādibhiḥ prapañcitam |
analyzed: kṛt grahaṇa sāmarthyana kṛt anta mātra śakti graha prayojya upasthiti viṣaya kriyā kartṛ karmaṇoḥ eva ṣaṣṭhī vidhānāt anyathā tiṅ yoge na loke iti niṣedhena kṛt yoge eva ṣaṣṭhī siddhau tad vaiyarthya spaṣṭam eva iti kaiyaṭa ādibhiḥ prapañcitam

original: prakṛte ca na kṛdantamātraśaktigrahaḥ kriyopasthitiprayojako'pi tu taddhitāntaśaktigrahaḥ, tathā hi kṛtetiktapratyayo na karmaṇi, kaṭamiti dvitīyānāpatteḥ, kiṃ tu karmaṇo'vivakṣayākarmakatvādbhāve ktaḥ | sa ca katapūrvī adhītītyādivṛttiviṣaya eva | taduktaṃ bhāṣye 'yadā vākyaṃ na tadā pratyayaḥ, yadā pratyayaḥ sāmānyena tadā vṛttiḥ' iti |
analyzed: prakṛte ca na kṛt anta mātra śakti grahaḥ kriyā upasthiti prayojakaḥ upi tu taddhita anta śakti grahaḥ tathā hi na karmaṇi kaṭam iti dvitīya anāpatteḥ kim tu karmaṇaḥ vivakṣayā akarmaka tvāt bhāve ktaḥ sa ca kata pūrvī adhi iti ityādi vṛtti viṣayaḥ eva tat uktam bhāṣye yadā vākyam na tadā pratyayaḥ yadā pratyayaḥ sāmānyena tadā vṛttiḥ iti

original: 'na tadā pratyayaḥ' ityasya na tadā bhāve pratyayaḥ, sakarmakatvādityarthaḥ | 'yadā pratyayaḥ' bhāve iti śeṣaḥ, sarva vākyamiti nyāyena, 'tadā vṛttiḥ' ityasya tadā vṛttirevetyarthaḥ | sā ca na karmaktāntenetyāha 'sāmānyena' iti | upadaśitarītyā karmarahitārthakadhātuprakṛtikaktāntenetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: na tadā pratyayaḥ iti asya na tadā bhāve pratyayaḥ sakarmaka tvāt iti arthaḥ yadā pratyayaḥ bhāve iti śeṣaḥ sarva vākyam iti nyāyena tadā vṛttiḥ iti asya tadā vṛttiḥ eva iti arthaḥ sā ca na sāmānyena iti upadaśita rītyā karma rahita arthaka dhātu prakṛtika kta antena iti arthaḥ

original: tarkaratnākare tu pakkapūrvī sūpān kṛtapūrvī kaṭamityādau pākādyanukūlabhāvanāvāvānini- pratyayasyaivārthaḥ, ktāntastu nirarthakaḥ, kṛtītyupādānasāmarthyāt | anyathā ktena karmam̐ṇo'bhihitatvenānabhihitādhikārīyatvena ṣaṣṭhyaprāptyā tadvaiyarthyasya spaṣṭatvāt | dvitīyāprasaktyā sūpānityādiprayogānupapatteśca |

original: tātparyagrāhakatayā sārthakyāt | evaṃ ca karmaṇo'nabhidhānena ṣaṣṭhīprasaktiriti kṛdgrahaṇaṃ sārthakam, dvitīyāsiddhiśca, niṣṭhāprayuktaniṣedhaprasaktiśca na, pratyāsattyā niṣṭhāprakṛtyarthakriyānvayinoreva ṣaṣṭhīniṣedhādityuktam, tanmahābhāṣyānanuguṇamiti spaṣṭaṃ tadvidām |
analyzed: tātparya grāhaka tayā sārthakyāt evam ca karmaṇaḥ ūnabhidhānena ṣaṣṭhī prasaktiḥ iti kṛt grahaṇam sārthakam dvitīyā siddhiḥ ca niṣṭhā prayukta niṣedha prasaktiḥ ca na pratyāsattyā niṣṭhā prakṛti artha kriyā anvayinoḥ eva ṣaṣṭhī niṣedhāt iti uktam tat mahābhāṣya ananuguṇam iti spaṣṭam tad vidām

original: sūpādiśabdād dvitīyānupapattiśca, uktavyāpārasya dhātvarthatvābhāvena dhātvarthatāvacchedaphalaśālitvābhāvāt | bhāve ktapratyayastu prāgupapādita eva, bhāṣyādyanusāreṇātiprasaṅgo'pi vārita evetyalamanalpajalpanena | kaṭakarmakātītakālavṛttyutpattyanukūlavyāpārāśraya iti kṛtapūrvītyādivākyajanyo bodhaḥ | 'tadarham' iti nirdeśādanityo'yaṃ vidhiḥ |
analyzed: sūpa ādi śabdāt dvitīyā anupapattiḥ ca ukta vyāpārasya dhātvartha tva abhāvena dhātvartha tā avaccheda phala śāli tva abhāvāt bhāve ktapratyayaḥ tu prāk upapāditaḥ eva bhāṣya ādi anusāreṇa atiprasaṅgaḥ api vāritaḥ eva iti alam analpa jalpanena kaṭa karmaka atīta kāla vṛtti utpatti anukūla vyāpāra āśrayaḥ iti kṛtapūrvī ityādi vākya janyaḥ bodhaḥ tad arham iti nirdeśāt anityaḥ yam vidhiḥ

original: tena 'dhāyairāmodamuttamam' iti bhaṭṭiprayogopapattirityādyanyatra vistaraḥ | jagat kurvan, kurvāṇa ityādau na ṣaṣṭhī | 'na loka-' iti niṣedhāditi ṣaṣṭhyarthanirṇayaḥ |

original: adhītī vyākaraṇe, atra 'ktasyenaviṣaya ' iti saptamī | innanto viṣayo vartanabhūmiryasyetyarthaḥ | yadvā viṣayaśabdena prakṛtiḥ samarpyate | ino viṣaya iti ṣaṣṭhītatpuruṣo'tra pakṣe | atrāpi kṛtapūrvītivat bhāve ktaḥ | 'iṣṭādibhyaśca' iti kartari iniḥ | saptamyarthaḥ karmatvādiḥ | vyākaraṇakarmakādhyayamakarteti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: vyākaraṇe atra ktasya ina viṣayaḥ iti saptamī in nantaḥ viṣayaḥ vartana bhūmiḥ yasya iti arthaḥ yat vā viṣaya śabdena prakṛtiḥ samarpyate inaḥ viṣayaḥ iti ṣaṣṭhī tatpuruṣaḥ utra pakṣe atra api kṛta pūrvī iti vat bhāve ktaḥ iṣṭa ādibhyaḥ ca iti kartari iniḥ saptamī arthaḥ karmatva ādiḥ vyākaraṇa karmaka adhyayama kartā iti bodhaḥ

original: 'carmaṇi dvīpinaṃ hanti dantayorhanti kuñjaram' ityādau 'nimittāt karmayoge' iti saptamī | nimittaṃ - phalaṃ tadvācakāt saptamī bhavati, saṃyogasamavāyānyatararūpakarmasaṃbandhe satīti tadarthaḥ | atra karmasaṃbandhaḥ svarūpasannimitaṃ, na tu tasya saptamīvācyakoṭāvantarbhāvaḥ |
analyzed: carmaṇi dvīpinam hanti dantayoḥ hanti kuñjaram ityādau nimittāt karma yoge iti saptamī nimittam phalam tad vācakāt saptamī bhavati saṃyoga samavāya anyatara rūpa karma saṃbandhe sati iti tad arthaḥ atra karma saṃbandhaḥ sva rūpa sat nimitam na tu tasya saptamī vācya koṭau antarbhāvaḥ

original: itthaṃ ca phalaṃ saptamyarthaḥ, tasya svaniṣṭhaphalatānirūpakatvādisaṃbandhena 'dvopyādikarmakahananakriyāyāmanvayaḥ, tatra dvīpicarmaṇormṛgāṇḍakośayośca samavāya, itarayoḥ saṃyogaḥ | carmādīnāṃ hananaphalatvaṃ ca svaviṣayakecchāprayojakecchāviṣayatvam | hananecchāprajikecchā carmādilābheccheti carmādau tādṛśaphalatvamakṣatam |
analyzed: ittham ca phalam saptamī arthaḥ tasya sva niṣṭha phalatā nirūpaka tva ādi saṃbandhena dvopi ādi karmaka hanana kriyāyām anvayaḥ tatra dvīpi carmaṇoḥ mṛgāṇḍa kośayoḥ ca samavāyaḥ itarayoḥ saṃyogaḥ carma ādīnām hanana phalatvam ca sva viṣayaka icchā prayojaka icchā viṣaya tvam hanana icchā prajikā icchā carma ādi lābha icchā iti carma ādau tādṛśa phalatvam akṣatam

original: tārkikanaye phalatvaṃ, nibhittatvaṃ, tādarthya vā saptamyarthaḥ | lāghavādanuśāsanavirodhābhāvāccedameva yuktamityāhuḥ | brahmaṇeṣvadhīyāneṣu gataḥ, goṣu duhyamānāsu gataḥ, atra 'yasya ca bhāvena bhāvalakṣaṇam' iti saptamī | yasya bhāvena - kriyāyā kriyāntaraṃ lakṣyate - jñāyate tataḥ - tadvācakāt saptamīti tadarthaḥ |
analyzed: tārkika naye phalatvam nibhitta tvam tādarthya vā saptamī arthaḥ lāghavāt anuśāsana virodha abhāvāt ca idam eva yuktam iti āhuḥ gataḥ goṣu duhyamānāsu gataḥ atra yasya ca bhāvena bhāva lakṣaṇam iti saptamī yasya bhāvena kriyāyāḥ kriyā antaram lakṣyate jñāyate tatas tad vācakāt saptamī iti tad arthaḥ

original: ato narāṇāṃ rākṣasa ityādiprayogasya nāpattirityāhuḥ | pare tu vyāvṛttatvasya vibhaktyarthatve na bhagavataḥ sūtrakatastātparyam | 'na nirdhāraṇe' iti sūtreṇa nirdhāraṇasya vibhaktivācyakoṭipraveśasya bodhanāt | tatratyanirdhāraṇapadasya vyāvṛttatvārthakatve pramāṇābhāvāt |
analyzed: atas narāṇām rākṣasaḥ ityādi prayogasya nā āpattiḥ iti āhuḥ pare tu vyāvṛtta tvasya vibhakti artha tve na bhagavataḥ sūtrakataḥ tātparyam na nirdhāraṇe iti sūtreṇa nirdhāraṇasya vibhakti vācya koṭi praveśasya bodhanāt tatratya nirdhāraṇa padasya vyāvṛtta tva arthaka tve pramāṇa abhāvāt

original: tasmājjātiguṇakriyāsaṃjñāviśiṣṭasyaikadeśasya yataḥ svasajātīyaghaṭitasamudāyāt svetarasamudāyaghaṭakavyāvṛttadharmakaraṇakaṃ pṛthakkaraṇaṃ tataḥ ṣaṣṭhīsaptamyābityarthaḥ sūtrasya, uktanirdhāraṇaviṣayatvamavayāvayavibhāvasaṃbandhaśca nirdhāryamāṇānvayī vibhaktyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tasmāt jāti guṇa kriyā saṃjñā viśiṣṭasya eka deśasya yatas sva sajātīya ghaṭita samudāyāt sva itara samudāya ghaṭaka vyāvṛtta dharma karaṇakam pṛthakkaraṇam tatas ṣaṣṭhī saptamyā iti arthaḥ sūtrasya ukta nirdhāraṇa viṣaya tvam avayā avayavi bhāva saṃbandhaḥ ca nirdhāryamāṇa anvayī vibhakti arthaḥ

original: nṛsamudāyāvadhika- dvijetaranaravyāvṛttaśreṣṭhatvakaraṇakanirdhāraṇaviṣayo nṛsamudāyāvayavo dvija iti bodhaḥ | nṛṇāṃ śūdraḥ śreṣṭha iti prayogavyāvartanāyādyasya saṃbandhasya, nṛṇāṃ rākṣasaḥ śūratama ityasya vyāvartanāya dvitīyasya vibhaktyarthatvāṅgīkāraḥ |
analyzed: dvija itara nara vyāvṛtta śreṣṭha tva karaṇaka nirdhāraṇa viṣayaḥ nṛ samudāya avayavaḥ dvijaḥ iti bodhaḥ nṛṇām śūdraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ iti prayoga vyāvartanāya ādyasya saṃbandhasya nṛṇām rākṣasaḥ śūratamaḥ iti asya vyāvartanāya dvitīyasya vibhakti artha tva aṅgīkāraḥ

original: śūdrepya'ntyajātyādyapekṣayā śreṣṭhatvasya vidyamānatayā tadbodhena tathāvidhaprayogāpatteravāraṇāt | saṃsargaghaṭakakaraṇaṃ ca pratyāsattyā śreṣṭhatvādirūpameva grāhyam | tena nṛṇāṃ kṣatriyādiḥ śreṣṭha iti prayogāpattirna | anyathā kṣatriyāderapi śūratamatvādikaraṇakapṛthakkaraṇa- viṣayatayā syādeva tādṛśaprayogaḥ |
analyzed: śūdre pi antya jāti ādi apekṣayā śreṣṭhatvasya vidyamānatayā tad bodhena tathāvidha prayoga āpattyāḥ avāraṇāt saṃsarga ghaṭaka karaṇam ca pratyāsattyā śreṣṭha tva ādi rūpam eva grāhyam tena nṛṇām kṣatriya ādiḥ śreṣṭhaḥ iti prayoga āpattiḥ na anyathā kṣatriya ādeḥ api śūratama tva ādi karaṇaka pṛthakkaraṇa viṣayatayā syāt eva tādṛśa prayogaḥ

original: nṛṇāṃ madhye dvijaḥ śreṣṭha ityatra madhyayoge ṣaṣṭhī | tadyoge saptamī tu na sādhuḥ | na ca tatstve'pi madhyārthe'nvayāvivakṣayā nirdhāraṇasaptamī sādhureveti vācyam | tatsattve tadarthasya niyamenāvadhyākāṅkṣayā tatraivānvayasya yuktatvāt | nirdhāraṇavibhaktisthale śreṣṭhatamatvādau
analyzed: nṛṇām madhye dvijaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ iti atra madhya yoge ṣaṣṭhī tad yoge saptamī tu na sādhuḥ na ca tad stve pi madhya arthe nvaya avivakṣayā nirdhāraṇa saptamī sādhuḥ eva iti vācyam tad sattve tad arthasya niyamena avadhya ākāṅkṣayā tatra eva anvayasya yukta tvāt nirdhāraṇa vibhakti sthale śreṣṭhatama tva ādau

original: dvijetaranarādivyāvṛttatvabodhastu devadatto vāmenākṣaṇetyādyuktau dakṣiṇanetrakaraṇa- kadarśanābhāvabodhavanmānasa eva, dvijamaṇḍale vartamāno'vaśiṣṭaḥ śreṣṭha ityādhārasaptamīghaṭitavākye'pi tathāpratītaruktarūpāvaśyakyeva |
analyzed: dvija itara nara ādi vyāvṛtta tva bodhaḥ tu devadattaḥ vāmena akṣaṇa ityādi uktau dakṣiṇa netra karaṇa ka darśana abhāva bodha vat mānasaḥ eva dvija maṇḍale vartamānaḥ vaśiṣṭaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ iti ādhāra saptamī ghaṭita vākye api tathā apratīta rukta rūpa āvaśyakyā eva

original: nirdhāraṇāvadhinirdhāryamāṇanirdhāraṇahetūnāṃ saṃnidhye eva nirdhāraṇa- pratītiratastatraiva nirdhāraṇavibhaktiḥ samāsaniṣedhaśca | ata eva puruṣāṇāmuttaṃma ityatra śeṣaṣaṣṭhīti puruṣottama iti samāsaḥ sādhuriti 'dvivacanavibhajya-' iti sūtre kaiyaṭa ityāhuḥ |
analyzed: nirdhāraṇa avadhi nirdhāryamāṇa nirdhāraṇa hetūnām saṃnidhye eva nirdhāraṇa pratītiḥ atas tatra eva nirdhāraṇa vibhaktiḥ samāsa niṣedhaḥ ca atas eva puruṣāṇām uttaṃmaḥ iti atra śeṣa ṣaṣṭhī iti puruṣa uttamaḥ iti samāsaḥ sādhuḥ iti dvivacana vibhajyaḥ iti sūtre kaiyaṭaḥ iti āhuḥ

original: māthurā pāṭaliputrakebhya āḍhyatarā ityatra tu nirdhāryamāṇanirdhāraṇāvadhyorbhedasyaiva sattvena 'pañcamī vibhakte' iti pañcamī | tatra vibhaktapadena bhedo, nirdhāryamāṇasya nirdhāraṇāvadhito yatra bheda eva tadavadhivācakāt pañcamīti tadarthaḥ | ibhaktagrahaṇasāmarthyādavadhāraṇalābhaḥ | tanopattena kenāpi rūpeṇābhede naitatpravṛttiḥ |
analyzed: māthurā pāṭaliputrakebhyaḥ āḍhyatarāḥ iti atra tu nirdhāryamāṇa nirdhāraṇa avadhyoḥ bhedasya eva sattvena pañcamī vibhakte iti pañcamī tatra vibhakta padena bhedaḥ nirdhāryamāṇasya nirdhāraṇa avadhitaḥ yatra bhedaḥ eva tad avadhi vācakāt pañcamī iti tad arthaḥ kena api rūpeṇa abhede na etad pravṛttiḥ

original: atra nirdhāraṇāvadhivyāvṛttadharmakaraṇakanirdhāraṇaviṣayatvaṃ vibhaktyarthaḥ | pāṭaliputrakāvadhikatadvayāvṛttāḍhyataratvakaraṇakanirdhāraṇaviṣayā māthurā āḍhyatareti bodhaḥ | 'mūlenāvāhayeddevīṃ śravaṇena nisarjayet', mūle śravaṇe iti vā | atra 'nakṣatre ca lupi' iti sūtreṇa saptamī | lupśabdena lupsaṃjñayā luptapratyayārtho lakṣyate |
analyzed: atra nirdhāraṇa avadhi vyāvṛtta dharma karaṇaka nirdhāraṇa viṣaya tvam vibhakti arthaḥ pāṭaliputraka avadhika tad vaya āvṛtta āḍhyatara tva karaṇaka nirdhāraṇa viṣayā māthurā āḍhyatarā iti bodhaḥ mūlena āvāhayet devīm śravaṇena nisarjayet mūle śravaṇe iti vā atra nakṣatre ca lupi iti sūtreṇa saptamī lup śabdena lup saṃjñayā lupta pratyaya arthaḥ lakṣyate

original: tathā ca tādṛśapratyayārthe vartamānānnakṣatra- vācakādadhikaraṇe saptamī, tṛtīyā ceti tadarthaḥ | adhikaraṇa ityanuvṛttilabhyam | tatprayojanaṃ tvadya puṣya ityādau saptamyādivyāvṛttiḥ | anyathāntaraṅgatvāt prātipadikārthe eva syāt | mūlenetyatra 'nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ' ityaṇ | tatra nakṣatraśabdena tatsamīpavartī candra ucyate |
analyzed: tathā ca tādṛśa pratyaya arthe vartamānāt nakṣatra vācakāt adhikaraṇe saptamī tṛtīyā ca iti tad arthaḥ adhikaraṇe iti anuvṛtti labhyam tad prayojanam tu adya puṣyaḥ ityādau saptamī ādi vyāvṛttiḥ anyathā antaraṅga tvāt prātipadika arthe eva syāt mūlena iti atra nakṣatreṇa yuktaḥ kālaḥ iti aṇ tatra nakṣatra śabdena tad samīpa vartī candraḥ ucyate

original: tasyāṇaḥ 'lubaviśeṣa' iti lup | lupi sati lupyamānapratyayārthaḥ prakṛtyaiva pratyāyayate, yaḥ śiṣyate iti nyāyāt | ādhārādikaṃ saptamyādyarthaḥ | itthaṃ ca mūlanakṣatrasamīpavarticandrāyuktakālādhikaraṇakaṃ devīkarmakamāvāhanamityādyākārako bodhaḥ |
analyzed: tasya aṇaḥ lup aviśeṣaḥ iti lup lupi sati lupyamāna pratyaya arthaḥ prakṛtyā eva pratyāyayate yaḥ śiṣyate iti nyāyāt ādhāra ādikam saptamī ādi arthaḥ ittham ca mūla nakṣatra samīpa varti candra āyukta kāla adhikaraṇakam devī karmakam āvāhanam iti ādi ākārakaḥ bodhaḥ

original: adya bhuktvāyaṃ dvayahe dvayahādvā bhoktā, atra 'saptamīpañcamyau kārakamadhye' iti sūtreṇa saptamīpañcamyāvanuśiṣyete | kārakapadena kārakartṛtvādi- śaktirucyate | 'kālādhvanoḥ-' iti sūtrāt 'kālādhvānoḥ' ityanuvartate | tathā ca śaktidvayamadhye yau kālādhvānau tadvācakāt saptamīpañcamyābiti tadarthaḥ | anantarakālavṛttitvaṃ vibhaktyarthaḥ |
analyzed: adya bhuktvā ayam dvayahe dvayahāt vā bhoktā atra saptamī pañcamyau kāraka madhye iti sūtreṇa saptamī pañcamyau anuśiṣyete kāraka padena kāra kartṛ tva ādi śaktiḥ ucyate kāla adhvanoḥ iti sūtrāt kāla adhvānoḥ iti anuvartate tathā ca śakti dvaya madhye yau kāla adhvānau tad vācakāt saptamī pañcamyau iti tad arthaḥ anantara kāla vṛtti tvam vibhakti arthaḥ

original: adyapadārthaitaddivasādhikaraṇakatvasya bhojanakriyāyāmanvayaḥ, tadanvitaktāntapratipādyabhojanakriyāyāḥ svottarakālavṛttitvasvasamānakartṛkatvobhayasaṃbandhena bhojane prakṛtavibhaktyarthasyāpi tatraiva |
analyzed: adya padārtha etad divasa adhikaraṇaka tvasya bhojana kriyāyām anvayaḥ tad anvita ktānta pratipādya bhojana kriyāyāḥ sva uttara kāla vṛttitva sva samāna kartṛka tva ubhaya saṃbandhena bhojane prakṛta vibhakti arthasya api tatra eva

original: itthaṃ caitaddivasādhikaraṇakabhojanottarakālikaṃ tathāvidhabhojanasamānakartṛkametaddivasānantaradvayahānantara- kālavṛtti yad bhojanaṃ tadāśraya ityarthaḥ | dvayahe etaddivasānantaryalābhaḥ samabhivyāhārabalāt | so'pi na śābdaḥ kiṃ, tvārthaḥ | ihastho'yaṃ krośe krośādvā lakṣyaṃ vidhyet atrānantaradeśavṛttitvaṃ vibhaktyarthaḥ |
analyzed: ittham ca etad divasa adhikaraṇaka bhojana uttara kālikam tathāvidha bhojana samāna kartṛkam etad divasa anantara dvayaha anantara kāla vṛtti yat bhojanam tad āśrayaḥ iti arthaḥ dvayahe etad divasa ānantarya lābhaḥ samabhivyāhāra balāt saḥ api na śābdaḥ kim tu ārthaḥ ihasthaḥ ūyam krośe krośāt vā lakṣyam vidhyet atra anantara deśa vṛtti tvam vibhakti arthaḥ

original: ihaśabdapratipādyasyaitaddeśādhikaraṇaka vasya sthitāvanvayaḥ | tādṛśasthitiḥ kṛdarthāśraye, tasyākhyātārthakartari, tasya vyadhanakriyāyāṃ tatraiva krośānantaradeśasthitalakṣyakarmakatvasya | tathā caitaddeśādhikaraṇakasthitikartṛkartṛkametaddeśānantarakrośānantaradeśasthitalakṣyakarmakaṃ saṃbhāvanāviṣayībhūtaṃ vyadhanamiti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: ihaśabda pratipādyasya etad deśa adhikaraṇaka vasya sthitau anvayaḥ tādṛśa sthitiḥ kṛt artha āśraye tasya ākhyāta artha kartari tasya vyadhana kriyāyām tatra eva krośa anantara deśa sthita lakṣya karmaka tvasya tathā ca etad deśa adhikaraṇaka sthiti kartṛ kartṛkam etad deśa anantara krośa anantara deśa sthita lakṣya karmakam saṃbhāvanā viṣayībhūtam vyadhanam iti bodhaḥ

original: evamanyatrāpyūhyam | iti saptamyarthanirṇayaḥ ||

original: evaṃ subvibhaktyarthānupavarṇya tadanurodhena saṃbandhasahitasakalakārakaghaṭitavākyārthabodhaṃ varṇayati-- evaṃ ceti | uktarītyā dharmaṇāṃ vibhaktyarthatve ca | tadabhinnāśrayaka iti | ākhyātārthāśraye gorabhedenānvaya iti bhāvaḥ | vibhāgajanaka iti | dadātervibhārapūrvakadāne vṛttiriti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: evam sup vibhakti arthān upavarṇya tad anurodhena saṃbandha sahita sakala kāraka ghaṭita vākyārtha bodham varṇayati evam ca iti ukta rītyā dharmaṇām vibhakti artha tve ca tad abhinna āśrayakaḥ iti ākhyātārtha āśraye goḥ abhedena anvayaḥ iti bhāvaḥ vibhāga janakaḥ iti dadāteḥ vibhāra pūrvaka dāne vṛttiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: tathā tiṅāmiti | tiṅāmiti kartṛkarmaṇī saṃkhyā cārtha ityarthaḥ | niyama iti | arthaniyama
analyzed: tathā tiṅām iti tiṅām iti kartṛ karmaṇī saṃkhyā ca arthaḥ iti arthaḥ niyamaḥ iti artha niyama

original: ityarthaḥ | evaṃ ca karmatvādiśūnyārthakāvyayādapi vibhaktisiddhiḥ | pratyayaniyamapakṣe'pi tatra vibhaktisiddhimāha--niyamaḥ prakṛteṣu ceti | prakṛtakartrādyarthāpekṣo niyamaḥ, karmaṇyeva dvitīyetyādiniyamena kartrādau dvitīyādayo vyāvacchidyante na tu karmatvādiśūnya ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: iti arthaḥ evam ca karma tva ādi śūnya arthaka avyayāt api vibhakti siddhiḥ pratyaya niyama pakṣe api tatra vibhakti siddhim āha niyamaḥ prakṛteṣu ca iti prakṛta kartṛ ādi artha apekṣaḥ niyamaḥ karmaṇi eva dvitīya ityādi niyamena kartṛ ādau dvitīya ādayaḥ vyāvacchidyante na tu karma tva ādi śūnye iti arthaḥ

original: nanu 'svaujasamauṭ' ityādinā 'tiptasajhi-' ityādinā ca vihitānāṃ svādīnāṃ tibādīnāṃ ca 'karmaṇi dvitīyā' ityādiśāstrainiyamapakṣe na karmādau vācakatāgrāhakatvaṃ 'svaujas-' ityādiśāśtrasya labhyate, tatra 'karmaṇi-' ityāderabhāvāt, nāpi 'karmāṇi' ityādeḥ, niyāmakatvādityāśaṅkyāha-tathā hīti | ekavākyatayā - vākyaikavākyatayā, na padaikavakyatayā |
analyzed: nanu ityādinā ityādinā ca vihitānām su ādīnām tip ādīnām ca karmaṇi dvitīyā ityādi śāstra ainiyama pakṣe na karma ādau vācakatā grāhakatvam su ojaḥ ityādi śāśtrasya labhyate tatra karmaṇi ityādeḥ abhāvāt na api karmāṇi ityādeḥ niyāmakatvāt iti āśaṅkya āha tathā hi iti ekavākyatayā vākya ekavākyatayā na pada ekavakyatayā

original: vākyaikavākyatāyāṃ tu prātipadikāt svādayo bhavanti, te ca prātipadikārthamātragate ekatvādau bhavantītyādibodhākāro bhavati | tathā sati tatra prathamavākyenāvyayādau prāptirupapādayituṃ śakyate | kiṃ caivamarthaniyamaprakṛtārthāpekṣapratyayaniyamaśuddhapratyayaniyāmakayorucchedaścaivaṃ syāt |
analyzed: vākya ekavākyatāyām tu prātipadikāt su ādayaḥ bhavanti te ca prātipadika artha mātra gate eka tva ādau bhavanti ityādi bodha ākāraḥ bhavati tathā sati tatra prathama vākyena avyaya ādau prāptiḥ upapādayitum śakyate kim ca evam artha niyama prakṛta artha apekṣa pratyaya niyama śuddha pratyaya niyāmakayoḥ ucchedaḥ ca evam syāt

original: ekavacanādi- śabde sūtraśāṭakavad bhāvisaṃjñāśrayaṇamanyonyāśrayaparihārāyeti gauravaṃ cetyekavākyatāpadena vākyaikavākyataiva vikṣitā |

original: nanvevaṃ pūrvapūrvavākyavihitānāṃ kathaṃ karmādyarthabodhanaṃ kartu śakyam | na ca sāmagrīsattve tat saṃbhavatyeveti vācyam | evaṃ satyekavākyatāvirahe'pi 'dvayekayoḥ--' ityādinā ekatve evaikavacanamityapi bodhane kṛte satyekatvādyarthakatvabodhanasaṃbhave vākyaikavākyatāpuraskāro nirarthaka iti cenna |

original: ekavākyatāpakṣe svādivākyenaiva vākyaikavākyatoktahetubhiraṅgīkriyate, na tu 'karmaṇi dvitīyā' 'dvayekayoḥ-' ityādyoḥ, kiṃ tu padaikavākyatā | evaṃ ca karmagataikatve eva dvitīyaikavacanamam bhavatītyādyākāraniyamavalābho'tra bhavati |

original: paryāyāntarād dravyatvaprakārakabodhānupapattyā dravyapadajñānatvena hetutvopagamāsaṃbhavādityādikaṃ bṛhadbhūṣaṇe draṣṭavyamityabhipretyāha prapañcitaṃ bhūṣaṇa iti | pūrvavat - viṣayatāsaṃbandhena tādṛśakāraṇatāvacchedakamityarthasvīkāreṇa pariharaṇīyaḥ | anyathā pūrvamate ekasyaiva nāmārthatvametanmate ca dvayostathātvamiti virodhaḥ spaṣṭa eva |

original: pūrvatra viśiṣṭasya padārthatve virodhaḥ parihṛtaḥ, iha tu dvayostathātve sa parihṛtaḥ | nanu 'ratanakeśavatī strī syāt' ityādinā vivakṣitamavayavasaṃsthānaviśeṣarūpaṃ strītvādikaṃ naitacchāstrīyaprakriyā nirvāhakam | dārānityādau natvābhāvaprasaṅgāt | na cāropeṇa nirvāha iti yuktam | viśeṣadarśināntadasaṃbhavāt |
analyzed: pūrvatra viśiṣṭasya padārtha tve virodhaḥ parihṛtaḥ iha tu dvayoḥ tathātve sa parihṛtaḥ nanu ratana keśavatī strī syāt ityādinā vivakṣitam avayava saṃsthāna viśeṣa rūpam strītva ādikam na etat śāstrīya prakriyāḥ nirvāhakam dārān ityādau na tva abhāva prasaṅgāt na ca āropeṇa nirvāhaḥ iti yuktam viśeṣa darśi nān tad asaṃbhavāt

original: na cāgāryaḥ sa saṃbhavatyeveti vācyam | tadasattve'pi tathāvidhaprayogāṇāmiṣṭatvāt | ata eva striyāmiti sūtre bhāṣyakārairuktānupapattyānyathā strītvādinirvacanaṃ kṛtamityāśaṅkya bhāṣyoktarītimanusarati sattveti | nanūpacayāpacayāderviruddhasyaikatra samāveśāyogāt taṭastaṭī taṭamityāderanupapattiḥ |
analyzed: na ca āgāryaḥ sa saṃbhavati eva iti vācyam tad asattve pi tathāvidha prayogāṇām iṣṭatvāt atas eva striyām iti sūtre bhāṣyakāraiḥ ukta anupapattyā anyathā strī tva ādi nirvacanam kṛtam iti āśaṅkya bhāṣya ukta rītim anusarati sattva iti nanu upacaya apacaya ādeḥ viruddhasya ekatra samāveśa ayogāt taṭaḥ taṭī taṭam ityādeḥ anupapattiḥ

original: guṇānāṃ kṣaṇikatvapuraskāreṇa tadupapattirityapi na yuktam, evamapi yugapattathāvyavahārānupapatterduṣparihāratvāt | avikāriṇyupacayādyasaṃbhavādbrahma ātmetyādibyavahārānupapatteśca | āropādare tu laukikaliṅgānādaro nirbīja ityata āha tattacchabdaniṣṭhamiti |
analyzed: guṇānām kṣaṇikatva puraskāreṇa tad upapattiḥ iti api na yuktam evam api yugapad tathā vyavahāra anupapatteḥ duṣparihāra tvāt avikāriṇī upacaya ādi asaṃbhavāt brahma ātmā ityādi byavahāra anupapatteḥ ca āropa ādare tu laukika liṅga anādaraḥ nirbījaḥ iti atas āha tat tat śabda niṣṭham iti

original: nanvatrāpi pakṣe ekaśabde anekaviruddhaliṅgāsaṃbhavatādavasthyamata āha tameva viruddheti | bhidyanta iti | tathā ca
analyzed: nanu atra api pakṣe eka śabde aneka viruddha liṅga asaṃbhava tādavasthyam atas āha tam eva viruddha iti bhidyante iti tathā ca

original: noktadoṣāvakāśaḥ | nanvevaṃ 'taṭaṃ tri'ṣvityādivyavahārānupapattirata āha koṣāṃciditi | samāneti | ayaṃ cābhedārope hetuḥ | evaṃ ceti | viṅgasya śabdaniṣṭatve cetyarthaḥ | pare tu upacayādyavasthātrayasya sārvatrikatvādidaṃ liṅgaṃ kevalānvayi, idaṃ vastu iyaṃ vyaktirayaṃ padārtha ityādibyavaharāṇāmapratibaddhasakalajanasiddhaprasarāt |
analyzed: na ukta doṣa avakāśaḥ nanu evam taṭam triṣu ityādi vyavahāra anupapattiḥ atas āha samāna iti ayam ca abheda ārope hetuḥ evam ca iti viṅgasya śabda niṣṭa tve ca iti arthaḥ pare tu upacaya ādi avasthā trayasya sārvatrika tvāt idam liṅgam kevala anvayi idam vastu iyam vyaktiḥ ayam padārthaḥ ityādi byavaharāṇām apratibaddha sakala jana siddha prasarāt

original: taccārthaniṣṭham | 'ekārthe śabdānyatvād dṛṣṭaṃ liṅgānyatvamavayavānyatvācca' iti bhāṣyācca | 'puṣyatārakā nakṣatramiti nānāśabdatvadarśanāt stanakeśādyatiriktameva liṅgamarthaniṣṭhaṃ, kuṭī kuṭira ityādau rephasyāvayavasyopajanane liṅgabhedadarśanāccetyartha' iti kaiyaṭopādhyāyāḥ |
analyzed: tat ca artha niṣṭham ekārthe śabda anya tvāt dṛṣṭam liṅga anya tvam avayava anya tvāt ca iti bhāṣyāt ca puṣya tārakāḥ nakṣatram iti nānā śabda tva darśanāt stana keśa ādi atiriktam eva liṅgam artha niṣṭham kuṭī kuṭiraḥ ityādau rephasya avayavasya upajanane liṅga bheda darśanāt ca iti arthaḥ iti kaiyaṭa upādhyāyāḥ

original: ata evopakramabhāṣye 'rūparasagandhasparśaśabdānāṃ styānaprasavau liṅgam' ityuktam | yasmādrūpādayona hi śabdagatāḥ |
analyzed: atas eva upakrama bhāṣye rūpa rasa gandha sparśa śabdānām styāna prasavau liṅgam iti uktam yasmāt rūpa ādayaḥ na hi śabda gatāḥ

original: nanvevaṃ 'puṃliṅgaḥ śabda' iti vyavahārānupapattiriti cenna | vācyavācakayorabhedopacārādarśa ādyajantatvādvā tadupapatteḥ | ātmā brahmetyādi vyavahārasiddhistu brahmaṇi sarvasyaivādhyāsena paraṃparayā saṃratyānādisattvena copapadyate |
analyzed: nanu evam pum liṅgaḥ śabdaḥ iti vyavahāra anupapattiḥ iti ced na vācya vācakayoḥ abheda upacāra ādarśe ādi a c anta tvāt vā tad upapatteḥ ātmā brahma ityādi vyavahāra siddhiḥ tu brahmaṇi sarvasya eva adhyāsena paraṃparayā saṃratyā anādi sattvena ca upapadyate

original: 'upacayāderviruddhasyaikatrāsamāveśāt taṭastaṭītyādyanupapatti'riti na vācyam, kośabhāṣyādiprāmāṇyena virodhasyaiva virahāt | kaścicchabda ekaliṅgaviśiṣṭārthe, kaściliṅgadvayaviśiṣṭa ityādikaṃ kośādito'vaseyam | tatra ṭighubhādivallaghusaṃjñākaraṇaucitye'pi gurusaṃjñākaraṇāt natvādiśāśtrapravṛttau laukikamapi liṅgaṃ nimittatvenāśrīyate |
analyzed: upacaya ādeḥ viruddhasya ekatra asamāveśāt taṭaḥ taṭī ityādi anupapattiḥ iti na vācyam kośa bhāṣya ādi prāmāṇyena virodhasya eva virahāt kaścid śabdaḥ eka liṅga viśiṣṭa arthe kaścid liṅga dvaya viśiṣṭaḥ iti ādikam kośa āditaḥ vaseyam tatra ṭi ghubha ādi vat laghu saṃjñā karaṇa aucitye pi guru saṃjñā karaṇāt laukikam api liṅgam nimitta tvena āśrīyate

original: saṃkhyāsaṃjñāvat puṃsādisaṃketānāmadhikasaṃgrahārthatve'pi lokaprasiddhārthanirāsārthatvābhāvācca | laukikāsaṃbhave tu śāśtrīye eva natvādipravṛttiḥ | tatsaṃbhave tu śāśtrīyaviśiṣṭalaukika eva, na tu kevalaśāstrīye | natvādikāryeṇa lokikaliṅgasyārthagatasya bodhāt |
analyzed: saṃkhyā saṃjñā vat puṃsa ādi saṃketānām adhika saṃgraha artha tve pi loka prasiddha artha nirāsa artha tva abhāvāt ca laukika asaṃbhave tu śāśtrīye eva natva ādi pravṛttiḥ tad saṃbhave tu śāśtrīya viśiṣṭa laukike eva na tu kevala śāstrīye natva ādi kāryeṇa lokika liṅgasya artha gatasya bodhāt

original: 'āvirbhāvastirobhāvaḥ sthitiścetyapyapāyinaḥ |
analyzed: āvirbhāvaḥ tirobhāvaḥ sthitiḥ ca iti api apāyinaḥ

original: dharmā mūrtiṣu sarvāsu liṅgatvena vyavasthitāḥ ||'
analyzed: dharmāḥ mūrtiṣu sarvāsu liṅga tvena vyavasthitāḥ

original: iti harikārikāto'pi tasyārthaniṣṭatvamevāvasīyate | atrāpinā sati saṃbhave laukikaliṅgasyāpi natvādipravṛttau nimittatvamiti sūcitam' ityādi mañjūṣāyāṃ pratyapīpadan | nanu tasya śabdaniṣṭatve śabdavācyatve'pyarthe tadanvayāsaṃbhavena paśunā yajeteti vihitayāgasya cchāgyāpi karaṇāpattirityata āha tacca liṅgamiti | arthaparicchedakatveneti |
analyzed: iti tasya artha niṣṭatvam eva avasīyate atra apinā sati saṃbhave laukika liṅgasya api na tva ādi pravṛttau nimitta tvam iti sūcitam ityādi mañjūṣāyām pratyapīpadat nanu tasya śabda niṣṭatve śabda vācya tve pi arthe tad anvaya asaṃbhavena paśunā yajeta iti vihita yāgasya chāgyā api karaṇa āpattiḥ iti atas āha tat ca liṅgam iti artha paricchedaka tvena iti

original: tadviśeṣaṇatve- netyarthaḥ | liṅgaviśeṣaviśiṣṭasyaivārthaviśeṣavācakatāyā liṅgānuśāsanaśāśtrasiddhatayā ca svāśrayavācyatvasaṃbandhenārthaviśeṣaṇatvopapattiḥ |
analyzed: tad viśeṣaṇa tve na iti arthaḥ liṅga viśeṣa viśiṣṭasya eva artha viśeṣa vācaka tāyāḥ liṅga anuśāsana śāśtra siddha tayā ca sva āśraya vācyatva saṃbandhena artha viśeṣaṇa tva upapattiḥ

original: evaṃ ca puṃstvaviśiṣṭapaśoreva vidhānācchagyā na tatkaraṇāpattiḥ, puṃliṅgasya paśuśabdasya puṃvyaktereva vācakatvamanyathā paraṃparayā tasyārtha- viśeṣaṇatvābhyupagamavaiyarthyāpatteriti bhāvaḥ | paśvādiśabdoktamiti | asya 'puṃstvaṃ paśuśabdārtha- paricchedakatvenānvetī'ti śeṣaḥ | paśu śtriyāṃ nāstīti |
analyzed: evam ca puṃstva viśiṣṭa paśoḥ eva vidhānāt śagyāḥ na tad karaṇa āpattiḥ pum liṅgasya paśu śabdasya pum vyakteḥ eva vācakatvam anyathā paraṃparayā tasya artha viśeṣaṇatva abhyupagama vaiyarthya āpatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ paśu ādi śabda uktam iti asya puṃstvam paśu śabda artha paricchedaka tvena anveti iti śeṣaḥ paśu śtriyām na asti iti

original: paśu yadi śtriyāṃ nāsti-paśunā yajeteti vākyāntargataḥ paśuśabdaḥ-nābhāvena puṃliṅgatvabodhanāt striyāṃ nāstīti hetoḥ paśunā yajetetyādividhiśchāgyādīnaṅgatvena na prayojayati - na grāhayatītyarthaḥ | nanu puṃliṅgaḥ paśuśabdaḥ puṃvyaktereva vācaka iti yadi niyamaḥ syāttadoktaṃ saṃbhavet, sa eva tu netyāśayena śaṅkate-na ceti |
analyzed: paśu yadi śtriyām nā asti paśunā yajeta iti vākya antargataḥ paśu śabdaḥ na abhāvena pum liṅga tva bodhanāt striyām nā asti iti hetoḥ paśunā yajeta ityādi vidhiḥ chāgya ādīn aṅgatvena na prayojayati na grāhayati iti arthaḥ nanu pum liṅgaḥ paśu śabdaḥ pum vyakteḥ eva vācakaḥ iti yadi niyamaḥ syāt tadā uktam saṃbhavet saḥ eva tu na iti āśayena śaṅkatena ca iti

original: vyaktyādiśabdokteti | vyaktyādiśabdoktaliṅgasya yathā sādhāraṇyaṃ - svāśrayavācyatāsaṃbandhena pumādisaṃbaddhatvamata eva tattadarthavyāvartakaṃ, tathā paśvādiśabdoktaliṅgasyāpyuktaparaṃparāsaṃbandhena strīvyaktisaṃbaddhatvāttadapi na vyāvartakaṃ bhavet tanmātraniṣṭhasyaiva tadvayāvartakatvānna tu vyabhicāriṇa
analyzed: vyakti ādi śabda ukta iti vyakti ādi śabda ukta liṅgasya yathā sādhāraṇyam sva āśraya vācyatā saṃbandhena pum ādi saṃbaddhatvam atas eva tat tad artha vyāvartakam tathā paśu ādi śabda ukta liṅgasya api ukta paraṃparā saṃbandhena strī vyakti saṃbaddhatvāt tat api na vyāvartakam bhavet tad mātra niṣṭhasya eva tad vayāvartaka tvāt na tu vyabhicāriṇaḥ

original: iti samuditārthaḥ | paśvādiśabdoktasya-atra liṅgasyetyanuṣajyate | vyaktiśabdasya ktinnantatvena nityaśtrīliṅgatvāt sādhāraṇye'pi paśuśabdasya nityapuṃliṅgatve mānābhāvānna sādhāraṇyamiti pariharati-vyaktiśabdasyeti | vede darśanāditi | paśvetyādidarśanāt strīliṅge'pi paśuśabda iti bhāvaḥ . puliṅge nādeśapravṛtyoktarūpāsiddhiḥ spaṣṭaiva |
analyzed: iti samudita arthaḥ paśu ādi śabda uktasya atra liṅgasya iti anuṣajyate vyakti śabdasya nitya śtrī liṅga tvāt sādhāraṇye api paśu śabdasya nitya pum liṅga tve māna abhāvāt na sādhāraṇyam iti pariharati vyakti śabdasya iti vede darśanāt iti paśu etyādi darśanāt strī liṅge api paśu śabdaḥ iti bhāvaḥ pu liṅge na ādeśa pravṛtyā ukta rūpa asiddhiḥ spaṣṭā eva

original: tathā 'gherṅiti' iti guṇapravṛttyā paśva iti rūpāsiddhiśca | nanu strīliṅge'pi guṇapravṛttyoktarūpāsiddhistadavasthaiva | na ca 'ṅiti hrasvaśca' iti nadīsaṃjñāpravṛttyā na ghisaṃjñeti vācyam, tathā satyāṭpravṛttyoktadoṣatādavasthyādita cenna, chāntasatvādāḍapravṛtteḥ sūpapadatvamityāśayāt |
analyzed: tathā gheḥ ṅ iti iti guṇa pravṛttyā paśvaḥ iti rūpa asiddhiḥ ca nanu strī liṅge api guṇa pravṛttyā ukta rūpa asiddhiḥ tad avasthā eva na ca ṅ iti hrasvaḥ ca iti nadī saṃjñā pravṛttyā na ghi saṃjñā iti vācyam tathā ced na sūpapada tvam iti āśayāt

original: 'jasādiṣu cchandasi vāvacanam' iti vacanena puṃliṅga'pyuktaprayogasiddhiriti tu na śaṅkyam, strīliṅge tadāśrayaṇaṃ vināpyuktarītyā nirvāhaḥ | āgamaśāśtrasya 'sāgaraṃ tarttukāmasye'tyādāvanityatvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti tatrāṅapravṛttyarthaṃ chāndasatvamanā- śrayaṇīyamityāśayāt | liṅgāntarasādhakahetvantaramapyāha-mīmāṃsāyāmiti | caturthe - caturthādhyāye |
analyzed: jasa ādiṣu chandasi vā avacanam iti vacanena pum liṅga api ukta prayoga siddhiḥ iti tu na śaṅkyam strī liṅge tad āśrayaṇam vinā api ukta rītyā nirvāhaḥ āgama śāśtrasya sāgaram tarttu kāmasya ityādau anitya tvam dṛṣṭam iti tatra āṅ pravṛtti artham chāndasa tvam anā śrayaṇīyam iti āśayāt liṅga antara sādhaka hetu antaram api āha mīmāṃsāyām iti caturthe caturtha adhyāye

original: tatprathamacaraṇe etadavagantavyam | 'nanu niyatapuṃliṅgatve pramāṇābhāvā'dityasaṃgatam, 'upratyayāntāḥ puṃsī'ti vyākaraṇasyaiva mānatvādityāśaṅkya paśuśabdasya niyatapu'liṅgatve pramāṇasaddhāve'pi prakārāntareṇa cchāgīgrahaṇaprasakti vārayati vastutastviti | nābhāvābhāva ityukteriti |
analyzed: tad prathama caraṇe etat avagantavyam nanu niyata puṃliṅga tve pramāṇa abhāvāt iti asaṃgatam puṃsi iti vyākaraṇasya eva māna tvāt iti āśaṅkya paśu śabdasya niyata puṃliṅga tve pramāṇa saddhāve api prakāra antareṇa chāgī grahaṇa prasakti vārayati vastutas tu iti na abhāva abhāvaḥ iti ukteḥ iti

original: tathā ca paśvetyādiprayogānupapattirapi na paśuśabdasya niyatapuṃliṅgatve'pīti bhāvaḥ | nityapuṃstvanirṇayāditi | nityapuṃliṅgatvanirṇayādityarthaḥ | tathā ca puṃstvasya sādhāraṇyādvayāvartakatvānupapattiriti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca paśu ityādi prayoga anupapattiḥ api na paśu śabdasya niyata puṃliṅga tve api iti bhāvaḥ nitya puṃstva nirṇayāt iti nitya pum liṅga tva nirṇayāt iti arthaḥ tathā ca puṃstvasya sādhāraṇyāt vayāvartaka tva anupapattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: tathā ca strīvyaktivyāvartikāyā uktayukterasaṃbhave'pi tadvayāvartakayuktyantaraṃ ddarśayati 'chāgo vā mantra-' iti-ṣaṣṭhādhyāyacaramādhikaraṇasiddhāntasūtram | tatra hi 'agnīṣomīyaṃ paśumālabhete'tyatra paśuśabdena nāśvādirgrāhyaḥ ki tvaja eva 'chāgasya vapāyāḥ' iti mantravarṇāditi nirṇītam, tadvat puṃstvasyāpi tata eva nirṇaya ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca strī vyakti vyāvartikāyāḥ ukta yukteḥ asaṃbhave pi tad vayāvartaka yukti antaram ddarśayati chāgaḥ vā mantraḥ iti ṣaṣṭha adhyāya carama adhikaraṇa siddhānta sūtram tatra hi agnīṣomīyam paśum ālabheta iti atra paśu śabdena na aśva ādiḥ grāhyaḥ ki tu ajaḥ eva chāgasya vapāyāḥ iti mantra varṇāt iti nirṇītam tadvat puṃstvasya api tatas eva nirṇayaḥ iti arthaḥ

original: yathā 'saṃdigdhe tu vākyaśeṣāt' ityadhikaraṇe vidhau saṃdehe vākyaśeṣānnirṇayaḥ saṃkhyādivat, yathā 'sārasvatau meṣau bhavata' ityatra taddhitaprakṛtiḥ śabdaḥ puṃliṅgaḥ strīliṅgo veti saṃdehe 'etadvai daivyaṃ mithunam' ityarthavādekaśeṣeṇobhayorgrahaṇamiti nirṇītam |
analyzed: yathā saṃdigdhe tu vākyaśeṣāt iti adhikaraṇe vidhau saṃdehe vākyaśeṣāt nirṇayaḥ saṃkhyā ādi vat yathā sārasvatau meṣau bhavataḥ iti atra taddhita prakṛtiḥ śabdaḥ pum liṅgaḥ strī liṅgaḥ vā iti saṃdehe etat vai daivyam mithunam iti arthavāda ekaśeṣeṇa ubhayoḥ grahaṇam iti nirṇītam

original: tena rājapuruṣa ityādāvapi rājatvādiniṣṭhaprākāratānirūpitarājādiniṣṭhaviśeṣyatākabodhajanakatve'pi na tatrātivyāptiḥ, rājādau tajjanyabodhīyamukhyaviśeṣyatāvirahāt | evamagre'pi bodhyam | upakumbhamityādyavyayībhāvasya kumbhasamīpamityākārakasya pūrvapadārthamukhyaviśeṣyakabodhasya janakatvāllakṣaṇasaṃgatiḥ | ubhayapadārtheti |
analyzed: tena rāja puruṣaḥ ityādau api rājatva ādi niṣṭha prākāratā nirūpita rāja ādi niṣṭha viśeṣyatāka bodha janakatve pi na tatra ativyāptiḥ rāja ādau tad janya bodhīya mukhya viśeṣyatā virahāt evam agre api bodhyam upa kumbham ityādi avyayībhāvasya kumbha samīpam iti ākārakasya pūrva padārtha mukhya viśeṣyaka bodhasya janakatvāt lakṣaṇa saṃgatiḥ ubhaya padārtha iti

original: anekapadārthapradhāna ityarthaḥ | tena tryādipadaghaṭitasamāsasya nāsaṃgrahaḥ | paraspareti | parasparasya vyabhicārāt - lakṣaṇalakṣitāvacchedakayoḥ parasparābhāvavaddhatitvādityarthaḥ | vyabhicāraṃ padarśayati-tathā hīti | avyāptiriti | avyayībhāvalakṣaṇasyāvyāptiḥ | anyapadārthaprādhānye gamakamāha 'anyapadārthe ca' iti |
analyzed: aneka padārtha pradhānaḥ iti arthaḥ tena tri ādi pada ghaṭita samāsasya na asaṃgrahaḥ paraspara iti parasparasya vyabhicārāt lakṣaṇa lakṣita avacchedakayoḥ paraspara abhāva vat hati tvāt iti arthaḥ vyabhicāram darśayati tathā hi iti avyāptiḥ iti avyayībhāva lakṣaṇasya avyāptiḥ anya padārtha prādhānye gamakam āha anya padārthe ca iti

original: samāsāditi ayamanyapadārthaprādhānye hetuḥ | uttarapadārthaprādhānyasattvāditi | supsaṃbandhileśa ityākārakottarapadārthaviśeṣyakabodhajanakatvādityarthaḥ | nanvavyayībhāvasamāsa- vidhāyake'vyayasya prathamānirdiṣṭatvāt kathamatrāvyayasyottarapadatvamityata āha 'sup pratinā' iti |
analyzed: samāsāt iti ayam anya padārtha prādhānye hetuḥ uttara padārtha prādhānya sattvāt iti sup saṃbandhi leśaḥ iti ākāraka uttara padārtha viśeṣyaka bodha janaka tvāt iti arthaḥ nanu avyayībhāva samāsa prathamā nirdiṣṭa tvāt katham atra avyayasya uttara pada tvam iti atas āha sup pratinā iti

original: pūrvapadārtheti | pippalīsaṃbandhyarghamiti tato bodhodayāt | bhāṣyakāraistu samudāye dṛṣṭā iti nyāyena pippalī kāyādiśabdānāṃ pippalyādyavayavaparatārdhavippalī-pūrvakāya ityādiḥ karmadhārasya eva bhavati |
analyzed: pūrva padārtha iti pippalī saṃbandhi argham iti tatas bodha udayāt bhāṣyakāraiḥ tu samudāye dṛṣṭāḥ iti nyāyena pippalī kāya ādi śabdānām ityādiḥ karmadhārasyaḥ eva bhavati

original: evaṃ ca 'artha napusaṃkam' ityādi sūtratrayaṃ na kartavyamata evordhvakāyādisiddhāntitaṃ, tanmate tatrottarapadārthaprādhānyasattvena vyabhicārābhāve'pyanyo rājetyarthaka 'rājāntara'mityatra pūrvapadārthaprādhānya- bodhajanake mayūravyaṃsakādisamāse sarvamate vyabhicāro draṣṭavyaḥ |
analyzed: evam ca ityādi sūtra trayam na kartavyam atas eva ūrdhvakāya ādi siddhāntitam tad mate tatra uttara padārtha prādhānya sattvena vyabhicāra abhāve pi anyaḥ rājā iti arthaka rāja antaram iti atra pūrva padārtha prādhānya bodha janake mayūra vyaṃsaka ādi samāse sarva mate vyabhicāraḥ draṣṭavyaḥ

original: bhinnavācino'ntaraśabdasya napusaṃka- tayā samāsasya mayūkhyaṃsakādigaṇe nipātanāt paravalliṅgatā, etena 'paravalliṅgamiti sūtre bhāṣye ardhapippalītyādestatpuruṣodāharaṇasya karmadhāratvopagamenottarapadārthaprādhānyamāśrityānyathāsiddhi kṛtvā tatratyatatpuruṣagrahaṇapratyākhyānena kathamatra paravalliṅgateti dūṣaṇaṃ nirastam |
analyzed: bhinna vācinaḥ antara śabdasya tayā samāsasya mayūkhī aṃsaka ādi gaṇe nipātanāt paravat liṅga tā etena paravat liṅgam iti sūtre bhāṣye ardhapippalī ityādeḥ tatpuruṣa udāharaṇasya karmadhāra tva upagamena uttara padārtha prādhānyam āśritya anyathā asiddhi kṛtvā tatratya tatpuruṣa grahaṇa pratyākhyānena katham atra paravat liṅga tā iti dūṣaṇam nirastam

original: atra pūrvapadārthatāvacchedakadharmāśrayabuddhisthayatkiñcitpratiyogikatvaṃ vyutpattibalalabhyam | evaṃ 'nṛsomaḥ' 'prasannena dṛgabjene'tyādāvapi vyabhicāro draṣṭhavyaḥ | dṛgabjenetyādau mayūravyaṃsākāditvāt samāsaḥ | tata eva paravalliṅgatā, pūrvapadārthapradhānatā ca | rājāntaramiti tadvihitasamāse tasyādṛṣṭatvāt |
analyzed: atra vyutpatti bala labhyam evam nṛsomaḥ prasannena dṛś abjena ityādau api vyabhicāraḥ draṣṭhavyaḥ dṛś abjena ityādau mayūra vyaṃsa ākādi tvāt samāsaḥ tatas eva para vat liṅgatā pūrva padārtha pradhāna tā ca rāja antaram iti tad vihita samāse tasya adṛṣṭa tvāt

original: sāmānyavācakaprayogāt 'upamitaṃ vyāghrādibhiḥ ' iti samāsastu nātra padamādadhāti | upāttadharma eva sādṛśyaprayojakastadupādāna ityarthasya kāvyaprakāśe daśame sphuṭatvādanupāttadharmeṇaivātra sādṛśyamiti na yuktam | purenduḥ sakala ityādāvanupāttadharmeṇa sādṛśyāsaṃbhāvācca |
analyzed: sāmānya vācaka prayogāt upamitam vyāghra ādibhiḥ iti samāsaḥ tu na atra padam ādadhāti upātta dharmaḥ eva sādṛśya prayojakaḥ tad upādāne iti arthasya kāvyaprakāśe daśame sphuṭa tvāt anupātta dharmeṇa eva atra sādṛśyam iti na yuktam purā induḥ sakalaḥ ityādau anupātta dharmeṇa sādṛśya asaṃbhāvāt ca

original: kiṃ cedaṃ sūtraṃ samānaliṅgavacanatva eva pravartate, anyathā 'paravalliṅgam-' iti sūtre 'tatpuruṣaścāpi kaḥ prayojayati, yaḥ pūrvapadārthapradhānaḥ, ekadeśisamāsaḥ, ardhapippalīti,' iti bhāṣyasya dvandvaikadeśinoriti nyāsena tatpuruṣagrahaṇapratyākhyānaparabhāṣyasya cāsaṃgatvāpatteḥ |
analyzed: kim ca idam sūtram samāna liṅga vacana tve eva pravartate anyathā para vat liṅgam iti sūtre tatpuruṣaḥ ca api kaḥ prayojayati yaḥ pūrva padārtha pradhānaḥ ekadeśi samāsaḥ ardhapippalī iti iti bhāṣyasya dvandva ekadeśinoḥ iti nyāsena tatpuruṣa grahaṇa pratyākhyāna para bhāṣyasya ca asaṃga tva āpatteḥ

original: dṛgabjenetyāderapi pūrvapadārthapradhānasya dṛśyamānaparavalliṅgasya sattvāt | mukhacandra ityādāvapyanenaiva tasya pūrvapadārtha- pradhānatvāccandrarūpakavyavahāraḥ, paravalliṅgatā ca tata eveti mañjūṣāyāṃ spaṣṭam | ubhayapadārtha- prādhānyāditi, dvitrā ityato dvivyanyatara iti bodhotpatteḥ | dvandvātivyāptiriti | tallakṣaṇāti- vyāptirityarthaḥ |
analyzed: dṛś abjena ityādeḥ api pūrva padārtha pradhānasya dṛśyamāna para vat liṅgasya sattvāt mukha candraḥ ityādau api anena eva tasya pūrva padārtha pradhāna tvāt candra rūpaka vyavahāraḥ para vat liṅga tā ca tatas eva iti mañjūṣāyām spaṣṭam ubhaya padārtha prādhānyāt iti dvitrāḥ ityatas dvivi anyataraḥ iti bodha utpatteḥ dvandva ativyāptiḥ iti tad lakṣaṇa ati vyāptiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: evamagre'pi | samāhārānyeti | samāhārarūpo yo'nyapadārthastatprādhānyādityarthaḥ | dvandvāvyāptiśceti | dhavakhadirāvityādītaretarayoge ubhayapadārthaviśeṣyakabodhajakatvādisaṃbhavo neti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: evam agre pi samāhāra anyā iti samāhāra rūpaḥ yonya padārthaḥ tad prādhānyāt iti arthaḥ dvandva avyāptiḥ ca iti dhava khadirau ityādi itaretara yoge ubhaya padārtha viśeṣyaka bodha jaka tva ādi saṃbhavaḥ na iti bhāvaḥ

original: vastutastu 'cārthe dvandvaḥ' iti sūtrabhāṣyaparyālocanayetaretarayoge'pi bahuvrīhāvanyapadārthasyeva cārthasamūhasyaiva prādhānyaṃ labhyate, tatra hi cārthasyāsattvabhūtatayā tatparatipādakasamāsasyāpya- liṅgāsaṃkhyatāpattimāśaṅkya svabhāvena parihāraṃ kṛtvā guṇavacanavadyaddravyāśritaḥ samāsārthastad- dravyaliṅgasaṃkhyāgrāhaka iti ca
analyzed: vastutas tu ca arthe dvandvaḥ iti sūtra bhāṣya paryālocanayā itaretara yoge pi bahuvrīhau anya padārthasya iva ca artha samūhasya eva prādhānyam labhyate tatra hi ca arthasya a sattva bhūta tayā liṅga asaṃkhya tā āpattim āśaṅkya svabhāvena parihāram kṛtvā guṇavacana vat yat dravya āśritaḥ samāsa arthaḥ tat dravya liṅga saṃkhyā grāhakaḥ iti ca

original: samādhānamuktam | ata evedaṃ bhāṣyaṃ na samāhāradvandvaparaṃ, tasya tadgrāhitvābhāvāt, tatretaretarayoga udbhūtāvayavabhedaḥ samūhaḥ, samāhāradvandve tvanudbhūtāvayavaḥ sa iti viśeṣaḥ, udbhūtāvayavabhedatvamavayavayagāropitasaṃkhyāvattvam, avayavagatasaṃkhyānārope- 'nudbhūtāvayavabhedatvam, idameva tirohitāvayavabhedatvamityādyanyatra vistaraḥ |
analyzed: samādhānam uktam atas eva idam bhāṣyam na samāhāra dvandva param tasya tad grāhi tva abhāvāt tatra itaretara yoge udbhūta avayava bhedaḥ samūhaḥ samāhāra dvandve tu anudbhūta avayavaḥ saḥ iti viśeṣaḥ udbhūta avayava bheda tvam avayava yaj āropita saṃkhyāvat tvam avayava gata saṃkhyāna ārope n udbhūta avayava bheda tvam idam eva tirohita avayava bheda tvam ityādi anyatra vistaraḥ

original: etanmate tūktalakṣaṇāsaṃbhavo bahuvrīhilakṣaṇātivyāptiśca dvandve bodhyā | evaṃ prācīnoktānāṃ 'pūrvapadārthapradhāna' ityādīnāmavyayībhāvādilakṣaṇattvaṃ dūṣayitvā siddhāntimate tallakṣaṇānyāha siddhāntetviti |
analyzed: etad mate tu ukta lakṣaṇa asaṃbhavaḥ bahuvrīhi lakṣaṇa ativyāptiḥ ca dvandve bodhyā evam prācīna uktānām pūrva padārtha pradhānaḥ ityādīnām avyayībhāva ādi lakṣaṇa ttvam dūṣayitvā siddhānti mate tad lakṣaṇāni āha siddhānte tu iti

original: avyayībhāvādhikāreti | avyayībhāvādhikārāntargatalakṣaṇavihitasamāsatvamityarthaḥ | tenopakumbhāde- stadadhikāre pāṭhābhāve'pi na kṣatiḥ, tattadaghikārapaṭhitādeśādau nātivyāptiḥ, teṣāṃ samāsatvābhāvāt, samāsatvaṃ prāguktameveti na doṣaḥ | pare tu pāṇinyādisaṃketasaṃbandhenāvyayī- bhāvādipadavattvameva tattallakṣaṇamiti pratipannāḥ |
analyzed: avyayībhāva adhikāra iti avyayībhāva adhikāra antargata lakṣaṇa vihita samāsa tvam iti arthaḥ tena upakumbha ādeḥ tad adhikāre pāṭha abhāve api na kṣatiḥ tad tad aghikāra paṭhita ādeśa ādau na ativyāptiḥ teṣām samāsa tva abhāvāt samāsa tvam prāguktam eva iti na doṣaḥ pare tu pāṇini ādi saṃketa saṃbandhena avyayī bhāva ādi padavat tvam eva tat tat lakṣaṇam iti pratipannāḥ

original: avyayībhāvādivyavahāraviṣayatvaṃ na tallakṣaṇamitya- pare jaguḥ | bhautapūrvyādita mūle pūrva bhūtaṃ bhūtapūrva, bhūtapūrvameva bhautapūrvya, 'svārthe ṣyañ' | vṛtteḥ pūrvakāle bhūtaṃ yat pūrvapadārthaviśeṣyakabodhajanakatvaṃ tasmāddhetoḥ so'pi - utsārgau'pi gavayādivadāsthitaḥ, - svīkṛta ityarthaḥ | bhautapūrvyādityanenoktisaṃbhava uktaḥ |
analyzed: avyayībhāva ādi vyavahāra viṣaya tvam na tat lakṣaṇam iti a pare jaguḥ mūle pūrvam bhūtam bhūta pūrva bhūta pūrvam eva bhautapūrvya svārthe vṛtteḥ pūrva kāle bhūtam yat pūrva padārtha viśeṣyaka bodha janaka tvam tasmāt hetoḥ saḥ api gavaya ādi vat āsthitaḥ svīkṛtaḥ iti arthaḥ bhauta pūrvyāt iti anena uktisaṃbhavaḥ uktaḥ

original: na samāsalakṣatva- miti | rekhāgavayādeniṣṭhalāṅgūlādervāstavapaśugatatvābhāvānna vāstavapaśulakṣaṇatvaṃ yathā, tathā tādṛśatādṛśabodhajanakatvasya tattatsamāsaniṣṭhatvābhāvānna tattatsamāsalakṣaṇatvaṃ, tatra viśiṣṭa- śaktisvīkāreṇāvayavānāṃ nairarthakyāditi bhāvaḥ | bodhakatā tadvadeveti |
analyzed: na iti rekhāgavaya ādi niṣṭha lāṅgūla ādeḥ vāstava paśu gata tva abhāvāt na vāstava paśu lakṣaṇa tvam yathā tathā tādṛśa tādṛśa bodha janaka tvasya tad tad samāsa niṣṭha tva abhāvāt na tad tad samāsa lakṣaṇa tvam tatra viśiṣṭa śakti svīkāreṇa avayavānām nairarthakyāt iti bhāvaḥ bodhaka tā tadvat eva iti

original: rekhāgavayādiniṣṭalā- ṅgūlāderthathā sādṛśyena paśuniṣṭhalāṅgādibodhanadvārā vāstavapaśubodhakatvaṃ, tathā vṛtteḥ prāk tatta- tpadārthatvaṃ yatra dṛṣṭaṃ tattadarthaviśeṣyakabodhajanakatayā tattadāśraye ttatsamāsabodhakatvamiti bhāvaḥ ||
analyzed: sādṛśyena paśu niṣṭha lāṅgūla ādeḥ tathā vṛtteḥ prāk tad tad padārtha tvam yatra dṛṣṭam tad tad artha viśeṣyaka bodha janakatayā tad tad āśraye ttad samāsa bodhaka tvam iti bhāvaḥ

original: suvacamiti | tathā ca prācīnoktāni lakṣaṇāni nāsambhavaduktikānīti bhāvaḥ | jahatsvārtheti | jahatsvārthatvamevaikārthībhāvaḥ, ajahatsvārthatvameva vyapekṣeti bhāvaḥ | ekārthībhāvapakṣe samudāyaśaktyaiva viśiṣṭārthopasthitisaṃbhave'vayavā na svārthopasthiti kurvanti, vaiyarthyāt |
analyzed: suvacam iti tathā ca prācīna uktāni lakṣaṇāni na asambhavat uktikāni iti bhāvaḥ jahat svārtha iti jahat svārtha tvam eva ekārthībhāvaḥ ajahat svārtha tvam eva vyapekṣā iti bhāvaḥ ekārthībhāva pakṣe samudāya śaktyā eva viśiṣṭa artha upasthiti saṃbhava ivayavāḥ na svārtha upasthiti kurvanti vaiyarthyāt

original: ajahatsvārthatāṃ vinā parasparamanvayākāṅkṣārūpavyapekṣāyā asaṃbhavādvayapekṣāpakṣe'vayavāḥ svārtho- pasthāpakā eveti bhāvaḥ | uktavyavastheti | pūrvapārthapradhāno'vyayībhāva ityādivyavasthetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: ajahat svārthatām vinā parasparam anvaya ākāṅkṣā rūpa vyapekṣāyāḥ asaṃbhavāt vayapekṣā pakṣevayavāḥ svārtha upasthāpakāḥ eva iti bhāvaḥ ukta vyavasthā iti pūrva pārtha pradhānaḥ avyayībhāvaḥ ityādi vyavasthā iti arthaḥ

original: nāsaṃbhavinīti | upakumbhamityādyavyayībāvādau tasya saṃbhavāt | yathā sūpapatotyādāvavyā- ptyativyāptirūpadoṣasattve'pi samanantaramabhihito'saṃbhavo'saṃbhavītyarthaḥ | jahati padānīti | 'saptamī viśeṣaṇe ' iti sūtre saptamīgrahaṇājjñāpakādvayadhikaraṇānāmapi padānāṃ kkacidbahuvrīhi- rbhavatīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: na asaṃbhavinī iti upakumbham ityādi avyayībāva ādau tasya saṃbhavāt yathā sūpapati ityādau avyāpti ativyāpti rūpa doṣa sattve pi samanantaram abhihita usaṃbhava usaṃbhavī iti arthaḥ jahati padāni iti saptamī viśeṣaṇe iti sūtre saptamī grahaṇāt jñāpakāt vayadhikaraṇānām api padānām kkacid bahuvrīhiḥ bhavati iti bhāvaḥ

original: jahati svāni - vṛttighaṭakībhūtapadāni yaṃsa jahatsvastādṛśā'rtho yasyāmiti samānādhikaraṇapadako'pi saṃbhavatīti pare | vṛttau padānāmānarthakyamiti | śaktapadaghaṭakavarṇānāmiva vṛttighaṭakapadānāmānarthakyānaṅgīkāre padaghaṭakavarṇānāmapyānarthakyaṃ na syāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: jahati svāni vṛtti ghaṭakībhūta padāni yam sa jahatsvaḥ tādṛśa arthaḥ yasyām iti samāna adhikaraṇa padakaḥ api saṃbhavati iti pare vṛttau padānām ānarthakyam iti śakta pada ghaṭaka varṇānām iva vṛtti ghaṭaka padānām ānarthakya anaṅgīkāre pada ghaṭaka varṇānām api ānarthakyam na syāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu padaghaṭakavarṇānāṃ kutrāpyarthābodhakatayānarthakye'pi rājādipadānāṃ vākye'rthabodhakatayā samāse vākyadṛṣṭārthabodhotpādena ca na nairarthakyasaṃbhava ityāśaṅkyāha aya bhāva iti | rājaviśiṣṭeti | svāmitvādisaṃbandhena rājaviśiṣṭapuruṣetyarthaḥ | rājñaḥ puruṣa ityatrāpi saṃbandhasya saṃsargatayaiva bhānādbṛttivākyayoḥ samānārthatvanirvāhaḥ |
analyzed: nanu pada ghaṭaka varṇānām kutra api artha ābodhakatayā ānarthakye pi rāja ādi padānām vākya īrtha bodhakatayā samāse vākya dṛṣṭārtha bodha utpādena ca na nairarthakya saṃbhavaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha bhāvaḥ iti rāja viśiṣṭa iti svāmi tva ādi saṃbandhena rāja viśiṣṭa puruṣa iti arthaḥ rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ iti atra api saṃbandhasya saṃsargatayā eva bhānāt bṛtti vākyayoḥ samāna artha tva nirvāhaḥ

original: śaktigrahaṃ vinā śakyānupasthitau śakyasaṃbandharūpalakṣaṇāgrahavaidhuryeṇa pajhatvaviśiṣṭārtha- bodhāsaṃbhava iti bhāvaḥ | tathā cāvayavaśaktigrahavirahadaśāyamāpi paṅkajapadāt pajhatvaprakārakabodha- syānubhavasiddhasya saṃpattaye samudāyaśaktyāvaśyakatvamiti tātparyārthaḥ |

original: na bodha iti | tathā ca tatrāvayavaśaktigrahavirahasamaye tādṛśabodhābhāva evānubhavasiddho na tu bodha iti bodhānudaya iṣṭāpattireveti bhāvaḥ | 'bahuvyutpattibhañjanamiti | mūle eva prāgetadvayākhyātam | uttarapada eva lakṣaṇāyāṃ vinigamakamāha pūrvapadasyeti | tallakṣaṇāyā iti | pūrvapadalakṣaṇāgrahasyetyarthaḥ | dhātupratyayeti |

original: nanu 'prāpte'ti samudāye na lakṣaṇā, tasya śaktyabhāvena śakyasaṃbandharūpalakṣaṇāyā asaṃbhavāt, kiṃ tu tattaddhaṭakaktapratyaye eva, tathā ca tattadarthajñānamātrasādhyatvaṃ, na tu dhātutadarthajñānasādhyatvamapi, kartṛkaprāptikarmalakṣaṇāyāmapi udakaśabdatadarthajñānasādhyatayā sāmyameva |

original: nanu ktapratyaye udaka kartṛkaprāptikarmalakṣaṇāyāṃ tādṛśadhātusamabhivyāhārajñānasya tātparyagrāhakatvaṃ vācyamanyathātiprasaṅgāt, evaṃ ca dhātutadarthajñānasādhyatvamakṣatameva, kiṃ ca 'svabodhyasaṃbandho lakṣaṇe'ti māmāṃsakamate 'prāpte'ti samudāye lakṣaṇāsaṃbhavāttattadarthajñānasādhyatvamanapavādamiti sphuṭameveti cet udakapade tādṛśārtha-
analyzed: nanu ktapratyaye udaka kartṛka prāpti karma lakṣaṇāyām tādṛśa dhātu samabhivyāhāra jñānasya tātparya grāhaka tvam vācyam anyathā atiprasaṅgāt evam ca dhātu tad artha jñāna sādhyatvam akṣatam eva kim ca sva bodhya saṃbandhaḥ lakṣaṇā iti māmāṃsaka mate prāptā iti samudāye lakṣaṇā asaṃbhavāt tad tad artha jñāna sādhyatvam anapavādam iti sphuṭam eva iti ced udaka pade tādṛśa artha jñāna sādhyatvam anapavādam iti sphuṭam eva iti ced udaka pad

original: lakṣaṇāyāmapa prāptapadasamabhivyāhārasya tātparyagrāhakatayā dhātupratyayatadarthajñānasādhyatvaṃ durapahnavameva, prāptikarmajñānaṃ vinā tatsaṃbandharūpalakṣaṇāgrahā'saṃbhavādityata uttarapadalakṣaṇāyāṃ vinigamakāntaramāha pratyayānāmiti | saṃnihiteti | saṃnihitaṃ yatpadaṃ tadarthagatetyarthaḥ |

original: atra 'rājapuruṣamānaye'tyatra rājñi na pratyayārthakarmatvādyanvayaḥ, anyathā dvivacanāpatteḥ, puruṣe ānayanakarmatvavirahagrahadaśāyāṃ rājani ānayanakarmatvānvayatātparyeṇa 'rājapuruṣamānaye'ti prayogāpatteśca, tādṛśaśravaṇānantaraṃ tadarthabodhe sati rājānayanāpatteśca | etena rājani tadanvaye iṣṭāpattiniṃrastā |

original: ghaṭādipadaghaṭakakacaramavarṇasyaiva vācakatvaṃ syāttu lyanyāyāditi śābdikoktapratibandīrūpaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ nirasyati ghaṭādipade ceti | atiriktā śaktiriti | taddhaṭakadhātvādiśaktyatiriktā, gṛhītaśaktikapadaśaktyatiriktā, bodhakatvātiriktā vetyarthaḥ |

original: viśiṣṭe kalpyate - viśiṣṭa eva kalpyate | saṃketitatvāt - kośādinā saṃketitatvena bodhanāt | nanu bodhakatvarūpā śakticaramavarṇe eva syāt, kiṃ ca tadanyathānupapattyā tadatiriktā kalpyamānāpi śaktistatraiva paryavasyodityāśaṅkyāha bodhakatvasyāpīti | bodhajanakatvaparyāptyadhi- karaṇatvasyapītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: viśiṣṭe kalpyate viśiṣṭaḥ eva kalpyate saṃketita tvāt kośa ādinā saṃketita tvena bodhanāt nanu bodhaka tva rūpā śakti carama varṇe eva syāt kim ca tad anyathā anupapattyā tad atiriktā kalpyamānā api śaktiḥ tatra eva paryavasya uditi āśaṅkya āha bodhaka tvasya api iti bodha janakatva paryāpti adhi karaṇa tvasya api iti arthaḥ

original: tena bodhakatvāśrayatvasya tatra sattve'pi na kṣatiḥ | nanu prakṛte'pi 'citragusvāmī'ti bodhānyathānupapattyā kalpyamānā lakṣaṇāpi uttarapadavat pūrvapade'pi kalpyā'- viśeṣādityāśaṅkyāha prakṛte ceti . sā kalpyata iti | lakṣaṇā kalpya ityarthaḥ | viśeṣa iti |

original: 'śakyādaśakyopasthitirlakṣaṇe'ti pakṣe lakṣaṇā na śaktighaṭitā, pravāhādirūpo yo vastuto gaṅgāpadādiśakyārthastaddhetukatīrādyupasthitereva lakṣaṇātvāt, nacoktajñānasyopasthiti pratyupayoga ityata āha śakyasaṃbandharūpeti |

original: atra śakterviśeṣaṇavidhayaiva praveśo, na tūpalakṣaṇatayā, evaṃ ca gaṅgāpadaśakyapravāhasaṃbandhitīramityādyā- kāraka eva lakṣaṇāgrahe heturna tu pravāhasaṃbandhitīramityādyākāraka iti bhāvaḥ | samānaviṣayatvasya - tatpraveśasya, tadviṣayakopasthitau tanniṣṭhaviṣayatānirūpitaśaktiniṣṭhaviṣayatākajñānahetutva- syāvaśyakatvāditi paryavasito'rthaḥ |

original: gaṅgāpadaśakyasaṃbandhi tīramiti lakṣaṇājñānasya, śakyasaṃbandhasaṃsargakasya gaṅagāpadāttīramityākārasya vā lakṣaṇājñānasya tīraviṣayakatve sati śaktiviṣayakatve'pi na tīrāṃśe śaktiviṣayakatvamiti na śaktijñānavidhayā tīropasthitinirvāhakatā- saṃbhavaḥ | atra 'śaktijñānapadārthopasthityo'rityupalakṣaṇaṃ, śaktijñānaśābdabodhayorityapi bodhyam |

original: samānaviṣayakatvāpraveśe bādhakamāha anyatheti | saṃbandhāgraheti | tad‌grahadaśāyāṃ tu 'pravoho gaṅgāpadaśakya' iti jñānāttīrabodha iṣṭa eveti tad‌grahānusaraṇam |

analyzed: dyotaka tā pakṣe sarvaṣām eva teṣām nirarthaka tayā vyāvartya abhāvāt spaṣṭa tvāt iti tatra anarthakasya iti tu pāda pūrāṇa arthānām sarvathā na arthavat tvam sūcayitum pratyākhyāta tvāt iti adhi parī anarthakau iti asya anarthakasya api arthavat kṛtam bhavati iti arthe jñāpaka tām ākṣitya pratyākhyāta tvāt bahuvacanam mīmāṃsaka iti

original: śaktigrahasyāpīti | atra 'kāryakāraṇabhāva āvaśyaka' ityanuṣajyate | ubhayamapi - vācatvadyotakatvobhayamapītyarthaḥ | ata eva - vācakatvadyotakatvobhayasvīkārādeva || 47 ||

original: evaṃ puruṣarūpeṇa vastugatyā rājasaṃbandhavān yaḥ puruṣaḥ sa samāsārtha iti pakṣe-tvapratyayārthaḥ puraṣatvameva, tadvayaktamātranirūpatā- dheyatvasaṃbandhena prakṛtyarthasya tatrānvayaḥ, ata eva tatpakṣe kṛttaddhitetyādivacanamāvaśyakamiti śaṅkānavakāśaḥ | ityanvayabodhaḥ - iti śābdabodhaḥ |
analyzed: evam puruṣa rūpeṇa vastu gatyā rāja saṃbandhavān yaḥ puruṣaḥ sa samāsa arthaḥ iti pakṣetva pratyaya arthaḥ pura sattvam eva tad vayakta mātra nirūpatā dheyatva saṃbandhena prakṛti arthasya tatra anvayaḥ atas eva tad pakṣe kṛt taddhita ityādi vacanam āvaśyakam iti śaṅkā anavakāśaḥ iti anvaya bodhaḥ iti śābda bodhaḥ

original: taddhitānte'piśaktisattvena pṛthagupasthitiviṣayārthayoḥ saṃsargasyaivānvayatvena yathāśrutāsaṃgatyāpatteḥ, śābdatvaṃ tu tatrāpa 'śabdayāmī'tyanubhavādityanyatra vistaraḥ | 'upasthitayoḥ saṃbandho'nvaya' iti mate tu yathāśrutamevāstu | avyabhicaritasaṃbandhe tu-apatyāpatyavatsaṃbandhasyāvyabhicaritasaṃbandhatve tu |

original: yathā sat sattayoḥ saṃbandhaḥ kadāpi na vyabhicaritastathānayorapi, sata utpattiprabhṛti-āvināśāt saṃbandhasya vidyamānatvādapatyasyotpattiprabhṛti-āvināśāduktasaṃbandhasyāpi tathātvāditi bhāvaḥ |

original: ata eva saṃbandhārthakatvaprasaktiḥ | abhedapratyayāditi | matupo lugvidhānaṃ tu 'paṭasya śukrala' iti guṇaguṇinorbhedavyavahārasyāpi sattvācchuklavānityaviṣṭaprayoga- nivṛttyartham | jātāveveti | lokanirūḍhena 'so'ya'miti pratyayena bhedasaṃbandhasya tirodhānānna saṃbandhe pratyayaḥ, evaṃ 'śukla' ityādāvapi |

original: pācakādau tu kriyayābhedasyaiva pratītervyabhicārācca krayāsaṃbandhājñānamūlikaiva śabdasya dravye pravṛttiḥ, evaṃ rājapuruṣādāvapīti tattatsaṃbandha eva
analyzed: pācaka ādau tu kriyayā abhedasya eva pratīteḥ vyabhicārāt ca kraya asaṃbandha ajñāna mūlikā eva śabdasya dravye pravṛttiḥ evam rāja puruṣa ādau api iti tad tad saṃbandhaḥ eva

analyzed: tad tad uttara bāva pratyaya arthaḥ nīla ghaṭa tvam ati ādau nīla ghaṭa ādi vṛtti ghaṭa tva ādikam eva tu ādi vācyatve na āśrayati na tu saṃbandhi viśeṣaṇa abhinna rūpatvena pūrva uttara padārthayoḥ viśeṣya viśeṣaṇa bhāva atirikta saṃbandhasya abhāvāt ghaṭa tvam eva nīla ghaṭa śabda pravṛtti namittam nīla ādi viśeṣaṇa balāt tu ghaṭa tva rūpeṇa

original: 'dhavakhadiratva'mityādau jātisamudāyastadvācyaḥ, samudāyasyānud‌bhūtāvayavatve ekavacanam, udbhūtāvayavatve punardvivacanādakamapīti bodhyamiti vadanti, tad dhvanayannāha digiti | tārkikāstu karmadhārayottarabāvapratyayaḥ padārthatāvacchedakayonī'latva- ghaṭatvādyoḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyavacana ityūcuḥ ||

original: prakṛtyarthaviśiṣṭeti | saṃyogādisaṃbandhena vastugatyā daṇḍādiviśiṣṭetyarthaḥ, tatra syogādiḥ saṃsagamaryādayā bhāsata iti tatra na śaktiḥ, kiṃ tu prakṛterdaṇḍe, āśraye ca pratyayasya | mātrapadena saṃyogādirūpasaṃbandhavyāvṛttiḥ, ata eva 'pācaka' ityādāvapi saṃbandho na śakyaḥ | uktaṃ ca bhaṭṭaiḥ
