original: kālaḥ samayo velā vā bhoktum | atra 'kālasamayavelāsu tumun' iti tumun | atra kālaniṣṭho yogyatālakṣaṇo bhojanasya saṃbandhastumun‌dyotyaḥ, atra praiṣādigrahaṇānuvartanāt praiṣādivivakṣāyāmeva tumun, nānuvāde,--bhūtāni kālaḥ pacatī'tyādāvityalamativistareṇa | prakṛtamanusarāmi--'bhuktvā tṛpta' iti vākyajaṃ bodhamāha--bhojanajanyeti |
analyzed: kālaḥ samayaḥ velā vā bhoktum atra kāla samaya velāsu tumun iti tumun atra kāla niṣṭhaḥ yogyatā lakṣaṇaḥ bhojanasya saṃbandhaḥ tumun dyotyaḥ atra praiṣa ādi grahaṇa anuvartanāt praiṣa ādi vivakṣāyām eva tumun na anuvādebhūtāni kālaḥ pacati ityādau iti alam ati vistareṇa prakṛtam anusarāmi bhuktvā tṛptaḥ iti vākya jam bodham āha bhojana janya iti

original: bhojanajanyā yā tṛptistadāśraya ityarthaḥ, 'gatyarthākarmake'ti sūtreṇa kartari ktpratyayavidhānāt | nanvānantaryasamānakartṛkatvayoreva tatra saṃsargatayā bhāvamastu, kiṃ guruśarīrajanyatvasya saṃsargatayā bhālasvīkāreṇetyata āha-ata eveti | janyatvasya saṃsargatayā bhānasvīkārādevetyarthaḥ | na prayoga iti |
analyzed: bhojana janyā yā tṛptiḥ tad āśrayaḥ iti arthaḥ gati arthā akarmakā iti sūtreṇa kartari ktpratyaya vidhānāt nanu ānantarya samāna kartṛka tvayoḥ eva tatra saṃsargatayā bhāvam astu kim guru śarīra janya tvasya saṃsargatayā bhāla svīkāreṇa iti atas āha atas eva iti janya tvasya saṃsargatayā bhāna svīkārāt eva iti arthaḥ na prayoge iti

original: bhojanajanyatṛptau jalapānajanyatvābhāvāditi bhāvaḥ | samānakartṛkatvamapīti | 'bhuktvā vrajatī'tyatra vrajane bhojanādhikaraṇavṛttitvasya bhāne kriyayāradhikaraṇaniṣṭhaikyasyāpyarthasiddhatvāt, samānādhikaraṇyasya tadaikyaṃ vinānupapadyamānatvāt |
analyzed: bhojana janya tṛptau jala pāna janya tva abhāvāt iti bhāvaḥ samāna kartṛkatvam api iti bhuktvā vrajati iti atra vrajane bhojana adhikaraṇa vṛtti tvasya bhāne kriyayāḥ adhikaraṇa niṣṭha aikyasya api artha siddha tvāt samānādhikaraṇyasya tad aikyam vinā anupapadyamāna tvāt

original: 'matprasūtimanārādhya prajeti tvāṃ śaśāpa sā' ityatra 'sthitasye'tyadhyāhārāt sthitikriyāsamānakartṛkatvādikamastīti ktvāpratyayasya nānupapattiḥ |
analyzed: mad prasūtim an ārādhya prajā iti tvām śaśāpa sā iti atra sthitasya iti adhyāhārāt sthiti kriyā samāna kartṛkatva ādikam asti iti ktvāpratyayasya na anupapattiḥ

original: pūrvottarabhāva iti | pūrvakālavṛttitvottarakālavṛttitvasamudāya ityarthaḥ, etasya saṃsargatayā bhānānabhyupagame vrajanasya pūrvakālavṛttitve'pi bhuktvā vrajatīti prayogāpattiḥ, sāmānādhikaraṇyasya tathātvānabhyupagame bhinnakartṛkatathāvidhakriyāyugalābhiprāyeṇa tadāpattirityubhayoḥ saṃsargatvānusaraṇam |
analyzed: pūrva uttara bhāvaḥ iti pūrva kāla vṛtti tva uttara kāla vṛtti tva samudāyaḥ iti arthaḥ etasya saṃsarga tayā bhāna anabhyupagame vrajanasya pūrva kāla vṛtti tve api bhuktvā vrajati iti prayoga āpattiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyasya tathātva anabhyupagame bhinna kartṛka tathāvidha kriyā yugala abhiprāyeṇa tad āpattiḥ iti ubhayoḥ saṃsarga tva anusaraṇam

original: pūrvottarabhāve'vyavadhānāṃśo'pi niveśyaḥ | anyathā pūrvavarṣotpannaṃ śvaśuragṛhe bhojanabhetadvarṣādhikaraṇakaṃ vrajanaṃ cādāya 'śvaśuragṛhe bhuktvā vrajatī'ti prayogāpattiḥ | avyavadhānaṃ tu tātparyavasāt kkacid daṇḍena kkacinmuhūrtena kkacit praharādinā yathāyartha grāhyam |
analyzed: niveśyaḥ anyathā pūrva varṣa utpannam śvaśura gṛhe vrajanam ca ādāya śvaśura gṛhe bhuktvā vrajati iti prayoga āpattiḥ avyavadhānam tu tātparyavasāt kkacid daṇḍena kkacid muhūrtena kkacid prahara ādinā yathāyartha grāhyam

original: daṇḍādinā vyavadhānaṃ ca svaprāgabhāvādhikaraṇadaṇḍādiprāgabhāvanādhikaraṇatvaṃ, svaṃ - samabhivyāhṛtavrajanādikriyāviśeṣaḥ |
analyzed: daṇḍa ādinā vyavadhānam ca sva prāgabhāva adhikaraṇa daṇḍa ādi prāgabhāvana adhikaraṇa tvam svam samabhivyāhṛta vrajana ādi kriyā viśeṣaḥ

original: tathā cāvyavahitapūrvatvaṃ kālaniṣṭhaṃ tādṛśāvyavadhānaviśiṣṭatatkriyāprāgabhāvādhikaraṇatvaṃ, bhojanottaraṃ daṇḍottaraṃ gamanasthale tu bhojanādhikaraṇakṣaṇādestatra vrajanapāgabhāvādhikaraṇadaṇḍaprāgabhāvādhikaraṇatayā na tathāvidhaprayogaprahaṅgaḥ | viśeṣyadalaniveśād‌brajanottaraṃ bhojanatātparyeṇa na 'bhokte' iti prayogaprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca avyavahita pūrva tvam kāla niṣṭham tādṛśa avyavadhāna viśiṣṭa tad kriyā prāgabhāva adhikaraṇa tvam bhojana uttaram daṇḍa uttaram gamana sthale tu bhojana adhikaraṇa kṣaṇa ādeḥ tatra vrajana pāgabhāva adhikaraṇa daṇḍa prāgabhāva adhikaraṇa tayā na tathāvidha prayoga prahaṅgaḥ viśeṣya dala niveśāt brajana uttaram bhojana tātparyeṇa na bhokte iti prayoga prasaṅgaḥ

original: vastutastad‌vrajanakāle bhojalādhikaraṇasamaya dhvaṃsādhikaraṇatvarūpottaratvavirahānnoktātiprasaṅga iti tannaniveśyam | 'adya bhuktvā śvo gantā' 'mārgaśīrṣe udvāhya paupe kāśīṃ gata' ityādirathale dinamāsādinoktavyavadhānābhāvo vivakṣita iti nānupapattiḥ |
analyzed: vastutas tad vrajana kāle dhvaṃsa adhikaraṇa tva rūpa uttaratva virahāt na ukta atiprasaṅgaḥ iti tat na niveśyam adya bhuktvā śvas gantā mārgaśīrṣe udvāhya paupe kāśīm gataḥ ityādiḥ rathale dina māsa ādinā ukta vyavadhāna abhāvaḥ vivakṣitaḥ iti nā anupapattiḥ

original: prāgabhāvānabhyupagame tu--svādhikaraṇakṣaṇotpattikadhvaṃsapratiyogidaṇḍādhikaraṇakotpattikadhvaṃsāpratiyogitvavadhānaṃ, tadadhikaraṇasamayotpattikadhvaṃsapratiyogitvaṃ tatpūrvaṃtvam | paraṃ tu prakṛte etanniveśānāvaśyakatā pūrvavadavaseyā | kālaviśeṣeti |
analyzed: prāgabhāva anabhyupagame tu sva adhikaraṇa kṣaṇa utpattika dhvaṃsa pratiyogi daṇḍa adhikaraṇaka utpattika dhvaṃsa apratiyogi tva avadhānam tad adhikaraṇa samaya utpattika dhvaṃsa pratiyogi tvam tad pūrvaṃtvam param tu prakṛte etad niveśa anāvaśyaka tā pūrvavat avaseyā kāla viśeṣa iti

original: tatkālāvacchinnasvādhikaraṇaniṣṭhātyantābhāvapratiyogitānavacchedakamukhavyādānatvādimat sāmānādhikaraṇyarūpaṃ vyāpyatvamityarthaḥ | kālaviśeṣāvacchinneti |
analyzed: tad kāla avacchinna sva adhikaraṇa niṣṭha atyanta abhāva pratiyogitā anavacchedaka mukhavyādāna tva ādimat sāmānādhikaraṇya rūpam vyāpyatvam iti arthaḥ kāla viśeṣa avacchinna iti

original: atra--kālaḥ kṣaṇādirūpaḥ sūkṣmakālo grāhyaḥ, nātaḥ sthūlakālāvacchinnavyāpyatvamādāya mukhavyādānottaraṃ mukhavyādānaśūnyakālikasvāpavyattayabhiprāyeṇa tatkāle mukhaṃ vyādāya svapitīti prayogāpattiḥ | ata eva nirantarādhyayānaśālinyevāyamadhītya tiṣṭhatīti prayogo, na tu kadācidadhyayanakartarīti vyavasthopapadyate |
analyzed: atra kālaḥ kṣaṇa ādi rūpaḥ sūkṣma kālaḥ grāhyaḥ na atas sthūla kāla avacchinna vyāpyatvam ādāya mukha vyādāna uttaram mukha vyādāna śūnya kālika svāpa vyattaya bhiprāyeṇa tad kāle mukham vyādāya svapiti iti prayoga āpattiḥ atas eva nirantara adhyayāna śālini eva ayam adhītya tiṣṭhati iti prayogaḥ na tu kadācid adhyayana kartari iti vyavasthā upapadyate

original: tatrāpyuktavyāpyatvasya saṃbandhatayā bhānānnirantarādhyayanavirahipuruṣasthitau adhyayanavyāpyatvābhāvāt tādṛśaprayogāprasaṅgāt | paraṃ tu svasamānādhikaraṇetyatra svaśabdena tatpuruṣoyanidrādiśūnyakālikasthitisānānyaṃ grāhyaṃ,-nāta uktadoṣatādavasthyam |
analyzed: tatra api ukta vyāpya tvasya saṃbandhatayā bhānāt nirantara adhyayana virahi puruṣa sthitau adhyayana vyāpya tva abhāvāt tādṛśa prayoga aprasaṅgāt param tu sva samāna adhikaraṇa iti atra sva śabdena grāhyam na atas ukta doṣa tādavasthyam

original: 'mukhaṃvyādāye'tyatra tu svapadena tu tattat‌svāpavyaktirgrāhyā, nāto vyādānaśūnyakāle tādṛśaprayogāpattirvyādānakāle tādṛśaprayogopapattiśceti pratibhāti | sthādidhāturapi tādṛśasthititvādyavacchinnaparaḥ, nāta uddeśyatāvacchedakāvacchedena tādṛśavyāpyatvānvayānupapattiḥ |
analyzed: mukham vyādāya iti atra tu sva padena tu tad tad svāpa vyaktiḥ grāhyā na atas vyādāna śūnya kāle tādṛśa prayoga āpattiḥ vyādāna kāle tādṛśa prayoga upapattiḥ ca iti pratibhāti sthā ādi dhātuḥ api tādṛśa sthiti tva ādi avacchinna paraḥ na atas uddeśya tā avacchedaka avacchedena tādṛśa vyāpya tva anvaya anupapattiḥ

original: yadyapyetādṛśavyāpyatvabhānenaivātiprasaṅganirāse sāmānādhikaraṇyasya saṃbandhatābhyupagamo nirarthakastathāpi sāmānādhikaraṇyaghaṭitāvyāptiḥ saṃbandhatayā svīkāryeti sūcanāya--'sāmānadhikaraṇyaṃ ca saṃsarga' ityuktam | athavoktavyāptau sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ na praveśyamiti yathāśrutameva ramaṇīyam |
analyzed: yadi api etādṛśa vyāpya tva bhānena eva atiprasaṅga nirāse sāmānādhikaraṇyasya saṃbandhatā abhyupagamaḥ nirarthakaḥ tathā api sāmānādhikaraṇya ghaṭita avyāptiḥ saṃbandhatayā svīkāryā iti sūcanāya sāmānadhikaraṇyam ca saṃsargaḥ iti uktam athavā ukta vyāptau sāmānādhikaraṇyam na praveśyam iti yathāśrutam eva ramaṇīyam

original: athavā kālikasaṃbandhāvacchinnaṃ vyāpyatvaṃ saṃbandha ityeva kālaviśeṣāvacchinnetyādigranthatātparyārthaḥ | evaṃ ca kādācitkādhyayanakartṛpuruṣasthiterapi puruṣāntarīyādhyayananirūpitoktavyāpyatāśrayatayā 'dhītya tiṣṭhatī'ti prayogāpattirataḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyasyāpi saṃbandhatvapuraskāraḥ |
analyzed: athavā kālika saṃbandha avacchinnam vyāpya tvam saṃbandhaḥ iti eva kāla viśeṣa avacchinna ityādi grantha tātparyārthaḥ evam ca kādācitka adhyayana kartṛ puruṣa sthiteḥ api puruṣa antarīya adhyayana nirūpita ukta vyāpya tā āśraya tayā dhītya tiṣṭhati iti prayoga āpattiḥ atas sāmānādhikaraṇyasya api saṃbandha tva puraskāraḥ

original: svasamānādhikaraṇeti-svaśabdaḥ pūrvoktārthaka evato na pūrvoktadoṣāvakāśaḥ, tattatkālaviśeṣagarbhasvasamānakālikatvena sāmānādhikaraṇyasahitena tādṛśasthititvādyavacchedenānvayo lāghavāt svīkartumucita iti cet, yadīyasvāpakāle bahudhā mukhavyādānaṃ yadīyastitikāle tathādhyayanaṃ tatraiva tādṛśaprayoga iṣyate, na tu kādācitkaṃyadīyasvāpādisamaye
analyzed: sva samāna adhikaraṇa iti sva śabdaḥ pūrvokta arthakaḥ evatas na pūrvokta doṣa avakāśaḥ tad tad kāla viśeṣa garbha sva samāna kālika tvena sāmānādhikaraṇya sahitena tādṛśa sthiti tva ādi avacchedena anvayaḥ lāghavāt svīkartum ucitaḥ iti ced yadīya svāpa kāle bahudhā mukha vyādānam tathā adhyayanam tatra eva tādṛśa prayogaḥ iṣyate na tu kādācitkam yadīya svāpa ādi samaye

original: mukhavyādānādikaṃ tatretyato'tiprasaṅgavāraṇāyoktavyāpyatvabhānānusaraṇamiti pratibhāti |
analyzed: mukha vyādāna ādikam tatra ityataḥ utiprasaṅga vāraṇāya ukta vyāpyatva bhāna anusaraṇam iti pratibhāti

original: yadi tūktasthale'pi sa prayogaḥ prāmāṇikastadedamevocitaṃ, prakṛtagranthasyāpyatraiva tātparyamiti vāstu | adhyayanamukhavyādānottaramapi svāpasthitasattvena pūrvakālatvādeḥ saṃbandhasya sattvānna ktvaḥ sādhutvānupapattiḥ | spaṣṭaṃ ceda' prakṛtasūtrabhāṣye |
analyzed: yadi tu ukta sthale api sa prayogaḥ prāmāṇikaḥ tadā idam eva ucitam prakṛta granthasya api atra eva tātparyam iti vā astu adhyayana mukha vyādāna uttaram api sva apasthita sattvena pūrva kāla tva ādeḥ saṃbandhasya sattvāt na ktvaḥ sādhutva anupapattiḥ spaṣṭam ced prakṛta sūtra bhāṣye

original: na ca 'bhuñjāne bhuṅkte' iti prayogavāraṇāya samabhivyāhṛtatatphalaviśeṣānukūlayāvatkriyāvadhikapūrvatvasyaiva grāhyatayā kathamuktarītyā 'mukhaṃvyādāya svapitī'ti prayoga iti vācyam, tatra phalabhedakalpanayā mukhavyādānottarasukhaviśeṣādiphalakavyāpārasāmānyapūrvakatvasya mukhavyādāne saṃbhavenādoṣāt |
analyzed: na ca bhuñjāne bhuṅkte iti prayoga vāraṇāya samabhivyāhṛta tad phala viśeṣa anukūla yāvat kriyā avadhika pūrvatvasya eva grāhya tayā katham ukta rītyā mukham vyādāya svapiti iti prayogaḥ iti vācyam tatra phala bheda kalpanayā mukha vyādāna uttara sukha viśeṣa ādi phalaka vyāpāra sāmānya pūrvakatvasya mukha vyādāne saṃbhavena adoṣāt

original: 'bhuktvā bhuṅkte' iti prayogasyanusāritvāt 'madhyāhna bhuktvā rātrau bhuṅkte' iti prayogastviṣyata evoktarītyopapadyate ca | tātparyasattve ekabhojanasthale'pi 'odanaṃ bhuktvā roṭikāṃ bhuṅkte' ityāhuḥ |
analyzed: bhuktvā bhuṅkte iti prayoga syanusāri tvāt madhyāhna bhuktvā rātrau bhuṅkte iti prayogaḥ tu iṣyate eva ukta rītyā upapadyate ca tātparya sattve eka bhojana sthale api odanam bhuktvā roṭikām bhuṅkte iti āhuḥ

original: atra kecana naiyāyikāḥ-prāgabhāvāvacchinnakālavṛttitvarūpaṃ pūrvakālikatvaṃ kartā ca ktvārthaḥ, tatra pūrvakālavṛttitve pūrvakāle taddhaṭakaprāgabhāve eva śaktirvā, kartari tu śaktinirūḍhalakṣaṇā vā | prathamapakṣe pūrvakālavṛttitvasyāśrayatvasaṃbandhena prakṛtyarthabhojanādāvanvayaḥ |
analyzed: atra kecana naiyāyikāḥ prāgabhāva avacchinna kāla vṛtti tva rūpam pūrva kālika tvam kartā ca ktvā arthaḥ tatra pūrva kāla vṛtti tve pūrva kāle tad dhaṭaka prāgabhāve eva śaktiḥ vā kartari tu śakti nirūḍha lakṣaṇā vā prathama pakṣe pūrva kāla vṛtti tvasya āśraya tva saṃbandhena prakṛti artha bhojana ādau anvayaḥ

original: dvitīyapakṣe-pūrvakālasya kālikasaṃbandhavacchinnādheyatvaṃ saṃsargaḥ,tṛtīyakalpe-pratiyogitvasaṃbandhena prāgabhāve prakāratā, prakṛtyarthabhojanādeḥ ktvārthe kartari svaniṣṭhakartṛtvanirūpakatvasaṃbandhena viśeṣaṇatvam |
analyzed: dvitīya pakṣe pūrva kālasya kālika saṃbandha vacchinna ādheya tvam saṃsargaḥ tṛtīya kalpe pratiyogitva saṃbandhena prāgabhāve prakāratā prakṛti artha bhojana ādeḥ ktvā arthe kartari sva niṣṭha kartṛ tva nirūpaka tva saṃbandhena viśeṣaṇa tvam

original: tadarthakartari vrajatītyākhyātopāttakartṛtvasyātrprayatayā viśeṣaṇatvamiti vrajanaprāgabhāvavācchinnakālavṛttibhojanānukūlakṛtimān vrajanakartṛtvāśraya iti bodhaḥ | 'pakttvā bhujyate odana' ityatra tūktavidhāpākakartuḥ ktvāntārthasya bhujadhātvarthavyāpāre svaniṣṭhakartṛkatānirūpakatvasaṃbandhenānvayaḥ |
analyzed: tad artha kartari vrajati iti ākhyāta upātta kartṛ tvasya atrprayatayā viśeṣaṇatvam iti vrajana prāgabhāvavān chinna kāla vṛtti bhojana anukūla kṛtimān vrajana kartṛ tva āśrayaḥ iti bodhaḥ pakttvā bhujyate odanaḥ iti atra tu ukta vidhā pāka kartuḥ ktvā anta arthasya bhuja dhātvartha vyāpāre sva niṣṭha kartṛkatā nirūpaka tva saṃbandhena anvayaḥ

original: tathā ca bhojanaprāgabhāvavāvacchinnakālavṛttipākakartṛkartṛkavyāpārajanyagalādhaḥsaṃyogānukūlakriyāśraya odana iti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca odanaḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: yatkriyāvyaktau ktvārthakartuḥ sākṣāt kartṛtvādvārā vānvayastatkriyāvyaktereva ktvārthaprāgabhāve'nvaya iti vyutpat‌tyaṅgīkārānnānyakartṛkavrajanapūrvakālavṛttikasvakartṛkavrajanottarakālikabhojanakartari bhuktvā vrajatīti prayogaprasaṅgaḥ |
analyzed: yad kriyā vyaktau ktvārtha kartuḥ sākṣāt kartṛ tvāt dvārā vā anvayaḥ tad kriyā vyakteḥ eva ktvārtha prāgabhāve anvayaḥ iti vyutpatti aṅgīkārāt na anya kartṛka vrajana pūrva kāla vṛttika sva kartṛka vrajana uttara kālika bhojana kartari bhuktvā vrajati iti prayoga prasaṅgaḥ

original: 'caitro bhuktvā vrajatī'tyatra tu caitre ākhyātārthānvitaktvārthakarturabhedena viśeṣaṇatvaṃ viśeṣyatvaṃ vā | 'caitrasya bhuktvā vrajana'mityatra caitrakartṛkaṃ yadbajanapūrvakālikabhojanaṃ tatkartṛ kartṛkaṃ vrajanamiti bodhaḥ | vrajane tathāvidhabhojanakartuḥ svaniṣṭhakartṛtānirūpakatvaṃ saṃbandhaḥ |
analyzed: caitraḥ bhuktvā vrajati iti atra tu caitre ākhyātārtha anvitaktvā artha kartuḥ abhedena viśeṣaṇa tvam viśeṣya tvam vā caitrasya bhuktvā vrajanam iti atra caitra kartṛkam yat bajana pūrva kālika bhojanam tad kartṛ kartṛkam vrajanam iti bodhaḥ vrajane tathāvidha bhojana kartuḥ sva niṣṭha kartṛtā nirūpaka tvam saṃbandhaḥ

original: 'caitro na bhuktvā vrajatī'tyatra nañā vartamānabrajanakartṛtvaviśiṣṭavrajanapūrvakālikabhojanakartṛbhedaścaitre pratyāyyate | tena yadā ca tādṛśaprayoganirvāhaḥ, yena puruṣeṇa kadāpi bhojanottaraṃ gamanādikaṃ na kṛtaṃ tattātparyako'yaṃ bhuktvā na vrajatīti prayogo'pyupapadyate |
analyzed: caitraḥ na bhuktvā vrajati iti atra nañā vartamāna brajana kartṛ tva viśiṣṭa vrajana pūrva kālika bhojana kartṛ bhedaḥ caitre pratyāyyate tena yadā ca tādṛśa prayoga nirvāhaḥ yena puruṣeṇa kadāpi bhojana uttaram gamana ādikam na kṛtam tad tātparyakaḥ yam bhuktvā na vrajati iti prayogaḥ upi upapadyate

original: etena-caitrābhinna uktavidhabhojanakartari vartamānavrajanakartṛtvābhāvabodho'bhyupeyata iti nirastam | uktasthale'nirvāhāditi digityāhuḥ |
analyzed: etena caitra abhinne uktavidha bhojana kartari vartamāna vrajana kartṛ tva abhāva bodhaḥ abhyupeyate iti nirastam ukta sthale nirvāhāt iti diś iti āhuḥ

original: aparaṃ punastārkikā evaṃ varṇayāṃcakruḥ--prāgabhāvaśakyaḥ karttā lakṣyaḥ, prāgabhāve prakṛtyarthasya svādhikaraṇakālavṛttitvasaṃbandhena kālikasambandhāvacchinnavṛttitvasaṃbandhena vānvayaḥ | kartrekadeśakṛtautvamukūlatvaviṣayitvarūpasaṃbandhena prakṛtyarthānvitaprāgabhāvasyottarakriyāyāṃ pratiyogitāviśeṣaṇatvam |
analyzed: aparam punar tārkikāḥ evam varṇayāṃcakruḥ prāgabhāva śakyaḥ karttā lakṣyaḥ prāgabhāve prakṛti arthasya sva adhikaraṇa kāla vṛtti tva saṃbandhena kālika sambandha avacchinna vṛtti tva saṃbandhena vā anvayaḥ kartṛ eka deśa kṛtautva mukūlatva viṣayi tva rūpa saṃbandhena prakṛti artha anvita prāgabhāvasya uttara kriyāyām pratiyogitā viśeṣaṇa tvam

original: bhojanakartuḥ svaniṣṭhakartṛtānirūpakatvasaṃbandha uttarakriyāyāṃ viśeṣaṇatāghaṭakaḥ, tāvataiva samānakartṛkatvalābhaḥ | itthaṃ ca caitro bhuktvā vrajatīti vākyāt caitrābhinnabhojanakartṛkartṛkabhojanādhikaraṇakālavṛttirbhojanavṛttirvā yaḥ prāgabhāvastatpratiyogi vrajanaṃ tatkartṛtvavāṃścetra iti bodhaḥ |
analyzed: bhojana kartuḥ sva niṣṭha kartṛtā nirūpaka tva saṃbandhaḥ uttara kriyāyām viśeṣaṇatā ghaṭakaḥ tāvatā eva samāna kartṛka tva lābhaḥ ittham ca caitraḥ bhuktvā vrajati iti vākyāt caitra abhinna bhojana kartṛ kartṛka bhojana adhikaraṇa kāla vṛttiḥ bhojana vṛttiḥ vā yaḥ prāgabhāvaḥ tad pratiyogi vrajanam tad kartṛ tvavān cetraḥ iti bodhaḥ

original: prathamāntapadāsamabhivyāhāre tu vrajanakartṛtvamukhyaviśeṣyaka eva bodhaḥ | caitreṇa bhuktvā vrajanamityādau tu vrajanādimukhyaviśeṣyaka eva saḥ | ktvārthadvayasyaikakriyāvyaktāvevānvaya iti niyamāttat puruṣāntarakartṛkavrajanaprākṛkālikasvakartṛkavrajanottarakālikabhojanakartari tādṛk‌prayogāpattiḥ |
analyzed: prathama anta pada a samabhivyāhāre tu vrajana kartṛ tva mukhya viśeṣyakaḥ eva bodhaḥ caitreṇa bhuktvā vrajanam ityādau tu vrajana ādi mukhya viśeṣyakaḥ eva saḥ ktvā artha dvayasya eka kriyā vyaktau eva anvayaḥ iti niyamāt tat puruṣa antara kartṛka vrajana prākṛ kālika sva kartṛka vrajana uttara kālika bhojana kartari tādṛś prayoga āpattiḥ

original: caitro na bhuktvā vrajatītyatra tathāvidhavrajanakartṛtvābhāvavāṃścaitra iti bodha iti | ityādimatāni nāśrayituṃ yogyānītyāha--evañceti | evaṃ - pūrvakālatvādīnāṃ saṃsargatvapuraskāre | anyalabhyatvād‌vṛttiṃ vinaiva saṃsargavidhayā bhānasaṃbhavāt | anyathānvayamātre śaktisvīkārāpatteriti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: caitraḥ na bhuktvā vrajati iti atra tathāvidha vrajana kartṛ tva abhāvavān caitraḥ iti bodhaḥ iti iti ādi matāni na āśrayitum yogyāni iti āha evam ca iti evam pūrva kāla tva ādīnām saṃsarga tva puraskāre anya labhya tvāt vṛttim vinā eva saṃsarga vidhayā bhāna saṃbhavāt anyathā anvaya mātre śakti svīkāra āpatteḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: ādyapakṣe vrajanapūrvakālikabhojanakartetyādikarmeṇa bodhasvīkāre'nubhavasiddhasya pūrvakriyāprakārakottarakriyāviśeṣyakabodhasyānupapattirūpamapi dūṣaṇaṃ draṣṭvyam |
analyzed: ādya pakṣe vrajana pūrva kālika bhojana kartā ityādi karmeṇa bodha svīkāra inubhava siddhasya pūrva kriyā prakāraka uttara kriyā viśeṣyaka bodhasya anupapatti rūpam api dūṣaṇam draṣṭvyam

original: ata eva maṇikāraiḥ--pūrvakālatvasya vācyatvapakṣe pūrvakriyāviśeṣyaka eva bodhaḥ syānna tūttarakriyāviśeṣyakastathā cānubhavaviredha iti dūṣaṇamabhidhāyānantaramasya ktvāvācyatvamaṅgīkṛtam |
analyzed: atas eva maṇikāraiḥ pūrva kālatvasya vācyatva pakṣe pūrva kriyā viśeṣyakaḥ eva bodhaḥ syāt na tu uttara kriyā viśeṣyakaḥ tathā ca anubhava viredhaḥ iti dūṣaṇam abhidhāya anantaram asya ktvā vācyatvam aṅgīkṛtam

original: na ca pūrvakālatvasya vācyatve'pi tasya nirūpakatāsaṃbandhenottarakriyāyāmanvayopagamenānubhavasiddho bodho nirvahatyevetyāśaṅkya na bhuktvā vrajatītyatra nirūpakatvasya bodhayitumaśkyatvam | āśrayatvasaṃbandhāvacchinnapratiyogitākābhāvabodhābhyupagame bhojanottaraṃ gamanakartaryapi nañghaṭitaprayogāpattiḥ |
analyzed: na ca pūrva kāla tvasya vācya tve pi tasya nirūpakatā saṃbandhena uttara kriyāyām anvaya upagamena anubhava siddhaḥ bodhaḥ nirvahati eva iti āśaṅkya na bhuktvā vrajati iti atra nirūpakatvasya bodhayitum aśkyatvam āśraya tva saṃbandha avacchinna pratiyogitāka abhāva bodha abhyupagame bhojana uttaram gamana kartari api nañ ghaṭita prayoga āpattiḥ

original: ānantaryasya tu āśrayatvasaṃbandhāvacchinnapratiyogitākābhāvaḥ pratyāyayitu śakyata evetyapi tairabhyadhāyi | anyalabhyatvādevottarakālatvādestatsaṃbandhatayaiva bhānamaṅgīkṛtaṃ navyatārkikairapītyabhāṇi--gurucaraṇaiścaṣake ityalaṃ pallavitena |
analyzed: ānantaryasya tu āśraya tva saṃbandha avacchinna pratiyogitāka abhāvaḥ pratyāyayitu śakyate eva iti api taiḥ abhyadhāyi anya labhya tvāt evā uttara kāla tva ādeḥ tad saṃbandhatayā eva bhānam aṅgīkṛtam navya tārkikaiḥ api iti abhāṇi guru caraṇaiḥ caṣake iti alam pallavitena

original: nanvevaṃ 'darśapūrṇamāsābhyāmiṣṭvā somena yajete'ti vākyena darśapūrṇamāsottarakālaḥ somo vidhīyata iti mīmāṃsakasiddhāntāsaṃgatiḥ, kālasyāvācyatvāditi cenna | uttarakālatvasaṃndhena darśapūrmamāsavaiśiṣṭyaṃ vidhīyata iti svīkāreṇākṣateḥ |
analyzed: nanu evam darśa pūrṇamāsābhyām iṣṭvā somena yajeta iti vākyena darśa pūrṇamāsa uttara kālaḥ somaḥ vidhīyate iti mīmāṃsaka siddhānta asaṃgatiḥ kālasya avācya tvāt iti ced na uttara kāla tva saṃndhena darśa pūrma māsa vaiśiṣṭyam vidhīyate iti svīkāreṇa akṣateḥ

original: tāvatāpi tatsiddhāntaphalasya darśapūrṇamāsābhyāṃ prāk somānuṣṭhāne pratyavāyasya siddheḥ darśādhikaraṇe somākaraṇe ca tatsiddheḥ | prakṛtyartheti | prakṛtyarthaśca kriyā ceti dvandvaḥ | athavā ktvāpratyayasya samabhivyāhṛtapratyayasya ca prakṛtirgrāhyeti nāsaṃgatiḥ | svaśabdenopātteti |
analyzed: tāvatā api tad siddhānta phalasya darśa pūrṇamāsābhyām prāk soma anuṣṭhāne pratyavāyasya siddheḥ darśa adhikaraṇe soma akaraṇe ca tad siddheḥ prakṛti artha iti prakṛti arthaḥ ca kriyā ca iti dvandvaḥ athavā ktvā pratyayasya samabhivyāhṛta pratyayasya ca prakṛtiḥ grāhyā iti nā asaṃgatiḥ sva śabdena upāttā iti

original: iha kasmānna bhavati pūrvaṃ bhuṅkte paścād‌vrajatīti pūrvapakṣasya samādānamuktaṃ--svaśabdenetyādi | dyotye iti | anena pūrvakālatvottarakālatvāderdyotakatvameva ktvādīnāṃ na tu vācakatvamiti spaṣṭameva sūcyate tena saṃsargatayaiva kaiyaṭābhimatamiti bhāvaḥ | parimalakārādimataṃ dūṣayati--yatviti | sūtrāditi |
analyzed: iha kasmāt na bhavati pūrvam bhuṅkte paścāt vrajati iti pūrvapakṣasya samādānam uktam sva śabdena ityādi dyotye iti anena pūrva kāla tva uttara kāla tva ādeḥ dyotaka tvam eva ktvā ādīnām na tu vācaka tvam iti spaṣṭam eva sūcyate tena saṃsargatayā eva kaiyaṭa abhimatam iti bhāvaḥ parimala kāra ādi matam dūṣayati yatu iti sūtrāt iti

original: samānakartṛkayoriti dharmaparaṃ, dvivacanaṃ tu kriyādvayarūpāśrayagatadvitvāropanimittakamiti bhāvaḥ | athavā dharmiparameva tat, kriyārūpadharmiṇo dhātuta eva lābhāt, samānakartṛkatve kartaryeva vā śaktiḥ sūtrabalāt kalpyata iti bhāvaḥ | astuvānubhavānurodhāt kartṛkartṛkatveśaktiḥ, bhuktavāghrajatītyatra bhojanasya kartṛtve'nvayaḥ |
analyzed: samāna kartṛkayoḥ iti dharma param dvivacanam tu kriyā dvaya rūpa āśraya gata dvi tva āropa nimittakam iti bhāvaḥ athavā dharmi param eva tat kriyā rūpa dharmiṇaḥ dhātutaḥ eva lābhāt samāna kartṛka tve kartari eva vā śaktiḥ sūtra balāt kalpyate iti bhāvaḥ kartṛ kartṛka tve śaktiḥ iti atra bhojanasya kartṛ tvenvayaḥ

original: tasyāvācyatve bādhakamāha--anyatheti | tṛtīyeti | ktvāpratyayena karturanabhidhānāditi bhāvaḥ | abhihite tṛtīyā na bhavatīti prasajyapratiṣedhamabhyupetyāha--na ceti | kriyākartṛrabidhānepīti | kriyākartṛtvaviśi,ṭasyābhidhāne'pītyarthaḥ | kriyākartṛtvaśakteriti paryavasito'rthaḥ | kriyādvayasyaika eva karteti yathāśrutasyāsaṃgatyāpatteḥ |
analyzed: tasya avācya tve bādhakam āha anyathā iti tṛtīyā iti ktvāpratyayena kartuḥ anabhidhānāt iti bhāvaḥ abhihite tṛtīyā na bhavati iti prasajya pratiṣedham abhyupetya āha na ca iti iti kriyā kartṛ rabidhāne api iti kriyā kartṛ tva viśiṭasya abhidhāne api iti arthaḥ kriyā kartṛ tva śakteḥ iti paryavasitaḥ ūrthaḥ kriyā dvayasya ekaḥ eva kartā iti yathāśrutasya asaṃgati āpatteḥ

original: evamagranimasyāpi kriyākarturityasyārthaḥ | paryudāsāśrayaṇāt | prasajyapratiṣedhe tu abhihite na bhavatītyarthāt tiṅā kartṛtvaśakterabhidhānānna mayeti tṛtīyāpattiḥ | paryudāsāśrayaṇe tu abhihitabhinne bhavatītyarthādanabhihatabhujikriyānirūpitakartṛtvaśaktimādāya tṛtīyāpattirdṛḍhaiveti bhāvaḥ | lāghavāt paryudāsāśrayaṇameva yuktam |
analyzed: evam kriyā kartuḥ iti asya arthaḥ paryudāsa āśrayaṇāt prasajya pratiṣedhe tu abhihite na bhavati iti arthāt tiṅā kartṛ tva śakteḥ abhidhānāt na mayā iti tṛtīyā āpattiḥ paryudāsa āśrayaṇe tu abhihita bhinne bhavati iti arthāt anabhihata bhuji kriyā nirūpita kartṛ tva śaktim ādāya tṛtīyā āpattiḥ dṛḍhā eva iti bhāvaḥ lāghavāt paryudāsa āśrayaṇam eva yuktam

original: prasajyapratiṣedhe hi asamarthasamāso vākyabhedaścāśrayaṇīyaḥ syāt | tadāśrayaṇe phalamapyāha--kriyādhikaraṇasyeta?| prasīdatyasminnityadhikaraṇe 'halaśca' iti ghañ pratyayaḥ | kriyādhikaraṇasyeti karturitivad‌ vyākhyeyam | bhāṣye spaṣṭamiti | asyānabhihite ityādiḥ |
analyzed: prasajya pratiṣedhe hi asamartha samāsaḥ vākyabhedaḥ ca āśrayaṇīyaḥ syāt tad āśrayaṇe phalam api āha kriyā adhikaraṇasya ita prasīdati asmin iti adhikaraṇe ha laḥ ca iti ghañ pratyayaḥ kriyā adhikaraṇasya iti kartuḥ iti vat vyākhyeyam bhāṣye spaṣṭam iti asya anabhihite ityādiḥ

original: vastutastu śakteḥ sādhanatvamiti siddhāntapakṣe ghañā prakṛtyarthanirūpitaśakterabidhānena tasyāṃ vācyāyāṃ saptamīniṣedhepi āsanakriyānirūpitādhikaraṇatvaśaktau vācyāyāṃ niṣethābhāvena prāsāde āste ityatra saptamīṃsiddhirniṣpratyūhaiva | spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ kaiyaṭodyote | evaṃ cātra lāghavādeva paryudāsāśrayaṇamiti tattvam | upasaṃharati--tasmāditi |
analyzed: vastutas tu śakteḥ sādhanatvam iti siddhānta pakṣe ghañā prakṛti artha nirūpita śakteḥ abidhānena tasyām vācyāyām saptamī niṣedhe pi āsana kriyā nirūpita adhikaraṇa tva śaktau vācyāyām niṣetha abhāvena prāsāde āste iti atra saptamīṃsiddhiḥ niṣpratyūhā eva spaṣṭam ca idam kaiyaṭa udyote evam ca atra lāghavāt eva paryudāsa āśrayaṇam iti tattvam upasaṃharati tasmāt iti

original: sāmānakartṛkayoriti | samāna ekaḥ kartā yayoḥ kriyayoriti kriyārūpe'nyapadārthe bahuvrīhiḥ | pūrvakāla ityādi | pūrvaḥ kālo'syeti bahuvrīhiḥ | tathā ca samānakartṛkayoḥ kriyārūpārthayormadhye pūrvakālavṛttyarthābhidhāyino dhātoḥ ktvāpratyayo bhavatītyeva sūtrārthaḥ | evaṃ ca karturvācyatvaṃ kathamapi na labhyata iti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: sāmāna kartṛkayoḥ iti samānaḥ ekaḥ kartā yayoḥ kriyayoḥ iti bahuvrīhiḥ pūrva kālaḥ ityādi pūrvaḥ kālaḥ asya iti bahuvrīhiḥ tathā ca samāna kartṛkayoḥ kriyā rūpa arthayoḥ madhye pūrva kāla vṛtti artha abhidhāyinaḥ dhātoḥ ktvāpratyayaḥ bhavati iti eva sūtra arthaḥ evam ca kartuḥ vācyatvam katham api na labhyate iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu pūrvoktarītyā tallabhyata evetyāśaṅkyāha--anyatheti | pūrvoktakrameṇa karturvācyatve vivakṣite | samānakartari iti samānapadopādānaṃ ktvārthakartuḥ samabhivyāhṛtakriyākartaryabhedānvayaḥ pūrvoktarītyeti bodhanāyeti bodhyam | nyāsaḥ syāt - nyāsaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt | api ca pūrvoktarītyā vākyārthavarṇanaṃ na mabhañjasamiti bodhyam |
analyzed: nanu pūrvokta rītyā tat labhyate eva iti āśaṅkya āha anyathā iti pūrvokta krameṇa kartuḥ vācya tve vivakṣite samāna kartari iti samāna pada upādānam ktvā artha kartuḥ samabhivyāhṛta kriyā kartari abheda anvayaḥ pūrvokta rītyā iti bodhanāya iti bodhyam nyāsaḥ syāt nyāsaḥ kṛtaḥ syāt api ca pūrvokta rītyā vākya artha varṇanam na bodhyam

original: nanu tṛtīyādarśanameva pūrvoktārthakalpanadvārā karturvācyatve mānaṃbhaviṣyatītyāśaṅkya tṛtīyādarśanasyānyathāsiddhamāha--tṛtīyāpādanaṃ tvityādinā | pradhānetarayoriti--kārikādvayaṃ prāgvyākhyātam | ime ca harikārike 'svādumi ṇamul' iti sūtrasthabhāṣyārthānuvādinyāviti spaṣṭaṃ śekharādau |
analyzed: nanu tṛtīyā darśanam eva pūrvokta artha kalpana dvārā kartuḥ vācyatve mānam bhaviṣyati iti āśaṅkya tṛtīyā darśanasya anyathā asiddham āha tṛtīyā āpādanam tu ityādinā pradhāna itarayoḥ iti kārikā dvayam prāk vyākhyātam ime ca hari kārike svādumi ṇamul iti sūtrastha bhāṣya artha anuvādinyau iti spaṣṭam śekhara ādau

original: nanu krimityevaṃ varṇyate tṛtīyāvāraṇārtha ktvādeḥ kartari śaktirevābhyupagamyatāmata eva 'samānakartṛkayoḥ' iti sūtrakāroktiḥ saprayojanā | anyathā ḍajajanyatvādisaṃbandhavadetasyāpi saṃbandhasyānubhavabalādeva lābhā bhaviṣyatīti vyarthā soktirityāśaṅkyāha--anyatheti | prakārāntareṇeti |
analyzed: nanu krim iti evam varṇyate tṛtīyā vāraṇa artha ktu ādeḥ kartari śaktiḥ eva abhyupagamyatām atas eva samāna kartṛkayoḥ iti sūtrakāra uktiḥ sa prayojanā anyathā ḍaja janya tva ādi saṃbandha vat etasya api saṃbandhasya anubhava balāt eva lābhāḥ bhaviṣyati iti vyarthā sā uktiḥ iti āśaṅkya āha anyathā iti prakāra antareṇa iti

original: kartari śaktyaṅgīkāre'pi karmaṇā'nabhidhānādodanapadād dvītīyāpattirdurvāraiva | karmaṇyapi śaktisvīkāre tu gauravaṃ mānābhāvaśca | uktarītyanusaraṇe tu tiṅntopāttapradhānabhujikriyānirūpitakarmaśaktestiṅābhidhānād‌guṇabhūtapacikriyānirūpitāyāstasyā anabhidhāne'pi na dvitīyāpattiriti samuditatātparyārthaḥ |

original: yuttyantaramapyāha-avyabhīti | kartrādyarthajñānādhikaraṇe tajjñānapūrvasamaye niyamena lakārajñānasattvādityarthaḥ | tathā ca na svamate vyatirekavyabhicāraḥ | paramate tu sostītyāha--ādeśānāmiti | bhinnatayā - parasparapratiyogikabhedavattayā,-anekatayeti yāvat |
analyzed: yutti antaram api āha avyabhi iti kartṛ ādi artha jñāna adhikaraṇe tad jñāna pūrva samaye niyamena lakāra jñāna sattvāt iti arthaḥ tathā ca na sva mate vyatireka vyabhicāraḥ para mate tu saḥ asti iti āha ādeśānām iti bhinnatayā paraspara pratiyogika bhedavattayā anekatayā iti yāvat

original: na caivaṃ 'bhū-la' ityato'pi bodhaḥ syāditi vācyam, samabhivyāhāraviśeṣasya kāraṇatvābhyupagamāt | anyathā tava mate'pi bhū-ati ityāderapi bodhapattiḥ | ādeśijñānavidhurāṇāṃ bodhastu śaktibhramādupapadyate, apabhraṃśeṣu tathākalpanāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: na ca evam bhūlaḥ ityatas api bodhaḥ syāt iti vācyam samabhivyāhāra viśeṣasya kāraṇatva abhyupagamāt anyathā tava mate pi ityādeḥ api bodha pattiḥ ādeśi jñāna vidhurāṇām bodhaḥ tu śakti bhramāt upapadyate apabhraṃśeṣu tathā kalpanāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: athaivaṃ śatrādyantasthale kartṛkarmabodho na syāt, lakārasya tava mate kṛtikarmatvamātravācakatvāditi cenna | lakārasya kṛtyādimātravācakatvepi śatrādeḥ kartrādivācakatvābhyupagamāt, 'kartari kṛ'dityanuśāsanāt | nāmārthayopabhedānvayānurodhāttatra lakārasyaiva kartrādyartha iti na ko'pi doṣaḥ |
analyzed: atha evam śatṛ ādi anta sthale kartṛ karma bodhaḥ na syāt lakārasya tava mate kṛti karmatva mātra vācaka tvāt iti ced na lakārasya kṛti ādi mātra vācaka tve pi śatṛ ādeḥ kartṛ ādi vācaka tva abhyupagamāt kartari kṛt iti anuśāsanāt nāma artha yopa bheda anvaya anurodhāt tatra lakārasya eva kartṛ ādi arthaḥ iti na kaḥ api doṣaḥ

original: evaṃ ca śrūyamāṇamātravṛttivācakatāvirahād varṇayanti sma-ādeśānāṃ vācakatve 'rāma' ityādo visarga ekatvasya vācaka iti vyavasthā bhavati, smṛtānāṃ vācakatve'vyavasthā syāt |
analyzed: evam ca śrūyamāṇa mātra vṛtti vācakatā virahāt varṇayanti sma ādeśānām vācaka tve rāmaḥ ityādaḥ visargaḥ ekatvasya vācakaḥ iti vyavasthā bhavati smṛtānām syāt

original: tathā hi 'rāma' ityatra visargeṇa kiṃ suḥ ? kiṃ vā ruḥ ? kiṃ vā siḥ smartavyaḥ ? pāṇinīyaiḥ suḥ, anyai ruḥ, kālāpatantrābhijñaiḥ siḥ, yastu sakalatantrābhijñastasya vinigamanāviraheṇa pratibandhāt kasyāpi smaraṇaṃ na syāditi | tattu na yuktam |
analyzed: tathā hi rāmaḥ iti atra visargeṇa kim suḥ kim vā ruḥ kim vā siḥ smartavyaḥ pāṇinīyaiḥ suḥ anyaiḥ ruḥ kālāpa tantra abhijñaiḥ siḥ yaḥ tu sakala tantra abhijñaḥ tasya vinigamanā viraheṇa pratibandhāt kasya api smaraṇam na syāt iti tat tu na yuktam

original: anekalipijñānasattve'pi yathā nam śabde ekakāle na śabdopasthitipratibandhastathā sakalavyākaraṇābhijñasya nādeśismṛtibandhaḥ | api tu sarveṣāṃ smṛtistayācārthopasthitiravilakṣaṇaivetyabhyupagamamācca | ata eva ghaṭakalaśādyanekaparyāyebhyopyavilakṣaṇabodha upapadyate'tonyathā vyācaṣṭe-tathāhītyādinā | bodhāditi |
analyzed: aneka lipi jñāna sattve api yathā śabde eka kāle na śabda upasthiti pratibandhaḥ tathā sakala vyākaraṇa abhijñasya na ādeśi smṛti bandhaḥ api tu sarveṣām smṛtiḥ avilakṣaṇā evā iti abhyupagama māt ca atas eva ghaṭa kalaśa ādi aneka paryāyebhyaḥ api avilakṣaṇa bodhaḥ upapadyate itas nyathā vyācaṣṭe tathā hi ityādinā bodhāt iti

original: tathā ca bodhānāpattirevātrāvyavasthāpadārtha iti bhāvaḥ | mānābhāvāditi | tato bodhodayena tatra vācakatvasyābādhitatvāditi bhāvaḥ | vinigamanāvirahātsarveṣāmapi sthānināṃ vācakatvaṃ bhavatītyāśaṅkāyāmāha-sarveṣāmiti | vyabhicāraścāstyeveti |
analyzed: tathā ca bodha anāpattiḥ eva atra avyavasthā padārthaḥ iti bhāvaḥ māna abhāvāt iti tatas bodha udayena tatra vācakatvasya abādhita tvāt iti bhāvaḥ vinigamana avirahāt sarveṣām api sthāninām vācakatvam bhavati iti āśaṅkāyām āha sarveṣām iti vyabhicāraḥ ca asti eva iti

original: tathā ca yadbhayādādeśānāṃ vācakatvapakṣaparityāgastau doṣau sthānino vācakatvapakṣepi duṣpariharāvevetyarthaḥ | ādeśānāṃ tivādīnāmādhikyāttatpakṣāpekṣayātra pakṣe bahu gauravamityanuśayāna āha-tathā ceti | mukhya iti | śaktigrahe jananīye śaktigrāhakāntarānapekṣatvarūpamukyātvam |
analyzed: tathā ca yad bhayāt ādeśānām vācaka tva pakṣa parityāgaḥ tau doṣau sthāninaḥ vācaka tva pakṣe pi duṣpariharau eva iti arthaḥ ādeśānām tiva ādīnām ādhikyāt tad pakṣa apekṣayā atra pakṣe bahu gauravam iti anuśayānaḥ āha tathā ca iti mukhye iti śaktigrahe jananīye śakti grāhaka antara anapekṣa tva rūpa mukyātvam

original: vyākaraṇādīnāṃ tu na tathātvam,-tathāha-'tasyāpatya'mityādināṇādipratyayasya śaktigrahe'patyādiśabdaśaktigraho'pekṣyate, sa cecchabdāntareṇa, tasyāpi śabdāntareṇaiva śaktigraha ityabhyupagame'navasthāprasaṅgo'to vyavahārasyāpatyādiśabdaśaktigrahasaṃpādanadvārā'pekṣaṇāditi bhāvaḥ | ta eva - tiṅādaya eva | evakāreṇa syānibhūtalakārādivyavacchedaḥ |
analyzed: vyākaraṇa ādīnām tu na tathātvam tathā āhatasya apatyam ityādinā aṇ ādi pratyayasya sa ced śabda antareṇa tasya api śabda antareṇa eva śaktigrahaḥ iti abhyupagamena avasthā prasaṅga utaḥ vyavahārasya apatya ādi śabda śaktigraha saṃpādana dvāra apekṣaṇāt iti bhāvaḥ te eva tiṅ ādayaḥ eva evakāreṇa

original: nanu vyavahārāttiḍaṣu gṛhyamāṇāpi śaktirlāghavādādeśini vyavasthāpyate, na tu tiṅṣu, gauravāt, yathā vyavahārādvākye gṛhītāpi śaktirlāghavāttattatpade kalpyate tadvat | anekasmaraṇakalpanāgauravaṃ tu phalamukhatvānna doṣāyetyāśaṅkamāno mūle sādhakāntaramāha-taddhetunyāyata iti | taddhetunyāyapadayoḥ karmadhārayaḥ | vyākhyāyāṃ-kiṃ ceti |
analyzed: nanu vyavahārāt tiḍaṣu gṛhyamāṇā api śaktiḥ lāghavāt ādeśini vyavasthāpyate na tu tiṅṣu gauravāt yathā vyavahārāt vākye gṛhītā api śaktiḥ lāghavāt tad tad pade kalpyate tadvat aneka smaraṇa kalpanā gauravam tu phala mukha tvāt na doṣāya iti āśaṅkamānaḥ mūle sādhaka antaram āha tad hetu nyāyataḥ iti tad hetu nyāya padayoḥ karmadhārayaḥ vyākhyāyām kim ca iti

original: asya 'sādhakāntaramāhe'ti śeṣaḥ | pūrvaphakkikāsthasyānuṣaṅge vā bodhyaḥ | nyāyaṃ vyutpādayati-lakārasyeti | tādṛśe bodhe - ekakartṛkavartamānakālikaviklityanukūlo vyāpāra iti bodha ityarthaḥ | pacatīti samabhivyāhāropīti | avyavahitottaratvasaṃbandhena pac‌dhātuviśiṣṭa ativiśiṣṭa pacatiśabdarūpaḥ samabhivyāhāra ityarthaḥ |
analyzed: asya sādhaka antaram āha iti śeṣaḥ pūrva phakkikā sthasya anuṣaṅge vā bodhyaḥ nyāyam vyutpādayati lakārasya iti tādṛśe bodhe eka kartṛka vartamāna kālika vikliti anukūlaḥ vyāpāraḥ iti bodhaḥ iti arthaḥ pacati iti samabhivyāhāraḥ upi iti avyavahita uttaratva saṃbandhena pac dhātu viśiṣṭa ati viśiṣṭa pacati śabda rūpaḥ samabhivyāhāraḥ iti arthaḥ

original: vācakatvaśaktiḥ - vācakatvarūpā śaktirityarthaḥ | samabhivyāhārasya vācakatve siddhepi sādhuśabdāntargatavarṇatvāvacchedena na tatsiddhamityāśaṅkāmapākartumāha--tathā cetyādinā | sidhyatīti | vinigamanāvirahātsamabhivyāhṛtavarṇānāmapi vācakatvaṃ sidhyatītyarthaḥ |
analyzed: vācaka tva śaktiḥ vācaka tva rūpā śaktiḥ iti arthaḥ samabhivyāhārasya vācaka tve siddhe pi sādhu śabda antargata varṇa tva avacchedena na tat siddham iti āśaṅkām apākartum āha tathā ca ityādinā sidhyati iti vinigamana avirahāt samabhivyāhṛta varṇānām api vācaka tvam sidhyati iti arthaḥ

original: anye tu-vinigamanāvirahātpratyekāvṛtteḥ samudāyāvṛttitvācca samabhivyāhṛtavarṇānāmeva vācakatvam | na ca dvitvavat pratyekāvṛttitve'pi samudāyavṛttitvasaṃbhavaḥ, dvitvasyāpi pratyekaṃ vṛttitvasvīkārādityāhuḥ |
analyzed: anye tu vinigamana avirahāt pratyeka avṛtteḥ samudāya avṛtti tvāt ca samabhivyāhṛta varṇānām eva vācaka tvam na ca dvi tva vat pratyeka avṛtti tve pi samudāya vṛtti tva saṃbhavaḥ dvi tvasya api pratyekam vṛtti tva svīkārāt iti āhuḥ

original: 'peṭākṛtastu rathāṅgeṣu pratyekaṃ gamanānukūlaśaktidhirahe'pi tatsamudāyarūpe rathe tatsadbhāva ityarthavatsūtre-'dṛṣṭo hyatadarthena guṇena guṇino'rthabhāvaḥ, 'yathā tarhi rathāṅgāni vihṛtāni pratyekaṃta vrajikriyāṃ pratyasamarthāni tatsamudāyaśca rathaḥ samartha iti rathāṅgavaditi bhāṣyakārai rabhihitaṃ, tadvat prakṛte'pi saṃbhava iti
analyzed: peṭākṛtaḥ tu rathāṅgeṣu pratyekam gamana anukūla śakti dhi rahe pi tad samudāya rūpe rathe tad sadbhāvaḥ iti arthavat sūtre dṛṣṭaḥ hi a tad arthena guṇena guṇinā ūrtha bhāvaḥ yathā tarhi rathāṅgāni vihṛtāni vraji kriyām prati asamarthāni tad samudāyaḥ ca rathaḥ samarthaḥ iti rathāṅga vat iti bhāṣyakāraiḥ abhihitam tadvat prakṛte api saṃbhavaḥ iti

original: vinigamanaḥviraheṇa samabhivyāhṛtavarṇānāmapi vācakatvamityeva yuktamityāhuḥ | samabhivyāhṛtatāvadvarṇavṛttirvācakatetyabhyupagamānna taddhaṭakaikaikādivarṇāt tattadarthabodhapattiriti bodhyam | kartṛbhāvaneti | kṛtaḥ kartṛvācakatvaṃ, tiṅo bhāvanāvācakatvamiti vibhāgo na syādityarthaḥ | bhavanmate na syāditi |
analyzed: vinigamanaḥ viraheṇa samabhivyāhṛta varṇānām api vācakatvam iti eva yuktam iti āhuḥ samabhivyāhṛta tāvat varṇa vṛttiḥ vācakatā iti abhyupagamāt na tad ghaṭaka ekaika ādi varṇāt tad tad artha bodha pattiḥ iti bodhyam kartṛ bhāvanā iti kṛtaḥ kartṛ vācakatvam tiṅaḥ bhāvanā vācakatvam iti vibhāgaḥ na syāt iti arthaḥ bhavat mate na syāt iti

original: śatrādirūpe kṛti kartṛvācakatvasyāsaṃbhavāt tasyāpi lādeśatvāviśeṣeṇavācakatvāsaṃbhavāt, sthānibhūtalakārasya tu bhāvanāmātravācakatvāditi bhāvaḥ | nirākāṅkṣatayeti | 'arthāṃśe' iti śeṣaḥ | kartarītyasyeti | 'kartari kṛ'dityasyetyarthaḥ | apravṛtteriti | ākāṅkṣitavidhānasyaivocitatvāditi bhāvaḥ || 62 ||
analyzed: śatṛ ādi rūpe kṛti kartṛ vācakatvasya asaṃbhavāt tasya api lā deśa tva aviśeṣeṇa vācakatva asaṃbhavāt sthāni bhūta lakārasya tu bhāvanā mātra vācakatvāt iti bhāvaḥ nirākāṅkṣatayā iti artha aṃśe iti śeṣaḥ kartari ityasya iti kartari kṛt iti asya iti arthaḥ apravṛtteḥ iti ākāṅkṣita vidhānasya eva ucitatvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: ityādisāmānādhikaraṇyeti | ityādau sāmānādhikaraṇyānurodhāt, abhedānvayānurodhādityarthaḥ | yadi kartā śānajartho na syāt tadā caitraḥ pacamāna ityādāvananvayaḥ syādabhedasya bādhitatvāt | ādhārādheyabhāvasaṃbandhenānvayasya nāmārthayoriti vyutpattivirodhenāsaṃbhavāt | kartṛvācakatā syāditi | asya 'tiṅā'mityādiḥ |
analyzed: ityādi sāmānādhikaraṇya iti ityādau sāmānādhikaraṇya anurodhāt abheda anvaya anurodhāt iti arthaḥ yadi kartā na syāt tadā caitraḥ pacamānaḥ ityādau ananvayaḥ syāt abhedasya bādhita tvāt ādhāra ādheya bhāva saṃbandhena anvayasya nāma arthayoḥ iti vyutpatti virodhena asaṃbhavāt kartṛ vācaka tā syāt iti asya tiṅām ityādiḥ

original: 'pacatitarāṃ maitra' ityātrātiśayitaviklittyanukūlakriyānukūlabhāvanāyā nāmārthatvena maitreṇa sahābhedānvayāsaṃbhavāt kartrākhyātasya kartṛvācakatvaṃ syāt, tacca paramate'niṣṭamiti bhāvaḥ | ityatrāpyāpatteriti | śānaco'nyatra śaktyanirṇayena śakyaśambandha rūpā lakṣaṇā na saṃbhavatīti na śaṅkyam |
analyzed: pacatitarām maitraḥ iti ātra atiśayita viklitti anukūla kriyā anukūla bhāvanāyāḥ nāma artha tvena maitreṇa saha abheda anvaya asaṃbhavāt kartṛ ākhyātasya kartṛ vācaka tvam syāt tat ca paramate niṣṭam iti bhāvaḥ iti atra api āpatteḥ iti śakti anirṇayena śakya śambandha rūpā lakṣaṇā na saṃbhavati iti na śaṅkyam

original: prathamāntapadāsamabhivyāhṛtākhyātavaditarāsamabhivyāhṛtapacamāna iti prayoge śānaco'pi bhāvanāyāṃ śaktinirṇayasaṃbhavāt | athavā tatsthāninolakārasya tatra lakṣaṇāpattirbodhyā |
analyzed: prathamā anta pada a samabhivyāhṛta ākhyāta vat itara a samabhivyāhṛta pacamānaḥ iti prayoge bhāvanāyām śakti nirṇaya saṃbhavāt athavā tad sthāninā ulakārasya tatra lakṣaṇa āpattiḥ bodhyā

original: na ca 'nāmārthayo'riti vyutpattau nāmapadaṃ sattvapradhānaparaṃ, tiṅantaprakṛtikatarabādyantapratipādyā bhāvanā tvasattvabhūtaiveti na doṣaḥ, kiṃ ca 'nāmārthayo'rityādivyutpatternāmajanyapratītiviśeṣyayorevānvayaḥ sa cābhedenaiveti śarīram, evaṃ ca bhavanmate'pi 'pacatitarāṃ devadattaḥ' 'pacatikalpaṃ devadatta' ityatra kathaṃ devadattasya
analyzed: na ca nāma arthayoḥ iti vyutpattau nāma padam sattva pradhāna param tiṅ anta prakṛtika tarap ādi anta pratipādyā bhāvanā tu asattva bhūtā eva iti na doṣaḥ kim ca nāma arthayoḥ ityādi vyutpatteḥ nāma janya pratīti viśeṣyayoḥ eva anvayaḥ sa ca abhedena eva iti śarīram evam ca bhavat mate pi pacatitarām devadattaḥ pacati kalpam devadattaḥ iti atra katham devadattasya

original: viśeṣaṇībhūtena tiṅarthakartrā sahānvayaḥ | tava mate vyutpattestatra saṃkoca iti cenmayāpi so'nusriyata iti vācyam | nāmapadena prātipadikamātrasya, suvantamātrasya vā grahaṇaṃ, nāmajanyapratītiviśeṣyayorevetyādiniyame mānābhāvaścetyāśayāt |
analyzed: viśeṣaṇībhūtena tiṅartha kartrā saha anvayaḥ tava mate vyutpatteḥ tatra saṃkocaḥ iti ced mayā api iti vācyam nāma padena prātipadika mātrasya suvanta mātrasya vā grahaṇam nāma janya pratīti viśeṣyayoḥ eva ityādi niyame māna abhāvaḥ ca iti āśayāt

original: na ca tathāvidhaniyamānabhyupagame 'nityo ghaṭa' ityasya vākyasya ghaṭatve nityapadārthānvayasaṃbhavāt prāmāṇyāpattiriti vācyam | ghaṭatvasya padārthaikadeśatayā 'padārthaḥ padārthenānvetī'tyādivyutpattivirodhena tatra tadanvayāsaṃbhavenoktavākyasya prāmāṇyāpatterabhāvāt |
analyzed: na ca tathāvidha niyama anabhyupagame nityaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti asya vākyasya ghaṭa tve nitya padārtha anvaya saṃbhavāt prāmāṇya āpattiḥ iti vācyam ghaṭa tvasya padārtha eka deśa tayā padārthaḥ padārthena anveti ityādi vyutpatti virodhena tatra tad anvaya asaṃbhavena ukta vākyasya prāmāṇya āpatteḥ abhāvāt

original: kartuḥ padārthaikadeśatvābhāvena 'pacatikalpaṃ devadatta' ityādāvanvayopapattistvakṣataiva | tasmāt samabhivyāhṛtavarṇānāmeva vācakatvamiti varṇasphoṭo niṣpratyūhaḥ | nanu tivādyādeśānāṃ vācakatve 'laḥ karmaṇi--ityādyanuśāsanavirodhastena sthānināmeva vācakatvabodhanādityāśaṅkyāha--'laḥ karmaṇo'tyanuśāsanamiti || iti varṇasphoṭanirūpaṇam
analyzed: kartuḥ padārtha eka deśa tva abhāvena pacati kalpam devadattaḥ ityādau anvaya upapattiḥ tu akṣatā eva tasmāt samabhivyāhṛta varṇānām eva vācaka tvam iti varṇa sphoṭaḥ niṣpratyūhaḥ nanu ti vādi ādeśānām vācaka tve laḥ karmaṇi ityādi anuśāsana virodhaḥ tena sthāninām eva vācaka tva bodhanāt iti āśaṅkya aha laḥ karmaṇā iti anuśāsanam iti iti varṇa sphoṭa nirūpaṇam

original: samabhivyāhṛtavarṇānām--tattatpadaghaṭakayāvatāṃ samabhivyāhṛtavarṇānāmityarthaḥ | vācakatve siddhe iti | tāvatāṃ varṇānāṃ vācakatvaṃ vinā vakṣyamāṇasvarūpapadasya vācakatvaṃ nopapadyate, ataḥ padasya vācakatvasiddhistāvatāṃ varṇānāṃ vācakatvasiddhyadhoneti bhāvaḥ | evaṃ ca pūrvagranthena sahāsya granthasyopajīvyopajīvakabhāvasaṃgatiḥ sūcitā |
analyzed: samabhivyāhṛta varṇānām tad tad pada ghaṭaka yāvatām samabhivyāhṛta varṇānām iti arthaḥ vācaka tve siddhe iti tāvatām varṇānām vācaka tvam vinā vakṣyamāṇa svarūpa padasya vācaka tvam na upapadyate atas padasya vācaka tva siddhiḥ tāvatām varṇānām vācaka tva siddhi adhonā iti bhāvaḥ evam ca pūrva granthena saha asya granthasya upajīvya upajīvaka bhāva saṃgatiḥ sūcitā

original: nanu tathāpi vācakatā prativarṇaṃ viśrāmyatu nāma, naitāvatā 'padaṃ vācaka'mityabhimatasiddhirityāśaṅkyāha--prativarṇamiti | samabhivyāhārarūpeti | samudāyarūpatyarthaḥ | nalopādyāpatteścati | supaḥ śravaṇaṃ tu nāpāditaṃ, samudāyātmakaprātipadikāvayavattevana 'supo dhātvi'ti luk‌saṃbhavāt |
analyzed: nanu tathā api vācakatā prativarṇam viśrāmyatu nāma na etāvatā padam vācakam iti abhimata siddhiḥ iti āśaṅkya āha prativarṇam iti samabhivyāhāra rūpa iti samudāya rūpati arthaḥ na lopa ādi āpatteḥ ca iti supaḥ śravaṇam tu na āpāditam samudāya ātmaka prātipadika avayava tā ivana supaḥ dhātu iti luk saṃbhavāt

original: samāsagrahaṇasya-'bhede sati padārthayoḥ parasparaṃ saṃsargastathāvidhārthavatsamudāyasya cedbha vati tarhi samāsasyaive'ti niyamārthatayā prakṛte samudāye prātipadikatvasya niṣpratyūhatvāt | pratīpodyotakṛtaḥ-prativarṇaṃ sakhyārthakarpetvābhāvānna tad‌dyotakavibhaktyutpattiḥ | etādṛśasthale eva saṃkhyotpatteḥ |
analyzed: samāsa grahaṇasya bhede sati padārthayoḥ parasparam saṃsargaḥ tathāvidha arthavat samudāyasya ced bha vati tarhi samāsasya eva iti niyama artha tayā prakṛte samudāye prātipadika tvasya niṣpratyūha tvāt pratīpa udyota kṛtaḥ prativarṇam tad dyotaka vibhakti utpattiḥ etādṛśa sthale eva saṃkhyā utpatteḥ

original: saṃkhyā ca samudāyasyaivārtho na pratyekavarṇānām, 'ekatvaṃ saṃdhātasyārtha'iti 'aiu'ṇasūtrasthabhāṣyasvarasāt | tathā ca tatra bhāṣyaṃ--saṃghātasyaikārthyāt subabhāvo varṇā'dityādi | prakṛtyaṃśe varṇavyatyayopajanayoḥ sattve'pi saṃkhyāntarānavagamāt saṃkhyā samudāyasyaivārtha iti tadāśayaḥ |
analyzed: saṃkhyā ca samudāyasya eva arthaḥ na pratyeka varṇānām eka tvam saṃdhātasya arthaḥ eti aiuṇa sūtra stha bhāṣya svarasāt tathā ca tatra bhāṣyam saṃghātasya aikārthyāt suba bhāvaḥ varṇāt ityādi prakṛti aṃśe varṇa vyatyaya upajanayoḥ sattve api saṃkhyā antara anavagamāt saṃkhyā samudāyasya eva arthaḥ iti tad āśayaḥ

original: na cāvyayebhya ivaikavacanaṃ durvāramiti vācyaṃ, saṃkhyāśūnyārthake eva bhāṣyaprāmāṇyāttathākalpane'pi na tadyuktārthake'nabhidhāyakasvādyutpattiḥ kalpanārhā, mānābhāvāt | gamakasattve eva tatkalpanācca | evaṃ caiṣāṃ pratyayod‌deśyatvarūpaṃ prakṛtitvameva neti 'na kevale'ti nyāyasyāpi nāvatāraḥ | evaṃ ca na nalopādyāpattiriti-prāhuḥ |
analyzed: na ca avyayebhyaḥ iva ekavacanam durvāram iti vācyam saṃkhyā śūnya arthake eva bhāṣya prāmāṇyāt tathā kalpane pi na tad yukta arthakena abhidhāyaka sva ādi utpattiḥ kalpanā arhā māna abhāvāt gamaka sattve eva tad kalpanāt ca evam ca eṣām pratyaya uddeśya tva rūpam prakṛti tvam eva na iti na kevalā iti nyāyasya api nā avatāraḥ evam ca na na lopa ādi āpattiḥ iti prāhuḥ

original: evaṃ cānubhavavirūddhārthasmaraṇāpattyā varṇavyatyayopajanādisattve'pi 'tarku' 'rajju'rityādau dhātvarthāntarānavagatyā gauraveṇa ca na varṇānāṃ pratyekamarthavattvamityeva jyāyaḥ | spaṣṭaṃ cedam 'aiuṇ' sūtrabhāṣye | etacceti | samabhivyāhāravācakatvasamarthanaṃ cetyarthaḥ | caramavarṇa eveti | prakṛtyādighaṭakacaramarṇa evetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: evam ca anubhava virūddha artha smaraṇa āpattyā varṇa vyatyaya upajana ādi sattve pi rajjuḥ ityādau dhātvartha antara anavagatyā gauraveṇa ca na varṇānām pratyekam arthavattvam iti eva jyāyaḥ spaṣṭam ca idam sūtra bhāṣye etat ca iti samabhivyāhāra vācakatva samarthanam ca iti arthaḥ carama varṇaḥ eva iti prakṛti ādi ghaṭaka caramarṇaḥ eva iti arthaḥ

original: prathamādivarṇe tu na śaktiḥ, tanmātroccāraṇādarthapratyayāpatteḥ, uttaravarṇānubhavajanyasaṃskārasya tadānutpādena prathamavarṇāṃnubhavasyottarottaravarṇānubhavajanyasaṃskāraṇāṃ sahakāritvāsaṃbhavāt |
analyzed: prathama ādi varṇe tu na śaktiḥ tanmātra uccāraṇāt artha pratyaya āpatteḥ uttara varṇa anubhava janya saṃskārasya tadā anutpādena prathama varṇa aṃnubhavasya uttarottara varṇa anubhava janya saṃskāraṇām sahakāri tva asaṃbhavāt

original: uttarottaravarṇānubhavajanitasaṃskārasahakṛtaprathamādivarṇānubhavajanyasaṃskarasya hetutve tu vinigamanāviraheṇa tāvadvarṇasamudāye śaktisiddhayāpattiriti bhāvaḥ | vyāsajyavṛttitve--anekavarṇaparyāptatve | mānābhāvāditi | caramavarṇānubhavottaramevārthabodhodayena tatraiva vācakatvaviśrāntiriti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: uttara uttara varṇa anubhava janita saṃskāra sahakṛta prathama ādi varṇa anubhava janya saṃskarasya hetu tve tu vinigamana aviraheṇa tāvat varṇa samudāye śakti siddhayā āpattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ vyāsajya vṛtti tve aneka varṇa paryāpta tve māna abhāvāt iti carama varṇa anubhava uttaram eva artha bodha udayena tatra eva vācaka tva viśrāntiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanvevaṃ caramavarṇamātroccāraṇepyarthabodhāpattirata āha-pūrvepūrveti | ata eva netaravarṇanairarthakyam | pūrvoktadoṣaparāhatatvādevaitatpakṣadūṣaṇasyaivoddeśyatayā,--dūṣaṇāyaivetyarthaḥ | ānupūrvyā eveti | na tu caramavarṇamātravṛttitadvyaktitvādeḥ |
analyzed: nanu evam carama varṇa mātra uccāraṇe api artha bodha āpattiḥ atas āha pūrva pūrva iti atas eva na itara varṇa nairarthakyam pūrva ukta doṣa parāhata tvāt eva etad pakṣa dūṣaṇasya eva uddeśya tayā dūṣaṇāya eva iti arthaḥ ānupūrvyā eva iti na tu carama varṇa mātra vṛtti tad vyakti tva ādeḥ

original: nanu 'ghaṭa' ityādau ghottarāvarṇottaraṭakārottarāvarṇatvādarūpānupūrvyāścarame varṇe eva vṛtterna tāvadvarṇasamudāyavṛttitvamiti kathaṃ padasya vācakatvarūpabhavadabhimatasiddhiriti cenna | ānupūrvyāṃ padārthāntaratvavādimīmāṃsakamate etaddopāsaṃsparśāt |
analyzed: nanu ghaṭaḥ ityādau carame varṇe eva vṛtteḥ na tāvat varṇa samudāya vṛtti tvam iti katham padasya vācaka tva rūpa bhavat abhimata siddhiḥ iti ced na ānupūrvyām padārtha antara tva vādi mīmāṃsaka mate etad dopa a saṃsparśāt

original: 'pūrvoktarūpanupūrvīṃ'ti mate'pi ghāvyavahitottarāvarṇatvasyāvarṇe, tadavyavahitapūrvaghatvādirūpānupūrvāyastatpadaghaṭakasakalavarṇeṣu viśrānterakṣateḥ | etāsāṃ nānātvena gauravānna śaktatāvacchedakatvamiti cenna, agatyā svīkārāt | 'avyavahitottaratva'saṃbandhena pūrvapūrvavarṇasaṃśliṣṭottarottaravarṇasamudāyatvasyānupūrvīṃrūpatvādvā |
analyzed: pūrva ukta rūpa anupūrvī iti mate api gha avyavahita uttara avarṇa tvasya avarṇe viśrānteḥ akṣateḥ etāsām nānātvena gauravāt na śakta tā avacchedaka tvam iti ced na agatyā svīkārāt avyavahita uttara tva saṃbandhena pūrva pūrva varṇa saṃśliṣṭa uttara uttara varṇa samudāya tvasya ānupūrvīṃrūpa tvāt vā

original: athavā caramavarṇamātraviśrāntānupūrvīṃviṣayitāvyāpakaviṣayatāpratiyogitkarūpānupūrvīṃghaṭakanvaṃ, tena saṃbandhenānupūrvī vā śaktatāvacchediketyaṅgīkriyatāṃ, padabhedena ghaṭakavarṇānāṃ bhede'pi ghatvādyavacchinnaviṣayitātvena varṇaviṣayitānāṃ tādṛśānupūrvī viṣayitāvyāpakatvaṃ vivakṣaṇīyamiti nāvyāpakatvāsaṃbhavādidoṣa ityalaṃ pallavitena |
analyzed: athavā tena saṃbandhena ānupūrvī viṣayitā vyāpaka viṣayatā pratiyogitka rūpa anupūrvīm ghaṭaka nvam tena saṃbandhena ānupūrvī vā śakta tā avacchedikā iti aṅgīkriyatām pada bhedena ghaṭaka varṇānām bhede pi gha tva ādi avacchinna viṣayitā tvena varṇa viṣayitānām tādṛśa ānupūrvī viṣayitā vyāpaka tvam vivakṣaṇīyam iti na avyāpaka tva asaṃbhava ādi doṣaḥ iti alam pallavitena

original: nanu tādṛśānupūrvyāḥ sahakāritvādevīktatiprasaṅgavāraṇe'laṃ tasyāḥ śaktatāvacchedakatvakalpaneyetyata āha--digiti | tadarthastu--samudāyasyārthavattvābhāvena prādipadikatvānāpattiḥ, arthabodhajanane sahakāritvamātreṇa samudāyasya prātipadikatvas‌vīkāre'pi caramavarṇamāvrasyāpi prātipadikatvāttato'pi pratyayotpattyāpattiḥ |
analyzed: nanu tādṛśa ānupūrvyāḥ sahakāri tvāt tasyāḥ śakta tā avacchedaka tva kalpanā iya iti atas āha diś iti tad arthaḥ tu samudāyasya arthavat tva abhāvena prādipadika tva anāpattiḥ artha bodha janane sahakāri tva mātreṇa samudāyasya prātipadika tva svīkāre api carama varṇa māvrasya api prātipadika tvāt tatas api pratyaya utpatti āpattiḥ

original: evaṃ caramavarṇasyaiva vācakteva tadarthe vibhattayarthānvayo na syāt, tasyāprakṛtitvāt | samudāyasya prakṛtitve'pi prakṛtārthasya tadvṛttyānupasthityā tadarthatvābhāvāt |
analyzed: evam carama varṇasya eva tad arthe vibhatta yartha anvayaḥ na syāt tasya aprakṛti tvāt samudāyasya prakṛti tve pi prakṛta arthasya tad vṛttyā anupasthityā tad artha tva abhāvāt

original: kiṃ ca--paṅkajādipade samudāye śaktyabhāve yaugikayogarūḍhādivibhāgocchedāpattiḥ, 'pācaka'iti vaktavye 'pāc' ityanantara ghaṭikādivyavadhānenāka ityuccāraṇe'pi pākakartteti bodhāpattyā sarvatra samudāyānuparvyā eva yatra sahakāritvaṃ tatra yaugika'mityādervaktumaśakytvāt |
analyzed: kim ca paṅkaja ādi pade samudāye śakti abhāve yaugika yoga rūḍha ādi vibhāga uccheda āpattiḥ pācakaḥ eti vaktavye iti anantara ghaṭikā ādi vyavadhānena ākaḥ iti uccāraṇe api pāka karttā iti bodha āpattyā sarvatra samudāya ānuparvyāḥ eva yatra sahakāri tvam tatra yaugikam ityādeḥ vaktum aśakya tvāt

original: nanu yatsvaghaṭaprakṛtyādicaramavarṇaśaktyaivārthopasthāpakaṃ tadyaugikaṃ,yathā pācakādipadaṃ | yat svacaramavarṇaśaktyaivārthopasthāpakaṃ tat 'kevalarūḍhaṃ'--yathā-ḍitthādipadaṃ |
analyzed: nanu yat sva ghaṭa prakṛti ādi carama varṇa śaktyā eva artha upasthāpakam tat yaugikam yathā pācaka ādi padam yat sva carama varṇa śaktyā eva artha upasthāpakam tat kevala rūḍham yathā aṭ itthā ādi padam

original: yatra svaghaṭakaprakṛtyādicaramavarṇaśaktyā, svīyacaramavarṇaśaktyā ca pṛthagupasthitayorarthayoḥ parasparamanvayastadyogarūḍhaṃ, yathā-paṅkajādipadamityevaṃ vibhāgaḥ saṃbhavatyeveti cenna | pācakādipadaghaṭakapratyayacaramavarṇe svacaramavarṇatvasyāpi sattvena niruktyaugikatvasyāsaṃbhavāpatteḥ |
analyzed: yatra sva ghaṭaka prakṛti ādi carama varṇa śaktyā svīya carama varṇa śaktyā ca pṛthak upasthitayoḥ arthayoḥ parasparam anvayaḥ tad yoga rūḍham yathā paṅkaja ādi padam iti evam vibhāgaḥ saṃbhavati eva iti ced na pācaka ādi pada ghaṭaka pratyaya carama varṇe sva carama varṇa tvasya api sattvena nirukti yaugika tvasya asaṃbhava āpatteḥ

original: evaṃ gopade kevalarūḍhatvaṃ na syāt, taccaramavarṇasya taddhaṭakapratyayacaramavarṇābhinnatayā svacaramavarṇaśaktyaivopasthityabhāvādityādirbodhyaḥ || 64 ||
analyzed: evam go pade kevala rūḍha tvam na syāt tad carama varṇasya tad dhaṭaka pratyaya carama varṇa abhinnatayā sva carama varṇa śaktyā eva upasthiti abhāvāt ityādiḥ bodhyaḥ 64

original: paribhāṣitapadasyeti | tasyaivetyarthaḥ | arthavatpadatvenābhimataprakṛtipratyayavyudāptaḥ | subantādereva prayogeṇa vyavahārāttatraiva śaktigrahāditi bhāvaḥ | anye tu-paribhāṣitapadasyāpottharthaḥ ityāhuḥ | tādṛśapadasya vācakatve'nyathānupapattimapi pramaṇayati--mūle ghaṭenetyādaṣviti | tadvyācaṣṭe-ghaṭenetyādāviti | neti pratyaya iti |
analyzed: paribhāṣita padasya iti tasya eva iti arthaḥ arthavat pada tvena abhimata prakṛti pratyaya vyudāptaḥ sup anta ādeḥ eva prayogeṇa vyavahārāt tatra eva śaktigrahāt iti bhāvaḥ anye tu paribhāṣita padasya apottharthaḥ iti āhuḥ tādṛśa padasya vācaka tvena yathā anupapattim api pramaṇayati mūle ghaṭena ityādaṣu iti tat vyācaṣṭe ghaṭena ityādau iti na iti pratyayaḥ iti

original: asye'ti vibhāgasye'tyatrānvayaḥ | iti vibhāgasya jñānāsaṃbhavāditi yojanā | nirṇayāsaṃbhavādityarthaḥ | viśiṣya jñānasaṃbhavāditi | 'varṇayorādeśa'iti pakṣe-ekārarūpa ādeśaḥ pūrvāvayavo vā pasavayavo veti saṃśayāḍitastatsaṃśayaḥ saṃbhavati | 'sarve sarvapadādeśā' iti pakṣe tu --vasnasādāviva saṃpramohādvibhāgajñānameva na saṃbhavatīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: asya iti vibhāgasya iti atra anvayaḥ iti vibhāgasya jñāna asaṃbhavāt iti yojanā nirṇaya asaṃbhavāt iti arthaḥ viśiṣya jñāna saṃbhavāt iti varṇayoḥ ādeśaḥ iti pakṣe ekāra rūpaḥ ādeśaḥ pūrva avayavaḥ vā vā iti saṃśaya āḍitaḥ tad saṃśayaḥ saṃbhavati sarve sarva pada ādeśāḥ iti pakṣe tu saṃpramohāt vibhāga jñānam eva na saṃbhavati iti bhāvaḥ

original: kaścidatra prakṛtibhāgaḥ syāditi jñānaṃ saṃbhavatyevetyato 'viśiṣye'tyuktam | ayaṃ prakṛtibhāgo'yaṃ pratyayabhāgaḥ iti jñānāsaṃbhavādityarthaḥ | vibhāgaḥ saṃbhavatīti | tathā ca yathā vaiyākaraṇānāmapi vatnasādau vibhāgajñānaṃ na saṃbhavati tathā 'sarve sarvapadādeśāḥ' iti pakṣe 'rāmeṇe'tyādāvapīti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: kaścid atra prakṛti bhāgaḥ syāt iti jñānam saṃbhavati eva iti atas viśiṣya iti uktam ayam prakṛti bhāgaḥ yam pratyaya bhāgaḥ iti jñāna asaṃbhavāt iti arthaḥ vibhāgaḥ saṃbhavati iti tathā ca yathā vaiyākaraṇānām api vatnasādau vibhāga jñānam na saṃbhavati tathā sarve sarva pada ādeśāḥ iti pakṣe rāmeṇa ityādau api iti bhāvaḥ

original: atra pakṣe ṭāsthāne nādeśaṃ vidadhato bhāṣyakāramate'pi vaiyākaraṇānāmapi vibhāgajñānaṃ na suśakamiti bodhyam | evaṃ satyapi 'rāmeṇe'tyato rāmābhinnaḥ kartetyādirūpabodhānyathānupapattyā suvantādyātmakapadasya vācakatvamāstheyamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: atra pakṣe ṭā sthāne na ādeśam vidadhataḥ bhāṣyakāra mate pi vaiyākaraṇānām api vibhāga jñānam na suśakam iti bodhyam evam sati api rāmeṇa iti atas rāma abhinnaḥ kartā ityādi rūpa bodha anyathā anupapattyā suvanta ādi ātmaka padasya vācaka tvam āstheyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: yatra prakṛtyādivibhāgakalpanā na saṃbhavati tasyaiva padasya vācakatvaṃ, yatra tu tathā kalpanāsaṃbhavastatra prakṛtipratyayoreva vācakatvamityāhuḥ | bhāṣyattvavidastu-etādṛśasthale padasya vācakatve klṛpte sarvatraiva padasya vācakatvamanyathārdhajaratīyatāpattervyāvahārāttatraiva śaktigrahāccetyāhuḥ | evaṃ vākyasphoṭe'pi matadvayaṃ bodhyam ||
analyzed: yatra prakṛti ādi vibhāga kalpanā na saṃbhavati tasya eva padasya vācaka tvam yatra tu tathā kalpanā saṃbhavaḥ tatra prakṛti pratyayoḥ eva vācaka tvam iti āhuḥ bhāṣya ttva vidaḥ tu etādṛśa sthale padasya vācaka tve klṛpte sarvatra eva padasya vācaka tvam anyathā ardhajaratīya tā āpatteḥ vyāvahārāt tatra eva śakti grahāt ca iti āhuḥ evam vākya sphoṭe api mata dvayam bodhyam

original: tadāha - vācakatvamāhetyarthaḥ | padayoreṅa iti | varṇayorādeśapakṣe padāvayavavarṇayorityarthaḥ | 'sarve sarvapadādeśāḥ' iti pakṣe tu yathāśrutameva sādhu | tadvibhāgaḥ - pūrvapadottarapadavibhāgaḥ | harevetyādāvityādipadād--'viṣṇo'va' 'kṛṣṇeve'tyādisaṃgrahaḥ | ādeśenāpahāro na prakṛtipratyayabhāgayoryathā--'lihaṃ lihau liha' ityādau |
analyzed: tat āha vācaka tvam āha iti arthaḥ padayoḥ e ṅaḥ iti varṇayoḥ ādeśa pakṣe pada avayava varṇayoḥ iti arthaḥ sarve sarva pada ādeśāḥ iti pakṣe tu yathāśrutam eva sādhu tad vibhāgaḥ pūrva pada uttara pada vibhāgaḥ harā iva ityādau iti ādi padāt viṣṇo iva kṛṣṇā iva ityādi saṃgrahaḥ ādeśena apahāraḥ na prakṛti pratyaya bhāgayoḥ yathā liham lihau lihaḥ ityādau

original: tatrāpi samudāyaśaktiraśyābhyupeyetyāha--evaṃ prakṛtīti | mūle--vākyaphoṭamiti | vākyaṃ - vācakamityarthaḥ | nanu yatra vibhāgajñānaṃ na saṃbhavati tasya vākyasya vācakatvasiddhāvapi na sarvavākyeṣu tatsiddhirata āha-vastuta ityādināḥ padaiḥ-ghaṭādiprātipadikaiḥ, subantairvā--yathā ghaṭādirūportho bodhyate, tathā 'ghaṭo'stī'tyādivākyairvākyārthaḥ
analyzed: tatra api samudāya śaktiḥ aśyā abhyupeyā iti āha evam prakṛti iti mūle vākya phoṭam iti vākyam vācakam iti arthaḥ nanu yatra vibhāga jñānam na saṃbhavati tasya vākyasya vācaka tva siddhau api na sarva vākyeṣu tad siddhiḥ atas āha vastutas ityādinā padaiḥ ghaṭa ādi prātipadikaiḥ sup antaiḥ vā yathā ghaṭa ādi rūpaḥ arthaḥ bodhyate tathā ghaṭaḥ asti ityādi vākyaiḥ vākya arthaḥ

original: pratyāyyate, paraṃ tu prāptāprāptavivekena saṃsarge sā śaktiḥ paryavasyatīti bodhyam |
analyzed: pratyāyyate param tu prāpta aprāpta vivekena saṃsarge sā śaktiḥ paryavasyati iti bodhyam

original: peṭikākṛtastu-vibhaktyaiva kriyākārakabhāvasaṃbandhasyābhihitatayā tadaśe vākyaśakterasaṃbhave'pi viśeṣyaviśeṣaṇabhāve vākyaśaktiḥ |
analyzed: peṭikā kṛtaḥ tu vibhaktyā eva kriyā kāraka bhāva saṃbandhasya abhihita tayā tad aśe vākya śakteḥ asaṃbhave pi viśeṣya viśeṣaṇa bhāve vākya śaktiḥ

original: vibhaktiprakṛtyarthagataviśeṣaṇatvasya vibhaktiśakyatve'pi viṣeṣyaniṣṭhamitarapadārthaviśeṣaṇatāpratiyogikaṃ viśeṣyatvaṃ tacchakyaṃ bodhyaṃ, viṣayatāyā api śābdabodhe bhānamāvaśyakamiti 'arthavat--'sūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭam | tathā prātipadikārthasūtre ',ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe' iti sūtre ca bhāṣye |
analyzed: vibhakti prakṛti artha gata viśeṣaṇa tvasya vibhakti śakya tve pi viṣeṣya niṣṭham itara padārtha viśeṣaṇatā pratiyogikam viśeṣyatvam tat śakyam bodhyam viṣayatāyāḥ api śābdabodhe bhānam āvaśyakam iti arthavat sūtre bhāṣye spaṣṭam tathā prātipadika artha sūtre ṣaṣṭhī śeṣe iti sūtre ca bhāṣye

original: tatra hi--'vīraḥ puruṣa' ityādau 'viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyabhāvarūpaṃ yadādhikyaṃ sa vākyārtha' ityuktam | 'ādhikya'mityatra svārthe ṣyañiti prāhuḥ | vākye śaktyakalpane bādhakamāha--anyatheti | tādṛśavyutpattīti | 'ghaṭaḥ karmatva'mityādivākyaṃ ghaṭakarmakānayanabodhajanakamiti jñānarahitasyetyarthaḥ | bodhaprasaṅga iti |
analyzed: tatra hi vīraḥ puruṣaḥ ityādau viśeṣaṇa viśeṣya bhāva rūpam yat ādhikyam sa vākya arthaḥ iti uktam ādhikyam iti atra svārthe ṣyañ iti prāhuḥ vākye śakti akalpane bādhakam āha anyathā iti tādṛśa vyutpatti iti ghaṭaḥ karma tvam ityādi vākyam ghaṭa karmaka ānayana bodha janakam iti jñāna rahitasya iti arthaḥ bodha prasaṅgaḥ iti

original: ghaṭakarmakamānayanamiti bodhaprasaṅgaḥ | 'ghaṭādipadaśaktigrahavata' iti śeṣaḥ | tathā ca 'ghaṭamānaye'tyatrevātrāpi padārthopasthatyādighaṭitasāmagrīsattvāt tathābidhabodhaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ | tādṛśavyutpattimato bodha iṣṭa eveti tādṛśavyutpattirāhityānusaraṇam |
analyzed: ghaṭa karmakam ānayanam iti bodha prasaṅgaḥ ghaṭa ādi pada śakti grahavataḥ iti śeṣaḥ tathā ca ghaṭam ānaya iti atra iva atra api padārtha upastha tyādi ghaṭita sāmagrī sattvāt tathābidha bodha prasaṅgaḥ iti arthaḥ tādṛśa vyutpattimataḥ bodhaḥ iṣṭaḥ eva iti tādṛśa vyutpatti rāhitya anusaraṇam

original: nanu 'ghaṭaḥ kamatva'mityādivākyaṃ svarūpāyogyameveti na tato bodhāpattiḥ,ghaṭe'vyavahitapūrvavartitvasaṃbandhenām‌padamattvasyāmpade'vyavahitottaravartitvasaṃbandhena ghaṭādipadavattvasyā'kāre 'ānay'padavattvasyānayūpade'kāravattvasya vākāṅkṣātvād--'ghaṭaḥ karmatvaṃ'mityādau ca tādṛśākāṅkṣābhāvāt |
analyzed: nanu ghaṭaḥ svarūpa ayogyam eva iti na tatas bodha āpattiḥ ghaṭe vyavahita pūrva varti tva saṃbandhena ām pada mattvasya ām pade vyavahita uttara varti tva saṃbandhena ghaṭa ādi pada vat tvasya ākāre vā ākāṅkṣā tvāt ghaṭaḥ karma tvam ityādau ca tādṛśa ākāṅkṣā bhāvāt

original: ghaṭapade karmatvapadavattvāderākāṅkṣātvābhāvāt, śābdabodhajanakasamabhivyāhārasyaivākāṅkṣātvādityata āha--ghaṭamānayetyatreveti | ātrāpi 'tādṛśavyutpattirahitasye'tyanupajyate | bodhābhāvācceti | vākyaśaktyanaṅgīkāre tu tajjñānetarasakalakāraṇakalāpasattvācchābdabodhāpattirityarthaḥ | tatraiva - ghaṭamānayetyatraiva |
analyzed: ghaṭa pade karmatva padavat tva ādeḥ ākāṅkṣā tva abhāvāt śābda bodha janaka samabhivyāhārasya eva ākāṅkṣā tvāt iti atas āha ghaṭam ānaya iti atra iva iti ātrā api tādṛśa vyutpatti rahitasya iti anupajyate bodha abhāvāt ca iti vākya śakti anaṅgīkāre tu tad jñāna itara sakala kāraṇa kalāpa sattvāt śābda bodha āpattiḥ iti arthaḥ tatra eva ghaṭam ānaya iti atra eva

original: 'iti jñānavato bodhā'diti yojanā | ghaṭārthakaprātipadiketi | tena kalaśādipadasaṃgrahaḥ | karmatvavācaketi | etattu spaṣṭārtham | ghaṭādipadottarāmpadasya karmatvavācakatvāvyabhicārāt | kkacit 'karmatvavācakavibhakte'rityeva pāṭhaḥ | karmatvavācakavibhaktitvenauśasoḥ saṃgrahaḥ |
analyzed: iti jñānavataḥ bodhāt iti yojanā ghaṭa arthaka prātipadikā iti tena kalaśa ādi pada saṃgrahaḥ karmatva vācaka iti etat tu spaṣṭa artham ghaṭa ādi pada uttarām padasya karmatva vācaka tva avyabhicārāt kkacid karmatva vācaka vibhakteḥ iti eva pāṭhaḥ karmatva vācaka vibhakti tvena ośasoḥ saṃgrahaḥ

original: tathā ca ghaṭakalaśādipadabhedenā'mādivacanabhedena ca na kāryakāraṇabhāvabāhulyamiti bhāvaḥ | 'dhāto'rityanantaraṃ vikāraṇasyeti kkacid‌bodhyam | parantu vikaraṇasya sarvatra na niveśaḥ, 'odanaṃ papāce'tyādau tadasattvāt |
analyzed: tathā ca ghaṭa kalaśa ādi pada bhedena āma ādi vacana bhedena ca na kārya kāraṇa bhāva bāhulyam iti bhāvaḥ dhātoḥ iti anantaram vikāraṇasya iti kkacid bodhyam parantu vikaraṇasya sarvatra na niveśaḥ odanam papāca ityādau tad asattvāt

original: yadyapyānayetyādāvākhyātasyāpi na śrūyamāṇatvam, anusaṃdhānaṃ cobhayatra samānameva, tathāpyākhyātasyārthopasthityarthamanusaṃdhānamāvaśyakaṃ, vikaraṇasya tvanarthakatayā tadanāvaśyakamityaśayena dhātorityanantaraṃ vikaraṇasyeti nābhihitam | athavā vikaraṇasya nirarthakatvarūpamaprādhānyaṃ sūcayituṃ vikaraṇānabhidhānam | tajjñānamapīti |
analyzed: yadi api ānayā ityādau ākhyātasya api na śrūyamāṇa tvam anusaṃdhānam ca ubhayatra samānam eva tathā api ākhyātasya artha upasthiti artham anusaṃdhānam āvaśyakam vikaraṇasya tu anarthaka tayā tat anāvaśyakam iti aśayena dhātoḥ iti anantaram vikaraṇasya iti na abhihitam athavā vikaraṇasya nirarthaka tva rūpam aprādhānyam sūcayitum vikaraṇa anabhidhānam tad jñānam api iti

original: tathāvidhakāryakāraṇabāvajñānamapi | heturiti | tathā cānvayavyatirekābhyāmetādṛśākāṅkṣājñānahetutvenaivopapattau vākye śaktisadbhāve mānābhāva iti bhāvaḥ | siddho vākyasphoṭa iti | vākyasya vācakatā siddhetyarthaḥ | viśiṣṭavākyārthabodhe - vākyārthaviśeṣabodhe | 'ghaṭakarmakamānayana'mityādyākārakabodhe iti yāvat | padasamabhivyāhāreti |
analyzed: tathāvidha kārya kāraṇa bāva jñānam api hetuḥ iti tathā ca anvaya vyatirekābhyām etādṛśa ākāṅkṣā jñāna hetu tvena eva upapattau vākye śakti sadbhāve māna abhāvaḥ iti bhāvaḥ siddhaḥ vākya sphoṭaḥ iti vākyasya vācaka tā siddhā iti arthaḥ viśiṣṭa vākya artha bodhe vākya artha viśeṣa bodhe ghaṭa karmakam ānayanam ityādi ākāraka bodhe iti yāvat pada samabhivyāhāra iti

original: uktapūrvāparībhāvāpannapadasamudāyarūpaṃ ca tadvākyaṃ cetyarthaḥ | idaṃ ca 'ghaṭamānaye'ti vākyādeva bodha ityabhipretya |
analyzed: ukta pūrva aparībhāva āpanna pada samudāya rūpam ca tat vākyam ca iti arthaḥ idam ca ghaṭam ānaya iti vākyāt eva bodhaḥ iti abhipretya

original: yadi tu 'ānaya-ghaṭa'miti viparyastādapi vākyāttathāvidhabodho'nubhavasiddhaḥ, ata eva samarthasūtre bhāṣye uktam--'yatheṣṭamanyatareṇābisaṃbandho bhavati vākye--rājñaḥ puruṣaḥ, puruṣo rājña itī'tyucyate--tadoktasamabhivyāhāramiva viparītatiṅantasamabhivyāhāramādāya tanniṣṭhaprakṛtavākyārthabodhakatvagrahasyāpi tathāvidhabodhe kāraṇatvaṃ bodhyam |
analyzed: yadi tu ānaya ghaṭam iti viparyastāt api vākyāt tathāvidha bodhaḥ anubhava siddhaḥ atas eva samartha sūtre bhāṣye uktam yatheṣṭam anyatareṇa a visaṃbandhaḥ bhavati puruṣaḥ puruṣaḥ rājñaḥ iti iti ucyate tadā ukta samabhivyāhāram iva viparīta tiṅanta samabhivyāhāram ādāya tad niṣṭha prakṛta vākya artha bodhaka tva grahasya api tathāvidha bodhe kāraṇa tvam bodhyam

original: nanu tādṛśakāryakāraṇabhāvajñānamabyupagantavyamanyathā ghaṭaviṣayakavṛttijñānāt paṭādiviṣayakabodhāpattiḥ | evaṃ viṣayabhedena kāryakāraṇabhāvabhedāvaśyakatve hetutvakalpane'pi vākye śaktiḥ kathaṃ siddhetya āha--arthopasthāpaketi | arthopasthāpakaṃ-yajjñānaṃ tadviṣaye yaḥ śabdastadvṛti yajjñānanirūpitakāraṇatvaṃ tasyetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: nanu tādṛśa kārya kāraṇa bhāva jñānam abyupagantavyam anyathā ghaṭa viṣayaka vṛtti jñānāt paṭa ādi viṣayaka bodha āpattiḥ evam viṣaya bhedena kārya kāraṇa bhāva bheda āvaśyaka tve hetu tva kalpane api vākye śaktiḥ katham siddhā iti a āha artha upasthāpaka iti artha upasthāpakam yat jñānam tad viṣaye yaḥ śabdaḥ tad vṛti yat jñāna nirūpita kāraṇa tvam tasya iti arthaḥ

original: 'ghaṭamānaye'tivākyaniṣṭhaghaṭakarmakānayanarūpavākyārthajñānakāraṇatvajñānasya śaktitvavāraṇāyā'rthopasthāpake'ti | prakṛtārthopasthāpaketyarthaḥ | tena na tattaddoṣatāvasthyam | tathā ca paramate yā ākāṅkṣā saivāsmākaṃ vākyaśaktiriti nādhikyamiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: ghaṭam ānaya iti vākya niṣṭha ghaṭa karmaka ānayana rūpa vākya artha jñāna kāraṇatva jñānasya śaktitva vāraṇāya artha upasthāpaka iti prakṛta artha upasthāpaka iti arthaḥ tena na tad tad doṣa tāvasthyam tathā ca paramate yā ākāṅkṣā sā eva asmākam vākya śaktiḥ iti na ādhikyam iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu tadviṣayakaśābdabodhe tadviṣayakavṛttijñānasya hetutve prayojanābhāvena saṃbandharūpaviṣayaṃ niveśya kāryakāraṇabhāvakalpanāttadaśe śaktyanabhyupagame'pi tad‌bodhopapattisaṃbhava ityāśaṅkyāha--yuktaṃ caitadityādinā | viṣayatāsaṃbandheneti |
analyzed: nanu tad viṣayaka śābdabodhe tad viṣayaka vṛtti jñānasya hetu tve prayojana abhāvena saṃbandha rūpa viṣayam niveśya kārya kāraṇa bhāva kalpanāt tad daśe śakti anabhyupagamaḥ api tad bodha upapatti saṃbhavaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha yuktam ca etat ityādinā viṣayatā saṃbandhena iti

original: tathā ca na viṣayedena kāryakāraṇabhāvavāhulyamiti saṃbandhāṃśe śaktyanabhyupagame tad‌bodhānirvāhānna śaktisvīkāra āvaśyaka iti bhāvaḥ | nanu 'ghaṭamānaya' 'paṭamānaye'tyādisamabhivyāhārānantyācchaktyānantyaṃ syādati cet, tavāpi mate tattatsamabhivyāhārabhedena kāryakāraṇabhāvānantyaṃ syāditi gauravasya tulyatvāt |
analyzed: tathā ca na kārya kāraṇa bhāva vāhulyam iti saṃbandha aṃśe śakti anabhyupagame tad bodha anirvāhāt na śakti svīkāraḥ āvaśyakaḥ iti bhāvaḥ nanu ghaṭam ānaya paṭam ānaya ityādi samabhivyāhāra ānantyāt śakti ānantyam syāt ati ced tava api mate tad tad samabhivyāhāra bhedena kārya kāraṇa bhāva ānantyam syāt iti gauravasya tulya tvāt

original: yadi ghaṭaprakāraśābdabodhavāvacchinnaṃ prati ghaṭārthakapadottaravibhaktyādijanyopasthitirhetuḥ, kāryatākāraṇatayoravacchedakaḥ saṃbandho viśeṣyatā, eve viśeṣyatāsambandhena karmatvaprakāraśābdatvāvacchinnaṃ prati karmatvārthakavibhaktiprāgvartipadajanyopasthitirviśeṣyatāsaṃbandhena hetuḥ |
analyzed: yadi ghaṭa prakāra śābda bodha va avacchinnam prati ghaṭa arthaka pada uttara vibhakti ādi janya upasthitiḥ hetuḥ kāryatā kāraṇatayoḥ avacchedakaḥ saṃbandhaḥ viśeṣyatā eve viśeṣyatā sambandhena karma tva prakāra śābda tva avacchinnam prati karma tva arthaka vibhakti prāgvarti pada janya upasthitiḥ viśeṣyatā saṃbandhena hetuḥ

original: idaṃ ca karmatvasya dvitīyādyarthasya prakṛtyarthe viśeṣaṇatvābhyupagame | viśeṣyatvābhyupagame tu prakāratāsaṃbandhena karmatvaviśeṣyakaśābde sāmānyata eva kāryakāraṇabhāvaḥ sarvatrābhyupeyate,--tadā vākyaśaktisvīkāre tadānantyāpattiratiricyate iti cettadā mamāpi mate 'ghaṭamānaya' 'paṭamānaye'tyādisakalavākyaniṣṭhaikaiva śaktirabhyupeyate |
analyzed: idam ca karmatvasya dvitīya ādi arthasya prakṛti arthe viśeṣaṇa tva abhyupagame viśeṣya tva abhyupagame tu prakāratā saṃbandhena karmatva viśeṣyaka śābde sāmānyatas eva kārya kāraṇa bhāvaḥ sarvatra abhyupeyate tadā vākya śakti svīkāre tad ānantya āpattiḥ atiricyate iti ced tadā mama api mate ghaṭam ānaya paṭam ānaya ityādi sakala vākya niṣṭhā ekā eva śaktiḥ abhyupeyate

original: vākyārrthaviṣayiṇyāstu nirūpitatvādeḥ karmatvādisaṃbandhasyaikyāt | 'ghaṭamānaye'tyatra paṭasya padādupasthityabhāvādeva na paṭakarmakabodhāpattiḥ | vastutastu ghaṭaprakārakaśābdabodhe ghaṭapadottarāmpadajanyopasthitirheturiti viśiṣyaiva tattapadamantarbhāvya hetuhetumadbhāvakalpanamāvaśyakam |
analyzed: vākyāḥ arrtha viṣayiṇyāḥ tu nirūpita tva ādeḥ karmatva ādi saṃbandhasya aikyāt ghaṭam ānaya iti atra paṭasya padāt upasthiti abhāvāt eva na paṭa karmaka bodha āpattiḥ vastutas tu ghaṭa prakāraka śābdabodhe ghaṭa pada uttarām pada janya upasthitiḥ hetuḥ iti viśiṣya eva tat tad padam antar bhāvya hetu hetumat bhāva kalpanam āvaśyakam

original: anyathā nirākāṅkṣaghaṭapadād ghaṭopasthitau kalaśapade'gṛhītaśaktikapuṃsaḥ 'kalaśamānaye'ti vākyād‌bodhāpatteriti bodhyam | etatsūvanāyaiva bhūṣaṇe--'yadi ghaṭaprakārake'tyatra 'yadī'tyuktam | tattatpadamantarbhāvya taduktau tu noktāpattiḥ | tatpadaghaṭitākāṅkṣājñānasahakṛtatattatpadajanyopasthitereva sāmagrīmadhye niveśāt |
