original: etena naṣṭavidyamānapuruṣayorayaṃ pūrvo'yaṃ para iti vyavahāravadannāpi paurvakālikatvādinibandhanaḥ sa vyavahāra upapadyata iti parāstam | tathāpi tayoḥ saṃbandhānupapatterjāgarūkatvāt, vaktumaśakytvācca kālikasaṃbandhavat |
analyzed: etena naṣṭa vidyamāna puruṣayoḥ ayam pūrvaḥ yam paraḥ iti vyavahāra vat anna api paurvakālika tva ādi nibandhanaḥ sa vyavahāraḥ upapadyate iti parāstam tathā api tayoḥ saṃbandha anupapatteḥ jāgarūka tvāt vaktum aśakya tvāt ca kālika saṃbandha vat

original: evaṃ padapratyokṣopapādane'pi tatra vṛttyāśrayatvajñānāsaṃbhavāccaca padasyāvidyamānatvāt, avidyamāne'pyāśrayatvopagame''tītaghaṭo jalavā'miti pratyayāpattiḥ, abādhitārthakatayā tajjñānasya pramātvāt |
analyzed: evam pada pratyokṣa upapādane api tatra vṛtti āśraya tva jñāna asaṃbhavāt ca ca padasya avidyamāna tvāt avidyamāna ipi āśraya tva upagama iti ita ghaṭaḥ jalavām iti pratyaya āpattiḥ abādhita arthaka tayā tad jñānasya pramā tvāt

original: nanvidānīmatīte vṛttyāśrayatvābhāvepi pūrvakālāvacchedena vṛttyāśrayatvaṃ tatra sughaṭamevātītaghaṭe rūpādyāśrayatvavaditi cenna, varṇasamudāyātmakapadasya pūrvamapyasattvāt | ghaṭasya pūrvaṃ sattvena tatra tadā rūpādyāśrayatvamupapadyate eveti spaṣṭam |
analyzed: nanu idānīm atīte vṛtti āśraya tva abhāve pi pūrva kāla avacchedena vṛtti āśraya tvam tatra sughaṭam eva atīta ghaṭe rūpa ādi āśraya tva vat iti ced na varṇa samudāya ātmaka padasya pūrvam api asattvāt ghaṭasya pūrvam sattvena tatra tadā rūpa ādi āśraya tvam upapadyate eva iti spaṣṭam

original: nanvatītaghaṭo javavāniti pratyayo nāpādayituṃ śakyaḥ, matupā vartamānasaṃbandhasyaivābhidhānāt, 'tadasyāstyasmi'nniti sūtreṇa tathaiva bodhanāt | evaṃ ca buddhiviṣayavarṇasamudāyatmakapade vṛttyāśrayatvāṅgīkāre na kiṃcidbādhakam | ata evā'tītaghaṭaṃ jānāmī'ti prayoga upapadyate |
analyzed: nanu atīta ghaṭaḥ javavān iti pratyayaḥ nā āpādayitum śakyaḥ matupā vartamāna saṃbandhasya eva abhidhānāt tat asya asti asmin iti sūtreṇa tathā eva bodhanāt evam ca buddhi viṣaya varṇa samudāya tmaka pade vṛtti āśraya tva aṅgīkāre na kiṃcid bādhakam atas eva atīta ghaṭam jānāmi iti prayogaḥ upapadyate

original: anyathātītaghaṭe idānīntanajñānādyāśrayatvābhāvāttadanupapattiḥ spaṣṭaiveti cenna, evamapi padavākyayorabhāvena śabdārthasaṃbandhasyaiva hānyāpattiḥ taduktaṃ vākyapadīye--
analyzed: anyathā atīta ghaṭe idānīntana jñāna ādi āśraya tva abhāvāt tad anupapattiḥ spaṣṭā eva iti ced na evam api pada vākyayoḥ abhāvena śabda artha saṃbandhasya eva hāni āpattiḥ tat uktam vākyapadīye

original: 'aśābdo yadi vākyārthaḥ padārthopi tathā bhavet' iti |
analyzed: aśābdaḥ yadi vākya arthaḥ padārthaḥ api tathā bhavet iti

original: padasamudāyarūpavākyavadvarṇasamudāyarūpapadasyāpi virahāt, arthasaṃbandhasyobhayatrāpyasattvāditi tadbhāvaḥ | evaṃ tadevedaṃ kṛṣṇapadamekaṃ vākyamiti buddheranupapattiśca | upapāditaṃ tattvametat | kiṃ caivamuccāraṇabhedabhinnaśabdeṣu śaktigrahāsaṃbhavaḥ, vyaktivādānantyavyabhicāraprasarāt |
analyzed: pada samudāya rūpa vākya vat varṇa samudāya rūpa padasya api virahāt artha saṃbandhasya ubhayatra api asattvāt iti tad bhāvaḥ evam tat eva idam kṛṣṇa padam ekam vākyam iti buddheḥ anupapattiḥ ca upapāditam tattvam etat kim ca evam uccāraṇa bheda bhinna śabdeṣu śakti graha asaṃbhavaḥ vyakti vāda ānantya vyabhicāra prasarāt

original: gṛhītaśaktikādeva bodha iti niyame vyabhicāro'vagantavya iti dik | evaṃ ca kaiyaṭoktameva samyagiti prāhuḥ | sphoṭaśca parāpaśyantīmadhyamāvaikharīticaturvidhavāṅmadhye yā madhyamā vāk tasyā yo nādāṃśastadātmakaḥ | vistarastu harigrandhādavagantavya iti mañjūṣāyāṃ spaṣṭam |
analyzed: gṛhīta śaktikāt eva bodhaḥ iti niyame vyabhicāraḥ avagantavyaḥ iti diś evam ca kaiyaṭa uktam eva samyak iti prāhuḥ sphoṭaḥ ca parā paśyantī madhyamā vaikharī iti caturvidha vāc madhye yā madhyamā vāc tasyāḥ yaḥ nāda aṃśaḥ tad ātmakaḥ vistaraḥ tu harigrandhāt avagantavyaḥ iti mañjūṣāyām spaṣṭam

original: sa cākhaṇḍa ekavarṇasvīkārapakṣe yadyepyekavarṇenābivyajyate tathāpi netaravarmavaiyarthyamantyavarṇābhivyaktasyaiva tasya bodhahetutvāt | na ca tathāpi taditaravarmavaiyarthyaṃ durvārameveti vācyam | pūrvapūrvavarṇānubhavajanitasaṃskārāṇāmapi sahakāritvāt, saṃskārāṇāṃ ca sthiratayā noktopapattyasaṃbhavaḥ |
analyzed: sa ca akhaṇḍaḥ eka varṇa svīkāra pakṣe tathā api na itara varma vaiyarthyam antya varṇa abhivyaktasya eva tasya bodha hetu tvāt na ca tathā api tad itara varma vaiyarthyam durvāram eva iti vācyam pūrva pūrva varṇa anubhava janita saṃskārāṇām api sahakāri tvāt saṃskārāṇām ca sthiratayā na ukta upapatti asaṃbhavaḥ

original: anubhavaśca tadānīntana upādeyaḥ, nāto devadattādipade dakārādivarṇānāṃ sārthakyaṃ durupapādam, kālāntarīṇatāvadvarṇānubhavajanitasaṃskārāṇāṃ sattvāditi dūṣaṇāvakāśaḥ | saṃskārod‌bodhanārthaṃ cāritārthyācca | ud‌buddhasaṃskārāṇāmeva sahakāritvāt | na caivaṃ sphoṭavaiyarthyam, dattottaratvāt |
analyzed: anubhavaḥ ca tadānīntanaḥ upādeyaḥ na atas devadatta ādi pade dakāra ādi varṇānām sārthakyam durupapādam kāla antarīṇa tāvat varṇa anubhava janita saṃskārāṇām sattvāt iti dūṣaṇa avakāśaḥ saṃskāra udbodhana artham cāritārthyāt ca udbuddha saṃskārāṇām eva sahakāri tvāt na ca evam sphoṭa vaiyarthyam datta uttara tvāt

original: 'paraḥ saṃnikarṣaḥ-' iti sūtrabhāṣye'pyuccaritapradhvastānāṃ varṇānāṃ saṃnikarṣaḥ paurvāparyaṃ cānupapannamiti śaṅkāpanodāyoktam--
analyzed: paraḥ saṃnikarṣaḥ iti sūtra bhāṣye pi uccarita pradhvastānām varṇānām saṃnikarṣaḥ paurvāparyam ca anupapannam iti śaṅkā apanodāya uktam

original: 'buddhau kṛtvā sarvāśceṣṭāḥ kartā dhīrastattvannītiḥ' |
analyzed: buddhau kṛtvā sarvāḥ ceṣṭāḥ kartā dhīraḥ tattvat nītiḥ

original: śabdenārthān vācyān dṛṣṭ‌vā buddhau kuryāt paurvāparyam ||
analyzed: śabdena arthān vācyān dṛṣṭvā buddhau kuryāt paurvāparyam

original: buddhiviṣayameva śabdānāṃ paurvāparyam | iha ya eṣa manuṣyaḥ prekṣāpūrvakārī bhavati sa paśyatyasminnarthe'yaṃ śabdaḥ prayoktavyo'smistāvacchabdo'yaṃ tāvadvarṇastato'yaṃ tato'yamiti | tattvannītiḥ - sakalaviṣayakajñānavān |
analyzed: buddhi viṣayam eva śabdānām paurvāparyam iha yaḥ eṣa manuṣyaḥ prekṣā pūrva kārī bhavati sa paśyati asmin artha iyam śabdaḥ prayoktavyaḥ asmin tāvat śabdaḥ iyam tāvat varṇaḥ tatas yam tatas yam iti tattvat nītiḥ sakala viṣayaka jñānavān

original: dhīraḥ - pāṇḍityabhāk, buddhāvantaḥ karaṇe, ceṣṭāḥ - kaṇṭhādyabhighātavyāpārajanyaśabdān pratibimbitān kṛtvā, 'śabdene'ti sāhitye tṛtīyā, tathā ca tatsahitatadvācyārthān buddhāvupadeśe dṛṣṭvā tatraiva paurvāparyavyavahāraṃ kuryāditi tadarthaḥ | 'buddhiviṣaya'mityasya buddhisthaśabdaviṣayamityarthaḥ |
analyzed: dhīraḥ pāṇḍitya bhāj buddhau antar karaṇe ceṣṭāḥ kaṇṭha ādi abhighāta vyāpāra janya śabdān pratibimbitān kṛtvā śabdena iti sāhitye tṛtīyā tathā ca tad sahita tad vācyārthān buddhau upadeśe dṛṣṭvā tatra eva paurvāparya vyavahāram kuryāt iti tad arthaḥ buddhi viṣayam iti asya buddhi stha śabda viṣayam iti arthaḥ

original: 'ya eṣa' ityādinā vaktṛbuddhisthatvopapādanaṃ tu śāstrasya vaktrudeśenaiva pravṛttestasyaiva dharmaphalaśravaṇācceti bodhyam | buddhigatapaurvāparyasya varṇetvāropaparamidaṃ bhāṣyamiti tu na yuktam | buddhīnamapi kramikotpannāśuvināśitayā paurvāparyāsaṃbhavāt |
analyzed: yaḥ eṣaḥ ityādinā vaktṛ buddhi stha tva upapādanam tu śāstrasya vaktru deśena eva pravṛtteḥ tasya eva dharma phala śravaṇāt ca iti bodhyam buddhi gata paurvāparyasya varṇa itu āropa param idam bhāṣyam iti tu na yuktam buddhīnam api kramika utpanna āśu vināśi tayā paurvāparya asaṃbhavāt

original: evamayamiti pratkṣaviṣayamātraparāmarśakedamābhilāpāsaṃbhavo'pi sphoṭānaṅgīkāre bodhyaḥ | tadaṅgīkāre tu svāmātraśravyasūkṣmoccāraṇavyaṅgyatvena tadupapattiriti bhāvaḥ | eva doṣa iti | vikalpātmiko doṣa ityarthaḥ | tamupapādayati--tattadvarṇeti | pratyekaṃ vyañjakatvamiti | tadhātve ca taditaravāyusaṃyogopādānanairarthakyāpattiriti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: evam ayam iti sphoṭa anaṅgīkāre bodhyaḥ tad aṅgīkāre tu svā mātra śravya sūkṣma uccāraṇa vyaṅgya tvena tad upapattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ eva doṣaḥ iti vikalpa ātmikaḥ doṣaḥ iti arthaḥ tam upapādayati tad tad varṇa iti pratyekam vyañjaka tvam iti tadhātve ca tad itara vāyu saṃyoga upādāna nairarthakya āpattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ

original: nābhipradeśādud‌gatavāyostattatsthāne krameṇaiva saṃyogotpattyā samuditānāṃ vāyusaṃyogānāmasaṃbhavo bodhyaḥ | pratyekaṃ saṃyogonāmabhivyañjakatvepi kaścana gatvena kaścanautvena kaścidvisargatvena rūpeṇa sphoṭamabhivyanakti, tathā ca tāvadrūpavaiśiṣṭenābhivyaktasyaiva tasyārthabodhakatvamiti na kasyāpi vāyusaṃyogasya vaiyarthyamityāśayena
analyzed: nābhi pradeśāt udgata vāyoḥ tad tad sthāne krameṇa eva saṃyoga utpattyā samuditānām vāyu saṃyogānām asaṃbhavaḥ bodhyaḥ pratyekam saṃyogaḥ nām abhivyañjaka tve pi kaścana ga tvena kaścana au tvena kaścid visarga tvena rūpeṇa sphoṭam abhivyanakti tathā ca tāvat rūpa vaiśiṣṭena abhivyaktasya eva tasya artha bodhaka tvam iti na kasya api vāyu saṃyogasya vaiyarthyam iti āśayena

original: samādhatte--pratyekameveti | ata eva - vāyusaṃyogānāṃ svavṛttigatvādinābhivyañjakatvādeva | tadatirekāsvīkāropi - sphoṭātiriktāsvīkīropītyarthaḥ | vāyusaṃyogasya gatvādinābhivyañjakatvānupagame tu tathābhivyaktayeriktavarṇasvīkāra āvaśyako bhavediti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: samādhatte pratyekam eva iti atas eva vāyu saṃyogānām sva vṛtti ga tva ādinā abhivyañjaka tvāt eva tad atireka asvīkāraḥ api sphoṭa atirikta asvīkīraḥ api iti arthaḥ vāyu saṃyogasya ga tva ādinā abhivyañjaka tva anupagame tu tathā abhivyaktayā īrikta varṇa svīkāraḥ āvaśyakaḥ bhavet iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanu vāyusaṃyogānāṃ pūrvokta diśā yaugapadyāsaṃbhavena kathaṃ yugapattattadrūpeṇa sphoṭābhivyāktisaṃbhava iti cenna,nābipradeśādud‌gatavāyoḥ sthūlatayā yugapadevānekasthāneṣu nānāsaṃyogotpattisaṃbhavenoktadoṣānavakāśāt | nanvevamapi padābhāvena padajñānasyārthadhīkāraṇatā'saṃbhavaduktikaivetyāśaṅkāmapanudati--evaṃ ceti |
analyzed: nanu vāyu saṃyogānām pūrva ukta diśā yaugapadya asaṃbhavena katham yugapad tad tad rūpeṇa sphoṭa abhivyākti saṃbhavaḥ iti ced na nābi pradeśāt udgata vāyoḥ sthūla tayā yugapad eva aneka sthāneṣu nānā saṃyoga utpatti saṃbhavena ukta doṣa anavakāśāt nanu evam api pada abhāvena pada jñānasya artha dhī kāraṇatā asaṃbhavat uktikā eva iti āśaṅkām apanudati evam ca iti

original: vāyusaṃyogagatatatadrūpeṇa sphoṭābhivyaktau cetyarthaḥ | 'gṛhyat' ityasya 'yatre'ti śeṣaḥ | tathā ca yatra jñāne ghaṭatvaṃ ṭakāre bhāsate tādṛśaṃ yatpadajñānaṃ tatkāraṇatayā ityarthaḥ | avivādāditi | sarvamatatvādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: vāyu saṃyoga gata tad tad rūpeṇa sphoṭa abhivyaktau ca iti arthaḥ gṛhyat iti asya yatra iti śeṣaḥ tathā ca yatra jñāne ghaṭa tvam ṭakāre bhāsate tādṛśam yat pada jñānam tad kāraṇatayā iti arthaḥ avivādāt iti sarva mata tvāt iti arthaḥ

original: nanu ghaṭatvādinā bhāsamānasya sphoṭasya nityatayā svādhikaraṇakṣaṇadhvaṃsādhikaraṇakṣaṇadhvaṃsānadhikaraṇatvaviśiṣṭasvādhikaraṇakṣaṇadhvasādhikaraṇatvavān yaḥ kṣaṇastadutpattikatvarūpamavyavahitottaratvamasaṃbhavītyata āha-paraṃ tvavyavahitottaratvamiti | svajñāneti | svaṃ - ghaṭatvādinā bhāsamānaḥ sphoṭaḥ |
analyzed: nanu ghaṭa tva ādinā bhāsamānasya sphoṭasya nitya tayā sva adhikaraṇa kṣaṇa dhvaṃsa adhikaraṇa kṣaṇa dhvaṃsa anadhikaraṇa tva viśiṣṭa sva adhikaraṇa kṣaṇa dhvasa adhikaraṇa tvavān yaḥ kṣaṇaḥ tad utpattika tva rūpam avyavahitottaratvam asaṃbhavi iti atas āha param tu avyavahitottaratvam iti sva jñāna iti svam ghaṭa tva ādinā bhāsamānaḥ sphoṭaḥ

original: etādṛśāvyavahitottaratvaniveśo na dṛṣṭacara ityāśaṅkyāha--ata eveti | parimaloktaṃ sphoṭakhaṇḍanaṃ dūṣayati--eteneti | uktavakṣyamāṇahetubhirityarthaḥ | ghaṭapadaeveti | ghaṭapadābivyakte evetyarthaḥ | kalaśapadāditi | kalaśapadābhivyaktādityarthaḥ | bodhaprasaṅgāditi |
analyzed: etādṛśa avyavahita uttara tva niveśaḥ na dṛṣṭacaraḥ iti āśaṅkya āha atas eva iti parimala uktam sphoṭa khaṇḍanam dūṣayati etena iti ukta vakṣyamāṇa hetubhiḥ iti arthaḥ ghaṭa pada eva iti ghaṭa pada abivyakte eva iti arthaḥ kalaśa padāt iti kalaśa pada abhivyaktāt iti arthaḥ bodha prasaṅgāt iti

original: sphoṭasyaikyena ghaṭapadābhivyakte tatra śaktigrahasya vṛttatvāt--kalasapadābhivyaktādapi tato'rthabodhaprasaṅga ityarthaḥ | varṇasamudāyarūpapadasya vācakatvamate tu nāyaṃ doṣaḥ, tena śabdena bodhe jananīye tacchaktigrahasya hetutvāt | arthadhīheturiti | tatparyāyaśravaṇajābhivyaktistatparyāyābhivyāktaśaktigrahasahakṛtārthadhīheturityarthaḥ |
analyzed: sphoṭasya aikyena ghaṭa pada abhivyakte tatra śaktigrahasya vṛtta tvāt kalasa pada abhivyaktāt api tatas ṛtha bodha prasaṅgaḥ iti arthaḥ varṇa samudāya rūpa padasya vācaka tva mate tu na ayam doṣaḥ tena śabdena bodhe jananīye tad śakti grahasya hetu tvāt artha dhī hetuḥ iti tad paryāya śravaṇa ja abhivyaktiḥ tad paryāya abhivyākta śaktigraha sahakṛta artha dhī hetuḥ iti arthaḥ

original: tatparyāyaśravaṇena sphoṭabhivyaktidvārārthabodhe jananīye tatparyāyābhivyaktiśaktigrahaḥ sahakāri kāraṇamiti vārthaḥ | tattatparyāyagataśaktigrahahetutāyā ucitatve hetumāha--tathā satīti | śaktigrahatvenaiveti | tattatparyāyagataśaktigrahatvenaivetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: tad paryāya śravaṇena sphoṭa abhivyakti dvārā artha bodhe jananīye tad paryāya abhivyakti śakti grahaḥ sahakāri kāraṇam iti vā arthaḥ tad tad paryāya gata śakti graha hetutāyāḥ ucita tve hetum āha tathā sati iti śaktigraha tvena eva iti tad tad paryāya gata śakti graha tvena eva iti arthaḥ

original: athavā upadhāyakatāsaṃbandhena śābdabuddhitvāvachinnaṃ prati viṣayatāsaṃbandhena śaktigrahatvenaivetyarthaḥ | lāghavācceti | co hetau | kāraṇatāvacchedakalāghavādityarthaḥ | tattve--hetutve | parimaloktamiti | 'parimalā'dyuktamityarthaḥ | ādinā 'nyāyarakṣāmaṇi'parigrahaḥ | sarvasiddhatvāditi |

original: kkacid‌bhūṣaṇasārapustake--bhṛguvallyāmityādigrantho dṛśyate, sa tu na yuktaḥ, uktahetubhyām | athavoktāsvarasādeva bhṛguvallyupanyāsānantaramānandavallyupanyāsa iti yojanā vidheyā | nanu vyākaraṇajñānaṃ vinotpannasphoṭajñāne vyabhicāro'ta āha--tathā ca byākaraṇeti | vaijātyaṃ kalpyata iti | tathā ca kāryatāvacchedakabhedānna vyabhicāraḥ |
analyzed: kkacid bhūṣaṇasāra pustake bhṛguvallyām ityādi granthaḥ dṛśyate sa tu na yuktaḥ ukta hetubhyām athavā ukta a svarasāt eva bhṛguvallī upanyāsa anantaram ānandavallī upanyāsaḥ iti yojanā vidheyā nanu vyākaraṇa jñānam vinā utpanna sphoṭa jñāne āha tathā ca byākaraṇa iti vaijātyam kalpyate iti tathā ca kārya tā avacchedaka bhedāt na vyabhicāraḥ

original: mantreti | mantreṇārthasmṛtiḥ prakārāntareṇāpīti vyabhicāravāraṇāya mantrajanyārthasmṛtau vaijātyaṃ mīmāṃsakaiḥ kalpyate tadbadatrāpīti bhāvaḥ | 'mantrajanya'mityasya mantrajanyatāvacchedakamityarthaḥ | vedānteti | tacchruvaṇajanyatāvacchedakam |
analyzed: mantra iti mantreṇa artha smṛtiḥ prakāra antareṇa api iti vyabhicāra vāraṇāya mantra janya artha smṛtau vaijātyam mīmāṃsakaiḥ kalpyate tad bat atra api iti bhāvaḥ mantra janyam iti asya mantra janya tā avacchedakam iti arthaḥ vedānta iti tad śruvaṇa janya tā avacchedakam

original: anyathā bhāṣāgranthaśravaṇenāpi brahmajñānasyotpattervyabhicārāpattiriti vedāntibhistatra vaijātyaṃ yathā kalpyate tatheti bhāvaḥ | tasya ca jñānasyeti | śāstrābhyāsajanitasphoṭajñānasyetyarthaḥ | śarīrādiśuddhāvupayoga iti | evaṃ ca na śāstravaiyarthyamiti bhāvaḥ | paramparayā veti | yajñādyanuṣṭhānadvārā vetyarthaḥ |
analyzed: anyathā bhāṣā grantha śravaṇena api brahma jñānasya utpatteḥ vyabhicāra āpattiḥ iti vedāntibhiḥ tatra vaijātyam yathā kalpyate tathā iti bhāvaḥ tasya ca jñānasya iti śāstra abhyāsa janita sphoṭa jñānasya iti arthaḥ śarīra ādi śuddhau upayogaḥ iti evam ca na śāstra vaiyarthyam iti bhāvaḥ paramparayā vā iti yajña ādi anuṣṭhāna dvārā vā iti arthaḥ

original: uktārthe vākyapadīyaṃ pramāṇayati--taduktamiti | cikitsā saṃjītā yatretyarthaḥ | vāṅmūlānāmapanayaheturiti paryavasito'rthaḥ | adhividyamiti-vibhaktyarthe'vyayībhāvaḥi | sarvavidyāvyāpakamiti paryavasito'rthaḥ | atīteti | atīto viparyāso bhramo yasyetyarthaḥ | kevalām - parākhyāṃ vācam | kathaṃ vāstaveti |
analyzed: ukta arthe vākyapadīyam pramāṇayati tat uktam iti cikitsā saṃjītā yatra iti arthaḥ vāc mūlānām apanaya hetuḥ iti paryavasita ūrthaḥ adhividyam iti vibhakti artha avyayībhāvaḥ sarva vidyā vyāpakam iti paryavasita ūrthaḥ atīta iti atītaḥ viparyāsaḥ bhramaḥ yasya iti arthaḥ kevalām para ākhyām vācam katham vāstavā iti

original: alīkajalodervāstavatṛḍādinivṛttijananādarśanādalīkaprakṛtyādikalpanayā vāstavasphoṭapratītirna saṃbhavatīti bhāvaḥ | vakṣyamāṇatvāditi | 'anekavyaktyabhivyaṅgye'tyādigranthena pañcakośādivat sadrasadvailakṣaṇyasya sūcayiṣyamāṇatvāt | ādinā - 'pañcakośādī'tyādipadena || 66 ||
analyzed: alīka jala udeḥ vāstava tṛḍ ādi nivṛtti janana adarśanāt alīka prakṛti ādi kalpanayā vāstava sphoṭa pratītiḥ na saṃbhavati iti bhāvaḥ vakṣyamāṇa tvāt iti aneka vyakti abhivyaṅgya ityādi granthena pañcakośa ādi vat sat rasat vailakṣaṇyasya sūcayiṣyamāṇa tvāt ādinā pañcakośa ādi ityādi padena

original: varṇajātīnām - varṇavṛttitvenābimatakatvādijātīnām | utpanna iti na syāditi | iti pratītirna syādityarthaḥ | jātīnāṃ nityatvābidhānaṃ--'śikhī dhvasta'iti vadviśeṣaṇībhūtajātiviṣayakatayaivo'tpannaḥ kakāra' ityādipratītinirvāha--ityasya nirākaraṇāya | idamupalakṣaṇaṃ 'vinaṣṭaḥ kakāra'iti pratīteriti bodhyam |
analyzed: varṇa jātīnām utpannaḥ iti na syāt iti iti pratītiḥ na syāt iti arthaḥ jātīnām nitya tva abidhānam śikhī dhvastaḥ eti vat viśeṣaṇībhūta jāti viṣayaka tayā eva utpannaḥ kakāraḥ ityādi pratīti nirvāhaḥ etyasya nirākaraṇāya idam upalakṣaṇam vinaṣṭaḥ kakāraḥ eti pratīteḥ iti bodhyam

original: āvidyako dharnaviśeṣo jātiriti mate noktapratītyanupapattirityata āha--vāyusaṃyogeti | parairapīti | mūle--'para'śabdo mīmāṃsakaparaḥ | mūle--'svaradairdhyādyapi hyanye' ityatrādyo'nyasabdo'pi tatparaḥ | 'svaradairdhyādī'tyatra svaraśabdenodāttatvādisvaro grāhyaḥ | 'vināśādī'tyādipadena prāgabāvasaṃgrahaḥ |
analyzed: āvidyakaḥ dharna viśeṣaḥ jātiḥ iti mate na ukta pratīti anupapattiḥ iti atas āha vāyu saṃyoga iti paraiḥ api iti mūle para śabdaḥ mīmāṃsaka paraḥ mūle svara dairdhya ādi api hi anye iti atra ādyaḥ nya sabdaḥ api tad paraḥ svara dairdhya ādi iti atra svara śabdena udātta tva ādi svaraḥ grāhyaḥ vināśa ādi iti ādi padena prāgabāva saṃgrahaḥ

original: tasyaikatvāt - sphoṭātmakavarṇasyaikatvādityarthaḥ | tathā ca viruddhodāttatvādyanekadharmasamāveśānupapattiḥ | na cedāttādīnāmavirodha eveti vācyam, 'agni'mityākāro'nudāttaḥ, 'yajñasya'tyādisthalīyo'kāra udātta ityādipratītyanāpatteḥ | nanu tasyānityatvamaṅgīkriyata iti noktapratītyanupapattirityāśaṅkyāha--tasya nityatvācceti |
analyzed: tasya ekatvāt sphoṭa ātmaka varṇasya ekatvāt iti arthaḥ tathā ca viruddha udātta tva ādi aneka dharma samāveśa anupapattiḥ na ced ātta ādīnām avirodhaḥ eva iti vācyam agnim iti ākāraḥ nudāttaḥ yajñasya tyādi sthalīya ukāraḥ udāttaḥ ityādi pratīti anāpatteḥ nanu tasya anitya tvam aṅgīkriyate iti na ukta pratīti anupapattiḥ iti āśaṅkya āha tasya nitya tvāt ca iti

original: na ca gatvāvacchinneti | tathā ca pūrvaṃkālaitatkālabhavagakārayoḥ parasparaṃ tadvyaktitvāvacchinnapratiyogitākabhede'pi gatvāvacchinnapratiyogitākabhedo na gatvāvacchinne gakāre iti tādṛśabhedābhāvo'kṣata iti bhāvaḥ | tadviṣayaḥ - sa evāyaṃ gakāra iti pratyabhijñāviṣayaḥ |
analyzed: na ca ga tva avacchinna iti tathā ca pūrvaṃkāla etad kāla bhava gakārayoḥ parasparam tad vyakti tva avacchinna pratiyogitāka bhedaḥ api ga tva avacchinna pratiyogitāka bhedaḥ na ga tva avacchinne gakāre iti tādṛśa bheda abhāva ukṣate iti bhāvaḥ tad viṣayaḥ saḥ eva ayam gakāraḥ iti pratyabhijñā viṣayaḥ

original: evaṃ ca varṇānāmanekatve na kṣatiriti nodāttādipratītyanupapattiriti bhāvaḥ | vyaktyāśābhedasyeti | etatkālavṛttivyaktāvatītakālavṛttivyaktestadvyaktitvāvacchinnapratiyogitākabhedābhāvasyetyarthaḥ | tyāgāyogāditi | anyathā padārthamātrasya kṣaṇikatvāpattiḥ, pratyabhijñāyā uktarītyaivopapattiriti bhāvaḥ | anubhaveti |
analyzed: evam ca varṇānām aneka tve na kṣatiḥ iti na udātta ādi pratīti anupapattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ vyakti āśā bhedasya iti etad kāla vṛtti vyaktau atīta kāla vṛtti vyakteḥ tad vyakti tva avacchinna pratiyogitāka bheda abhāvasya iti arthaḥ tyāga ayogāt iti anyathā padārtha mātrasya kṣaṇikatva āpattiḥ pratyabhijñāyāḥ ukta rītyā eva upapattiḥ iti bhāvaḥ anubhava iti

original: 'utpanno gakāra'ityasya tvabhivyakto gakāra ityartha iti tātparyam | nanū'tpanno ghaṭa'itivadu'tpanno gakāra'iti pratīteḥ prāgasattvaviśiṣṭasattvarūpotpattireva viṣayo vācyaḥ, samānākārapratītyorvibhinnaviṣayatvasyānucitatvādityāśaṅkyāha--kiṃ ceti |
analyzed: utpannaḥ gakāraḥ etyasya tu abhivyaktaḥ gakāraḥ iti arthaḥ iti tātparyam nanu utpannaḥ ghaṭa eti vat utpannaḥ gakāraḥ eti pratīteḥ prāk asattva viśiṣṭa sattva rūpa utpattiḥ eva viṣayaḥ vācyaḥ samāna ākāra pratītyoḥ vibhinna viṣaya tvasya anucita tvāt iti āśaṅkya āha kim ca iti

original: uccaritatvaṃ tālvoṣṭhapuṭasaṃyogajanyatvamevetyutpattipratītirjāgartyevaityāśaṅkāyāmāha--uccaritatvaṃ ceti | paramparayā - svāśrayavyaṅgyatvarūpaparāsaṃbandhena | utpattyāde'rityādipadena nāśaparigrahaḥ | tasya tu svapratiyogivyaṅgyatvarūpaḥ saṃbandho yodhyaḥ | varṇaniṣṭhatveti | nityavarṇaniṣṭhatvābhyupagamādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: uccarita tvam tālu oṣṭha puṭa saṃyoga janya tvam eva iti utpatti pratītiḥ jāgarti eva eti āśaṅkāyām āha auccarita tvam ca iti paramparayā sva āśraya vyaṅgya tva rūpa parā saṃbandhena utpatti ādeḥ iti ādi padena nāśa parigrahaḥ tasya tu sva pratiyogi vyaṅgya tva rūpaḥ saṃbandhaḥ yodhyaḥ varṇa niṣṭhatva iti nitya varṇa niṣṭhatva abhyupagamāt iti arthaḥ

original: itthaṃ ca pūrvānūbhūtenedānīṃtanānubhūtasyābhedasiddhau tāvatkālastiraṃ cainaṃ kaḥ paścānnāśayiṣyati" iti nyāyena varṇānāṃ nityatvaṃ siddhameveti bhāvaḥ | sākṣāt saṃbandhāṃśe iti | utpattyādeḥ sākṣātsaṃbandhenotpanno gakāra iti sākṣāt‌saṃbandhāṃśe yā pratītistasyā bhratvarūpaṃ dūṣaṇamavaśiṣyata ityarthaḥ | vyaktyabhedāṃśe iti |
analyzed: ittham ca pūrva anūbhūtena idānīṃtana anubhūtasya abheda siddhau tāvat kālaḥ tiram ca enam kaḥ paścāt nāśayiṣyati iti nyāyena varṇānām nitya tvam siddham eva iti bhāvaḥ sākṣāt saṃbandha aṃśe iti utpatti ādeḥ sākṣāt saṃbandhena utpannaḥ gakāraḥ iti sākṣāt saṃbandha aṃśe yā pratītiḥ tasyāḥ bhra tva rūpam dūṣaṇam avaśiṣyate iti arthaḥ vyakti abheda aṃśe iti

original: vyaktayabhedāvagāhinī yā 'sa evāyaṃ gakāra'iti pratītistasyā abhedāśe ityarthaḥ | tava bhramatvavaditi | tasyāḥ pratīteryathā tava mate bhramatvaṃ tathā sākṣātsaṃbandhenotpattyādipratītemama mate bhramatvaṃ tulyamityarthaḥ | ekapratīterbhramatvāpattirūpaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ matadvayena samānamiti paryavasito'rthaḥ |
analyzed: vyaktayā abheda avagāhinī yā saḥ eva ayam gakāraḥ eti pratītiḥ tasyāḥ abheda āśe iti arthaḥ tava bhrama tva vat iti tasyāḥ pratīteḥ yathā tava mate bhrama tvam tathā sākṣāt saṃbandhena utpatti ādi pratītā mama mate bhrama tvam tulyam iti arthaḥ eka pratīteḥ bhrama tva āpatti rūpam dūṣaṇam mata dvayena samānam iti paryavasitaḥ ūrthaḥ

original: nanu pakṣadvaye dūṣaṇasāmye nityanānāvarṇapakṣopekṣā nirvījetyāśaṅkyāha--parantviti | mama - nityavarmavādinaḥ | lāghavamatiricyata iti | paramate tūktagauravāt tatpakṣopekṣeti bhāvaḥ | varṇasthale dhvaninaiyatyaṃ yadi syāt tadā paraṃparāsaṃbandhenotpattyā pratītinirvāhastatra dhvanisattve eva tu na mānamityāśayena śaṅkate--na ceti |
analyzed: nanu pakṣa dvaye dūṣaṇa sāmye nitya nānā varṇa pakṣa upekṣā nirvījā iti āśaṅkya āha parantu iti mama nitya varma vādinaḥ lāghavam atiricyate iti para mate tu ukta gauravāt tad pakṣa upekṣā iti bhāvaḥ varṇa sthale dhvani naiyatyam yadi syāt tadā paraṃparā saṃbandhena utpattyā pratīti nirvāhaḥ tatra dhvani sattve eva tu na mānam iti āśayena śaṅkatena ca iti

original: nanu gakāra utpanna ityādipratītyathānupapattireva tatra mānaṃ bhaviṣyatītyāśaṅkyāha--tadutpādaketi | dhvanyutpādakasāmagryabhāvena tadasaṃbhavaḥ | na hyanyathānupapattireva kāryotpādikā, sāmagrīṃ vinānyathānupapattiśatamapi kāryotpādanasamarthaṃ na dṛṣṭacaramiti bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: nanu gakāraḥ utpannaḥ ityādi prati iti atha anupapattiḥ eva tatra mānam bhaviṣyati iti āśaṅkya āha tad utpādaka iti dhvani utpādaka sāmagrī abhāvena tad asaṃbhavaḥ na hi anyathā anupapattiḥ eva kārya utpādikā sāmagrīm vinā anyathā anupapatti śatam api kārya utpādana samartham na dṛṣṭa caram iti bhāvaḥ

original: samādhatte--kakārādyuccāraṇeti | kakārādyuccāraṇasvarūpayogyayatnādisattva ityarthaḥ | īṣadantareti | īṣadviśleṣe satītyarthaḥ | jihveti | jihvātattatsthānayoryo'bhighātākhyasaṃyogastajjanyo yo vāyukaṇṭhasaṃyogādistasyetyarthaḥ | dhvanijanakatveti | anvayavyatirekābhyāmuktavidhāvāyutatsthānasaṃyogāderdhvanijanakatvakalpanādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: samādhatte kakāra ādi uccāraṇa iti kakāra ādi uccāraṇa svarūpa yogya yatna ādi sattve iti arthaḥ īṣat antarā iti īṣat viśleṣe sati iti arthaḥ jihvā iti jihvā tad tad sthānayoḥ yaḥ abhighāta ākhya saṃyogaḥ tad janyaḥ yaḥ vāyu kaṇṭha saṃyoga ādiḥ tasya iti arthaḥ dhvani janaka tva iti anvaya vyatirekābhyām ukta vidhau āyu tad sthāna saṃyoga ādeḥ dhvani janaka tva kalpanāt iti arthaḥ

original: tasya - tādṛśavāyusaṃyogādeḥ | sattvāditi | tathā ca sāmagrīsattvena varṇotpattispale'pi dhvanyutpādo'kṣata eveti bhāvaḥ | varṇotpādakasāmagryāḥ pratibandhakatvānna varṇotpattisthale dhvanyutpādasaṃbhava ityāśaṅkate--tavaiveti | evam - uktarītyā varṇānāṃ nityaikatvarūpatve | 'dīrghatvādikamapī'tyapinotpattyādiparigrahaḥ |
analyzed: tasya tādṛśa vāyu saṃyoga ādeḥ sattvāt iti tathā ca sāmagrī sattvena varṇa utpatti spale pi dhvani utpādaḥ ukṣate eva iti bhāvaḥ varṇa utpādaka sāmagryāḥ pratibandhaka tvāt na varṇa utpatti sthale dhvani utpāda saṃbhavaḥ iti āśaṅkate tava eva iti evam ukta rītyā varṇānām nitya ekatva rūpatve dīrgha tva ādikam api iti apinā utpatti ādi parigrahaḥ

original: tathā cotpattyādivaddīrghatvādikamapi na varṇaniṣṭhaṃ virodhāditi bhāvaḥ | teṣāṃ - mīmāṃsakānāṃ | pramādādipūrvakoccāritaśabdāt prayoktṛniṣṭhapramādajanyatvānumānānupapattistu na śaṅkanīyā, etanmate tadanumāpakasya tattaduccāritaśabde vaijātyasyāsambhavepi pramādādijanyatāvacchedakatālvoṣṭhasaṃyogādigatavaijātyasya barṇeṣvāropeṇa
analyzed: tathā ca utpatti ādi vat dīrgha tva ādikam api na varṇa niṣṭham virodhāt iti bhāvaḥ teṣām mīmāṃsakānām pramāda ādi pūrvaka uccārita śabdāt prayoktṛ niṣṭha pramāda janya tva anumāna anupapattiḥ tu na śaṅkanīyā etad mate tad anumāpakasya tat tat uccārita śabde vaijātyasya asambhave pi pramāda ādi janya tā avacchedaka tālu oṣṭha saṃyoga ādi gata vaijātyasya barṇeṣu āropeṇa

original: pramādādijanyatvānumānopapatteḥ | dhūmatvena jñāyamānapadārthāntareṇāpi vahnyanumiterdṛṣṭatvāt | na ca 'seyaṃ gurjarī' 'seyaṃ dīpakalike'ti pratyabhiṃjñāvaśāt teṣāmapi nityatvaṃ syāt | gurjarī rāgaviśeṣa iti vācyam | tatra mānāntareṇa nāśapratiyogitvasiddhau agatyā pratyatrijñāyā bhramatvasya sājātyāvalambasya vāṅgīkārāt |
analyzed: pramāda ādi janya tva anumāna upapatteḥ dhūma tvena jñāyamāna padārtha antareṇa api vahni anumiteḥ dṛṣṭa tvāt na ca sā iyam gurjarī sā iyam dīpa kalikā iti pratyabhiṃjñā vaśāt teṣām api nitya tvam syāt gurjarī rāga viśeṣaḥ iti vācyam tatra māna antareṇa nāśa pratiyogi tva siddhau agatyā bhrama tvasya sājātya avalambasya vā aṅgīkārāt

original: varṇānāmekatve 'ghaṭika' ityatra dvyajlakṣaṇaṣṭhān ghaṭena taratītyarthe āvṛttigatadvitvasaṃkhyāmāropya nirvāhyaḥ | evaṃ 'ghaṭene'tyādau 'sāvekācaḥ--' iti vibhakt‌yudāttatvamapi āvṛttigatadvitvasaṃkhyayaikatvasya bādhādvāraṇīyam | spaṣṭaṃ cedaṃ sarvaṃ pratyāhārahnike bhāṣyadau ityāstāṃ vistaraḥ | pratibandyevottaramiti |
analyzed: varṇānām eka tve ghaṭikaḥ iti atra ghaṭena tarati iti arthe āvṛtti gata dvi tva saṃkhyām āropya nirvāhyaḥ evam ghaṭena ityādau sau eka a caḥ iti vibhakti udātta tvam api āvṛtti gata dvi tva saṃkhyayā ekatvasya bādhāt vāraṇīyam spaṣṭam ca idam sarvam pratyāhā rahnike bhāṣya dau iti āstām vistaraḥ pratibandya iva uttaram iti

original: kkacit pratibanderapyuttaratvamiti bhāvaḥ | etādṛśasthale pratibanderanuttaratve parasiddhāntasyaiva bhaṅgāpatteḥ | pañceti | varṇapadavākyasphoṭāstrayaḥ, caramayoḥ sakhaṇḍatvākhaṇḍatvābhyāṃ dvaividhyamiti vyaktisphoṭānāṃ pañcavidhatvamiti bhāvaḥ || 70 ||
analyzed: kkacid pratibandeḥ api uttaratvam iti bhāvaḥ etādṛśa sthale pratibandeḥ anuttaratve para siddhāntasya eva bhaṅga āpatteḥ pañca iti varṇa pada vākya sphoṭāḥ trayaḥ caramayoḥ sa khaṇḍatva akhaṇḍa tvābhyām dvaividhyam iti vyakti sphoṭānām pañcavidha tvam iti bhāvaḥ

original: iti vyaktisphoṭanirūpaṇam
analyzed: iti vyaktisphoṭa nirūpaṇam

original: 'bopadeva'rītimavalambavya jātisphoṭamāha--śakyatva iveti | nanu akhaṇḍasphoṭabādinā varṇānāmanahgīkārādāśrayaṃ vinā jāterasaṃbhavājjātervācakatvamasaṃbhavaduktikamityāśaṅkāmapākartumāha--ayaṃ bhāva ityādinā | uktarītyeti | varṇānaṅgīkārasahitaḥ sphoṭāhgīkāra ityuktarītyetyarthaḥ | nanvetanmate 'yo'yaṃ gakāra' ityādipratītiriṣṭaiva |
analyzed: bopadeva rītim avalambavya jāti sphoṭam āha śakyatve iva iti nanu akhaṇḍa sphoṭa bādinā varṇānām anahgīkārāt āśrayam vinā jāteḥ asaṃbhavāt jāteḥ vācaka tvam asaṃbhavat uktikam iti āśaṅkām apākartum āha ayam bhāvaḥ ityādinā ukta rītyā iti varṇa anaṅgīkāra sahitaḥ sphoṭa āhgīkāraḥ iti ukta rītyā iti arthaḥ nanu etad mate yaḥ yam gakāraḥ ityādi pratītiḥ iṣṭā eva

original: advaitavādimate 'yo'yaṃ devadattaḥ sa yajñadatta' itivaditya āha-gakāro'yaṃ neti | nanvāsepitabhedāvalambano 'gakāro'yaṃ na hakāra' iti pratyaya upapadyate, vedāntinaye parasparaṃ jīvabhedapratyayavadityanuśayāno dūṣaṇāntaramāha-kiṃ ceti | gatvādīti | anāropitaṃ gatvādyabhyupeyaṃ na vetyarthaḥ | āropitasva pareṇāpyaṅgīkārādyathāśrutāsaṃgateḥ |
analyzed: advaita vādi mate yaḥ yam devadattaḥ sa yajñadattaḥ iti vat iti aḥ āha gakāraḥ yam na iti nanu āsepita bheda avalambanaḥ gakāraḥ yam na hakāraḥ iti pratyayaḥ upapadyate vedānti naye parasparam jīva bheda pratyaya vat iti anuśayānaḥ dūṣaṇa antaram āha kim ca iti gatvā ādi iti anāropitam gatvā ādi abhyupeyam na vā iti arthaḥ āropita sva pareṇa api aṅgīkārāt yathāśruta asaṃgateḥ

original: tadeva - gatvādyeva | gatvādergakārādirūpatve hetumāha--varṇanityateti | atirikteti | varṇātiriktetyarthaḥ | gatvānaṅgīkārāditi | gatvādyanaṅgīkārādityarthaḥ | anekavyaktīnāmānugatapratītaye hi atiriktajātyabhyupagamaḥ | varṇānāṃ nityatvamate tu gakārādivyakteraikyenānanugamāprasaktyā gakārādyatiriktagatvāṅgīkārasya niṣprayojanatvāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: tat eva gatvā ādi eva gatvā ādeḥ gakāra ādi rūpatve hetum āha varṇa nityatā iti atiriktā iti varṇa atiriktā iti arthaḥ ga tva anaṅgīkārāt iti ga tva ādi anaṅgīkārāt iti arthaḥ aneka vyaktīnām ānugata pratītaye hi atirikta jāti abhyupagamaḥ varṇānām nitya tva mate tu gakāra ādi vyakteḥ aikyena ananugama aprasaktyā gakāra ādi atirikta ga tva aṅgīkārasya niṣprayojana tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: tathā ca - sphoṭe gatvādyabhyupagame ca | athavā gakārādergatvādirūpatve cetyarthaḥ | atiriktasphoṭeti | gatvādyatiriktasphoṭakalpane ityarthaḥ | gauravam - atiriktasphoṭātmakadharmikalpanāgauravamityarthaḥ | antye - sphoṭe gatvādyanabhyupagamapakṣe | pratītivirodha iti | gatvādyabhāve gatvādiprakārakoktapratītyanupapattirityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tathā ca sphoṭe ga tva ādi abhyupagame ca athavā gakāra ādeḥ ga tva ādi rūpatve ca iti arthaḥ atirikta sphoṭa iti ga tva ādi atirikta sphoṭa kalpane iti arthaḥ gauravam atirikta sphoṭa ātmaka dharmi kalpanā gauravam iti arthaḥ antye sphoṭe ga tva ādi anabhyupagama pakṣe pratīti virodhaḥ iti ga tva ādi abhāve ga tva ādi prakāraka ukta pratīti anupapattiḥ iti arthaḥ

original: āropya tathā pratyaya iti | gatvādeḥ sphoṭāvṛttitve'pi vāyusaṃyogādivṛttigatvādiprakārakārope bādhakābhāva iti bhāvaḥ | āropyetyasya sthitasyetyadhyāhāreṇopapattiḥ | anyathā pratītibhavanasamānakartṛkatvābhāvena ktvāpratyayānupapatteḥ | paurtrakālikāropānusaraṇaṃ tu tathāvidhapratyayamūlakasya vyavahārasyopapatteḥ |
analyzed: āropya tathā pratyayaḥ iti ga tva ādeḥ sphoṭa avṛtti tve api vāyu saṃyoga ādi vṛtti ga tva ādi prakāraka ārope bādhaka abhāvaḥ iti bhāvaḥ āropya ityasya sthitasya iti adhyāhāreṇa upapattiḥ anyathā pratīti bhavana samāna kartṛka tva abhāvena ktvā pratyaya anupapatteḥ paurtrakālika āropa anusaraṇam tu tathāvidha pratyaya mūlakasya vyavahārasya upapatteḥ

original: evaṃ ca pratyayorvyavahāra ityarthaḥ | yadvā samānakālikatvaṃ pratyayabhavane saṃbandhatayā bhāsata iti yathāśrutārthakameva pratyayapadamastu | 'vāyusaṃyoga eve'tyevena sphoṭavyavacchedaḥ | gakāro'pīti | tathāvidhapratyayaviṣayo'pītyarthaḥ | evaṃ ca pratīterna bhramatvaprasaktiḥ | apinā--'kakāra' ityādipratyayaviṣayasaṃgrahaḥ |
analyzed: evam ca pratyayoḥ vyavahāraḥ iti arthaḥ yat vā samāna kālika tvam pratyaya bhavane saṃbandhatayā bhāsate iti yathāśruta arthakam eva pratyaya padam astu vāyu saṃyoge eva iti evena sphoṭa vyavacchedaḥ gakāraḥ upi iti tathāvidha pratyaya viṣayaḥ upi iti arthaḥ evam ca pratīteḥ na bhrama tva prasaktiḥ apināka kāraḥ ityādi pratyaya viṣaya saṃgrahaḥ

original: tasya - vāyusaṃyogasya | atīndriyatvaṃ doṣa iti | saṃyogapratyakṣe yāvadāśrayapratyakṣasya hetutvamabhyupeyam, anyathā ghaṭākāśasaṃyogapratyakṣāpatteḥ | tathā ca vāyorapratyakṣatvena vāyutattatsthānasaṃyogasyātīndriyatayā gakāra ityādipratyakṣānupapattirityarthaḥ | dharmavaditi | vāyudharmasya sparśavadityarthaḥ |
analyzed: tasya vāyu saṃyogasya atīndriya tvam doṣaḥ iti saṃyoga pratyakṣe yāvat āśraya pratyakṣasya hetu tvam abhyupeyam anyathā ghaṭa ākāśa saṃyoga pratyakṣa āpatteḥ tathā ca vāyoḥ apratyakṣa tvena vāyu tad tad sthāna saṃyogasya atīndriya tayā gakāraḥ ityādi pratyakṣa anupapattiḥ iti arthaḥ dharma vat iti vāyu dharmasya sparśa vat iti arthaḥ

original: yathā vāyoratīndriyatve'pi vāyusparśastvācapratyakṣaviṣayastathā tālvādyanuyogikavāyusaṃyogā aindriyiko bhaviṣyati bahirdravyagrāhakendriyajanyasaṃyogapratyakṣe eva yāvadāśrayapratyakṣasya hetutvāṅgīkārāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: yathā vāyoḥ atīndriya tve pi vāyu sparśaḥ tvāca pratyakṣa viṣayaḥ tathā tālu ādi anuyogika vāyu saṃyogāḥ aindriyikaḥ bhaviṣyati bahis dravya grāhaka indriya janya saṃyoga pratyakṣe eva yāvat āśraya pratyakṣasya hetu tva aṅgīkārāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: athavā 'gagane śabda' itivadvāyusaṃyoge gatvāmiti saṃyogaviśeṣaṇakaṃ saṃyogopanītameva gatvādiviśeṣyakaṃ tadaśe laukikapratyakṣamastu, saṃyogalaukikapratyakṣe eva yāvadāśrayapratyakṣasya hetutvāt | tadeka pratyakṣaṃ 'gakāra' iti śabdenābhilapyata iti bhāvaḥ | etatpakṣe dharmavat - atīndriyagaganādidharmavaditi vyākhyeyam |
analyzed: athavā gagane śabdaḥ iti vat vāyu saṃyoge ga tvām iti saṃyoga viśeṣaṇakam saṃyoga upanītam eva ga tva ādi viśeṣyakam tad āśe laukika pratyakṣam astu saṃyoga laukika pratyakṣe eva yāvat āśraya pratyakṣasya hetu tvāt tat eka pratyakṣam gakāraḥ iti śabdena abhilapyate iti bhāvaḥ etad pakṣe dharma vat atīndriya gagana ādi dharma vat iti vyākhyeyam

original: kṛtaṃ sphoṭena - alaṃ sphoṭena tattadvāyusaṃyogaireva tattadarthabodhanirvāhāditi bhāvaḥ | tattatsaṃyogasamudāya eva idamekapadamityādipratītiviṣaya iti hṛdayam | vastutastvetatpratītyanyathānupapattyātiriktasphoṭāṅgīkāra āvaśyaka ityāhuḥ | nirūpitaṃ caitat pūrvam |
analyzed: kṛtam sphoṭena alam sphoṭena tad tad vāyu saṃyogaiḥ eva tad tad artha bodha nirvāhāt iti bhāvaḥ tad tad saṃyoga samudāyaḥ eva idam eka padam ityādi pratīti viṣayaḥ iti hṛdayam vastutas tu etad pratīti anyathā anupapattyā atirikta sphoṭa aṅgīkāraḥ āvaśyakaḥ iti āhuḥ nirūpitam ca etat pūrvam

original: ākṛtyadhikaraṇeti | tatra hi yathā ānantyavyabicārābhyāṃ vyaktirna śabdavācyā kiṃ tu jātirityuktam | tathā śabdavatā jātireva vāciketi svīkāraḥ, samucitastulyahetīrityarthaḥ | nanu varṇavṛttijātīnāmapi nānātvāt kathaṃ vācakatvanirvāha ityāśaṅkyāha--idaṃ harīti |
analyzed: ākṛti adhikaraṇa iti tatra hi yathā ānantya vyabicārābhyām vyaktiḥ na śabda vācyā kim tu jātiḥ iti uktam tathā śabdavatā jātiḥ eva vācikā iti svīkāraḥ samucitaḥ tulya hetīḥ iti arthaḥ nanu varṇa vṛtti jātīnām api nānātvāt katham vācaka tva nirvāhaḥ iti āśaṅkya āha edam hari iti

original: nanu nānugatapratītyā jātisiddhiḥ saṃmatā tantrikāṇāmapi tu kāraṇatāvacchedakatayā, kāryatāvacchedakatavā vetyata āha--hartupastitīti | tadavacchevakatayā - hetutāvacchedakakoṭipraviṣṭatayā | varṇānupūrvyaivānugatapratītinirvāhaḥ, saiva ca hetutāvacchedikā bhaviṣyīti kṛtamatiriktajātisvīkāreṇetyāśaṅkate--na ceti | anyathāsiddhyāpatteriti |
analyzed: nanu na anugata pratītyā jāti siddhiḥ saṃmatā tantrikāṇām api tu kāraṇatā avacchedaka tayā vā iti atas āha tad avacchevaka tayā hetu tā avacchedaka koṭi praviṣṭatayā varṇa ānupūrvyā eva anugata pratīti nirvāhaḥ sā eva ca hetu tā avacchedikā bhaviṣyī iti kṛtam atirikta jāti svīkāreṇa iti āśaṅkatena ca iti anyathā asiddhi āpatteḥ iti

original: saṃyogaviśeṣaviśiṣṭamṛdādibhireva ghaṭa ityādyanugatapratīterdaṇḍādikāryatāvacchedakatvasya ca nirvāhād ghaṭatvādijātirapi na sidhyet | saṃyogaviśeṣāvacchinnamṛdādikaṃ prati daṇḍādeḥ kāraṇatvasya vaktuṃ śakyatvāditi bhāvaḥ evaṃ ghaṭādiravayavyapi na sidhyet, ghaṭa ityādipratīteḥ-saṃyogaviśeṣaviśiṣṭamṛdādiviṣayakatvenaivāpapatterityarthaḥ |
analyzed: saṃyoga viśeṣa viśiṣṭa mṛd ādibhiḥ eva ghaṭaḥ ityādi anugata pratīteḥ daṇḍa ādi kāryatā avacchedaka tvasya ca nirvāhāt ghaṭa tva ādi jātiḥ api na sidhyet saṃyoga viśeṣa avacchinna mṛd ādikam prati daṇḍa ādeḥ kāraṇatvasya vaktum śakyatvāt iti bhāvaḥ evam ghaṭa ādiḥ avayavī api na sidhyet ghaṭaḥ ityādi pratītyāḥ saṃyoga viśeṣa viśiṣṭa mṛd ādi viṣayaka tvena eva apapatteḥ iti arthaḥ

original: ākāraḥ - anugatasaṃsthānaviśeṣaḥ | yadyavayavasaṃyogānāmananugamād ghaṭatvādijātyabhyupagama āvaśyakaḥ, evaṃ saṃyogaviśeṣaviśiṣṭānāmavayavānāṃ nānātvāt 'ghaṭa' iti pratītestadviṣayakatve gauravaneko ghaṭa iti pratītyanupapattiśceti ghaṭaghaṭatvādyāśrayaṇamiti cet, prakṛte'pi tulyamityāśayenāha--tasmāditi | uktarītyā jātisvīkārādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: ākāraḥ anugata saṃsthāna viśeṣaḥ yadi avayava saṃyogānām ananugamāt ghaṭa tva ādi jāti abhyupagamaḥ āvaśyakaḥ evam saṃyoga viśeṣa viśiṣṭānām avayavānām nānātvāt ghaṭaḥ iti pratīteḥ tad viṣayaka tve gaurava anekaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti pratīti anupapattiḥ ca iti ghaṭa ghaṭa tva ādi āśrayaṇam iti ced prakṛte api tulyam iti āśayena āha tasmāt iti ukta rītyā jāti svīkārāt iti arthaḥ

original: nanu padādivṛttijātereva vācakatve tad‌vṛttidharmasya sakalaghaṭādipadasamavetatvaviśiṣṭaghaṭapadādyariktāsamavetatvarūpasya vācakatāvacchedakatvamurarīkatavyaṃ, tathā cātigauravamityata āha--tādātmyeneti |
analyzed: nanu pada ādi vṛtti jāteḥ eva vācaka tve tad vṛtti dharmasya sakala ghaṭa ādi pada samaveta tva viśiṣṭa ghaṭa pada ādi arikta asamaveta tva rūpasya vācakatā avacchedaka tvam urarīkatavyam tathā ca ati gauravam iti atas āha tādātmyena iti

original: avacchedikā - vācakatāvacchedikā, tādātmyatya vṛttyaniyāmakatve'pyavacchedakatāvacchedakatvasya nānupapattiḥ, svādhikaraṇasambaddhatvasyavāvacchedakatāyāṃ tantratvāditi bhāvaḥ | jātyoḥ sattvāditi | padadvaye'pi āśrayībhūtānāṃ me pāmeva varṇānāṃ sattvādvinigamanāviraheṇaikasmin jātidvayasattvāviśeṣādityarthaḥ |
analyzed: avacchedikā vācakatā avacchedikā vṛtti aniyāmaka tve api avacchedakatā avacchedaka tvasya na anupapattiḥ sva adhikaraṇa sambaddha tvasya vā avacchedakatāyām tantratvāt iti bhāvaḥ jātyoḥ sattvāt iti pada dvaye pi āśrayībhūtānām varṇānām sattvāt vinigamana aviraheṇa ekasmin jāti dvaya sattva aviśeṣāt iti arthaḥ

original: vāśabdasya vikalpārthakatve'thosaṃgatirata āha--vā tvarthe iti | tvarthaśca prakṛte'vadhāraṇamityāśayenāha--saiveti | bhedaḥ kāraṇībhūteti |
analyzed: vā śabdasya vikalpa arthaka tve ithosaṃgatiḥ atas āha vā tu arthe iti tu arthaḥ ca prakṛtā avadhāraṇam iti āśayena āha sā eva iti bhedaḥ kāraṇībhūtā iti

original: tathā cobhayatra varṇānāmabhede'pyānupūrvībhedasya jāgarūkatayā tattadānupūrvīviśeṣeṇa ekaiva jātirabhivyajyate ekatra, anyatrānyaiva jātirabhivyajyata iti tattajjātijñānarūpakāraṇabhedāt 'saro' 'rasa' ityatra vilakṣaṇabodharūpakāryopapattirityarthaḥ | vyañjiketīti | iti - iti hetoḥ | kāraṇībhūtajñānasya bheda iti yojanā |
analyzed: tathā ca ubhayatra varṇānām abhede pi ānupūrvī bhedasya jāgarūka tayā tad tad ānupūrvī viśeṣeṇa ekā eva jātiḥ abhivyajyate ekatra anyatra anyā eva jātiḥ abhivyajyate iti tad tad jāti jñāna rūpa kāraṇa bhedāt saraḥ rasaḥ iti atra vilakṣaṇa bodha rūpa kārya upapattiḥ iti arthaḥ vyañjikā iti iti iti hetoḥ kāraṇībhūta jñānasya bhedaḥ iti yojanā

original: atiprasaṅgaḥ - avilakṣaṇabodhasyātiprasaṅgaḥ | upādhiprayukteti | balavaducvāritatvādikaṃ tatropādhiḥ | tena yathā 'tāro' 'manda' iti pratītivailakṣaṇyaṃ tadvadityarthaḥ || 71 ||
analyzed: atiprasaṅgaḥ avilakṣaṇa bodhasya atiprasaṅgaḥ upādhi prayuktā iti balavat ucvārita tva ādikam tatra upādhiḥ tena yathā tāraḥ mandaḥ iti pratīti vailakṣaṇyam tadvat iti arthaḥ

original: jāteriti | ghaṭapadādivṛttitvenābhimatajāteḥ | sphuṭati bodhaviṣayo bhavatyasmādartha iti vyutpattyā sphoṭapadaṃ bodhakaparamityāha--yogārthatayeti | apāstamiti | jāteḥ sarvadā sattve'pyabhivyaktiviśiṣṭāyā asattvena noktadoṣaḥ, abhivyaktiviśiṣṭāyā eva jāterbodhakatvāditi bhāvaḥ |
analyzed: jāteḥ iti ghaṭa pada ādi vṛtti tvena abhimata jāteḥ sphuṭati bodha viṣayaḥ bhavati asmāt arthaḥ iti vyutpattyā sphoṭa padam bodhaka param iti āha yoga arthatayā iti apāstam iti jāteḥ sarvadā sattve pi abhivyakti viśiṣṭāyāḥ asattvena na ukta doṣaḥ abhivyakti viśiṣṭāyāḥ eva jāteḥ bodhaka tvāt iti bhāvaḥ

original: nanvevamapi padaghaṭakadvyādivarṇebhyo'rthabodho durvāra evābivyaktiviśiṣṭajāteḥ sattvāt | na ca padaghaṭakayāvadvarṇaireva jāterabhivyaktirityabhyupagamānna doṣa iti vācyam | tathā sati padasphoṭevākyasphoṭe vā paryasāmenaitatpakṣe varṇasphoṭocchedāpattestyiāśaṅkāmapākartumāha--ayaṃ bhāva iti |
analyzed: nanu evam api pada ghaṭaka dvi ādi varṇebhyaḥ ṛtha bodhaḥ durvāraḥ eva a bi vyakti viśiṣṭa jāteḥ sattvāt na ca pada ghaṭaka yāvat varṇaiḥ eva jāteḥ abhivyaktiḥ iti abhyupagamāt na doṣaḥ iti vācyam tathā sati pada sphoṭe vākya sphoṭe vā varṇa sphoṭa uccheda āpatteḥ tyiā śaṅkām apākartum āha ayam bhāvaḥ iti

original: kathatadoṣaḥ - yat‌kiñcid‌varṇādarthabodhāpattirūpo doṣaḥ | pakṣayornetyatra 'kathita doṣaḥ' ityanukṛṣyate | tatra vyāsajyavṛttitvasya - padādighaṭakayāvadvarṇasamudāyavṛttitvasya | varṇasphoṭapakṣe tu naivaṃ vaktuṃ śakyam | pratyekāvṛttestadanatiriktatāvadvarṇasamudāyavṛttitvasyāsambhavāt |
analyzed: yat kiñcid varṇāt artha bodha āpatti rūpaḥ doṣaḥ pakṣayoḥ na iti atra doṣaḥ iti anukṛṣyate tatra vyāsajya vṛtti tvasya pada ādi ghaṭaka yāvat varṇa samudāya vṛtti tvasya varṇa sphoṭa pakṣe tu na evam vaktum śakyam pratyeka āvṛtteḥ tad anatirikta tāvat varṇa samudāya vṛtti tvasya asambhavāt

original: samudāyasyātiriktatve tu padasphoṭo vākyasphoṭa eva vā sidhyenna varṇasphoṭa iti bhāvaḥ | padavākyapakṣayoḥ - tayoḥ dhārmigrāhaketi | dharmo - jātirūpastad‌grāhakaṃ mānam - idaṃ haripadamityādyanugatapratītyādirūpaṃ, tatsiddhatvāt | tathā ca varṇaṃsphoṭo'smin pakṣe duṣṭatvānnābhyupeyata iti bhāvaḥ | mūle vyaktya evāsyā iti |
